papers.title: InterleaveThinker: Reinforcing Agentic Interleaved Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent image generators have demonstrated impressive photorealism and instruction-following capabilities in single-image generation and editing. However, constrained by their architectures, they cannot achieve interleaved generation (text-image sequence), which has crucial applications in visual narratives, guidance, and embodied manipulation. Even the latest open-source Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) exhibit limited performance in this regard. In this paper, we introduce InterleaveThinker, the first multi-agent pipeline designed to endow any existing image generator with interleaved generation capabilities. Specifically, we employ a planner agent to organize the image-text input sequence, instructing the image generator on the required execution at each step. Subsequently, we introduce a critic agent to evaluate the generator's outputs, identify samples that deviate from the planned instructions, and refine the instructions for regeneration. To implement this pipeline, we construct the Interleave-Planner-SFT-80k and Interleave-Critic-SFT-112k to perform a format cold-start. Then we develop Interleave-Critic-RL-13k to reinforce the step-wise instruction correction capability within a generation trajectory using GRPO. Since a single interleaved generation trajectory may involve over 25 generator calls, optimizing the entire trajectory is computationally impractical. Therefore, we propose accuracy reward and step-wise reward, allowing single-step RL to effectively guide the entire generation trajectory. The results show that InterleaveThinker improves performance across various image generators. On interleaved generation benchmarks, it achieves performance comparable to Nano Banana and GPT-5. Surprisingly, it also significantly enhances the base model on reasoning-based benchmarks; for example, on 4-step FLUX.2-klein, we observe substantial gains on WISE and RISE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InterleaveThinker 是首个多智能体管道，旨在赋予现有图像生成器交错生成（text-image sequence）能力。它使用规划器智能体组织输入序列，并通过批评家智能体评估输出、修正指令。通过构建专门的数据集进行冷启动，并采用 GRPO 强化学习优化批评家的逐步指令校正能力。在交错生成基准上达到与 Nano Banana 和 GPT-5 相当的性能，同时在推理基准（如 4-step FLUX.2-klein）上显著提升基础模型表现。
Motivation: 当前图像生成器受限于架构，无法生成文本-图像交错的序列，而这一能力在视觉叙事、引导和具身操作中至关重要。最新的开源统一多模态模型（UMMs）在此任务上表现有限。
Method: 提出多智能体管道：规划器智能体组织图像-文本输入序列，指令图像生成器执行每一步；批评家智能体评估输出，识别偏离规划的样本并修正指令。构建 Interleave-Planner-SFT-80k 和 Interleave-Critic-SFT-112k 进行格式冷启动，再通过 Interleave-Critic-RL-13k 使用 GRPO 强化逐步指令校正能力。提出准确率奖励和步骤奖励，使单步 RL 有效引导整个生成轨迹。
Result: InterleaveThinker 提升了多种图像生成器的交错生成性能；在交错生成基准上与 Nano Banana 和 GPT-5 相当。在推理基准（如 4-step FLUX.2-klein）上，显著提升了 WISE 和 RISE 指标。
Conclusion: 论文表明，通过多智能体管道和强化学习，可以有效地赋予现有图像生成器交错生成能力，并同时提升推理性能。但单次交错生成轨迹可能涉及超过 25 次生成调用，优化整个轨迹计算开销大，文中提出的单步奖励机制缓解了这一问题。

papers.title: EurekAgent: Agent Environment Engineering is All You Need For Autonomous Scientific Discovery
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents have shown increasing potential in automating scientific discovery. Given an optimizable metric and an execution environment, they can propose, validate, and iterate scientific solutions, and have produced results that outperform human-designed approaches. As model capabilities continue to improve, we argue that the bottleneck for autonomous scientific discovery is shifting from prescribing agent workflows to designing agent environments: the resources, constraints, and interfaces that shape agent behavior. We frame this as environment engineering: building environments that amplify productive behaviors, such as open-ended exploration, systematic artifact management, and inter-agent collaboration, while suppressing harmful behaviors, such as reward hacking and high-friction human oversight. We present EurekAgent, an environment-engineered agent system for metric-driven autonomous scientific discovery. EurekAgent engineers the environment along four dimensions: permissions engineering for bounded agent execution and isolated evaluation; artifact engineering for filesystem and Git-based collaboration; budget engineering for budget-aware exploration; and human-in-the-loop engineering for easy human supervision and intervention. EurekAgent sets new state-of-the-art results on multiple mathematics, kernel engineering, and machine learning tasks, including new state-of-the-art 26-circle packing results discovered with less than $11 in total API cost. We open-source our code and results, and call for environment engineering as a core research direction for developing reliable autonomous research agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EurekAgent，一个基于环境工程（environment engineering）的智能体系统，用于度量驱动的自主科学发现。摘要指出，随着模型能力提升，自主科学发现的瓶颈已从制定智能体工作流程转向设计智能体环境，包括资源、约束和接口。EurekAgent从权限工程、工件工程、预算工程和人机交互工程四个维度设计环境，在数学、内核工程和机器学习任务上取得新SOTA结果，例如以不到11美元的API成本发现新的26圆填充结果。
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体在科学发现中表现良好，但摘要认为瓶颈正从工作流设计转向环境设计，而当前缺乏系统性的环境工程方法。
Method: 提出EurekAgent，通过四维度环境工程：权限工程（限制智能体执行范围）、工件工程（基于文件系统和Git的协作管理）、预算工程（预算感知探索）和人机交互工程（简化人类监督与干预）。
Result: 在多个数学、内核工程和机器学习任务上达到新SOTA，包括以不到11美元总API成本实现新的26圆填充结果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调环境工程应成为开发可靠自主研究智能体的核心研究方向，并开源代码以推动该领域发展。

papers.title: Dense Supervision, Sparse Updates: On the Sparsity and Geometry of On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (\textsc{OPD}) has recently become a prominent post-training recipe by combining two desirable ingredients: on-policy student trajectories and dense teacher supervision. However, how this hybrid changes a model's parameters remains unclear. Across several language and vision-language model pairs and \textsc{OPD} use cases, our analysis yields two main findings. On sparsity, \textsc{OPD} updates are small and coordinate-sparse. They are distributed across layers, with the largest relative movement usually appearing in FFN modules. This sparse structure is operationally useful: training only the discovered subnetwork nearly recovers full-training performance. The sparse support does not remove the need for adaptive optimization: SGD, previously reported to be competitive in \textsc{RLVR}, underperforms AdamW in our \textsc{OPD} optimizer ablation, suggesting that dense teacher supervision preserves useful momentum structure and heterogeneous second-moment scales. On geometry, the updates are numerically full-rank but spectrally concentrated; they lie mostly away from the principal singular subspaces of the source weights and fall disproportionately on coordinates where the source weights are close to zero. These findings suggest that dense teacher supervision does not turn \textsc{OPD} into ordinary dense parameter rewriting; instead, \textsc{OPD} retains important geometric signatures of on-policy post-training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析了策略蒸馏（On-Policy Distillation, OPD）如何改变模型参数，发现更新具有坐标稀疏性且主要集中于FFN模块，稀疏子网络可接近全训练性能。几何上更新数值满秩但谱集中，远离源权重的奇异子空间。研究表明密集教师监督并未使OPD退化为普通密集参数重写，而是保留了策略后训练的几何特征。
Motivation: 策略蒸馏结合了策略学生轨迹和密集教师监督，但其如何改变模型参数尚不明确。
Method: 对多个语言和视觉-语言模型对及OPD使用案例进行参数级分析，研究更新的稀疏性和几何结构。
Result: 更新小而坐标稀疏，主要分布在FFN模块；稀疏子网络恢复接近全训练性能；AdamW优于SGD；更新数值满秩但谱集中，远离源权重的主奇异子空间且落在接近零的坐标上。
Conclusion: 密集教师监督并未使OPD变成普通密集参数重写，而是保留了策略后训练的重要几何特征。

papers.title: Generative Modeling of Bach-Style Symbolic Music: A Comparative Study of Autoregressive, Latent-Variable, and Adversarial Approaches
papers.abstract_en: We study generative modeling of Bach-style symbolic piano music using a shared MIDI corpus and three model families: autoregressive LSTMs with attention, latent-variable models including recurrent VAEs and vector-quantized VAEs, and generative adversarial networks. We compare their ability to model polyphonic note sequences, learn useful latent representations, and generate stylistically coherent compositions. Our experiments show that the autoregressive LSTM with attention produces the most musically coherent samples, while vector quantization helps mitigate posterior collapse and yields more structured outputs than conventional recurrent VAEs. The adversarial approach captures local pitch patterns but remains difficult to train and generalizes less reliably to Bach's style. These results highlight the relative strengths and failure modes of autoregressive, latent-variable, and adversarial approaches for symbolic music generation.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较了自回归LSTM（带注意力）、潜变量模型（循环VAE和向量量化VAE）以及生成对抗网络（GAN）在生成巴赫风格钢琴音乐方面的表现。实验表明，自回归LSTM生成的样本音乐连贯性最佳；向量量化缓解了后验坍塌问题，产生了比常规循环VAE更结构化的输出；GAN能捕捉局部音高模式但训练困难且泛化不可靠。
Motivation: 符号音乐生成领域需要系统比较不同生成模型家族（自回归、潜变量、对抗）在特定风格（巴赫）下的能力与局限。
Method: 使用共享MIDI语料库，对三种模型家族进行训练与评估：自回归LSTM加注意力机制、循环VAE和向量量化VAE等潜变量模型、以及生成对抗网络。
Result: 自回归LSTM在音乐连贯性上最优；向量量化VAE优于常规循环VAE，产生更结构化输出；GAN虽能捕捉局部模式但训练不稳定且泛化至巴赫风格不够可靠。
Conclusion: 不同生成方法各有优劣：自回归模型适合保持全局结构，潜变量模型需缓解后验坍塌，对抗方法需克服训练不稳定性。

papers.title: Is It You or Your Environment? A Bayesian Inference Framework for Genomically-Anchored Personalized Physiological Interpretation
papers.abstract_en: Personalized health AI systems face a fundamental cold-start problem: machine learning models for physiological interpretation require weeks of individual behavioral data before they can distinguish constitutional variation from environmentally driven deviation. We propose a solution grounded in causal inference and Bayesian prior design. An individual's genomic profile serves as an exogenous genetic anchor -- a domain-informed, personalized prior that is fixed at conception, immune to reverse causation, and available before a single behavioral observation is collected. The anchor initializes a Bayesian belief state over an individual's physiological set point G-hat = mu + sum(beta_i * g_i), where beta_i are GWAS-derived effect sizes and g_i are risk-allele counts. Each incoming physiological measurement P produces a non-constitutional deviation delta = P - G-hat that separates the signal attributable to environment and state from the constitutionally fixed baseline. As behavioral data accrue, the prior decays according to G-hat_t = w(t)*G-hat_genomic + [1-w(t)]*P-bar_t, transitioning from genome-dominated to empirical-baseline-dominated inference. The same observed HRV of 55 ms generates a suppression hypothesis for a person whose prior predicts 80 ms, and an enhancement hypothesis for a person whose prior predicts 30 ms -- a reversal impossible without a personalized anchor. We develop this architecture across six physiological domains, grading genomic priors by evidence strength, distinguishing robustly replicated anchors (FTO, FADS1/2, FKBP5) from contested candidate genes (SLC6A4, MAOA, DRD2). We address the inference boundary between association, Mendelian randomization, and individual token causation, and define four constraints for deployment: evidence-graded priors, dynamic decay, ancestry-matched effect sizes, and attribution rather than deterministic output.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于因果推断和贝叶斯先验设计的框架，利用个体基因组档案作为外生遗传锚点（genetic anchor），初始化生理设定点的贝叶斯信念状态，从而将生理测量信号分解为环境/状态偏差与体质基线。该框架解决了个性化健康AI的冷启动问题，无需大量行为数据即可区分体质变异与环境驱动偏差。
Motivation: 个性化健康AI系统面临冷启动问题：机器学习模型需要数周的行为数据才能区分体质变异与环境因素导致的偏差。
Method: 提出一个贝叶斯推理框架，使用GWAS效应大小和风险等位基因计数构建个体化基因组先验，通过动态衰减权重从基因组主导推断过渡到经验基线主导推断，将生理测量偏差分解为环境/状态信号。
Result: 同一生理测量值（如HRV 55 ms）在不同基因组先验下分别产生抑制或增强假设，体现了个性化锚点的必要性。框架覆盖六个生理领域，按证据强度对基因组先验分级。
Conclusion: 框架强调部署的四个约束：证据分级的先验、动态衰减、祖先匹配的效应大小、输出为归因而非确定性结果，并讨论了关联、孟德尔随机化与个体因果推断之间的边界。

papers.title: Ontology Memory-Augmented ASR Correction for Long Text-Speech Interleaved Conversations
papers.abstract_en: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) correction has traditionally focused on isolated utterances or short local contexts. However, as text and speech become increasingly interleaved in long interactions, ASR correction requires conversation-level contextual evidence. Existing ASR correction methods often rely on the current hypothesis or concatenate raw dialogue history. In such contexts, sparse correction evidence can be difficult to locate amid redundancy and noise. Addressing these challenges, we propose an ontology memory-augmented ASR correction framework for long text-speech interleaved conversations. The framework organizes preceding interaction history into a dynamically updatable ontology memory, where entities, terminology, surface variants, potential ASR confusions, and semantic relations are stored as retrievable nodes for context-grounded correction. To evaluate this setting, we construct RAMC-Corr, a dataset derived from MAGIC-RAMC for long-range ASR correction with grounded context. Experiments on RAMC-Corr show that our method improves over direct correction in 9 out of 10 paired backbone-setting combinations and encourages more selective and evidence-grounded corrections for context-dependent ASR errors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长文本语音交错对话中的ASR纠错问题，提出本体记忆增强的纠错框架。该框架将对话历史组织为动态更新的本体记忆，存储实体、术语、表面变体及潜在ASR混淆等节点，用于上下文感知的纠错。在构建的RAMC-Corr数据集上，方法在10个骨干组合中9个优于直接纠错基线，并能更选择性且基于证据地纠正上下文依赖的ASR错误。
Motivation: 传统ASR纠错局限于孤立话语或短上下文，而长交互中文本和语音交错，需要对话级上下文证据。现有方法依赖当前假设或拼接原始对话历史，导致纠错证据在冗余和噪声中难以定位。
Method: 提出本体记忆增强的ASR纠错框架，将前序交互历史组织为动态可更新的本体记忆，其中实体、术语、表面变体、ASR混淆和语义关系作为可检索节点存储，用于上下文引导的纠错。并构建RAMC-Corr数据集以评估长程ASR纠错。
Result: 在RAMC-Corr数据集上，方法在10个配对骨干-设置组合中9个优于直接纠错基线，并鼓励更选择性、基于证据的纠错。
Conclusion: 本文的工作聚焦于ASR纠错领域，展示了本体记忆在长文本语音交错对话中的有效性，但未涉及其他模态或领域。

papers.title: MiniMax Sparse Attention
papers.abstract_en: Ultra-long-context capability is becoming indispensable for frontier LLMs: agentic workflows, repository-scale code reasoning, and persistent memory all require the model to jointly attend over hundreds of thousands to millions of tokens, yet the quadratic cost of softmax attention makes this untenable at deployment scale. We introduce MiniMax Sparse Attention (MSA), a blockwise sparse attention built upon Grouped Query Attention (GQA). A lightweight Index Branch scores key-value blocks and independently selects a Top-k subset for each GQA group, enabling group-specific sparse retrieval while maintaining efficient block-level execution; the Main Branch then performs exact block-sparse attention over only the selected blocks. Designed around a principle of simplicity and scalability, MSA is deliberately streamlined, making it straightforward to deploy efficiently across a broad range of GPUs. To translate sparsity into practical speedups, we co-design MSA with a GPU execution path that uses exp-free Top-k selection and KV-outer sparse attention to improve tensor-core utilization under block-granular access. On a 109B-parameter model with native multimodal training, MSA performs on par with GQA while reducing per-token attention compute by 28.4x at 1M context. Paired with our co-designed kernel, MSA achieves 14.2x prefill and 7.6x decoding wall-clock speedups on H800. Our inference kernel is available at: https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MSA. A production-grade natively multimodal model powered by MSA has been publicly released at: https://huggingface.co/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MiniMax 稀疏注意力 (MSA)，一种基于分组查询注意力 (GQA) 的分块稀疏注意力机制。通过轻量级索引分支为每个 GQA 组独立选择 Top-k 键值块，主分支仅对选定块执行精确的块稀疏注意力，从而降低计算成本。在 109B 多模态模型上，MSA 在 1M 上下文下将每 token 注意力计算量减少 28.4 倍，并在 H800 上实现 14.2 倍预填充和 7.6 倍解码加速。推理内核和模型已开源。
Motivation: 超长上下文能力对前沿大语言模型至关重要，但 softmax 注意力的二次复杂度使其在大规模部署中不可行。需要一种高效的稀疏注意力机制来降低计算开销。
Method: 提出 MiniMax 稀疏注意力 (MSA)，采用分块稀疏注意力结构：索引分支使用无指数运算的 Top-k 选择为每个 GQA 组独立评分并选取关键值块；主分支对选定块执行块稀疏注意力。同时协同设计 GPU 执行路径，利用 KV-外层稀疏注意力优化 tensor-core 利用率。
Result: 在 109B 多模态模型上，MSA 在 1M 上下文下每 token 注意力计算量减少 28.4 倍，H800 GPU 上预填充加速 14.2 倍，解码加速 7.6 倍。性能与 GQA 持平。
Conclusion: MSA 是一种简单且可扩展的稀疏注意力方案，能有效实现超长上下文的实用加速，并已应用于生产级多模态模型。

papers.title: Quantizing Time-Series Models As Dynamical Systems: Trajectory-Based Quantization Sensitivity Score
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Trajectory-based Quantization Sensitivity Score (TQS), a metric that reframes post-training quantization (PTQ) through the lens of dynamical-systems stability. By modeling the network's rollout as a discrete-time dynamical system, TQS characterizes how quantization-induced errors propagate and amplify over the rollout horizon. Unlike conventional PTQ methods, where sensitivity analysis is often coupled to the quantization procedure, TQS enables a priori sensitivity estimation decoupled from quantizer selection and bit-width assignment. This separation allows for quantization budget planning even for black-box or compiled networks with fused operators. Building on this, we present TQS-PTQ, a flexible mixed-precision framework that requires no calibration data or costly second-order approximations. Our experiments show that a dynamical-systems perspective provides a robust, high-performing pathway for low-precision deployment in resource-constrained settings.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从动力系统稳定性角度重新审视时间序列模型的后训练量化（PTQ），提出轨迹量化敏感度分数（TQS）。TQS通过将网络展开视为离散时间动力系统，刻画量化误差在时间步上的传播与放大，实现先验敏感度估计，与量化器和位宽选择解耦。基于TQS，进一步提出TQS-PTQ混合精度框架，无需校准数据或二阶近似，实验表明该方法在资源受限场景下有效支持低精度部署。
Motivation: 传统PTQ方法中敏感度分析常与量化流程耦合，难以在量化器或位宽选定前预先评估误差传播，尤其对黑盒或编译网络受限。
Method: 将神经网络展开建模为离散时间动力系统，定义轨迹量化敏感度分数（TQS），通过分析误差在轨迹上的传播特性实现量化敏感性先验估计，并基于此设计无需校准数据的混合精度框架TQS-PTQ。
Result: 实验表明基于动力系统视角的TQS与TQS-PTQ可以在资源受限场景下实现高性能低精度部署。
Conclusion: 摘要强调动力系统视角为低精度部署提供了稳健且高性能的途径，避免了校准数据或二阶近似的需求。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: From Uncertain Judgments to Calibrated Rankings: Conformal Elo Estimation for LLM Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating new large language models typically requires costly human annotation campaigns at scale. LLM-as-a-judge offers a cheaper alternative, but judge scores carry systematic errors - such as position bias, self-preference, or intransitivity - that can strongly miscalibrate the resulting rankings. We quantify the resulting judge-human disagreement at two complementary levels. At the local level, we estimate per-battle uncertainty from the judge's own score differences by propagating calibrated win probabilities rather than hard labels into the Bradley-Terry procedure. This alone provides a drastic improvement to Elo estimation accuracy, bringing LLM-derived ratings within 17.9 Elo MAE of human-derived ones when averaged over 55 held-out models on LMArena. At the global level, we apply split conformal prediction to the residual gap between LLM-derived and human-derived Elo ratings across held-out models, producing prediction intervals with distribution-free marginal coverage guarantees that account for irreducible LLM-human disagreement. Together, these two layers yield a low-cost evaluation tool that provides developers with calibrated Elo estimates and honest uncertainty bounds, without access to large-scale human annotations. To facilitate reproducibility, we release our code at https://github.com/kargibora/SoftElo .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型评估中LLM作为裁判产生的系统偏差（如位置偏差、自我偏好、非传递性）问题，提出了一种称为Conformal Elo Estimation的方法。该方法在局部层面通过将校准后的获胜概率而非硬标签输入Bradley-Terry过程来估计每场对决的不确定性，从而大幅提升Elo评级精度；在全局层面应用分割共形预测（split conformal prediction）为LLM导出与人工导出的Elo评级之间的残差提供无分布假设的边际覆盖保证。实验表明，该方法将LLM导出的评级与人工评级的平均绝对误差降低至17.9 Elo。
Motivation: 现有LLM-as-a-judge方法虽成本低但存在系统误差，导致评级结果严重失准，需要一种无需大规模人工标注即可获得校准评级和可靠不确定性界限的低成本评估工具。
Method: 提出两层校准方法：局部层面，通过传播校准后的获胜概率替代硬标签到Bradley-Terry过程来估计单场对决的不确定性；全局层面，对LLM评级与人类评级之间的残差应用分割共形预测，生成具有边际覆盖保证的预测区间。
Result: 在LMArena上对55个保留模型进行平均，LLM导出评级与人工评级之间的平均绝对误差降至17.9 Elo。
Conclusion: 该方法为开发者提供了校准的Elo估计和诚实的不确定性界限，无需大规模人工标注，且代码已开源。

papers.title: Under What Conditions Can a Machine Be Called Genuinely Creative?
papers.abstract_en: Recent AI systems can generate texts, software architectures, hypotheses, designs, and scientific workflows that appear creative. This paper asks under what conditions a machine can be called genuinely creative, and how human agency can be preserved within shared cognitive and creative environments. It develops a requirement framework derived from Designics, the science of meaning-bearing intentional change. The paper argues that genuine machine creativity should not be defined by output novelty, current performance, or transient architecture alone. Instead, creativity is understood as the structural transformation of incomplete situations through recursive intervention dynamics. On this view, it depends on ten requirements: environment representation, scoped perception, conflict identification, intervention capability, consequence observation, knowledge and environment update, rescoping, local-to-global unfolding, value-based scoping, and human-AI co-living. These are organized through the three laws of Designics: perception, conflict, and capability. The paper illustrates the computational tractability of these requirements through selected cyber-physical and cyber-biological studies, including recursive element extraction, autonomous mesh generation, and neurophysiological and workload analysis. It then treats open-ended systems, automated discovery frameworks, self-modifying agents, foundation models, and agentic workflows as pressure cases: they demonstrate powerful generative means but do not by themselves establish genuine machine creativity. Finally, the paper argues that proactive AI ethics is internal to genuine machine creativity rather than an after-the-fact filter. Value-based scoping and human-AI co-living must shape how creative machines perceive environments, identify conflicts, select interventions, observe consequences, update knowledge, and rescope future action.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于Designics（意图性变化的科学）提出机器真正创造力的十项要求框架，包括环境表示、感知范围、冲突识别等，并通过三定律（感知、冲突、能力）组织。论文分析开放系统、自动发现框架、自修改代理、基础模型和代理工作流等压力案例，认为这些系统虽具生成能力但未实现真正创造力，并强调主动AI伦理应内嵌于创造力定义中。
Motivation: 当前AI系统可生成看似有创造力的输出，但缺乏判断机器是否真正具有创造力的明确条件，且需在共享认知环境中保持人类能动性。
Method: 从Designics推导出十项要求（环境表示、感知范围、冲突识别、干预能力、结果观察、知识与环境更新、范围重定、局部到全局展开、价值导向范围界定、人机共存），并通过三定律（感知、冲突、能力）组织，形成可计算框架。
Result: 论文通过递归元素提取、自主网格生成、神经生理和工作负载分析等实例展示要求的可计算性；压力案例表明当前生成系统（如基础模型）虽强大但未满足真正创造力条件。
Conclusion: 真正机器创造力需要价值导向的范围界定和人机共存，且主动AI伦理是内在组成部分而非事后过滤。

papers.title: MP3: Multi-Period Pattern Pre-training for Spatio-Temporal Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Spatio-Temporal forecasting is crucial in diverse fields, such as transportation, climate, and energy. Urban spatio-temporal data exhibits temporal mirage: similar short-window inputs have divergent future trends, and vice versa. Existing spatio-temporal graph neural networks (STGNNs) cannot effectively identify such mirages. We argue that the core reason lies in the short-window inputs that have incomplete period observation, heterogeneous global spatial correlation, and cross-period superposition causality. To bridge this gap, we develop a novel Multi- Period Pattern Pre-training (MP3), a plug-and-play pre-training plugin for distinguishing temporal mirages. MP3 presents two core innovations: (1) The multi-period pattern learning is designed to learn multi-period patterns from long time series. Specifically, multi-period temporal modeling leverages edge convolution to identify different multi-period patterns. Multi-period spatial modeling uses a bottleneck project and a global memory bank to capture heterogeneous global spatial relations efficiently. Cross-period pattern interaction employs a causality-enhanced Transformer to capture dependencies across different period patterns. (2) This plugin can seamlessly integrate into existing STGNN backbones to strengthen their forecasting performance. The experiment on five STGNN baselines across five real-world datasets (including a large-scale dataset CA) verify the effectiveness, superior scalability and strong adaptability of MP3, which brings consistent and robust performance improvements across all evaluated baselines. On average, MP3 reduces the MAE 4.7% and the RMSE 5.0%. The code can be available at https://github.com/YAN-outlook/MP3.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对时空预测中的“时间幻象”（即相似短窗口输入导致不同未来趋势）问题，提出一种名为MP3的多周期模式预训练插件。MP3通过学习长期时间序列中的多周期模式，利用边卷积、瓶颈投影和全局记忆库以及因果增强Transformer来建模时间、空间和跨周期依赖，并可与现有STGNN主干无缝集成。在五个数据集上的实验表明，MP3平均降低MAE 4.7%和RMSE 5.0%。
Motivation: 现有STGNN难以识别短窗口输入中的时间幻象，核心原因是观测周期不完整、全局空间异质性和跨周期叠加因果。
Method: 提出MP3预训练插件，包含三个模块：多周期时间建模（边卷积识别不同周期模式）、多周期空间建模（瓶颈投影+全局记忆库捕获异构全局空间关系）、跨周期模式交互（因果增强Transformer捕捉周期间依赖）。
Result: 在五个STGNN基线和五个真实数据集（含大规模CA数据集）上，MP3带来一致且稳健的性能提升，平均MAE降低4.7%，RMSE降低5.0%。
Conclusion: MP3作为即插即用插件，能有效增强STGNN对时间幻象的区分能力，并具有良好的可扩展性和适应性。
Relevance: 60

papers.title: TWLA: Achieving Ternary Weights and Low-Bit Activations for LLMs via Post-Training Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit exceptional general language processing capabilities, but their memory and compute costs hinder deployment. Ternarization has emerged as a promising compression technique, offering significant reductions in model size and inference complexity. However, existing methods struggle with heavy-tailed activation distributions and therefore keep activations in high precision, fundamentally limiting end-to-end inference acceleration. To overcome this limitation, we propose TWLA, a post-training quantization (PTQ) framework that achieves 1.58-bit weight compression and 4-bit activation quantization while maintaining high accuracy. TWLA comprises three components: (1) Euclidean-to-Manifold Asymmetric Ternary Quantizer (E2M-ATQ) minimizes layer-output error under weight ternarization via a two-stage optimization from Euclidean initialization to manifold relocation; (2) Kronecker Orthogonal Tri-Modal Shaping (KOTMS) applies a Kronecker-structured orthogonal rotation to reshape weights into ternary-friendly tri-modal distributions, while the shared rotation statistically suppresses activation outliers; and (3) Inter-Layer Aware Activation Mixed Precision (ILA-AMP) explicitly introduces adjacent-layer second-order interaction costs in bit allocation and jointly optimizes for the layer-wise disparity of activation quantization gains induced by the shared orthogonal transform, preventing cascades triggered by a few weak layers. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TWLA maintains high accuracy under W1.58A4, while delivering significant inference acceleration. The code is available at https://github.com/Kishon-zzx/TWLA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TWLA是一个面向大语言模型的后训练量化框架，同时实现1.58比特权重（三值化）和4比特激活量化，旨在解决现有方法因激活值重尾分布而需要高精度激活、限制端到端加速的问题。该框架包含三个核心组件：非对称三值量化器、Kronecker正交三峰整形和层间感知激活混合精度分配。实验表明TWLA在W1.58A4配置下保持高准确率并显著提升推理速度。
Motivation: 现有三值化方法因激活值分布重尾而被迫保持高精度激活，无法充分利用低比特计算加速，限制了LLM在实际部署中的内存和计算效率。
Method: 提出TWLA框架，包含三个组件：(1) E2M-ATQ，通过从欧几里得初始化到流形重定位的两阶段优化，最小化权重三值化后的层输出误差；(2) KOTMS，利用Kronecker结构正交旋转重塑权重分布为三值友好型，同时抑制激活异常值；(3) ILA-AMP，在比特分配中引入相邻层二阶交互成本，防止少数弱层引发级联效应。
Result: 在多项任务上，TWLA在W1.58A4（1.58比特权重、4比特激活）下保持高准确率，并实现显著的推理加速。
Conclusion: TWLA通过协同设计量化器和激活整形，有效克服了三值化LLM中激活重尾分布的限制，实现了低比特权重和激活的联合压缩与加速。

papers.title: DeepJEB++: Foundation Model-Driven Large-Scale 3D Engineering Dataset via 2D Latent Space Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: Data-driven engineering design is constrained by the lack of large-scale 3D datasets that pair geometry with physics-based performance labels. In particular, existing 3D data augmentation techniques have limitations in preserving subtle and diverse geometric variations, and it remains difficult to automate the subsequent simulation-labeling process, where boundary conditions vary depending on the generated geometry. We present DeepJEB++, a foundation-model-driven data-augmentation framework that expands a small seed set of jet engine brackets into a large, simulation-labeled 3D dataset under constrained resources. Our key idea is to augment in the data-rich 2D latent space, then transfer to 3D. In Stage 1, we fine-tune a pretrained 2D latent diffusion model on multi-view renders and synthesize novel views by latent interpolation, retaining manufacturable designs through a vision-language-model (VLM) quality filter. In Stage 2, the validated images are lifted to 3D meshes by a domain-adapted generative foundation model. In Stage 3, an automated pipeline recognizes the load and bolt interfaces on each mesh and assigns finite-element labels -- mass, stress, and displacement -- without manual intervention. We assess augmentation quality along three intrinsic axes: manufacturability, label fidelity against the SimJEB ground truth, and distributional consistency. Starting from fewer than 400 seed designs, DeepJEB++ yields 15,360 simulation-labeled 3D brackets -- a 40x expansion -- using a single GPU per stage. The dataset will be made publicly available to support reproducible engineering-AI research.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 14 figures. Submitted to ASME Journal of Mechanical Design
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeepJEB++ 提出一个基于基础模型的数据增广框架，从少量喷气发动机支架种子设计扩展出大规模、带仿真标签的3D数据集。该方法在2D潜空间进行增广，然后提升到3D网格，并通过自动流程分配有限元标签。从不到400个种子设计生成15,360个带标签的3D支架，实现40倍扩展。
Motivation: 数据驱动的工程设计受限于缺乏同时包含几何和物理性能标签的大规模3D数据集。现有3D数据增广技术在保持细微几何变化方面有局限，且后续仿真标注自动化困难。
Method: 三阶段框架：1) 在2D潜空间微调预训练潜在扩散模型，通过潜插值合成新视图，并用视觉语言模型过滤可制造设计；2) 将验证后的图像通过域适应生成基础模型提升为3D网格；3) 自动流水线识别每个网格上的载荷和螺栓接口，分配有限元标签（质量、应力、位移）。
Result: 从少于400个种子设计开始，使用单GPU每阶段，生成15,360个带仿真标签的3D支架，实现40倍扩展。
Conclusion: 该框架展示了在资源受限条件下，通过2D潜空间增广和自动化标注，可大规模扩展仿真标注的3D工程数据集。数据集将公开以支持可复现的工程AI研究。

papers.title: Order Is Not Control: Driven-Dissipative Response Laws Across Artificial and Biological Systems
papers.abstract_en: AI alignment, interpretability, steering, and neural perturbation studies identify order-inducing objects. We argue that order is not control. Control requires a receiver-gated response law: a denominator-indexed operator mapping material state, action/drive, bath, and receiver state to response displacement, sinks, effort, and basin projection. We identify it across biological, LLM, adapter, and stochastic-operator panels. The laws are local: an intervention can be admitted, saturated, sign-changing, leaky, or overdriven depending on medium, bath, receiver state, action port, and comparator. Control is assigned when finite effort moves a target or outcome-readout class under the same denominator while damage, null/evasive, invalid format, overdrive, and unnecessary effort stay bounded. Mouse ALM, C. elegans, and zebrafish panels provide physical response-operator evidence while excluding coordinate identity and controller conclusions. LLM panels show generated-output response laws: across four material conditions, response vectors are predictable at 72.8-73.7% component-sign accuracy, rising to 84.3-84.8% on nonzero components; held-out observers predict system-effect and target/oracle families at 93.6% and 91.7% accuracy. Constitution-conditioned adapters reshape susceptibility as prepared media, and stochastic-operator panels separate measured opportunity from deployable action policies. This gives a driven-dissipative response-system account at the mesoscopic control level: drives act through prepared media, baths, and receivers, producing admitted movement, impedance, sinks, or overdrive. The evidence supports local admitted control and measurable stochastic response operators, while leaving deployable pre-generation control, hidden/logit causal sufficiency, biological-to-LLM coordinate identity, and literal thermodynamic quantities outside scope.

TL;DR: 本文质疑“有序即控制”的常见假设，提出一种由接收器门控的响应定律（receiver-gated response law），该定律通过分母索引算子描述材料状态、作用/驱动、浴和接收器状态到响应位移、汇、努力和盆地投影的映射。作者在生物系统（小鼠ALM、线虫、斑马鱼）、大型语言模型（LLM）、适配器和随机算子面板中验证了这一框架。LLM实验表明，输出响应向量在四种材料条件下的分量符号预测准确率达72.8-73.7%，非零分量上达84.3-84.8%；独立观察者预测系统效应和目标/预言家族的准确率分别为93.6%和91.7%。结论支持局部可接受控制（local admitted control）和可测随机响应算子，但明确将预生成控制、隐藏/逻辑因果充分性、生物与LLM坐标同一性以及热力学量排除在范围之外。
Motivation: AI对齐、可解释性、神经扰动等研究常将有序对象等同于控制，但作者认为秩序不等于控制，需要更精确的控制响应定律来区分真正控制与仅仅是秩序的涌现。
Method: 提出分母索引的接收器门控响应算子框架，将控制定义为在相同分母下有限努力移动目标或结果输出类，同时保持损伤、空/逃避、无效格式、过驱和不必要努力有界。通过跨生物、LLM、适配器和随机算子面板的实验识别该定律。
Result: LLM面板中，响应向量的分量符号预测准确率在四种材料条件下为72.8-73.7%，非零分量上升至84.3-84.8%；独立观察者预测系统效应准确率93.6%，预测目标/预言家族准确率91.7%。生物面板提供了物理响应算子证据但排除了坐标同一性和控制器结论。
Conclusion: 摘要认为证据支持局部可接受控制和可测随机响应算子的驱动耗散响应系统解释，但预生成控制、隐藏因果充分性、生物-LLM坐标同一性及热力学量不在本文讨论范围内。

papers.title: MAStrike: Shapley-Guided Collusive Red-Teaming on Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Hierarchical multi-agent systems (MAS) are rapidly being deployed in high-stakes workflows across domains such as finance and software engineering. In these systems, safety and security are inherently distributed across role-specialized agents, significantly expanding the attack surface, particularly under coordinated adversarial behaviors such as privilege escalation and cross-agent collusion. Existing red-teaming approaches for MAS remain limited: they rely on heuristic selection of target agents and perturb isolated message streams, leaving critical questions unanswered as which agents are most responsible for system safety, and how compromised agents can coordinate to bypass defenses. We propose MAStrike, a closed-loop framework for collusive red-teaming in hierarchical MAS. We propose the first agent-level Shapley value analysis for MAS, quantifying each agent's marginal contribution to system robustness under task-specific distributions. GGuided by this attribution, MAStrike identifies vulnerable agent coalitions and generates coordinated, role-aware adversarial manipulations. These attacks are iteratively refined through structured causal diagnosis, attributing failure cases to uncompromised agents that block adversarial attempts. We further build a comprehensive MAS red-teaming benchmark and controllable environments spanning diverse hierarchical topologies and domains, including finance, software engineering, and CRM. Extensive experiments across MAS built on multiple frontier models show that MAStrike substantially outperforms heuristic baselines. Our analysis further uncovers non-trivial Shapley value distributions and higher-order interaction structures among agents, revealing critical vulnerabilities and coordination patterns that are overlooked by prior single-agent or template-based methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MAStrike，一种基于Shapley值的多智能体系统协同红队测试框架，通过量化每个智能体对系统鲁棒性的边际贡献，识别脆弱智能体联盟并生成协调攻击，在多个前沿模型上显著优于启发式基线。
Motivation: 现有红队测试方法局限于启发式选择目标或扰动孤立消息，未考虑多智能体系统中智能体间协作攻击面的扩展，缺乏对关键智能体识别和协同攻击的探索。
Method: 提出首个智能体级Shapley值分析，量化每个智能体对任务分布下系统鲁棒性的边际贡献；据此构建脆弱智能体联盟，生成角色感知的对抗操作；并通过因果诊断迭代优化攻击。
Result: 在金融、软件工程等领域的多智能体基准测试中，MAStrike显著优于启发式基线，并揭示非平凡的Shapley值分布和智能体间高阶交互结构。
Conclusion: 本方法揭示了被先前单智能体或模板方法忽视的关键漏洞和协调模式，为多智能体系统安全评估提供新工具。

papers.title: Bounding Boxes as Goals: Language-Conditioned Grasping via Neuro-Symbolic Planning
papers.abstract_en: For robotics to be effectively integrated into household or industrial environments, machines must adapt to natural-language prompts in real time. Although Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have enabled zero-shot generalization in robot task and motion planning (TAMP), current state-of-the-art approaches often remain computationally "heavyweight" or require extensive training on thousands of demonstrations. We present GRASP (Grounded Reasoning and Symbolic Planning), a framework designed as a step toward open-vocabulary tabletop manipulation. Our approach leverages a pretrained VLM to translate natural-language queries into neuro-symbolic goal states, grounded in the physical world via a bounding-box detection pipeline. Unlike methods that rely on fixed color lists or hard-coded coordinates, GRASP enables robots to interpret abstract spatial concepts such as "top shelf" and execute tasks without additional fine-tuning. We achieve 73.3% overall success across 90 real-robot trials at three difficulty levels, requiring no task-specific training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GRASP框架，利用预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）将自然语言查询转化为神经符号目标状态，并通过边界框检测管道进行物理世界锚定，实现开放词汇的桌面操作。该方法无需任务特定训练，在90次真实机器人试验中达到73.3%的整体成功率。
Motivation: 现有机器人操作方法依赖固定颜色列表或硬编码坐标，且多数方法计算开销大或需要大量演示训练；亟需一种轻量级、能理解抽象空间概念（如“顶层架子”）并适应自然语言指令的方法。
Method: GRASP框架：使用预训练VLM将自然语言查询转化为神经符号目标状态，并通过边界框检测管道将目标状态锚定到物理世界；无需额外微调即可执行任务。
Result: 在三个难度级别的90次真实机器人试验中达到73.3%的整体成功率，且无需任务特定训练。
Conclusion: GRASP是迈向开放词汇桌面操作的一步，展示了利用VLM进行符号规划的有效性，但摘要未提及局限性和泛化范围。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Direct Preference Optimization for Chatbot Fine-Tuning: An Empirical Study
papers.abstract_en: We present an approach to fine-tuning large language models using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), a reinforcement learning technique. Our experimental results demonstrate that DPO simplifies the training pipeline, improves computational efficiency, and achieves competitive performance. The evaluation using BLEU, ROUGE, and cosine similarity metrics indicates effective learning and convergence, though further investigation is needed to address observed training instability.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. All authors contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过直接偏好优化（DPO）对大语言模型进行微调，DPO简化了训练流程并提高了计算效率，在BLEU、ROUGE和余弦相似度等指标上表现出竞争力，但存在训练不稳定性问题。
Motivation: 现有强化学习微调方法（如RLHF）流程复杂，需要训练奖励模型和策略模型，计算开销大。DPO旨在简化流程并提升效率。
Method: 采用直接偏好优化（DPO）方法，替代传统的基于奖励模型的强化学习，直接利用偏好数据优化策略模型。
Result: 实验显示DPO在聊天机器人微调任务上取得了与RLHF相当的BLEU、ROUGE和余弦相似度分数，同时训练更高效。
Conclusion: DPO是一种简化且有效的微调方法，但需要进一步研究其训练稳定性问题。

papers.title: GUITrans2Act: Understanding User Operational Behaviors from Mobile GUI Interactions with Vision-Language Models
authors: (2) The Chinese University of Hong Kong
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the digital world on mobile devices is shifting from static UI perception to dynamic action comprehension. This capability enables models to convert visual state transitions into operational knowledge, defined as short natural-language sentences that describe action types, target UI elements, textual arguments, and execution orders. However, due to the highly diverse and heterogeneous UI designs across applications, existing vision-language models (VLMs) struggle to accurately infer these underlying operations. To bridge this gap, we introduce Teach VLM, a core model designed to translate mobile screen trajectories into step-wise operational knowledge by extracting and analyzing operation-related keyframes from demonstration videos. To address the scarcity of aligned training data, we develop a systematic data flywheel for scalable data acquisition. We further introduce a novel Chinese Mobile Screen Teach Benchmark for fine-grained evaluation. Building upon Teach VLM, we propose the Teach-and-Repeat paradigm, where the generated operational knowledge serves as an interpretable procedural reference to guide downstream screen-based execution agents. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that Teach VLM significantly outperforms strong VLM baselines, achieving state-of-the-art performance in operation semantics prediction. Furthermore, experiments in Android World show that our paradigm yields consistent Task Success Rate improvements for downstream agents. Together, Teach VLM and the Teach-and-Repeat paradigm offer a practical pathway from raw demonstrations to reusable task automation.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 9 figures. Yudong Zhang and Lei Hu contributed equally to this work. Zuojian Wang, and Zhilin Gao are corresponding authors
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Teach VLM模型，将移动设备屏幕轨迹转化为步骤化的操作知识（含动作类型、目标UI元素、文本参数和执行顺序），并构建Teach-and-Repeat范式的可解释流程参考以指导下游执行代理。在自定义的中文手机屏幕教学基准上，Teach VLM在操作语义预测上达到SOTA，并在Android World环境中提升下游代理的任务成功率。
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型难以准确推断移动应用中高度多样且异构的UI操作，缺乏从原始演示到可复用任务自动化的系统化方法。
Method: 提出Teach VLM核心模型，通过提取和分析演示视频中的操作相关关键帧，将屏幕轨迹翻译为逐步骤操作知识；并开发系统性数据飞轮以解决对齐训练数据稀缺问题，同时引入新的中文手机屏幕教学基准。
Result: Teach VLM在操作语义预测任务上显著优于强VLM基线；在Android World实验中，Teach-and-Repeat范式为下游代理带来一致的任务成功率提升。
Conclusion: Teach VLM与Teach-and-Repeat范式提供了一条从原始演示到可重用任务自动化的实用路径，但当前基准和实验仅限于中文手机屏幕场景。

papers.title: Let's Ask Gauss: Improved One-Run Privacy Auditing
papers.abstract_en: Privacy auditing provides an important safeguard by estimating the actual information leaked by a model, thus ensuring that theoretical privacy guarantees hold in practice. We study empirical privacy auditing for differentially private (DP) machine learning, focusing on efficient one-run methods for mechanisms such as DP-SGD. Prior one-run approaches threshold training examples or "canaries" into binary membership guesses, which discards useful information. We show that, in the white-box DP-SGD setting, canary-aligned signals naturally form a sequence of random variables whose normalized sum is asymptotically Gaussian. Leveraging this distributional perspective, we develop a DP-auditing framework that leads to tighter privacy lower bounds from a single training run.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究差分隐私（DP）机器学习中的隐私审计，提出一种基于高斯渐近分布的一次性审计方法。在白盒DP-SGD中，canary对齐的信号形成随机变量序列，其归一化和渐近高斯，利用该分布视角得到比二值猜测更紧的隐私下界。
Motivation: 现有一次性隐私审计方法将训练样本或canary二值化为二元成员猜测，丢弃了有用信息，导致隐私下界不够紧。
Method: 证明在白盒DP-SGD中，canary对齐的信号自然形成随机变量序列，其归一化和渐近高斯，基于此分布视角开发DP审计框架。
Result: 从单个训练运行得到更紧的隐私下界。
Conclusion: 通过分布建模改进了隐私审计的紧致性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EquiDexFlow: Contact-Grounded SE(3)-Equivariant Dexterous Grasp Generative Flows
papers.abstract_en: Most learned dexterous grasp generators relegate contact forces to a downstream verification step, so a kinematically-plausible pose can still violate the conditions for a stable physical grasp. We address this with EquiDexFlow, an SE(3)-equivariant flow-matching model that jointly predicts wrist pose, joint angles, fingertip contacts, surface normals, and contact forces from an object point cloud. Our architecture projects contacts onto the object surface and forces into the Coulomb friction cone by construction, so placement and friction compliance hold without loss penalties. We prove end-to-end SE(3) equivariance and verify it empirically over 200 rotations, with wrist residuals below $0.04^\circ$ and exactly zero joint deviation. Trained on 8,100 force-closure grasps across 81 objects for the 16-DoF Allegro Hand, our model achieves zero friction violations, the best composite score, and the lowest wrench residual among all ablation variants. We retarget decoded fingertip contacts to a 16-DoF LEAP Hand via per-finger inverse kinematics, and our hardware-feasible refinement places every joint at least 5% inside its actuator envelope while preserving wrench balance. On the physical robot, retargeted EquiDexFlow-decoded grasps complete open-loop pick-and-hold trials on all six test objects, with every asymmetric object succeeding at both the canonical pose and a $120^\circ$ co-rotation. Videos, code, and checkpoints are available at https://equidexflow.github.io.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 11 figures, 11 tables. Project page with videos, code, and checkpoints: https://equidexflow.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EquiDexFlow 是一个 SE(3) 等变流匹配模型，用于灵巧抓取生成。该模型联合预测手腕姿态、关节角度、指尖接触点、表面法向量和接触力，并确保接触点位于物体表面且力在库仑摩擦锥内，从而无需损失惩罚即可满足放置与摩擦约束。在 16 自由度 Allegro Hand 的 81 个物体共 8100 个力闭合抓取数据上训练，实现了零摩擦违规、最佳综合得分和最小力旋量残差。在物理机器人上，重定向的抓取在六个测试物体上成功完成开环抓取与保持任务。
Motivation: 现有灵巧抓取生成器通常将接触力作为后处理验证步骤，导致运动学上可行的抓取仍可能违反稳定物理抓取的条件。
Method: 提出 SE(3) 等变流匹配模型 EquiDexFlow，从物体点云联合预测手腕位姿、关节角、指尖接触、表面法向和接触力，并通过构造将接触投影到物体表面、将力约束在摩擦锥内。
Result: 在 200 次旋转测试中，手腕残差低于 0.04°，关节偏差为零；在 Allegro Hand 数据集上实现零摩擦违规、最佳综合得分和最低力旋量残差；重定向到 LEAP Hand 后所有关节余量 ≥5%；物理机器人上所有六个测试物体开环抓取成功。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该模型通过等变性和几何约束确保了抓取的物理可行性，并在仿真和实物上都验证了有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Quickest Detection of Hallucination Onset: Delay Bounds and Learned CUSUM Statistics
papers.abstract_en: Token-level hallucination detectors are evaluated as classifiers, by AUC over all tokens, yet a streaming monitor is judged by its reaction time: the number of tokens that pass between the onset of a hallucination and the alarm. We formulate hallucination onset detection as a quickest change detection problem. A first-order Markov model of the latent faithful/hallucinated state, validated on RAGTruth, places the task inside classical change-point theory and yields Lorden's lower bound on detection delay: about 1.3 tokens at a false-alarm rate of 0.01. We then show that a causal recurrent labeler acts as a CUSUM with a learned increment. Among the onsets it catches it detects in 11-13 tokens, against 31 for a linear per-token baseline, though at this false-alarm budget every detector catches under a third of onsets and the recall-honest delay is 56-66 tokens: low-false-alarm onset detection is hard. A controlled decomposition attributes the speed advantage mostly to a better per-token score rather than to temporal accumulation. An information-rate optimality theorem of Donsker-Varadhan type explains the remaining order-of-magnitude gap: the learned score realizes only 1/4.5 of the divergence the features carry, a deficit that recalibration cannot remove, with the remainder a finite-horizon effect. Classification metrics conceal this delay structure; sequential analysis makes it measurable.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 1 figure. v2: added Discussion and Appendix; recall-honest framing; robustness analyses (k-NN divergence estimate, seed-averaged decomposition)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将大型语言模型幻觉起始检测形式化为快速变化检测（quickest change detection）问题，利用CUSUM统计量学习增量，并在RAGTruth数据集上验证。研究发现，在0.01假警报率下，Lorden下界约1.3个token，因果循环标注器检测延迟11-13个token，但所有检测器仅捕捉不到三分之一幻觉起始，且召回-诚实延迟为56-66个token。分类指标（如AUC）掩盖了延迟结构，而序列分析使其可测量。
Motivation: 现有令牌级幻觉检测器以AUC评估，但流式监控更关注反应时间（幻觉起始到警报的令牌数），因此需要形式化快速检测问题以明确延迟界。
Method: 提出基于快速变化检测的框架，使用一阶马尔可夫模型验证忠诚/幻觉状态，并采用CUSUM方法，其中因果循环标注器作为学习增量。
Result: 在0.01假警报率下，Lorden下界约1.3个token；因果循环标注器检测延迟11-13个token，线性基线31个；但所有检测器仅捕捉33%以下起始，召回-诚实延迟56-66个token。速度优势主要来自更好逐令牌分数而非时序积累，信息率最优性定理指出学习分数仅实现特征携带散度的1/4.5。
Conclusion: 分类指标（如AUC）无法反映延迟结构，而序列分析能有效测量检测延迟，揭示低假警报下起始检测的固有难度。

papers.title: Holding the FP8 Quality Ceiling at 8-Bit Weights and Activations: INT8 and GGUF Post-Training Quantization of Ideogram 4.0 for Consumer GPUs
papers.abstract_en: We study post-training quantization (PTQ) of Ideogram 4.0, a 9.3B flow-matching diffusion transformer (DiT) that realizes classifier-free guidance with two separate-weight copies of a single-stream backbone and is conditioned by a Qwen3-VL text encoder, targeting Ampere RTX~3090 GPUs, which lack FP8 tensor cores. Because Ideogram~4.0 is trained on structured JSON captions, we evaluate every variant under schema-valid JSON prompts produced by an LLM expander built to Ideogram's published caption specification, and score them with a battery spanning human-preference (HPSv2), CLIP, and PickScore for standalone quality; PP-OCR exact-match and edit distance for text; and PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS for fidelity to the FP8 reference (the highest-precision public checkpoint) output. On a 300-prompt benchmark with paired bootstrap confidence intervals, an INT8 W8A8 recipe (per-channel weights, per-token dynamic activations, SmoothQuant, and bf16 protection of a small high-fragility layer set) is statistically indistinguishable from FP8 on CLIP and PickScore (paired CIs include zero) and within ~0.004 HPSv2, and, at its 8-bit size, is the most faithful reproduction of the FP8 output (LPIPS 0.243 vs 0.277/0.306 for the half-size 4-bit baselines; the INT8-Q4_K gap excludes zero). A GGUF Q4_K quantization reaches the same standalone quality as the published NF4 baseline at the same on-disk size, making it the Pareto choice on the quality-memory frontier. We further show that under JSON prompts all four variants reach parity on standalone quality, the variants separate on fidelity and text rendering, not on aggregate image-quality scores, and that text legibility, near-zero when the model is prompted with raw strings, reaches 55% OCR exact-match under the JSON captions it expects. We release the INT8 W8A8 and GGUF Q4_K quantized weights on Hugging Face under a gated, non-commercial license.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究Ideogram 4.0（9.3B参数的流匹配扩散Transformer）的后训练量化（PTQ），针对缺少FP8张量核心的Ampere RTX 3090 GPU。作者提出INT8 W8A8方案（每通道权重、每token动态激活、SmoothQuant，对少量高脆弱层使用bf16保护）和GGUF Q4_K量化，在300提示基准上比较图像质量（HPSv2、CLIP、PickScore）、忠实度（LPIPS等）和文本渲染（OCR）。结果显示INT8方案在CLIP和PickScore上与FP8统计无差异，HPSv2差约0.004，LPIPS最优（0.243）；GGUF Q4_K在相同大小下达到NF4基准的独立质量。文章强调JSON提示对文本渲染的关键作用。
Motivation: 消费级GPU（如RTX 3090）缺乏FP8张量核心，运行大型扩散模型需要高效的低比特量化方案，同时保持输出质量与FP8接近。
Method: 后训练量化（PTQ）：对权重进行每通道INT8量化，激活进行每token动态INT8量化，结合SmoothQuant，对少量高脆弱层使用bf16保护。同时探索GGUF Q4_K量化。
Result: 在300提示基准上，INT8 W8A8方案在CLIP和PickScore上与FP8统计无显著差异（配对置信区间包含零），HPSv2差异约0.004，LPIPS为0.243（优于4-bit基线的0.277/0.306）。GGUF Q4_K达到与NF4基线的相同质量，成为质量-内存前沿的Pareto最优。
Conclusion: 通过适当的量化策略，8位权重和激活可达到FP8质量，GGUF Q4_K在同等大小下最均衡。文本渲染在正确的JSON提示下显著提升，而原始字符串提示近乎零OCR准确率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Roleplaying, Do Models Believe What They Say?
papers.abstract_en: Language models can state that "the Earth orbits the Sun" and, when role-playing Aristotle, assert the opposite. Recent work argues that persona adoption is fundamental to how language models operate, with models constantly selecting the most appropriate persona for a given context. Does such role-playing merely change the model's outputs, or does it also affect what the model internally represents as truthful? We study this question with linear truth probes, applying them to LLMs role-playing historical personas whose likely beliefs differ from modern consensus. For each persona, we compare false claims the persona would likely have endorsed (*era-believed*) with topic-matched false claims they would not have endorsed (*era-false*). Across prompting, in-context learning, and supervised fine-tuning, persona induction suppresses era-believed statements less than equally false alternatives, yet they remain classified as false overall. Role-play therefore shifts what these models say more than what they internally represent as true. We contrast this with models trained on harmful advice that exhibit Emergent Misalignment (EM). Across three model families (Qwen 2.5 14B, Qwen 3 8B, and Llama 3.3 70B), their false claims move substantially toward the true region of probe space, are defended under challenge roughly half the time versus about a sixth for role-play, and are used in downstream reasoning. Role-play and Emergent Misalignment thus are points on a spectrum of belief internalization, where role-play changes what a model says with little representational change, while Emergent Misalignment shifts the internal representation of false claims without fully marking them as true.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过线性真相探针（linear truth probes）研究语言模型在角色扮演时内部表征是否改变，发现角色扮演主要改变输出而非内部信念，与新兴错位（Emergent Misalignment）形成对比。
Motivation: 现有研究认为角色扮演是语言模型工作的基础，但尚不清楚角色扮演是否仅改变输出，还是也影响模型内部对真理的表征。
Method: 利用线性真相探针，对三个模型家族（Qwen 2.5 14B、Qwen 3 8B、Llama 3.3 70B）进行角色扮演实验，比较历史人物时代信念与同等虚假但非时代信念的探针分类结果，并对比新兴错位训练。
Result: 角色扮演抑制时代信念的程度低于同等的虚假替代，但这些信念仍整体被分类为假；而新兴错位模型的虚假陈述向真相区域移动，并在挑战中约有半数被辩护。
Conclusion: 角色扮演和新兴错位是信念内化谱系上的不同点：角色扮演改变输出但内部表征变化小，新兴错位则改变内部表征但不完全标记为真。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Kling-Gupta linear regression
papers.abstract_en: Kling-Gupta efficiency ($\mathrm{KGE}$) is a model performance evaluation metric widely used in hydrology, but its properties as a statistical estimator have remained unexplored. We formalize the Kling-Gupta loss $L_\mathrm{KG} = (1 - \mathrm{KGE})^2$ in an extremum estimation framework (maximizing $\mathrm{KGE}$) for multiple linear regression. We give explicit formulas showing that Kling-Gupta regression scales the ordinary least squares (OLS) coefficient vector by a variance-inflation factor depending on sample variances and covariances. Its predictions reproduce the training set response variance, unlike OLS's variance reduction, while both maintain the response mean and achieve the same sample correlation. We prove that no estimator simultaneously maximizes Nash-Sutcliffe efficiency ($\mathrm{NSE}$) and $\mathrm{KGE}$: OLS maximizes $\mathrm{NSE}$ but not $\mathrm{KGE}$, whereas Kling-Gupta regression maximizes $\mathrm{KGE}$ at the expense of $\mathrm{NSE}$. We establish almost-sure convergence of the Kling-Gupta estimator to well-defined population limits. The training and test set performance metrics for both estimators converge asymptotically to identical limits (different for OLS vs. Kling-Gupta). In a single-predictor model with fixed intercept, we identify conditions where a global minimum of $L_\mathrm{KG}$ does not exist because of discontinuity at zero slope. This work establishes a mathematical foundation for $\mathrm{KGE}$-based estimation and clarifies its effects on predictive performance in hydrologic modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文正式将Kling-Gupta效率（KGE）作为极值估计框架用于多元线性回归，推导出Kling-Gupta回归与普通最小二乘（OLS）的关系，证明两者不能同时最大化NSE和KGE，并建立了估计量的几乎必然收敛性。在单变量截距模型中，发现零斜率处不连续导致全局最小值不存在。该工作为基于KGE的水文建模估计提供了数学基础。
Motivation: KGE是水文学中广泛使用的模型性能指标，但其作为统计估计量的性质尚未被探索。本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
Method: 将KGE损失（1-KGE）^2纳入极值估计框架，通过显式公式推导出Kling-Gupta回归对OLS系数向量的缩放因子（方差膨胀因子），并分析其预测方差、均值、相关性等统计性质。
Result: Kling-Gupta回归能重现训练集响应方差（而OLS会减少方差），两者保持相同的样本均值和样本相关性；证明了不存在同时最大化NSE和KGE的估计量；建立了估计量的几乎必然收敛性；在单变量模型中揭示了零斜率处的全局最小值不存在条件。
Conclusion: 本文建立了KGE的数学基础，阐明了其在统计估计中的性质以及对水文模型预测性能的影响。
Relevance: 60

summary_sections.result: Kling-Gupta回归能重现训练集响应方差（而OLS会减少方差），两者保持相同的样本均值和样本相关性；证明了不存在同时最大化NSE和KGE的估计量；建立了估计量的几乎必然收敛性；在单变量模型中揭示了零斜率处的全局最小值不存在条件。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文建立了KGE的数学基础，阐明了其在统计估计中的性质以及对水文模型预测性能的影响。

papers.title: StainFlow: Entity-Stain Tracking and Evidence Linking for Process Rewards in GUI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has become a promising approach for improving GUI Agents in long-horizon, stochastic digital environments, but trajectory-level success feedback is too sparse to provide reliable credit assignment for intermediate exploration steps. To mitigate this issue, recent studies introduce Process Reward Models (PRMs), which provide finer-grained training feedback through global milestone verification or local step-level evaluation. However, these methods still suffer from two level-specific limitations: global milestone decomposition is subjective and singular, making it difficult to accommodate the multiple valid execution paths in real GUI tasks, while fixed local judging windows may miss long-range key evidence or dilute the decision signal with irrelevant frames. Inspired by stain-tracing mechanisms in network flow analysis, we propose StainFlow, an entity-stain-flow process reward model for GUI Agents. To reduce the subjectivity of global partitioning, we introduce the Global Entity Stain Tracking module, which extracts visually verifiable task entities and tracks how their stain concentrations and states evolve along the trajectory, allowing task phases to be objectively separated by changes in the entity evidence flow. To improve the accuracy of local verification, we introduce the Local Stain Evidence Linking module. Centered on the triggering entities of each candidate key node, it retrieves relevant steps based on their stain concentrations and state changes, and dynamically constructs high-density evidence windows for verifying true key nodes. Extensive experiments on AndroidWorld and OGRBench show that StainFlow relatively improves online RL success by 3.2% and trajectory completion judgment accuracy by 1.8%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StainFlow，一种基于实体染色流的过程奖励模型，用于改进 GUI 智能体在长时域随机环境中的强化学习。通过全局实体染色追踪模块客观划分任务阶段，以及局部染色证据链接模块动态构建高密度证据窗口验证关键节点，缓解了现有过程奖励模型中全局分解主观、局部窗口遗漏长程证据的问题。在 AndroidWorld 和 OGRBench 上，StainFlow 相对提升了在线强化学习成功率 3.2% 和轨迹完成判断准确率 1.8%。
Motivation: 现有过程奖励模型（PRM）为 GUI 智能体提供细粒度训练反馈时，全局里程碑分解主观且单一，难以适应真实 GUI 任务中多条有效执行路径；局部固定判断窗口可能遗漏长程关键证据或用无关帧稀释决策信号。
Method: 提出 StainFlow，包含全局实体染色追踪模块（Global Entity Stain Tracking），通过提取视觉可验证的任务实体并追踪其染色浓度与状态沿轨迹的演变，客观划分任务阶段；以及局部染色证据链接模块（Local Stain Evidence Linking），以候选关键节点触发实体为中心，依据染色浓度与状态变化检索相关步骤，动态构建高密度证据窗口用于验证真实关键节点。
Result: 在 AndroidWorld 和 OGRBench 上，StainFlow 相对提升了在线强化学习成功率 3.2% 和轨迹完成判断准确率 1.8%。
Conclusion: StainFlow 通过实体染色流机制改进了 GUI 智能体过程奖励的全局分解客观性与局部验证准确性，实验证明其有效性。

papers.title: LiAuto-GeoX: Efficient Grounded Driving Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Dense 3D reconstruction has demonstrated immense potential for spatial understanding, yet its viability as a real-time, onboard representation for autonomous driving remains an open challenge. Existing large-scale visual geometry models typically require substantial computational resources and lack the long-range geometric fidelity, surround-view consistency, and real-time efficiency demanded by dynamic driving environments. To bridge this gap, we present \textbf{LiAuto-GeoX}, an efficient grounded driving transformer designed for deployable, ego-centric 3D scene understanding. Our approach begins by learning a high-capacity driving geometry model from large-scale surround-view data, utilizing sparse LiDAR priors to provide robust geometric grounding in distant, ambiguous, or structure-sparse regions. We then instantiate this capability into a highly compact 155M-parameter onboard model through a novel geometry-preserving distillation framework. This framework employs mask-guided depth-aware distillation to retain fine-grained metric structures by emphasizing geometrically informative regions, and relative-pose relational distillation to enforce cross-view spatial consistency through pose-induced geometric relations. Extensive evaluations reveal that \textbf{LiAuto-GeoX} runs at 220 FPS on KITTI while maintaining high-fidelity dense reconstruction, enabling real-time deployment. The learned geometry transfers seamlessly to downstream autonomy tasks, achieving 90.6 PDMS in trajectory prediction, 24.63 mIoU in occupancy prediction, and 47.67 IoU in future-frame prediction. These all demonstrate that efficient dense 3D reconstruction can transcend its traditional role as a perception target to serve as a scalable, foundational geometric representation for next-generation autonomous driving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LiAuto-GeoX，一种高效的可部署自车中心3D场景理解转换器。它利用大规模环视数据和稀疏LiDAR先验学习高容量驾驶几何模型，并通过几何保持蒸馏框架压缩为155M参数的板载模型，实现220 FPS的实时密集重建。该几何表示可迁移至下游轨迹预测、占用预测和未来帧预测任务。
Motivation: 现有大规模视觉几何模型计算开销大，且缺乏自动驾驶所需的远距离几何保真度、环视一致性和实时效率。
Method: 提出几何保持蒸馏框架，包含掩码引导的深度感知蒸馏（保留细粒度度量结构）和相对位姿关系蒸馏（强制跨视角空间一致性）。
Result: 在KITTI上达到220 FPS；轨迹预测PDMS 90.6，占用预测mIoU 24.63，未来帧预测IoU 47.67。
Conclusion: 高效的密集3D重建可作为自动驾驶中可扩展的基础几何表示，超越传统感知目标角色。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ZipSplat: Fewer Gaussians, Better Splats
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting methods reconstruct a scene from posed or pose-free images in a single forward pass, yet current approaches predict one Gaussian per input pixel, tying the representation budget to camera resolution rather than scene complexity. A flat wall and a richly textured object thus produce equally many Gaussians despite very different geometric needs. We propose ZipSplat, a token-based feed-forward model that decouples Gaussian placement from the pixel grid. A multi-view backbone extracts dense visual tokens, and k-means clustering compresses them into a compact set of scene tokens. Cross- and self-attention refine these tokens, and a lightweight MLP decodes each into a group of Gaussians with unconstrained 3D positions. Because clustering is applied at inference, a single trained model spans the quality-efficiency curve without retraining. ZipSplat operates without ground-truth poses or intrinsics, yet sets a new state of the art on DL3DV and RealEstate10K with ${\sim}6{\times}$ fewer Gaussians than pixel-aligned methods, surpassing the best pose-free baseline by 2.1dB and 1.2dB PSNR, respectively. It further generalizes zero-shot to Mip-NeRF360 and ScanNet++, outperforming all comparable baselines. Our project page is at https://veichta.com/zipsplat.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ZipSplat 是一种前馈式 3D 高斯泼溅方法，通过 token 机制将高斯数量与输入像素解耦，利用 k-means 聚类压缩视觉 token，生成更少但更优的高斯。在 DL3DV 和 RealEstate10K 上，以约 1/6 的高斯数超越基于像素的方法，PSNR 分别提升 2.1dB 和 1.2dB，并零样本泛化到 Mip-NeRF360 和 ScanNet++。
Motivation: 现有前馈式 3D 高斯泼溅方法为每个输入像素预测一个高斯，导致表示预算与相机分辨率绑定，而非场景复杂度，浪费资源于简单区域。
Method: 提出 ZipSplat，使用多视图骨干提取密集视觉 token，通过 k-means 聚类压缩为紧凑的场景 token，经交叉注意力和自注意力精炼，再由轻量 MLP 解码为多个高斯，位置不受约束。推理时聚类，单一模型可沿质量-效率曲线调整。
Result: 在 DL3DV 上以约 6 倍少的高斯数超越无位姿基线 2.1dB PSNR，在 RealEstate10K 上提升 1.2dB PSNR；零样本泛化到 Mip-NeRF360 和 ScanNet++ 并优于所有可比基线。
Conclusion: ZipSplat 首次将 token 压缩引入前馈式 3D 高斯泼溅，实现了更高效、更高质量的表示，且无需真实位姿或内参，具备强泛化能力。

papers.title: CoRe-MoE: Contrastive Reweighted Mixture of Experts for Multi-Terrain Humanoid Locomotion with Gait Adaptation
authors: Chenguang Yang (2) ((1) Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
papers.abstract_en: Humans primarily rely on walking and running to traverse complex terrains. Similarly, humanoid robots should be able to smoothly transition between walking and running while maintaining natural and stable locomotion. However, unifying gait transition and multi-terrain adaptation within a single policy remains challenging due to gradient interference between tasks and the distribution shift caused by terrain variations. Although Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures can mitigate multi-skill interference, direct joint training often fails to achieve clear expert specialization. To address these challenges, we propose CoRe-MoE, a two-stage reinforcement learning framework that decouples gait generation from terrain adaptation. In the first stage, a stable locomotion policy is learned to produce natural walking and running behaviors with smooth transitions. In the second stage, a terrain-aware MoE branch is introduced, and the gating network is trained with a contrastive objective to learn structured terrain representations and promote expert specialization. The final action is obtained through weighted fusion of the base gait policy and the terrain-aware branch, enabling the policy to preserve stable locomotion while adapting to complex terrains. Extensive simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms baseline approaches in terms of success rate, locomotion stability, and multi-terrain adaptability. Furthermore, zero-shot deployment on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot validates the effectiveness of our framework, achieving robust walking and running across stairs, slopes, steps, obstacles, and unstructured outdoor terrains while maintaining accurate foothold control and dynamic stability.
papers.comment: Kailun Huang, Zikang Xie, Yanzhe Xie and Panpan Liao contributed equally to this work. Corresponding authors: Renjing Xu, Haohui Huang and Chenguang Yang
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CoRe-MoE，一种两阶段强化学习框架，将步态生成与地形适应解耦，实现人形机器人在多地形上的稳定行走和奔跑。第一阶段学习基础步态策略，产生自然的走、跑及平滑过渡；第二阶段引入地形感知的混合专家（MoE）分支，通过对比学习训练门控网络，促进专家分化。最终动作通过加权融合基础策略和地形分支得到。仿真结果优于基线，并在Unitree G1机器人上零样本部署成功，验证了框架的有效性。
Motivation: 现有方法难以在一个策略中统一步态转换和多地形适应，因为任务间梯度干扰和地形变化导致分布偏移。标准MoE直接联合训练难以实现专家专业化。
Method: 两阶段RL框架：阶段一学习稳定基础步态策略（行走和奔跑）；阶段二引入地形感知MoE分支，用对比目标训练门控网络，学习结构化地形表示并促进专家分化。最终动作通过权重融合基础策略和地形分支得到。
Result: 仿真中在成功率、运动稳定性和多地形适应性上超越基线。在Unitree G1人形机器人上零样本部署，实现跨楼梯、斜坡、台阶、障碍物和非结构化户外地形的稳健行走和奔跑，保持精确的足部控制和动态稳定性。
Conclusion: 该方法通过解耦步态生成与地形适应，结合对比学习促进专家分化，有效提升了多地形人形机器人的步态适应能力，并展示了从仿真到真实机器人的零样本迁移性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EvoTrainer: Co-Evolving LLM Policies and Training Harnesses for Autonomous Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous LLM training is often framed as recipe search, which leaves the training harness largely static. This limitation sharpens in agentic RL, where shifting bottlenecks and scalar rewards mask diverse failure modes. We introduce EvoTrainer, an autonomous training framework that co-evolves LLM policies and training-side harnesses through empirical feedback: it diagnoses rollout-level evidence, revises diagnostics, backtests interventions, and accumulates reusable skills. Evaluated on mathematical reasoning, competitive-programming code generation, and repository-level software engineering, EvoTrainer matches or exceeds the human-engineered RL references under the same data, codebase, and evaluation protocol, with the largest gain on long-horizon agentic SWE. Trajectory analyses show that retained strategies diverge across domains, evolving diagnostics prevent invalid high-scoring branches from being promoted, and reusable skills shape later search. Autonomous LLM RL should move beyond recipe search toward joint evolution of policies and the training harnesses that interpret them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvoTrainer 是一个协同进化 LLM 策略和训练工具 (training harness) 的自主训练框架，通过经验反馈诊断轨迹、修正诊断、回测干预并积累可复用技能。在数学推理、竞赛编程和仓库级软件工程任务上，该框架在同等数据、代码库和评估协议下匹配或超越人工设计的强化学习基线，尤其在长周期智能体 SWE 任务上提升最大。轨迹分析表明，保留的策略在不同领域分化，演化的诊断可防止无效高分分支被提升，可复用技能塑造后续搜索。
Motivation: 现有自主 LLM 训练通常被框架化为配方搜索 (recipe search)，训练工具保持静态，这在智能体强化学习中成为瓶颈，因为标量奖励掩盖了多样的失败模式。
Method: 提出 EvoTrainer 框架，通过协同进化 LLM 策略和训练工具：诊断轨迹级证据、修正诊断、回测干预、积累可复用技能。
Result: 在数学推理、竞赛编程代码生成和仓库级软件工程上，EvoTrainer 在同等条件下匹配或超越人工设计的强化学习基线；在长周期智能体 SWE 任务上增益最大。
Conclusion: 自主 LLM 强化学习应超越配方搜索，转向策略与解释策略的训练工具的联合进化。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: EvoTrainer 是一个协同进化 LLM 策略和训练工具 (training harness) 的自主训练框架，通过经验反馈诊断轨迹、修正诊断、回测干预并积累可复用技能。在数学推理、竞赛编程和仓库级软件工程任务上，该框架在同等数据、代码库和评估协议下匹配或超越人工设计的强化学习基线，尤其在长周期智能体 SWE 任务上提升最大。轨迹分析表明，保留的策略在不同领域分化，演化的诊断可防止无效高分分支被提升，可复用技能塑造后续搜索。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有自主 LLM 训练通常被框架化为配方搜索 (recipe search)，训练工具保持静态，这在智能体强化学习中成为瓶颈，因为标量奖励掩盖了多样的失败模式。
summary_sections.method: 提出 EvoTrainer 框架，通过协同进化 LLM 策略和训练工具：诊断轨迹级证据、修正诊断、回测干预、积累可复用技能。
summary_sections.result: 在数学推理、竞赛编程代码生成和仓库级软件工程上，EvoTrainer 在同等条件下匹配或超越人工设计的强化学习基线；在长周期智能体 SWE 任务上增益最大。
summary_sections.conclusion: 自主 LLM 强化学习应超越配方搜索，转向策略与解释策略的训练工具的联合进化。

papers.title: Multi-component Causal Tracing in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Causal tracing systematically intervenes on a large language model's (LLM's) internal representations to uncover and quantify the causal pathways linking specific inputs or computations to specific metrics of interest, quantifying the LLM's behavior. Building on previous single-component or single-layer studies, this paper presents a unified framework for causally tracing multiple components simultaneously. This framework systematically identifies the subsets of components (e.g., attention heads and multi-layer perceptron neurons) most critical to a desired target performance metric (e.g., accuracy and fairness). This is achieved by incorporating flexible interventions applied to a wide range of desired metrics. To address the combinatorial complexity of the multi-component problem, an efficient algorithm is designed that leverages soft interventions and a carefully designed metric transformation, converting the combinatorial search problem into a continuous one that can be solved efficiently under proper constraints, thereby generating proper binary decisions for selecting components. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method efficiently identifies subsets of the model's components that have a high impact on the target metric, outperforming existing baseline approaches. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZiruiYan/multi-component-causal-tracing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一框架，用于同时追踪大语言模型中多个内部组件（如注意力头、MLP神经元）对目标性能指标（如准确率、公平性）的因果贡献。通过软干预和度量变换，将组合搜索问题转化为连续优化问题，高效识别关键组件子集。实验表明该方法在多个指标上优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有因果追踪方法通常局限于单组件或单层分析，无法处理多组件组合对模型行为的联合影响，且组合搜索存在指数级复杂度。
Method: 设计一个包含软干预和度量变换的高效算法，将离散的组合选择问题转化为带约束的连续优化问题，从而快速确定对目标指标影响最大的组件子集。
Result: 实验表明，该方法能有效识别出对目标指标（如准确性、公平性）影响显著的组件子集，性能超过现有基线方法。
Conclusion: 多组件因果追踪框架可以更全面地揭示LLM内部工作机制，为模型解释和调试提供新工具。代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Identifiable Markov Switching Models with Instantaneous Effects and Exponential Families
papers.abstract_en: Temporal systems often exhibit non-stationary behaviour, such as seasonal climate variation or glucose fluctuations in patients with type-1 diabetes. One way to model non-stationarity is through discrete latent regimes, i.e., stationary segments of time. Such systems induce a Markov Switching Model (MSM), a class of Hidden Markov Models with autoregressive dependencies among latent regimes and observed variables. Identifying latent regimes is challenging in the presence of frequent regime switches and nonlinear and non-Gaussian dynamics, particularly when there are instantaneous effects between the variables, e.g., due to slow rates of measurements. In this work, we establish the identifiability of both latent regimes and regime-dependent causal structures under temporal regime dependencies, nonlinear lagged and instantaneous effects, and independent noise from the exponential family. Our identifiability theory subsumes non-temporal mixtures of causal models. Furthermore, we introduce FlowMSM, a regime detection framework that can be paired with any stationary causal discovery method to recover regime-dependent causal structures. Experiments on synthetic benchmarks and a financial economics dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach to detect latent regimes and discover causal structures from non-stationary time series.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对存在瞬时效应、非线性滞后效应和指数族噪声的非平稳时间序列，建立了马尔可夫切换模型（MSM）中隐状态和依赖因果结构的可识别性理论，并提出了FlowMSM框架用于机制检测。实验在合成数据和金融经济学数据集上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有马尔可夫切换模型在频繁切换、非线性、非高斯动态以及瞬时效应下难以识别隐状态和因果结构，特别是在测量速率较低时。
Method: 从理论上证明了在时间机制依赖、非线性滞后和瞬时效应、指数族独立噪声条件下隐状态和机制依赖因果结构的可识别性；并引入FlowMSM框架，可与任意平稳因果发现方法结合，恢复机制依赖的因果结构。
Result: 在合成基准和金融经济学数据集上展示了方法在检测隐状态和发现非平稳时间序列因果结构方面的有效性。
Conclusion: 理论与方法可恢复非平稳时间序列中的隐机制和因果结构，且适用于更一般的非高斯和非线性情况。

papers.title: Evidence-Gated LLM Priors for Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as heuristic advisors for black-box optimization, yet their suggestions and self-reported confidence are not necessarily calibrated to downstream objective values. This issue becomes more pronounced in multi-objective Bayesian optimization, where different objectives may require different expert knowledge and where an LLM expert can be useful for one objective but misleading for another. We study how to use LLM-generated expert priors in discrete multi-objective Bayesian optimization without blindly trusting them. We propose an objective-wise reputation-market mechanism that treats each expert-objective pair as a falsifiable prior source. Expert weights are updated online from observed objective feedback, discounted over time, and gated by market-level trust. We then introduce a decoupled counterfactual gate that can use the LLM prior without confidence, use it with confidence, or abstain from the LLM prior entirely. Across controlled synthetic stress tests and three molecule optimization benchmarks with \qwenflash{}-generated expert priors, we find that dynamic objective-wise calibration improves robustness over fixed LLM priors. However, raw LLM confidence is not reliably beneficial: on ESOL, confidence is positively correlated with prediction error; on FreeSolv, confidence can help; and on Lipophilicity, ignoring confidence remains strongest. Our fixed three-arm counterfactual gate improves over the first counterfactual variant on ESOL and FreeSolv, while an attempted margin portfolio exposes a useful negative result: margin selection should be acquisition-aware rather than based only on one-step prior error.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多目标贝叶斯优化中LLM先验不可靠的问题，提出一种目标级声誉市场机制，通过在线更新专家权重和解耦反事实门控，动态校准每个专家-目标对的置信度。在合成测试和三个分子优化基准上，该方法比固定LLM先验更鲁棒，但原始LLM置信度并非总是有益。
Motivation: LLM先验和建议的置信度与目标值不校准，在多目标优化中不同目标可能需要不同专家知识，盲目信任LLM可能导致误导。
Method: 提出目标级声誉市场机制，将每个专家-目标对作为可伪造先验源，在线更新权重并随时间衰减，通过市场级信任门控。引入解耦反事实门控，可选择使用LLM先验（带或不带置信度）或完全弃用。
Result: 在合成测试和QwenFlash生成的专家先验的三个分子优化基准（ESOL、FreeSolv、Lipophilicity）上，动态目标级校准优于固定LLM先验。但LLM置信度不可靠：ESOL上置信度与预测误差正相关，仅FreeSolv上有效，Lipophilicity上忽略置信度最强。固定三臂反事实门控在ESOL和FreeSolv上优于第一个变体，而边缘组合证明了负结果。
Conclusion: 动态目标级校准能提升多目标贝叶斯优化中LLM先验的鲁棒性，但LLM置信度需谨慎使用；边缘选择应基于获取意识而非单步先验误差。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Representation Forcing for Bottleneck-Free Unified Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) aim to handle perception and generation in a single model. Yet existing UMMs still rely on a frozen, separately pretrained VAE for image generation, imposing a structural bottleneck. Naively removing it introduces a quality gap, as the model must learn both high-level structure and low-level details from raw pixels. In this paper, we propose Representation Forcing (RF), a technique that closes this gap by making representation prediction a native capability of the model. Concretely, RF forces the decoder to autoregressively predict visual representations as intermediate tokens before pixels; these tokens then stay in context to guide pixel diffusion within the same backbone. By turning representations from perception outputs into generation targets, RF eliminates the need for any external generative latent space. We find that RF benefits both understanding and generation. On image generation, our pixel-space model with RF matches state-of-the-art VAE-based unified models. On image understanding, pixel-space RF generally outperforms its VAE-based variant. Together, these results offer an effective step toward end-to-end, bottleneck-free UMMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出表示强制（Representation Forcing, RF）技术，用于消除统一多模态模型中的VAE瓶颈，使模型能从原始像素直接学习生成，无需外部生成潜在空间。实验表明，在图像生成上，像素空间模型配合RF匹配了最先进的基于VAE的统一模型；在图像理解上，像素空间RF通常优于其VAE变体。
Motivation: 现有统一多模态模型依赖冻结的、独立预训练的VAE进行图像生成，造成结构瓶颈；直接移除VAE会导致质量下降，因为模型需同时学习高级结构和低级细节。
Method: 表示强制（RF）通过强制解码器在生成像素前自回归地预测视觉表示作为中间token，这些token保留在上下文中指导同一骨干网络内的像素扩散，从而将表示从感知输出转变为生成目标，消除对外部生成潜在空间的需求。
Result: 在图像生成上，像素空间RF模型匹配了最先进的VAE-based统一模型；在图像理解上，像素空间RF通常优于其VAE变体。
Conclusion: 这些结果表明RF是实现端到端、无瓶颈统一多模态模型的有效步骤。

papers.title: VikingMem: A Memory Base Management System for Stateful LLM-based Applications
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models have revolutionized interactive applications; however, their finite context windows pose a critical data management challenge for maintaining stateful, long-term interactions. Existing memory approaches often rely on simplistic extraction methods that lead to incomplete memories or use rigid, single-purpose memory extraction prompts tailored to a single use case, such as chatbots. Consequently, they lack generalizability and perform poorly across diverse downstream tasks. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Memory Base, a novel data management paradigm for managing the persistent state of long-term interactions. It is characterized by three core principles: selective extraction of high-value memories from raw information streams; inherent statefulness and evolution, where memory content is progressively summarized, corrected, and temporally weighted to prioritize recent interactions; and a generalizable abstraction paradigm designed for robust transferability across diverse applications, including education, recommendation, and agent memory. Building on this foundation, we present VikingMem, an end-to-end Memory Base Management System implemented on the VikingDB vector engine. VikingMem materializes this paradigm through interconnected event and entity abstractions. It features event-centric memory extraction to selectively handle complex information streams, while entities are dynamically updated by events to achieve stateful evolution. Using temporal compression via a topic-wise timeline and time-weighted recall, the system progressively produces high-level summary memories, prioritizes recent items, and compresses and fades older ones. Extensive evaluations on long-term memory benchmarks demonstrate that VikingMem outperformes baselines by up to 30% in memory retrieval effectiveness while maintaining the low latency essential for interactive applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Memory Base范式，用于管理基于LLM的状态化长期交互记忆。核心原则包括选择性提取高价值记忆、状态演化（逐步总结、修正、时间加权）以及泛化抽象。基于此实现VikingMem系统，在VikingDB向量引擎上通过事件与实体抽象实现事件中心提取、实体动态更新、时间压缩等功能。实验表明在长期记忆基准上检索效果比基线提升最多30%，同时保持低延迟。
Motivation: LLM的有限上下文窗口导致维护状态化长期交互的数据管理挑战。现有记忆方法依赖简单的提取或针对单一场景的固定提示，缺乏泛化性，难以在多样下游任务中表现良好。
Method: 提出Memory Base范式，核心为选择性提取、状态演化、泛化抽象三条原则。VikingMem具体实现：采用事件和实体抽象，通过事件中心提取处理复杂信息流，实体由事件动态更新实现状态演化；利用话题时间线进行时间压缩、时间加权召回，渐进生成高层摘要记忆，优先近期内容并压缩淡化旧信息。
Result: 在长期记忆基准上，VikingMem的记忆检索效果比基线提升最多30%，同时保持交互应用所需的低延迟。
Conclusion: 摘要表明Memory Base范式及VikingMem系统能有效管理LLM的长期交互状态，并具备跨教育、推荐、智能体等多种应用的泛化能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Models That Know How Evaluations Are Designed Score Safer
papers.abstract_en: The validity of AI safety evaluations depends on models behaving consistently across controlled and deployment settings. Prior work has identified test-time contextual cues, such as hypothetical scenarios, as a source of verbalized evaluation awareness and subsequent behavioral shift. In this paper, we investigate a potential explanation of this phenomenon: evaluation meta-knowledge, defined as parametric knowledge about the structural traits that characterize evaluations. Similar to dataset contamination, where benchmark exposure leads to higher performance through memorization, we hypothesize that models trained on texts describing evaluation practices may implicitly learn to recognize and respond to evaluation-like contexts, for instance, through exposure to scientific articles or social media posts about AI benchmarking. To test this, we fine-tune models on synthetic documents describing evaluation traits such as verifiable structures or moral dilemmas. Evaluating this fine-tuned model on five safety benchmarks, we find that it is significantly safer than the base model and control model. This behavioral shift persists even when restricting the analysis to responses lacking explicit verbalization of evaluation awareness. Our results demonstrate that evaluation meta-knowledge may inflate safety benchmark performance, introducing a novel confounder that is independent of explicit memorization or verbalized evaluation awareness, thus, challenging to detect. These findings have important implications for the design and interpretation of AI safety evaluations. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/compass-group-tue/arxiv2026_evaluation_meta_knowledge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究AI模型在安全评估中表现改善的原因，提出“评估元知识”概念，即模型通过训练数据中的评估描述（如科学文章或社交媒体帖子）学习识别评估情境，从而在安全基准上表现更优。通过微调模型合成文档，实验发现该模型在五个安全基准上显著更安全，且行为转变在无明确评估意识表达时仍存在，表明评估元知识可能是一个独立于显式记忆的混杂因素。
Motivation: 现行AI安全评估的可信度依赖于模型在不同场景下的一致性，但已有研究发现测试时上下文线索（如假设情境）会导致模型行为变化。本文旨在探究这种变化的一种潜在解释：模型是否通过学习评估的结构特征（评估元知识）来调整行为，类似于数据集污染但更隐蔽。
Method: 作者通过微调模型合成文档，这些文档描述了评估的结构特征（如可验证结构或道德困境），然后在五个安全基准上评估微调后的模型，并与基线和控制模型对比。
Result: 微调后的模型在安全基准上显著更安全，即使仅考虑未明确表达评估意识的响应，该行为转变依然存在。这表明评估元知识可能人为提升安全基准性能，且难以检测。
Conclusion: 评估元知识是AI安全评估中一个被忽视的混杂因素，它独立于显式记忆或口头化的评估意识，对评估设计和解释具有重要影响。代码和模型已开源。

papers.title: Time Series Causal Discovery via Context-Conditioned and Causality-Augmented Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Causal discovery from time series is critical for many real-world applications, such as tracing the root causes of anomalies. Existing approaches typically rely on dataset-specific optimization, making it difficult to transfer their causal discovery capabilities to new time series governed by diverse causal mechanisms. In this paper, we propose \textbf{PTCD}, a novel \textbf{P}retraining framework for \textbf{T}ime-series \textbf{C}ausal \textbf{D}iscovery, which improves cross-task generalization through context-conditioned modeling and transferable causal augmentation. To model complex temporal causal dependencies, PTCD employs a dual-scale iterative attention mechanism to capture window-level causal relationships, and a Gaussian mixture with a context-level routing mechanism to handle heterogeneous exogenous distributions. To further address distribution shifts across causal graphs, PTCD adopts a pretraining paradigm on synthetic datasets that integrates intervention-based learning and a causal mixup strategy, promoting stable causal discovery and stronger generalization. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets demonstrate that PTCD excels in both causal discovery and root cause identification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PTCD，一个用于时间序列因果发现的预训练框架。通过上下文条件建模和因果增强提高跨任务泛化能力，采用双尺度迭代注意力机制捕获窗口级因果关系，并利用高斯混合与上下文路由处理异质外生分布。在多个真实场景的 OOD 数据集上，因果发现和根因定位均表现优异。
Motivation: 现有时间序列因果发现方法依赖数据集特定优化，难以将因果发现能力迁移到具有不同因果机制的新时间序列上。
Method: PTCD 框架包含：双尺度迭代注意力机制建模窗口级因果关系；上下文路由的高斯混合处理异质外生分布；基于合成数据的预训练范式，整合干预学习和因果混合策略。
Result: 在多个真实世界分布外（OOD）数据集上，PTCD 在因果发现和根因识别任务中均达到最佳性能。
Conclusion: PTCD 通过预训练和上下文条件建模有效提升了时间序列因果发现的跨任务泛化能力。
