papers.title: Metabolic cost of information processing in Poisson variational autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Computation in biological systems is fundamentally energy-constrained, yet standard theories of computation treat energy as freely available. Here, we argue that variational free energy minimization under a Poisson assumption offers a principled path toward an energy-aware theory of computation. Our key observation is that the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence term in the Poisson free energy objective becomes proportional to the prior firing rates of model neurons, yielding an emergent metabolic cost term that penalizes high baseline activity. This structure couples an abstract information-theoretic quantity -- the *coding rate* -- to a concrete biophysical variable -- the *firing rate* -- which enables a trade-off between coding fidelity and energy expenditure. Such a coupling arises naturally in the Poisson variational autoencoder (P-VAE) -- a brain-inspired generative model that encodes inputs as discrete spike counts and recovers a spiking form of *sparse coding* as a special case -- but is absent from standard Gaussian VAEs. To demonstrate that this metabolic cost structure is unique to the Poisson formulation, we compare the P-VAE against Grelu-VAE, a Gaussian VAE with ReLU rectification applied to latent samples, which controls for the non-negativity constraint. Across a systematic sweep of the KL term weighting coefficient $β$ and latent dimensionality, we find that increasing $β$ monotonically increases sparsity and reduces average spiking activity in the P-VAE. In contrast, Grelu-VAE representations remain unchanged, confirming that the effect is specific to Poisson statistics rather than a byproduct of non-negative representations. These results establish Poisson variational inference as a promising foundation for a resource-constrained theory of computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出泊松变分自编码器（P-VAE），通过将KL散度项与神经元先验发放率相关联，引入代谢成本，从而实现编码保真度与能量消耗的权衡。与高斯VAE的对比实验表明，该代谢成本结构是泊松公式特有的，且增加KL权重β会单调提升稀疏性并降低平均发放率。
Motivation: 生物系统的计算受能量约束，但现有计算理论假设能量自由可用，缺乏能量感知框架。本文旨在通过泊松变分推断建立资源受限的计算理论。
Method: 在P-VAE中，KL散度项正比于先验发放率，形成代谢成本项，耦合了编码率（coding rate）与发放率（firing rate）。通过系统改变KL权重β和潜在维度，并与施加非负约束的Grelu-VAE对比，验证泊松统计的独特性。
Result: 增加β单调提升稀疏性并降低平均发放率；Grelu-VAE的表征不受β影响，证明该效应源于泊松统计而非非负约束。
Conclusion: 泊松变分推断为资源受限的计算理论提供了有前景的基础，其代谢成本结构自然解释了神经编码中的能量效率。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Deep Doubly Debiased Longitudinal Effect Estimation with ICE G-Computation
papers.abstract_en: Estimating longitudinal treatment effects is essential for sequential decision-making but is challenging due to treatment-confounder feedback. While Iterative Conditional Expectation (ICE) G-computation offers a principled approach, its recursive structure suffers from error propagation, corrupting the learned outcome regression models. We propose D3-Net, a framework that mitigates error propagation in ICE training and then applies a robust final correction. First, to interrupt error propagation during learning, we train the ICE sequence using Sequential Doubly Robust (SDR) pseudo-outcomes, which provide bias-corrected targets for each regression. Second, we employ a multi-task transformer with a covariate simulator head for auxiliary supervision, regularizing representation learning, and a target network to stabilize training dynamics. For the final estimate, we discard the SDR correction and instead use the uncorrected nuisance models to perform Longitudinal Targeted Minimum Loss-Based Estimation (LTMLE) on the original outcomes. This second-stage, targeted debiasing ensures robustness and optimal finite-sample properties. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our model, D3-Net, robustly reduces bias and variance across different horizons, counterfactuals, and time-varying confoundings, compared to existing state-of-the-art ICE-based estimators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对纵向治疗效果估计中的因果推断问题，提出 D3-Net 框架，通过双重去偏方法减少 ICE G-computation 中的误差传播。第一重使用序贯双重稳健伪结果进行训练，第二重采用纵向目标最小损失估计进行最终校正。实验表明，D3-Net 在多种时间依赖混杂场景下稳健地降低了偏差和方差。
Motivation: 现有 ICE G-computation 方法在处理治疗-混杂反馈时存在误差传播问题，导致结果回归模型学习不准确，影响纵向治疗效果估计的可靠性。
Method: 提出 D3-Net：1) 在 ICE 训练阶段使用序贯双重稳健伪结果作为偏校正目标，打断误差传播；2) 采用多任务Transformer，包含协变量模拟器头进行辅助监督和表示学习正则化，以及目标网络稳定训练；3) 最终估计阶段舍弃SDR校正，改用纵向目标最小损失估计对原始结果进行去偏。
Result: 综合实验表明，D3-Net 在不同时间窗口、反事实和时间变化混杂条件下，相比现有最先进的基于 ICE 的估计器，稳健地降低了偏差和方差。
Conclusion: 本文提出的双重去偏框架有效缓解了 ICE G-computation 中的误差传播，并提供了最优有限样本性质。

papers.title: Generalizing GNNs with Tokenized Mixture of Experts
papers.abstract_en: Deployed graph neural networks (GNNs) are frozen at deployment yet must fit clean data, generalize under distribution shifts, and remain stable to perturbations. We show that static inference induces a fundamental tradeoff: improving stability requires reducing reliance on shift-sensitive features, leaving an irreducible worst-case generalization floor. Instance-conditional routing can break this ceiling, but is fragile because shifts can mislead routing and perturbations can make routing fluctuate. We capture these effects via two decompositions separating coverage vs selection, and base sensitivity vs fluctuation amplification. Based on these insights, we propose STEM-GNN, a pretrain-then-finetune framework with a mixture-of-experts encoder for diverse computation paths, a vector-quantized token interface to stabilize encoder-to-head signals, and a Lipschitz-regularized head to bound output amplification. Across nine node, link, and graph benchmarks, STEM-GNN achieves a stronger three-way balance, improving robustness to degree/homophily shifts and to feature/edge corruptions while remaining competitive on clean graphs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对部署后图神经网络（GNN）在清洁数据拟合、分布偏移泛化和扰动稳定性之间的固有折中，提出STEM-GNN框架。该框架采用混合专家（Mixture-of-Experts）编码器提供多样计算路径，通过向量量化（Vector-Quantized）令牌接口稳定编码器到头部信号，并结合Lipschitz正则化头部限制输出放大。在九个节点、边和图基准上，STEM-GNN实现了更强的三方面平衡，提升了对度数/同质性偏移和特征/边扰动的鲁棒性，同时在清洁图上保持竞争力。
Motivation: 静态推理下GNN在稳定性和泛化性之间存在根本性折中：提升稳定性需减少对偏移敏感特征的依赖，但会留下不可约的最坏情况泛化底线。实例条件路由可打破此界限，但易受偏移误导路由和扰动导致路由波动。
Method: 提出STEM-GNN框架，包括：1）混合专家编码器用于多样计算路径；2）向量量化令牌接口稳定编码器到头部信号；3）Lipschitz正则化头部限制输出放大。通过覆盖与选择、基础敏感性与波动放大的两种分解来指导设计。
Result: 在九个节点、边和图基准上，STEM-GNN实现了更强的稳定性、泛化性和清洁图性能三方面平衡，提升了对度数/同质性偏移以及特征/边扰动的鲁棒性，同时在清洁图上保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 通过分解揭示了实例条件路由的脆弱性，STEM-GNN有效打破了静态推理中的折中，为GNN部署提供了更好的三方面平衡。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Minimum Distance Summaries for Robust Neural Posterior Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Simulation-based inference (SBI) enables amortized Bayesian inference by first training a neural posterior estimator (NPE) on prior-simulator pairs, typically through low-dimensional summary statistics, which can then be cheaply reused for fast inference by querying it on new test observations. Because NPE is estimated under the training data distribution, it is susceptible to misspecification when observations deviate from the training distribution. Many robust SBI approaches address this by modifying NPE training or introducing error models, coupling robustness to the inference network and compromising amortization and modularity. We introduce minimum-distance summaries, a plug-in robust NPE method that adapts queried test-time summaries independently of the pretrained NPE. Leveraging the maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) as a distance between observed data and a summary-conditional predictive distribution, the adapted summary inherits strong robustness properties from the MMD. We demonstrate that the algorithm can be implemented efficiently with random Fourier feature approximations, yielding a lightweight, model-free test-time adaptation procedure. We provide theoretical guarantees for the robustness of our algorithm and empirically evaluate it on a range of synthetic and real-world tasks, demonstrating substantial robustness gains with minimal additional overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对神经后验估计（NPE）在测试时数据分布偏移下的鲁棒性问题，提出一种插件式方法——最小距离摘要（minimum-distance summaries）。该方法在测试阶段独立于预训练NPE，利用最大平均差异（MMD）调整查询的摘要统计量，使其与观测数据一致，从而继承MMD的强鲁棒性。作者通过随机傅里叶特征实现高效计算，并提供理论保证。
Motivation: 标准NPE在训练数据分布下估计，当测试观测偏离训练分布时容易产生错误推断。现有鲁棒SBI方法通常修改训练或引入误差模型，牺牲了可复用性和模块化。
Method: 提出最小距离摘要，在测试时通过MMD距离调整查询的摘要统计量，使摘要条件预测分布与观测数据分布匹配，独立于预训练NPE；使用随机傅里叶特征近似加速。
Result: 在合成和真实任务上展示了显著的鲁棒性提升，且额外开销极小；同时提供了鲁棒性的理论保证。
Conclusion: 该插件式方法在保持预训练NPE的模块化和摊销性同时，有效应对测试时分布偏移。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Efficient Large Language Reasoning Models via Extreme-Ratio Chain-of-Thought Compression
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning successfully enhances the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet it incurs substantial computational overhead for inference. Existing CoT compression methods often suffer from a critical loss of logical fidelity at high compression ratios, resulting in significant performance degradation. To achieve high-fidelity, fast reasoning, we propose a novel EXTreme-RAtio Chain-of-Thought Compression framework, termed Extra-CoT, which aggressively reduces the token budget while preserving answer accuracy. To generate reliable, high-fidelity supervision, we first train a dedicated semantically-preserved compressor on mathematical CoT data with fine-grained annotations. An LLM is then fine-tuned on these compressed pairs via a mixed-ratio supervised fine-tuning (SFT), teaching it to follow a spectrum of compression budgets and providing a stable initialization for reinforcement learning (RL). We further propose Constrained and Hierarchical Ratio Policy Optimization (CHRPO) to explicitly incentivize question-solving ability under lower budgets by a hierarchical reward. Experiments on three mathematical reasoning benchmarks show the superiority of Extra-CoT. For example, on MATH-500 using Qwen3-1.7B, Extra-CoT achieves over 73\% token reduction with an accuracy improvement of 0.6\%, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods. Our source codes have been released at https://github.com/Mwie1024/Extra-CoT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Extra-CoT框架，通过极端比率链式思维压缩减少推理计算量，同时保持答案准确性。方法包括训练语义保留压缩器、混合比率监督微调以及约束层次比率策略优化。在MATH-500等数学推理基准上，使用Qwen3-1.7B实现73%以上token缩减且准确率提升0.6%。
Motivation: 现有CoT推理产生大量计算开销，高压缩比下逻辑保真度损失严重，导致性能下降。
Method: 首先训练一个专用语义保留压缩器对数学CoT数据进行细粒度标注压缩；然后通过混合比率SFT微调LLM，使其适应不同压缩预算；最后提出CHRPO，通过分层奖励激励低预算下的解题能力。
Result: 在三个数学推理基准上，Extra-CoT优于现有方法。例如在MATH-500上用Qwen3-1.7B，实现超过73% token缩减且准确率提升0.6%。
Conclusion: Extra-CoT能在高压缩比下保持高保真度推理，显著降低计算成本。

papers.title: HyperPotter: Spell the Charm of High-Order Interactions in Audio Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: Advances in AIGC technologies have enabled the synthesis of highly realistic audio deepfakes capable of deceiving human auditory perception. Although numerous audio deepfake detection (ADD) methods have been developed, most rely on local temporal/spectral features or pairwise relations, overlooking high-order interactions (HOIs). HOIs capture discriminative patterns that emerge from multiple feature components beyond their individual contributions. We propose HyperPotter, a hypergraph-based framework designed to capture high-order relations associated with synergistic patterns through clustering-based hyperedges with class-aware prototype initialization. Extensive experiments on 13 test sets show that HyperPotter improves over the baseline on 11 sets, yielding an average relative EER reduction of 12.68\% across all test sets and 22.15\% on the improved sets. These results demonstrate strong cross-scenario generalization, while also revealing robustness limits under severe codec or channel distortion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HyperPotter，一个基于超图（hypergraph）的音频深度伪造检测框架，通过聚类基超边和类别感知原型初始化来捕获高阶交互（HOIs）。在13个测试集上的实验表明，HyperPotter在11个测试集上优于基线，平均相对EER降低12.68%，在改进集上降低22.15%。结果显示跨场景泛化能力强，但在严重编解码器或信道失真下存在鲁棒性限制。
Motivation: 现有音频深度伪造检测方法大多依赖局部时域/谱域特征或两两关系，忽略了高阶交互（HOIs），而HOIs能捕获多特征组件协同产生的判别模式。
Method: HyperPotter是一个超图框架，通过聚类基超边（clustering-based hyperedges）和类别感知原型初始化（class-aware prototype initialization）来捕获与协同模式相关的高阶关系。
Result: 在13个测试集上，HyperPotter在11个测试集上优于基线，所有测试集平均相对EER降低12.68%，在改进集上降低22.15%。
Conclusion: HyperPotter展示了强大的跨场景泛化能力，但也揭示了在严重编解码器或信道失真下的鲁棒性限制。

papers.title: Rethinking the Trust Region in LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a cornerstone for fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs), with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) serving as the de facto standard algorithm. Despite its ubiquity, we argue that the core ratio clipping mechanism in PPO is structurally ill-suited for the large vocabularies inherent to LLMs. PPO constrains policy updates based on the probability ratio of sampled tokens, which serves as a noisy single-sample Monte Carlo estimate of the true policy divergence. This creates a sub-optimal learning dynamic: updates to low-probability tokens are aggressively over-penalized, while potentially catastrophic shifts in high-probability tokens are under-constrained, leading to training inefficiency and instability. To address this, we propose Divergence Proximal Policy Optimization (DPPO), which substitutes heuristic clipping with a more principled constraint based on a direct estimate of policy divergence (e.g., Total Variation or KL). To avoid huge memory footprint, we introduce the efficient Binary and Top-K approximations to capture the essential divergence with negligible overhead. Extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate that DPPO achieves superior training stability and efficiency compared to existing methods, offering a more robust foundation for RL-based LLM fine-tuning. Our code is available at https://github.com/sail-sg/Stable-RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出PPO算法中比率裁剪机制对LLM大词表结构不适应，提出DPPO算法，用策略散度的直接估计（如TV或KL）替代启发式裁剪，并通过Binary/Top-K近似降低内存开销，实验表明DPPO在训练稳定性和效率上优于现有方法。
Motivation: PPO的比率裁剪机制在LLM大词表场景下存在结构性问题：低概率token被过度惩罚，高概率token的潜在危险更新却约束不足，导致训练低效和不稳定。
Method: 提出DPPO（Divergence Proximal Policy Optimization），用策略散度（如总变差或KL散度）的直接估计替代启发式裁剪，并引入高效的Binary和Top-K近似来捕获关键散度，避免巨大内存开销。
Result: 实验表明DPPO在训练稳定性和效率上优于现有方法。
Conclusion: DPPO为基于RL的LLM微调提供了更稳健的基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Quantized Evolution Strategies: High-precision Fine-tuning of Quantized LLMs at Low-precision Cost
papers.abstract_en: Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) is essential for deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) on memory-constrained devices, yet it renders models static and difficult to fine-tune. Standard fine-tuning paradigms, including Reinforcement Learning (RL), fundamentally rely on backpropagation and continuous weights to compute gradients. Thus they cannot be used on quantized models, where the parameter space is discrete and non-differentiable. While Evolution Strategies (ES) offer a backpropagation-free alternative, optimization of the quantized parameters can still fail due to vanishing or inaccurate gradient estimation. This paper introduces Quantized Evolution Strategies (QES), an optimization paradigm that performs full-parameter fine-tuning directly in the quantized space. QES is based on two innovations: (1) it integrates accumulated error feedback to preserve high-precision weight updating signals, and (2) it utilizes a stateless seed replay to reduce memory usage to low-precision inference levels. QES significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art zeroth-order fine-tuning methods on a variety of tasks, making direct fine-tuning for quantized models possible. It therefore opens up the possibility for scaling up LLMs entirely in the quantized space. The source code is available at https://github.com/dibbla/Quantized-Evolution-Strategies .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出量化进化策略（QES），一种直接在量化参数空间中对大规模语言模型进行全参数微调的优化范式。QES通过累积误差反馈保持高精度权重更新信号，并利用无状态种子重放将内存消耗降低到低精度推理水平。在多种任务上，QES显著优于现有的零阶微调方法，使得量化模型的直接微调成为可能。
Motivation: 标准微调依赖反向传播和连续权重，无法应用于离散且不可微的量化模型参数空间。进化策略虽无需反向传播，但梯度估计不准确或消失导致优化失败。
Method: 提出量化进化策略，包含两个创新：累积误差反馈以保持高精度更新信号；无状态种子重放以降低内存至低精度推理级别。
Result: 在多种任务上，QES显著优于最先进的零阶微调方法，使量化模型的直接微调成为可能。
Conclusion: 该方法为在量化空间中完全扩展LLM开辟了可能性，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fast Autoregressive Video Diffusion and World Models with Temporal Cache Compression and Sparse Attention
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive video diffusion models enable streaming generation, opening the door to long-form synthesis, video world models, and interactive neural game engines. However, their core attention layers become a major bottleneck at inference time: as generation progresses, the KV cache grows, causing both increasing latency and escalating GPU memory, which in turn restricts usable temporal context and harms long-range consistency. In this work, we study redundancy in autoregressive video diffusion and identify three persistent sources: near-duplicate cached keys across frames, slowly evolving (largely semantic) queries/keys that make many attention computations redundant, and cross-attention over long prompts where only a small subset of tokens matters per frame. Building on these observations, we propose a unified, training-free attention framework (FAST-AR) for FAST-AutoRegressive diffusion, consisting of three components: TempCache compresses the KV cache via temporal correspondence to bound cache growth; AnnCA accelerates cross-attention by selecting frame-relevant prompt tokens using fast approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) matching; and AnnSA sparsifies self-attention by restricting each query to semantically matched keys, also using a lightweight ANN. Together, these modules reduce attention, compute, and memory and are compatible with existing autoregressive diffusion backbones and world models. Experiments demonstrate up to x5 - x10 end-to-end speedups while preserving near-identical visual quality and, crucially, maintaining stable throughput and nearly constant peak GPU memory usage over long rollouts, where prior methods progressively slow down and suffer from increasing memory usage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自回归视频扩散模型推理时KV缓存增长导致的延迟和内存瓶颈，提出一种无需训练的统一注意力加速框架FAST-AR。该框架包含三个组件：TempCache通过时间对应压缩KV缓存以控制缓存增长；AnnCA使用快速近似最近邻匹配选择与帧相关的提示词令牌以加速交叉注意力；AnnSA通过将每个查询限制在语义匹配的键上稀疏化自注意力。实验表明，该方法在保持近相同视觉质量的同时实现5-10倍端到端加速，并在长序列生成中维持稳定的吞吐量和近乎恒定的峰值GPU内存使用。
Motivation: 自回归视频扩散模型的注意力层成为推理瓶颈：随着生成进行，KV缓存不断增长，导致延迟增加和GPU内存上升，限制了可用的时间上下文并损害长程一致性。
Method: 提出统一的训练自由注意力框架FAST-AR，包含三个模块：TempCache利用帧间时间对应压缩KV缓存；AnnCA通过快速近似最近邻（ANN）匹配选择帧相关的提示令牌来加速交叉注意力；AnnSA使用ANN将每个查询限制到语义匹配的键上稀疏化自注意力。
Result: 实验显示在自回归视频扩散模型上实现5-10倍端到端加速，同时保持近相同的视觉质量，并在长时间滚动生成中保持稳定的吞吐量和近乎恒定的峰值GPU内存使用。
Conclusion: 所提出的方法有效缓解了自回归视频扩散中的推理效率问题，与现有自回归扩散骨干和世界模型兼容，且无需重新训练。

papers.title: Pix2Fact: When Vision Is Not Enough -- Benchmarking Fine-Grained VQA with Web Verification on High-Resolution Real-World Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Despite progress on general tasks, vision-language models (VLMs) still struggle with challenges that demand both fine-grained visual grounding and external knowledge, a synergy overlooked by existing benchmarks that evaluate these abilities in isolation. To fill this void, we introduce Pix2Fact, a visual question-answering benchmark designed to assess expert-level visual perception and knowledge search. Pix2Fact comprises 1,000 high-resolution (4K+) images spanning eight scenarios. Its questions and answers are meticulously crafted by PhD-holding annotators from top global universities across diverse disciplines. Each question requires detailed visual grounding and the integration of external knowledge. Evaluating ten state-of-the-art VLMs, including proprietary models such as Gemini-3.1-Pro and GPT-5.4, we find that Pix2Fact poses a formidable challenge: the most advanced model (Gemini-3.1-Pro) achieves only 51.7% average accuracy, even with access to visual ground truth and search tools. Our analysis attributes this low accuracy to three factors, frequent visual grounding errors even with visual ground truth, shallow search harnessing, and VLM's inability to retrieve long-tail, unstructured local information. This striking gap exposes the limitations of current models in assisting humans with real-world scenarios that demand overwhelming visual comprehension. We believe Pix2Fact will serve as a critical benchmark to drive the next generation of language-vision agents that seamlessly integrate fine-grained perception with robust knowledge search.

papers.title: Residual Context Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to purely autoregressive language models because they can decode multiple tokens in parallel. However, state-of-the-art block-wise dLLMs rely on a "remasking" mechanism that decodes only the most confident tokens and discards the rest, effectively wasting computation. We demonstrate that recycling computation from the discarded tokens is beneficial, as these tokens retain contextual information useful for subsequent decoding iterations. In light of this, we propose Residual Context Diffusion (RCD), a module that converts these discarded token representations into contextual residuals and injects them back for the next denoising step. RCD uses a decoupled two-stage training pipeline to bypass the memory bottlenecks associated with backpropagation. We validate our method on both long CoT reasoning (SDAR) and short CoT instruction following (LLaDA) models. We demonstrate that a standard dLLM can be efficiently converted to the RCD paradigm with merely ~300 million tokens. RCD consistently improves frontier dLLMs by 4-11 percentage points in accuracy with minimal extra computation overhead across a wide range of benchmarks. Notably, on the most challenging AIME tasks, RCD nearly doubles baseline accuracy and attains up to 4-5x fewer denoising steps at baseline's peak accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出残差上下文扩散（RCD）模块，利用扩散大语言模型（dLLM）中丢弃的令牌表示作为上下文残差注入后续去噪步骤，避免计算浪费。通过解耦的两阶段训练绕过反向传播内存瓶颈，在长思维链推理（SDAR）和短思维链指令跟随（LLaDA）模型上验证。结果表明，RCD在标准dLLM上仅需约3亿令牌微调即可提升4-11个百分点准确率，在AIME任务上几乎翻倍基线准确率并减少4-5倍去噪步数。
Motivation: 现有块级dLLM依赖"remasking"机制，只解码最自信的令牌并丢弃其余部分，浪费计算资源。这些丢弃的令牌保留了对后续迭代有用的上下文信息。
Method: 提出RCD模块，将丢弃的令牌表示转换为上下文残差并注入下一步去噪循环。采用解耦的两阶段训练，先预训练dLLM再冻结其参数训练RCD，避免反向传播的显存瓶颈。
Result: 在多个基准上，RCD使前沿dLLM的准确率提升4-11个百分点，且额外计算开销极小。在AIME任务上，基线准确率近乎翻倍，并能在达到基线峰值准确率时减少4-5倍去噪步数。
Conclusion: RCD能高效地将标准dLLM转换为残差上下文范式，显著提升性能且仅需少量微调数据。所述方法适用于长思维链和短思维链模型。

papers.title: Enhancing Underwater Light Field Images via Global Geometry-aware Diffusion Process
papers.abstract_en: This work studies the challenging problem of acquiring high-quality underwater images via 4-D light field (LF) imaging. To this end, we propose GeoDiff-LF, a novel diffusion-based framework built upon SD-Turbo to enhance underwater 4-D LF imaging by leveraging its spatial-angular structure. GeoDiff-LF consists of three key adaptations: (1) a modified U-Net architecture with convolutional and attention adapters to model geometric cues, (2) a geometry-guided loss function using tensor decomposition and progressive weighting to regularize global structure, and (3) an optimized sampling strategy with noise prediction to improve efficiency. By integrating diffusion priors and LF geometry, GeoDiff-LF effectively mitigates color distortion in underwater scenes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework outperforms existing methods across both visual fidelity and quantitative performance, advancing the state-of-the-art in enhancing underwater imaging. The code will be publicly available at https://github.com/linlos1234/GeoDiff-LF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对水下光场（LF）成像质量提升问题，提出GeoDiff-LF框架，基于SD-Turbo扩散模型，通过改进U-Net架构、几何引导损失函数和优化采样策略，利用光场的空间-角度结构来抑制颜色失真。实验表明，该方法在视觉保真度和量化指标上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 水下成像常受颜色失真困扰，现有方法难以有效利用4-D光场数据中的全局几何结构。
Method: GeoDiff-LF包含三个关键适配：1）在U-Net中集成卷积和注意力适配器以建模几何线索；2）基于张量分解和渐进权重的几何引导损失函数，正则化全局结构；3）优化噪声预测采样策略提升效率。
Result: 大量实验表明，该框架在视觉保真度和量化性能上均优于现有方法，推动了水下成像增强的最新进展。
Conclusion: GeoDiff-LF通过融合扩散先验与光场几何，有效缓解水下颜色失真，但未提及在真实水下场景或其他光照条件下的泛化限制。

papers.title: Unsupervised Learning of Efficient Exploration: Pre-training Adaptive Policies via Self-Imposed Goals
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised pre-training can equip reinforcement learning agents with prior knowledge and accelerate learning in downstream tasks. A promising direction, grounded in human development, investigates agents that learn by setting and pursuing their own goals. The core challenge lies in how to effectively generate, select, and learn from such goals. Our focus is on broad distributions of downstream tasks where solving every task zero-shot is infeasible. Such settings naturally arise when the target tasks lie outside of the pre-training distribution or when their identities are unknown to the agent. In this work, we (i) optimize for efficient multi-episode exploration and adaptation within a meta-learning framework, and (ii) guide the training curriculum with evolving estimates of the agent's post-adaptation performance. We present ULEE, an unsupervised meta-learning method that combines an in-context learner with an adversarial goal-generation strategy that maintains training at the frontier of the agent's capabilities. On XLand-MiniGrid benchmarks, ULEE pre-training yields improved exploration and adaptation abilities that generalize to novel objectives, environment dynamics, and map structures. The resulting policy attains improved zero-shot and few-shot performance, and provides a strong initialization for longer fine-tuning processes. It outperforms learning from scratch, DIAYN pre-training, and alternative curricula. Code is available at: https://github.com/Octavio-Pappalardo/ulee-jax

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ULEE，一种无监督元学习方法，结合上下文学习器（in-context learner）与对抗性目标生成策略，在多情节探索与适应任务中预训练策略。在 XLand-MiniGrid 基准上，ULEE 预训练提升了零样本与少样本性能，并泛化至新目标、环境动态及地图结构。
Motivation: 无监督预训练可赋予强化学习智能体先验知识，但如何有效生成、选择并从自设目标中学习仍具挑战，尤其当下游任务分布广泛且零样本求解不可行时。
Method: 提出 ULEE：在元学习框架内优化多情节探索与适应，通过对抗性目标生成策略动态维持训练在智能体能力边界，并结合上下文学习器实现快速适配。
Result: 在 XLand-MiniGrid 基准上，ULEE 预训练获得的策略在零样本与少样本任务中优于从头学习、DIAYN 预训练及替代课程，并能为长时间微调提供强初始化。
Conclusion: ULEE 通过对抗性目标生成与上下文学习的结合，有效提升无监督预训练中探索与适应的泛化能力，但摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: FBSDiff++: Improved Frequency Band Substitution of Diffusion Features for Efficient and Highly Controllable Text-Driven Image-to-Image Translation
papers.abstract_en: With large-scale text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models achieving significant advancements in open-domain image creation, increasing attention has been focused on their natural extension to the realm of text-driven image-to-image (I2I) translation, where a source image acts as visual guidance to the generated image in addition to the textual guidance provided by the text prompt. We propose FBSDiff, a novel framework adapting off-the-shelf T2I diffusion model into the I2I paradigm from a fresh frequency-domain perspective. Through dynamic frequency band substitution of diffusion features, FBSDiff realizes versatile and highly controllable text-driven I2I in a plug-and-play manner (without need for model training, fine-tuning, or online optimization), allowing appearance-guided, layout-guided, and contour-guided I2I translation by progressively substituting low-frequency band, mid-frequency band, and high-frequency band of latent diffusion features, respectively. In addition, FBSDiff flexibly enables continuous control over I2I correlation intensity simply by tuning the bandwidth of the substituted frequency band. To further promote image translation efficiency, flexibility, and functionality, we propose FBSDiff++ which improves upon FBSDiff mainly in three aspects: (1) accelerate inference speed by a large margin (8.9$\times$ speedup in inference) with refined model architecture; (2) improve the Frequency Band Substitution module to allow for input source images of arbitrary resolution and aspect ratio; (3) extend model functionality to enable localized image manipulation and style-specific content creation with only subtle adjustments to the core method. Extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments verify superiority of FBSDiff++ in I2I translation visual quality, efficiency, versatility, and controllability compared to related advanced approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FBSDiff++，一种改进的频率域扩散特征替换框架，用于高效且高度可控的文本驱动图像到图像翻译。通过动态替换不同频带（低频、中频、高频）的潜在扩散特征，分别实现外观引导、布局引导和轮廓引导的翻译，并支持通过调节频带宽度连续控制翻译强度。相比基础版FBSDiff，FBSDiff++在推理速度（加速8.9倍）、支持任意分辨率输入和局部图像编辑方面有显著提升，实验证明其在视觉质量、效率和可控性上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有文本到图像扩散模型在图像翻译任务中需要微调或优化，且难以实现高效且细粒度的控制。
Method: 提出FBSDiff++框架，在预训练文本到图像扩散模型中通过动态频率带替换（低频/中频/高频）实现不同引导模式，并改进模型架构以加速推理、支持任意分辨率及局部编辑。
Result: FBSDiff++在推理速度上获得8.9倍加速，在视觉质量、效率和可控性方面优于多种先进方法。
Conclusion: 频率带替换方法为文本驱动图像翻译提供了高效、灵活且可控的解决方案，无需额外训练或优化。

papers.title: SMART: Scalable Mesh-free Aerodynamic Simulations from Raw Geometries using a Transformer-based Surrogate Model
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning-based surrogate models have emerged as more efficient alternatives to numerical solvers for physical simulations over complex geometries, such as car bodies. Many existing models incorporate the simulation mesh as an additional input, thereby reducing prediction errors. However, generating a simulation mesh for new geometries is computationally costly. In contrast, mesh-free methods, which do not rely on the simulation mesh, typically incur higher errors. Motivated by these considerations, we introduce SMART, a neural surrogate model that predicts physical quantities at arbitrary query locations using only a point-cloud representation of the geometry, without requiring access to the simulation mesh. The geometry and simulation parameters are encoded into a shared latent space that captures both structural and parametric characteristics of the physical field. A physics decoder then attends to the encoder's intermediate latent representations to map spatial queries to physical quantities. Through this cross-layer interaction, the model jointly updates latent geometric features and the evolving physical field. Extensive experiments show that SMART is competitive with and often outperforms existing methods that rely on the simulation mesh as input, demonstrating its capabilities for industry-level simulations.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2026, Seoul, South Korea
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SMART，一个基于 Transformer 的无网格代理模型，仅使用几何点云表示预测任意查询位置的物理量，无需仿真网格。通过将几何和仿真参数编码到共享隐空间，并用物理解码器跨层交互映射，SMART 在工业级空气动力学模拟上达到或超越了需要网格输入的方法。
Motivation: 现有基于机器学习的代理模型大多需要仿真网格作为输入，生成新几何的网格计算成本高；无网格方法则误差较大。SMART 旨在避免网格生成开销的同时保持高预测精度。
Method: 采用 Transformer 架构，将几何点云和仿真参数编码到共享隐空间；物理解码器通过跨层注意力机制关注编码器的中间表示，将空间查询映射到物理量，并联合更新几何特征和物理场。
Result: 大量实验显示 SMART 在多种空气动力学场景中与依赖仿真网格的方法竞争力相当，并且经常超越它们，证明了其在工业级模拟中的能力。
Conclusion: SMART 是一种有效的无网格替代模型，通过跨层交互和隐空间编码实现了无需仿真网格的高精度物理预测。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 SMART，一个基于 Transformer 的无网格代理模型，仅使用几何点云表示预测任意查询位置的物理量，无需仿真网格。通过将几何和仿真参数编码到共享隐空间，并用物理解码器跨层交互映射，SMART 在工业级空气动力学模拟上达到或超越了需要网格输入的方法。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有基于机器学习的代理模型大多需要仿真网格作为输入，生成新几何的网格计算成本高；无网格方法则误差较大。SMART 旨在避免网格生成开销的同时保持高预测精度。
summary_sections.method: 采用 Transformer 架构，将几何点云和仿真参数编码到共享隐空间；物理解码器通过跨层注意力机制关注编码器的中间表示，将空间查询映射到物理量，并联合更新几何特征和物理场。
summary_sections.result: 大量实验显示 SMART 在多种空气动力学场景中与依赖仿真网格的方法竞争力相当，并且经常超越它们，证明了其在工业级模拟中的能力。
summary_sections.conclusion: SMART 是一种有效的无网格替代模型，通过跨层交互和隐空间编码实现了无需仿真网格的高精度物理预测。

papers.title: Private Prediction via PAC Privacy
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models are increasingly served behind APIs. This renders private prediction, i.e., privatizing a model's outputs rather than its parameters, a natural privacy target: model outputs are lower-dimensional and far more stable to training-data changes than weights. While differential privacy (DP) cannot effectively exploit this as it calibrates noise to worst-case sensitivity that is intractable to bound for non-convex models, we argue that PAC privacy is a natural fit for private prediction. It is instance-based, and calibrates noise to a black-box function's empirical stability to control mutual-information (MI) leakage. The missing ingredient is efficient, adaptive composition. Serving predictions means answering a long stream of adaptively chosen queries from untrusted users; existing composition either fails under adaptivity, grows quadratically, or reverts to input-independent, DP-like noise. We close this gap with a new adversarial composition result via adaptive noise calibration and prove that MI accumulates only linearly under adaptive and adversarial querying. Experiments across modalities show that prediction stability enables high utility even at a tiny per-query budget: on CIFAR-10, we achieve 87.79% accuracy with a per-query MI budget of $2^{-32}$. This enables serving one million queries while provably bounding membership-inference success to 51.08% -- the same guarantee as $(0.04, 10^{-5})$-DP. Further, in the presence of auxiliary public data, the large volume of PAC-private predictions enables us to distill a publishable model that can be queried without limit. Concretely, 210,000 private labels on an ImageNet subset distill into a student reaching 91.86% accuracy on CIFAR-10 with membership inference success bounded by 50.49%, comparable to $(0.02, 10^{-5})$-DP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出使用PAC隐私（PAC privacy）作为机器学习模型私有预测（private prediction）的自然框架，解决了在自适应和对抗性查询下互信息（MI）累加的组合问题。通过自适应噪声校准，实现线性MI累加，并在CIFAR-10上以极小的每查询MI预算（2^{-32}）达到87.79%准确率，同时将成员推理攻击成功率限制在51.08%。此外，利用大量PAC私有预测结果可从公共数据中蒸馏出可公开查询的模型。
Motivation: 差分隐私（DP）在私有预测中效率低下，因为它需要针对非凸模型的难解最坏情况敏感性校准噪声。PAC隐私基于实例且校准噪声到经验稳定性，但缺乏高效的自适应组合方法，现有组合要么不适用于自适应查询，要么复杂度呈二次增长，要么退化为与输入无关的DP式噪声。
Method: 通过自适应噪声校准实现新的对抗性组合结果，证明互信息（MI）在自适应和对抗性查询下仅线性累加。该方法基于PAC隐私，利用模型预测的稳定性来校准噪声。
Result: 在CIFAR-10上，每查询MI预算为2^{-32}时达到87.79%准确率，服务一百万查询后成员推理成功率被限制在51.08%（相当于(0.04, 10^{-5})-DP）。在ImageNet子集上使用210,000个私有标签蒸馏的学生模型在CIFAR-10上达到91.86%准确率，成员推理成功率低于50.49%（相当于(0.02, 10^{-5})-DP）。
Conclusion: PAC隐私适用于私有预测场景，通过自适应组合实现高实用性，并能利用私有预测结果进行模型蒸馏，生成可任意查询的公开模型。

papers.title: Actionable Interpretability Must Be Defined in Terms of Symmetries
papers.abstract_en: This paper argues that interpretability research in Artificial Intelligence (AI) is fundamentally ill-posed as existing definitions of interpretability fail to describe how interpretability can be formally tested or designed for. We posit that actionable definitions of interpretability must be formulated in terms of *symmetries* that inform model design and lead to testable conditions. Under a probabilistic view, we hypothesise that four symmetries (inference equivariance, information invariance, concept-closure invariance, and structural invariance) suffice to (i) formalise interpretable models as a subclass of probabilistic models, (ii) yield a unified formulation of interpretable inference (e.g., alignment, interventions, and counterfactuals) as a form of Bayesian inversion, and (iii) provide a formal framework to verify compliance with safety standards and regulations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证了当前人工智能可解释性研究的基础定义存在缺陷，提出可操作的可解释性必须基于对称性（symmetries）来形式化定义。通过概率视角，假设四种对称性（推理等变性、信息不变性、概念闭包不变性、结构不变性）足以将可解释模型形式化为概率模型的子类，统一可解释推理（如对齐、干预、反事实）为贝叶斯逆推的一种形式，并提供验证安全标准合规性的形式化框架。
Motivation: 现有可解释性定义无法描述如何正式测试或设计可解释性，导致研究基础不牢。
Method: 提出基于四种对称性的可解释性形式化定义，在概率框架下将可解释模型视为概率模型的子类，并将可解释推理统一为贝叶斯逆推。
Result: 理论上表明四种对称性足以形式化可解释模型、统一可解释推理，并支持安全标准验证。
Conclusion: 可操作的可解释性必须基于对称性定义，才能指导模型设计并产生可测试条件。

papers.title: Temporal Complexity and Self-Organization in an Exponential Dense Associative Memory Model
papers.abstract_en: Dense Associative Memory (DAM) models generalize the classical Hopfield model by incorporating n-body or exponential interactions that greatly enhance storage capacity. While the criticality of DAM models has been largely investigated, mainly within a statistical equilibrium picture, little attention has been devoted to the temporal self-organizing behavior induced by learning. In this work, we investigate the behavior of a stochastic exponential DAM (SEDAM) model through the lens of Temporal Complexity (TC), a framework that characterizes complex systems by intermittent transition events between order and disorder and by scale-free temporal statistics. Transition events associated with birth-death of neural avalanche structures are exploited for the TC analyses and compared with analogous transition events based on coincidence structures. We systematically explore how TC indicators depend on control parameters, i.e., noise intensity and memory load. Our results reveal that the SEDAM model exhibits regimes of complex intermittency characterized by nontrivial temporal correlations and scale-free behavior, indicating the spontaneous emergence of self-organizing dynamics. Notably, such regimes arise over finite intervals of noise intensity rather than at a single critical point, consistent with the concept of extended criticality. Further, the noise intensity range needed to reach the critical region, where self-organizing behavior emerges, slightly decreases as the memory load increases. This study highlights the relevance of TC as a complementary framework for understanding learning and information processing in artificial and biological neural systems, revealing the link between the memory load and the self-organizing capacity of the network.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究随机指数密集关联记忆（SEDAM）模型的时间复杂性和自组织行为。通过时间复杂性框架分析神经雪崩的间歇性转变事件，发现模型在有限噪声强度区间内表现出非平凡时间关联和无标度行为，符合扩展临界性概念。记忆负载增加时，达到临界区的噪声强度范围略微减小。
Motivation: 现有密集关联记忆模型多从统计平衡角度研究临界性，缺乏对学习诱导的时间自组织行为的关注。
Method: 引入时间复杂性框架，利用神经雪崩结构的生灭转变事件进行分析，并与基于重合结构的转变事件比较，系统探索噪声强度和记忆负载对时间复杂性指标的影响。
Result: SEDAM模型展现出复杂间歇性区间，具有非平凡时间相关性和无标度行为，表明自组织动力学自发出现，且该区间存在于有限噪声强度范围而非单一点，支持扩展临界性概念。
Conclusion: 时间复杂性可作为理解人工和生物神经系统中学习与信息处理的补充框架，揭示记忆负载与网络自组织能力之间的关联。

papers.title: Concatenated Matrix SVD: Compression Bounds, Incremental Approximation, and Error-Constrained Clustering
papers.abstract_en: Large collections of matrices arise throughout modern machine learning, signal processing, and scientific computing, where they are commonly compressed by concatenation followed by truncated singular value decomposition (SVD). This strategy enables parameter sharing and efficient reconstruction and has been widely adopted across domains ranging from multi-view learning and signal processing to neural network compression. However, it leaves a fundamental question unanswered: which matrices can be safely concatenated and compressed together under explicit reconstruction error constraints? Existing approaches rely on heuristic or architecture-specific grouping and provide no principled guarantees on the resulting SVD approximation error. In the present work, we introduce a theory-driven framework for compression-aware clustering of matrices under SVD compression constraints. Our analysis establishes new spectral bounds for horizontally concatenated matrices, deriving global upper bounds on the optimal rank-$r$ SVD reconstruction error from lower bounds on singular value growth. The first bound follows from Weyl-type monotonicity under blockwise extensions, while the second leverages singular values of incremental residuals to yield tighter, per-block guarantees. We further develop an efficient approximate estimator based on incremental truncated SVD that tracks dominant singular values without forming the full concatenated matrix. Therefore, we propose three clustering algorithms that merge matrices only when their predicted joint SVD compression error remains below a user-specified threshold. The algorithms span a trade-off between speed, provable accuracy, and scalability, enabling compression-aware clustering with explicit error control.
papers.comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (06/2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对矩阵拼接后的截断奇异值分解（SVD）压缩问题，提出了理论驱动的压缩感知聚类框架。建立了水平拼接矩阵的谱界，推导了最优秩r SVD重构误差的全局上界，并提出了基于增量截断SVD的高效近似估计器。在此基础上设计了三种聚类算法，在保证用户指定重构误差阈值的前提下进行矩阵合并，实现了显式误差控制的压缩感知聚类。
Motivation: 现有矩阵压缩策略中，哪些矩阵可以安全地拼接并压缩，在给定重构误差约束下缺乏理论保证。现有方法依赖启发式或架构特定分组，无法提供SVD近似误差的原理性保证。
Method: 建立水平拼接矩阵的谱界，从奇异值增长的下界推导全局上界（基于Weyl型单调性）和逐块紧界（基于增量残差的奇异值）。开发基于增量截断SVD的高效估计器，避免形成完整拼接矩阵。提出三种聚类算法，通过预测联合SVD压缩误差是否低于用户指定阈值来决定是否合并矩阵，在速度、可证明准确性和可扩展性之间权衡。
Result: 摘要未明确给出具体数值结果，但声称建立了新的谱界并开发了高效估计算法。
Conclusion: 本文为SVD压缩约束下的矩阵聚类提供了理论驱动的框架，实现了显式误差控制的压缩感知聚类。

papers.title: Token-Level LLM Collaboration via FusionRoute
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strengths across diverse domains. However, achieving strong performance across these domains with a single general-purpose model typically requires scaling to sizes that are prohibitively expensive to train and deploy. On the other hand, while smaller domain-specialized models are much more efficient, they struggle to generalize beyond their training distributions. To address this dilemma, we propose FusionRoute, a robust and effective token-level multi-LLM collaboration framework in which a lightweight router simultaneously (i) selects the most suitable expert at each decoding step and (ii) contributes a complementary logit that refines or corrects the selected expert's next-token distribution via logit addition. Unlike existing token-level collaboration methods that rely solely on fixed expert outputs, we provide a theoretical analysis showing that pure expert-only routing is fundamentally limited: unless strong global coverage assumptions hold, it cannot in general realize the optimal decoding policy. By augmenting expert selection with a trainable complementary generator, FusionRoute expands the effective policy class and enables recovery of optimal value functions under mild conditions. Empirically, across both Llama-3 and Gemma-2 families and diverse benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning, code generation, and instruction following, FusionRoute outperforms both sequence- and token-level collaboration, model merging, and direct fine-tuning, while remaining competitive with domain experts on their respective tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出FusionRoute，一种token级别的多LLM协作框架，通过轻量路由器在每个解码步选择最合适的专家并贡献补充logit以修正或优化专家分布。理论分析表明纯专家路由存在根本局限，而FusionRoute通过可训练的互补生成器扩展有效策略类，可在温和条件下恢复最优值函数。在Llama-3和Gemma-2系列上，数学推理、代码生成、指令跟随等基准测试中优于序列/ token级协作、模型合并和直接微调，且与领域专家竞争力相当。
Motivation: 通用大模型成本高昂，小领域模型泛化能力有限，现有token级协作方法依赖固定专家输出，理论上有局限性。
Method: 轻量路由器同时执行两项任务：(i) 在每个解码步选择最合适的专家；(ii) 通过logit加法生成补充logit以修正或优化所选专家的下一token分布。路由器包含可训练的互补生成器，可学习调整专家输出。
Result: 在Llama-3和Gemma-2系列及数学推理、代码生成、指令跟随等多基准上，FusionRoute优于序列/ token级协作、模型合并、直接微调，并与领域专家表现相当。
Conclusion: FusionRoute通过结合专家选择与可训练补充logit，克服了纯专家路由的策略类局限性，在温和条件下可恢复最优值函数，为多LLM token级协作提供了有效且鲁棒的解决方案。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 轻量路由器同时执行两项任务：(i) 在每个解码步选择最合适的专家；(ii) 通过logit加法生成补充logit以修正或优化所选专家的下一token分布。路由器包含可训练的互补生成器，可学习调整专家输出。
summary_sections.result: 在Llama-3和Gemma-2系列及数学推理、代码生成、指令跟随等多基准上，FusionRoute优于序列/ token级协作、模型合并、直接微调，并与领域专家表现相当。
summary_sections.conclusion: FusionRoute通过结合专家选择与可训练补充logit，克服了纯专家路由的策略类局限性，在温和条件下可恢复最优值函数，为多LLM token级协作提供了有效且鲁棒的解决方案。

papers.title: CuMA: Aligning LLMs with Sparse Cultural Values via Demographic-Aware Mixture of Adapters
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) serve a global audience, alignment must transition from enforcing universal consensus to respecting cultural pluralism. We demonstrate that dense models, when forced to fit conflicting value distributions, suffer from \textbf{Mean Collapse}, converging to a generic average that fails to represent diverse groups. We attribute this to \textbf{Cultural Sparsity}, where gradient interference prevents dense parameters from spanning distinct cultural modes. To resolve this, we propose \textbf{\textsc{CuMA}} (\textbf{Cu}ltural \textbf{M}ixture of \textbf{A}dapters), a framework that frames alignment as a \textbf{conditional capacity separation} problem. By incorporating demographic-aware routing, \textsc{CuMA} internalizes a \textit{Latent Cultural Topology} to explicitly disentangle conflicting gradients into specialized expert subspaces. Extensive evaluations on WorldValuesBench, Community Alignment, and PRISM demonstrate that \textsc{CuMA} achieves state-of-the-art performance, significantly outperforming both dense baselines and semantic-only MoEs. Crucially, our analysis confirms that \textsc{CuMA} effectively mitigates mean collapse, preserving cultural diversity. Our code is available at https://github.com/Throll/CuMA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CuMA框架，通过人口感知路由的混合适配器（Mixture of Adapters）解决大语言模型在多文化价值对齐中的均值崩溃（Mean Collapse）和文化稀疏性（Cultural Sparsity）问题。在WorldValuesBench等基准上实现最先进性能，有效保持文化多样性。
Motivation: 现有对齐方法试图让模型符合普适价值共识，但不同文化群体的价值观存在冲突，密集模型因梯度干扰而收敛到通用平均值，无法代表多样群体。
Method: 将对齐视为条件容量分离问题，引入人口感知路由机制构建潜在文化拓扑（Latent Cultural Topology），显式将冲突梯度分离到专门的专家子空间。
Result: 在WorldValuesBench、Community Alignment和PRISM上取得最佳结果，显著优于密集基线和仅基于语义的MoE，并缓解了均值崩溃。
Conclusion: CuMA证明通过条件容量分离能有效处理文化价值冲突，为多文化场景下的LLM对齐提供新思路。

papers.title: Detecting Lookahead Bias in LLM Forecasts
papers.abstract_en: We develop a statistical procedure to detect lookahead bias in economic forecasts generated by large language models (LLMs). Using a date-only recall query for a firm-date pair, we estimate the probability that the LLM has internalized information about the realized outcome, a statistic we term Lookahead Propensity (LAP). LAP is materially positive throughout the in-sample period and collapses essentially to zero right after the training-data cutoff. We show that a positive interaction between LAP and the LLM forecast in an accuracy regression indicates lookahead-bias contamination, and apply the test to two forecasting tasks: news headlines predicting stock returns and earnings call transcripts predicting capital expenditures. In both applications, the LLM forecast's predictive power is amplified on high-LAP firm-date pairs, and the interaction loses significance on post-training-cutoff samples. Our test provides a cost-efficient, diagnostic tool for assessing the validity and reliability of LLM-generated forecasts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种统计检测方法，用于识别大语言模型（LLM）生成经济预测中的前瞻偏差（lookahead bias）。通过日期唯一召回查询估计LLM内化已实现结果信息的概率（称为Lookahead Propensity, LAP），发现LAP在样本期内显著为正，训练数据截止后降至零。将LAP与LLM预测的交互项用于准确性回归，可检验偏差污染。在新闻标题预测股票收益和财报电话会议记录预测资本支出两项任务中验证了方法有效性。
Motivation: LLM生成的经济预测可能无意中利用训练数据中包含的未来信息，导致前瞻偏差，影响预测有效性和可靠性。现有缺乏低成本、可操作性的诊断工具。
Method: 开发LAP统计量，通过仅包含日期的召回查询估计LLM对已实现结果的知晓概率；在预测准确性回归中加入LAP与LLM预测的交互项，检验其显著性以识别偏差。
Result: 在两项预测任务中，LLM预测的效力在高LAP样本点上被放大，且交互项在训练数据截止后的样本上失去显著性，表明方法有效检测前瞻偏差。
Conclusion: 该测试为评估LLM生成预测的效度和可靠性提供了成本低廉的诊断工具，有助于识别前瞻偏差污染。

papers.title: Fragile Knowledge, Robust Instruction-Following: The Width Pruning Dichotomy in Llama-3.2
papers.abstract_en: Structured width pruning of GLU-MLP layers in Llama-3.2 models, guided by the Peak-to-Peak Magnitude (PPM) criterion, reveals a systematic dichotomy in how reducing the expansion ratio affects different model capabilities. While performance on tasks relying on parametric knowledge (e.g., MMLU, GSM8K) and perplexity metrics degrades predictably with decreasing expansion ratios, instruction-following capabilities improve at the 2.4x equilibrium ratio (IFEval: +4.8 points / +46% in Llama-3.2-1B and +3.7 points / +39% in Llama-3.2-3B), and multi-step reasoning remains robust (MUSR). This pattern, observed consistently across both evaluated model sizes, challenges the prevailing assumption in compression research that pruning induces uniform degradation. To investigate this, we evaluated seven expansion ratio configurations using comprehensive benchmark suites that assess factual knowledge, mathematical reasoning, language comprehension, instruction-following, and truthfulness. Our analysis identifies the expansion ratio as a critical architectural parameter that selectively reshapes the model's task performance profile, rather than merely serving as a compression metric.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Code available at https://github.com/peremartra/llama-glu-expansion-pruning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究对 Llama-3.2 模型进行结构化宽度剪枝（基于峰-峰幅度准则）的影响，发现降低 GLU-MLP 层的扩展比会系统性损害依赖参数知识的任务（如 MMLU、GSM8K），但令人意外地提升了指令跟随能力（IFEval 提升 +4.8 分），且多步推理保持稳健。该发现挑战了剪枝导致均匀性能衰退的假设。
Motivation: 现有压缩研究通常认为剪枝会均匀降低模型能力，但本文通过实验发现不同能力对剪枝的敏感性不同，特别是指令跟随能力反而提升，因此需要重新审视扩展比作为架构参数的作用。
Method: 对 Llama-3.2 的 GLU-MLP 层采用基于峰-峰幅度（PPM）的结构化宽度剪枝，评估从 1.0x 到 4.0x 的七种扩展比配置，使用涵盖事实知识、数学推理、语言理解、指令跟随和真实性的综合基准。
Result: 在 2.4x 平衡比率下，指令跟随能力显著提升（IFEval: Llama-3.2-1B +4.8 分 / +46%，Llama-3.2-3B +3.7 分 / +39%），而 MMLU 和 GSM8K 等知识任务性能下降，多步推理（MUSR）保持稳健。
Conclusion: 扩展比是一个关键架构参数，它选择性重塑模型的任务性能剖面，而非仅作为压缩指标；剪枝可能对指令跟随等能力产生非单调影响。

papers.title: Schrödinger's Navigator: Imagining an Ensemble of Futures for Zero-Shot Object Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot object navigation (ZSON) requires robots to find target objects in unseen environments without task-specific fine-tuning or pre-built maps, a key capability for general-purpose service robots. Yet methods that perform well in simulation often degrade in cluttered real-world scenes with severe occlusion and latent hazards, where large unseen regions make single-scene inference brittle and unsafe. We propose Schrödinger's Navigator, a belief-aware framework that reasons at inference time over multiple trajectory-conditioned imagined 3D futures. Given candidate paths, a trajectory-conditioned 3D world model predicts hypothetical observations and maintains a superposition of plausible scene realizations rather than committing to one map. An adaptive occluder-aware sampler directs imagination to uncertainty-critical regions, while a Future-Aware Value Map (FAVM) aggregates imagined futures for robust, proactive action selection. Experiments in simulation and on a physical Go2 quadruped show that Schrödinger's Navigator outperforms strong ZSON baselines, improving hidden-target discovery and risk-aware waypoint selection in occlusion-heavy navigation scenarios. These results highlight imagined 3D futures as a scalable and generalizable strategy for zero-shot navigation in uncertain real-world environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Schrödinger's Navigator框架，在推理时通过轨迹条件3D世界模型想象多种可能的未来观测，从而在零样本目标导航中应对遮挡和未知区域。实验表明在模拟和物理Go2四足机器人上优于基线。
Motivation: 现有零样本目标导航方法在模拟中表现良好，但在遮挡严重、危险潜伏的杂乱真实场景中性能下降，单场景推理脆弱且不安全。
Method: 提出信念感知框架，包括轨迹条件3D世界模型（预测假设观测并保持叠加）、自适应遮挡感知采样器（聚焦不确定性关键区域）、未来感知价值图（FAVM）聚合想象未来以实现鲁棒主动动作选择。
Result: 在模拟和物理Go2四足机器人实验中，该方法在遮挡严重的导航场景中优于强基线，提高了隐藏目标发现率和风险感知路径点选择。
Conclusion: 想象3D未来可作为不确定真实世界中零样本导航的可扩展且泛化策略。

papers.title: Verbatim Chunks Beat Extracted Artifacts: A Controlled Ablation of Memory Representations for Long LLM Conversations
papers.abstract_en: A growing class of conversational-memory systems compresses dialogue history into structured artifacts -- extracted facts, decisions, or events -- on the premise that distilled structure retrieves better than raw text. We test this premise with a controlled ablation: within one fixed retrieval-rerank-reasoning pipeline, we swap only the stored representation -- LLM-extracted typed artifacts versus verbatim conversation chunks -- holding the model, retriever, reranker, and judge constant. Verbatim chunks win by 15.9 points on LoCoMo (43.9% vs. 28.0%) and 22.0 points on LongMemEval-S (67.4% vs. 45.4%); a 1-hop semantic graph does not recover the gap, and five confound controls reproduce the effect. The mechanism is lossy distillation: extraction discards verbatim detail that chunks retain for free, and the extracted-artifact pipeline never beats naive RAG in overall accuracy. Concurrent positive results with near-verbatim, provenance-preserving units fit the same account: retrieval accuracy tracks how far the representation departs from the source. For the extraction designs we test, structured memory should augment verbatim text rather than replace it: a chunks $\cup$ artifacts union store matches chunks on both benchmarks while artifacts alone forfeit the gap. Code and data: https://github.com/tao-hpu/cog-canvas
papers.comment: v2: substantially revised -- reframed from a system paper to a controlled ablation study; title and conclusions updated accordingly. 26 pages, 5 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过控制消融实验，在固定检索-重排序-推理流水线中比较了两种记忆表示：LLM提取的结构化工件（事实、决策等）与逐字对话块。结果表明，逐字块在两个长对话基准上显著优于结构化工件（LoCoMo 上 43.9% vs 28.0%；LongMemEval-S 上 67.4% vs 45.4%），原因在于提取过程丢失了详细内容。作者建议结构化记忆应作为逐字文本的补充而非替代。
Motivation: 现有对话记忆系统通常将对话历史压缩为结构化工件，假设提炼后的结构比原始文本检索效果更好。本文通过控制消融实验检验这一假设。
Method: 在固定检索-重排序-推理流水线中，仅替换存储表示（LLM提取的带类型工件 vs 逐字对话块），保持模型、检索器、重排序器和判断器不变，并进行多个混淆控制实验。
Result: 逐字块在 LoCoMo 上高出 15.9 点（43.9% vs 28.0%），在 LongMemEval-S 上高出 22.0 点（67.4% vs 45.4%）；1跳语义图无法恢复差距；五个混淆控制复现了该效果。提取工件管道从未在整体准确率上超过朴素RAG。
Conclusion: 对于所测试的提取设计，结构化记忆应增强逐字文本而非替换它；逐字块与工件的联合存储与单独逐字块表现相当，而单独工件则损失差距。

papers.title: Shuttling Compiler for Trapped-Ion Quantum Computers Based on Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We present the first shuttling compiler based on large language models (LLMs) for trapped-ion quantum computers, where qubits are shuttled between segments for gate execution and qubit storage. We fine-tune pre-trained LLMs on examples from linear and branched one-dimensional shuttling architectures. Thus, we obtain a layout-independent compilation strategy that learns the required shuttling operations directly from data. Using benchmark circuits with up to 16 qubits, such fine-tuned LLMs can now generate valid schedules for shuttling architectures. Notably, we also obtain a valid schedule for a previously unseen four-way junction layout. This demonstrates that trained LLMs can generalize to layouts not encountered during training. For various architectures, LLM-based schedules improve upon state-of-the-art baseline compiler results, reducing the shuttling effort by up to 15%.

papers.title: MCR-VQGAN: A Scalable and Cost-Effective Tau PET Synthesis Approach for Alzheimer's Disease Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Tau positron emission tomography (PET) is a critical diagnostic modality for Alzheimer's disease (AD), but its widespread clinical adoption is hindered by radiation exposure, limited availability, high clinical workload, and substantial financial costs. To address these limitations, we propose the Multi-scale CBAM Residual Vector Quantized Generative Adversarial Network (MCR-VQGAN) to synthesize high-fidelity tau PET images from structural T1-weighted MRI. MCR-VQGAN advances the standard VQGAN architecture through three enhancements: multi-scale convolutions, ResNet blocks, and Convolutional Block Attention Modules (CBAM), which collectively improve the capture of local and global features. Using 222 paired T1-weighted MRI and tau PET scans from the ADNI database, we trained and compared MCR-VQGAN against cGAN, WGAN-GP, CycleGAN, and baseline VQGAN. MCR-VQGAN achieved superior image synthesis performance across all metrics (MSE = 0.0056 +/- 0.0061, PSNR = 30.65 +/- 4.47 dB, SSIM = 0.9263 +/- 0.0469). A CNN-based AD classifier trained on real tau PET achieved comparable accuracy on real (63.64%) and synthetic (65.91%) images, indicating that diagnostically relevant features are preserved. Regional SUVR-equivalent analysis across Braak-defined ROIs further indicated strong agreement between real and synthetic tau PET (Pearson r = 0.78-0.88; ICC = 0.71-0.84), with the strongest agreement in Braak V/VI (ICC = 0.838). Together, these results suggest that MCR-VQGAN offers a promising and scalable surrogate for conventional tau PET imaging, potentially improving the accessibility of tau biomarkers for AD research and clinical workflows.

papers.title: Optimizing Rank for High-Fidelity Implicit Neural Representations
papers.abstract_en: Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) based on vanilla Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) are widely believed to be incapable of representing high-frequency content. This has directed research efforts towards architectural interventions, such as coordinate embeddings or specialized activation functions, to represent high-frequency signals. In this paper, we challenge the notion that the low-frequency bias of vanilla MLPs is an intrinsic, architectural limitation to learn high-frequency content, but instead a symptom of stable rank degradation during training. We empirically demonstrate that regulating the network's rank during training substantially improves the fidelity of the learned signal, rendering even simple MLP architectures expressive. Extensive experiments show that using optimizers like Muon, with high-rank, near-orthogonal updates, consistently enhances INR architectures even beyond simple ReLU MLPs. These substantial improvements hold across a diverse range of domains, including natural and medical images and novel view synthesis, with up to +9 dB PSNR over the same architecture. Code is available at (https://rank-inrs.github.io).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文挑战了传统观点，即基于普通MLP的隐式神经表示（INR）由于低频率偏差而无法表示高频内容。作者通过实验证明，低频率偏差实际上是训练过程中稳定秩退化的表现，而非架构固有的限制。通过使用如Muon等优化器进行高秩、近正交的更新来调控网络的秩，可以显著提高学习信号的保真度，甚至使简单的MLP架构也能表达高频信息。实验表明，该方法在自然图像、医学图像和新视角合成等多个领域，相比相同架构的基线方法，PSNR提升高达9 dB。
Motivation: 现有研究认为普通MLP的INR由于架构的低频率偏差无法表示高频内容，导致研究者转向坐标嵌入或特殊激活函数等架构干预。本文旨在证明低频率偏差并非固有局限，而是训练中秩退化的问题，并提出调控秩以提升高频表达能力。
Method: 本文通过实验证明，在训练过程中调控网络的稳定秩（stable rank）可以显著提升INR的保真度。具体使用如Muon等优化器，其具有高秩、近正交的更新特性，从而维持网络的高秩状态，使简单MLP也能有效学习高频信号。
Result: 实验表明，通过调控秩的方法，在自然图像、医学图像和新视角合成任务上，相比相同架构的普通MLP，PSNR提升高达9 dB。该方法不仅适用于简单ReLU MLP，还能增强更复杂的INR架构。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了普通MLP在INR中的低频率偏差问题源于训练中的秩退化，而非架构限制。通过使用高秩优化器（如Muon）调控秩，可以显著提升INR的表示能力，为设计更高效的INR方法提供了新思路。

papers.title: Multi-fidelity aerodynamic data fusion by autoencoder transfer learning
papers.abstract_en: Accurate aerodynamic prediction often relies on high-fidelity simulations; however, their prohibitive computational costs severely limit their applicability in data-driven modeling. This limitation motivates the development of multi-fidelity strategies that leverage inexpensive low-fidelity information without compromising accuracy. Addressing this challenge, this work presents a multi-fidelity deep learning framework that combines autoencoder-based transfer learning with a newly developed Multi-Split Conformal Prediction (MSCP) strategy to achieve uncertainty-aware aerodynamic data fusion under extreme data scarcity. The methodology leverages abundant Low-Fidelity (LF) data to learn a compact latent physics representation, which acts as a frozen knowledge base for a decoder that is subsequently fine-tuned using scarce HF samples. Tested on surface-pressure distributions for NACA airfoils (2D) and a transonic wing (3D) databases, the model successfully corrects LF deviations and achieves high-accuracy pressure predictions using minimal HF training data. Furthermore, the MSCP framework produces robust, actionable uncertainty bands with pointwise coverage exceeding 95%. By combining extreme data efficiency with uncertainty quantification, this work offers a scalable and reliable solution for aerodynamic regression in data-scarce environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高保真气动模拟计算成本高的问题，提出一种基于自编码器迁移学习的多保真度数据融合框架，并引入多分裂共形预测（MSCP）实现不确定性量化。在NACA翼型和跨声速机翼数据集上，该方法利用大量低保真数据学习潜在物理表示，再通过少量高保真样本微调解码器，有效修正低保真偏差并获得高精度压力预测，MSCP提供了超过95%点覆盖率的鲁棒不确定性区间。
Motivation: 高保真气动模拟计算成本高昂，严重限制了数据驱动模型的应用，因此需要开发利用低成本低保真信息同时保持精度的多保真度策略。
Method: 提出多保真度深度学习框架，结合自编码器迁移学习（先用大量低保真数据训练自编码器学习潜在物理表示，冻结编码器后仅用少量高保真样本微调解码器）与多分裂共形预测（MSCP）生成不确定性区间。
Result: 在NACA翼型（2D）和跨声速机翼（3D）数据集上，使用极少量高保真训练数据即实现高精度压力预测，MSCP产生点覆盖超过95%的可靠不确定性带。
Conclusion: 该方法在数据稀缺环境下提供了可扩展且可靠的气动回归解决方案，结合了极端数据效率与不确定性量化能力。

papers.title: RAMEN: Resolution-Adjustable Multimodal Encoder for Earth Observation
papers.abstract_en: Earth observation (EO) data spans a wide range of spatial, spectral, and temporal resolutions, from high-resolution optical imagery to low resolution multispectral products or radar time series. While recent foundation models have improved multimodal integration for learning meaningful representations, they often expect fixed input resolutions or are based on sensor-specific encoders limiting generalization across heterogeneous EO modalities. To overcome these limitations we introduce RAMEN, a resolution-adjustable multimodal encoder that learns a shared visual representation across EO data in a fully sensor-agnostic manner. RAMEN treats the modality and spatial and temporal resolutions as key input data features, enabling coherent analysis across modalities within a unified latent space. Its main methodological contribution is to define spatial resolution as a controllable output parameter, giving users direct control over the desired level of detail at inference and allowing explicit trade-offs between spatial precision and computational cost. We train a single, unified transformer encoder reconstructing masked multimodal EO data drawn from diverse sources, ensuring generalization across sensors and resolutions. Once pretrained, RAMEN transfers effectively to both known and unseen sensor configurations and outperforms larger state-of-the-art models on the community-standard PANGAEA benchmark, containing various multi-sensor and multi-resolution downstream tasks. Our code and pretrained model are available at https://github.com/nicolashoudre/RAMEN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RAMEN，一种分辨率可调的多模态编码器，用于地球观测（EO）数据，以传感器无关的方式学习共享的视觉表示。其核心贡献是将空间分辨率作为可控输出参数，允许用户在推理时灵活权衡空间精度与计算成本。通过掩码重建训练单一统一Transformer，RAMEN在PANGAEA基准上迁移至已知和未见传感器配置，并优于更大规模的现有模型。
Motivation: 现有EO基础模型通常要求固定输入分辨率或依赖特定传感器编码器，难以泛化到多种异构EO数据模态（如不同空间、光谱、时间分辨率）。为此，RAMEN旨在实现完全传感器无关的共享表示学习，并允许用户控制输出分辨率。
Method: RAMEN将模态、空间和时间分辨率作为输入特征，采用单一统一的Transformer编码器，通过掩码重建多模态EO数据进行预训练。其核心方法创新是将空间分辨率定义为可控输出参数，从而在推理时调整细节水平。
Result: 在PANGAEA基准上，RAMEN迁移到已知和未见传感器配置时，优于更大规模的现有模型。摘要未提供具体数值，但明确声称性能更优。
Conclusion: RAMEN通过分辨率可调的传感器无关编码器，实现跨模态EO数据的统一分析，并在多传感器多分辨率下游任务上展现优势。局限可能包括对极高分辨率或极低分辨率极端情况的适应性未提及。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: Aligned but Stereotypical? How System Prompts Shape Demographic Bias in LLM-Based Text-to-Image Models
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image (T2I) systems increasingly rely on Large Language Model (LLM)-based text conditioning to interpret and expand user prompts. While this improves prompt understanding and text-image alignment, we find that it can also introduce implicit demographic assumptions, even when demographic attributes are unspecified. To systematically investigate this behavior across varying levels of prompt ambiguity and complexity, we construct a comprehensive benchmark covering diverse prompt settings. Evaluations on eight recent T2I models show that LLM-based systems consistently exhibit stronger demographic skew than non-LLM-based baselines. We further analyze system prompts, a component unique to LLM-based T2I systems that guides prompt interpretation and expansion. Our analyses show that these instructions strongly influence text embeddings, which subsequently leads to biased image generations. Motivated by these findings, we propose FairPro, a training-free debiasing framework that adaptively generates fairness-aware instructions while preserving user intent. Experiments demonstrate that FairPro substantially reduces demographic disparities while maintaining prompt fidelity.

papers.title: Dual Cross-Attention Siamese Transformer for Rectal Tumor Regrowth Assessment in Watch-and-Wait Endoscopy
papers.abstract_en: Increasing evidence supports watch-and-wait (WW) surveillance for patients with rectal cancer who show clinical complete response (cCR) at restaging following total neoadjuvant treatment (TNT). However, accurate methods to early detect local regrowth (LR) from follow-up endoscopy images during WW are essential to manage care and prevent distant metastases. Hence, we developed a Siamese Swin Transformer with Dual Cross-Attention (SSDCA) to combine longitudinal endoscopic images at restaging and follow-up and distinguish cCR from LR. SSDCA leverages pretrained Swin Transformers to extract domain agnostic features and enhance robustness to imaging variations. Dual cross attention is implemented to emphasize features from the paired scans without requiring any spatial alignment to predict response. SSDCA as well as Swin-based baselines were trained using image pairs from 135 patients and evaluated on a held-out set of image pairs from 62 patients. SSDCA produced the best balanced accuracy (81.76% $\pm$ 0.04), sensitivity (90.07% $\pm$ 0.08), and specificity (72.86% $\pm$ 0.05). Robustness analysis showed stable performance irrespective of artifacts including blood, stool, telangiectasia, and poor image quality. UMAP clustering of extracted features showed maximal inter-cluster separation (1.45 $\pm$ 0.18) and minimal intra-cluster dispersion (1.07 $\pm$ 0.19) with SSDCA, confirming discriminative representation learning. Code and weights available at: https://github.com/Jotanator/SSDCA
papers.comment: Accepted to ISBI 2026 conference (6 pages, 5 figures, 1 table)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于双交叉注意力孪生Swin Transformer（SSDCA）的方法，用于评估直肠癌患者在watch-and-wait监测中从内镜图像判断局部复发（LR）与完全临床缓解（cCR）。该方法利用纵向配对图像，无需空间对齐，在62名患者的测试集上取得了平衡准确率81.76%、敏感度90.07%、特异性72.86%的结果。
Motivation: 在watch-and-wait监测中，早期检测局部复发对防止远处转移至关重要，但现有方法难以准确从随访内镜图像中区分cCR和LR。
Method: 采用预训练的Swin Transformer提取领域无关特征，并设计双交叉注意力机制融合配对图像的特征，无需图像空间对齐。
Result: 在135名患者训练、62名患者测试的数据集上，SSDCA达到最佳平衡准确率81.76%±0.04，敏感度90.07%±0.08，特异性72.86%±0.05；对伪影（血液、粪便、毛细血管扩张、图像质量差）鲁棒；UMAP聚类显示最大簇间分离和最小簇内分散。
Conclusion: SSDCA通过双交叉注意力有效结合纵向内镜图像，实现准确的直肠肿瘤局部复发评估，且对成像变化鲁棒。

papers.title: Adaptive Identification and Modeling of Clinical Pathways with Process Mining
papers.abstract_en: Clinical pathways are specialized healthcare plans that model patient treatment procedures. They are developed to provide criteria-based progression and standardize patient treatment, thereby improving care, reducing resource use, and accelerating patient recovery. However, manual modeling of these pathways based on clinical guidelines and domain expertise is difficult and may not reflect the actual best practices for different variations or combinations of diseases. We propose a two-phase modeling method using process mining, which extends the knowledge base of clinical pathways by leveraging conformance checking diagnostics. In the first phase, historical data of a given disease is collected to capture treatment in the form of a process model. In the second phase, new data is compared against the reference model to verify conformance. Based on the conformance checking results, the knowledge base can be expanded with more specific models tailored to new variants or disease combinations. We demonstrate our approach using Synthea, a benchmark dataset simulating patient treatments for SARS-CoV-2 infections with varying COVID-19 complications. The results show that our method enables expanding the knowledge base of clinical pathways with sufficient precision, peaking to 95.62% AUC while maintaining an arc-degree simplicity of 67.11%.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 41st ACM/SIGAPP Symposium On Applied Computing (ACM SAC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种两阶段流程挖掘方法，用于自适应识别和建模临床路径。第一阶段利用历史疾病数据生成过程模型，第二阶段对新数据进行合规性检查，并根据结果扩展知识库以覆盖新变种或疾病组合。在模拟SARS-CoV-2患者治疗的Synthea基准数据集上，该方法达到了95.62%的AUC，同时保持弧-度简易性为67.11%。
Motivation: 手动基于临床指南和领域知识建模临床路径困难，且可能无法反映不同疾病变种或组合的实际最佳实践，需要一种数据驱动的方法来自动化并扩展路径知识库。
Method: 采用两阶段流程挖掘：第一阶段从特定疾病的历史数据中提取过程模型作为参考；第二阶段将新数据与参考模型进行一致性检查，并根据检查结果生成更具体的子模型，从而扩展知识库。
Result: 在Synthea模拟数据集（COVID-19并发症）上，该方法的AUC最高达95.62%，弧-度简易性为67.11%，表明能在保持模型简洁性的同时高精度扩展临床路径知识库。
Conclusion: 该方法通过一致性检查诊断实现临床路径知识库的自动扩展，在模拟数据上验证了有效性和精度。

papers.title: A comparison between initialization strategies for the infinite hidden Markov model
papers.abstract_en: Infinite hidden Markov models provide a flexible framework for modeling time-series with structural changes and complex dynamics, without requiring the number of latent states to be specified in advance. This flexibility is achieved through the hierarchical Dirichlet process prior, while efficient Bayesian inference is enabled by the beam sampler, which combines dynamic programming with slice sampling to truncate the infinite state space adaptively. Despite extensive methodological developments, the role of initialization in this framework has received limited attention. This gap is addressed by systematically evaluating initialization strategies commonly used for finite hidden Markov models and assessing their suitability in the infinite setting. Results from both simulated and real datasets show that distance-based clustering initializations consistently outperform model-based and uniform alternatives, the latter being the most widely adopted in the existing literature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了无限隐马尔可夫模型（iHMM）中不同初始化策略的性能。基于层次狄利克雷过程先验和波束采样器，研究发现距离聚类初始化在多类数据集上一致优于模型基和均匀初始化，而均匀初始化是现有文献中最常用的方法。
Motivation: 无限隐马尔可夫模型避免预设隐状态数，但初始化策略对其性能的影响尚未被充分研究。现有文献中广泛使用的均匀初始化可能并非最优。
Method: 系统评估了有限隐马尔可夫模型中常用的初始化策略（基于距离聚类、模型基和均匀初始化）在无限设置（iHMM+层次狄利克雷过程+波束采样器）下的适用性。
Result: 在模拟和真实数据集上，距离聚类初始化的结果一致优于模型基和均匀初始化。
Conclusion: 建议在无限隐马尔可夫模型中优先考虑距离聚类初始化，避免使用默认的均匀初始化。

papers.title: MVAD: A Benchmark Dataset for Multimodal AI-Generated Video-Audio Detection
papers.abstract_en: The rapid advancement of AI-generated multimodal video-audio content has raised significant concerns regarding information security and content authenticity. Existing synthetic video datasets predominantly focus on the visual modality alone, while the few incorporating audio are largely confined to facial deepfakes--a limitation that fails to address the expanding landscape of general multimodal AI-generated content and substantially impedes the development of trustworthy detection systems. To bridge this critical gap, we introduce the Multimodal Video-Audio Dataset (MVAD), the first comprehensive dataset specifically designed for detecting AI-generated multimodal video-audio content. Our dataset exhibits three key characteristics: (1) genuine multimodality with samples generated according to three realistic video-audio forgery patterns; (2) high perceptual quality achieved through diverse state-of-the-art generative models; and (3) comprehensive diversity spanning realistic and anime visual styles, four content categories (humans, animals, objects, and scenes), and four video-audio multimodal data types. Our dataset will be available at https://github.com/HuMengXue0104/MVAD.

papers.title: An interpretable unsupervised representation learning for high precision measurement in particle physics
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised learning has been widely applied to various tasks in particle physics. However, existing models lack precise control over their learned representations, limiting physical interpretability and hindering their use for accurate measurements. We propose the Histogram AutoEncoder (HistoAE), an unsupervised representation learning network featuring a custom histogram-based loss that enforces a physically structured latent space. Applied to silicon microstrip detectors, HistoAE learns an interpretable two-dimensional latent space corresponding to the particle's charge and impact position. After simple post-processing, it achieves a charge resolution of $0.25\,e$ and a position resolution of $3\,μ\mathrm{m}$ on beam-test data, comparable to the conventional approach. These results demonstrate that unsupervised deep learning models can enable physically meaningful and quantitatively precise measurements. Moreover, the generative capacity of HistoAE enables straightforward extensions to fast detector simulations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Histogram AutoEncoder (HistoAE)，一种用于粒子物理高精度测量的可解释无监督表示学习方法。HistoAE 通过自定义直方图损失强制学习物理结构化的潜在空间，在硅微条探测器数据上实现电荷分辨率 0.25e 和位置分辨率 3μm，与传统方法相当。
Motivation: 现有无监督学习模型在粒子物理中缺乏对所学表示的精确控制，限制了物理可解释性和精确测量应用。
Method: 提出 HistoAE，一种无监督表示学习网络，使用基于直方图的损失函数来约束潜在空间具有物理结构。
Result: 在束流测试数据上，经过简单后处理，电荷分辨率达 0.25e，位置分辨率达 3μm，与传统方法性能相当。
Conclusion: 证明无监督深度学习模型能够实现物理上有意义且定量精确的测量，且 HistoAE 的生成能力可扩展至快速探测器模拟。

papers.title: Lower Complexity Bounds for Nonconvex-Strongly-Convex Bilevel Optimization with First-Order Oracles
papers.abstract_en: Although upper bound guarantees for bilevel optimization have been widely studied, progress on lower bounds has been limited due to the complexity of the bilevel structure. In this work, we focus on the smooth nonconvex-strongly-convex setting and develop new hard instances that yield nontrivial lower bounds under deterministic and stochastic first-order oracle models. In the deterministic case, we prove that any first-order zero-respecting algorithm requires at least $Ω(κ^{3/2}ε^{-2})$ oracle calls to find an $ε$-accurate stationary point, improving the optimal lower bounds known for single-level nonconvex optimization and for nonconvex-strongly-convex min-max problems. In the stochastic case, we show that at least $Ω(κ^{5/2}ε^{-4})$ stochastic oracle calls are necessary, again strengthening the best known bounds in related settings. Our results expose substantial gaps between current upper and lower bounds for bilevel optimization and suggest that even simplified regimes, such as those with quadratic lower-level objectives, warrant further investigation toward understanding the optimal complexity of bilevel optimization under standard first-order oracles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对光滑非凸-强凸双层优化问题，在确定性和随机一阶预言机模型下建立了新的下界复杂度。确定性情形下，任何一阶零变元算法需要至少 Ω(κ^{3/2}ε^{-2}) 次预言机调用；随机情形下需要 Ω(κ^{5/2}ε^{-4}) 次。这些结果改进了单层非凸优化以及非凸-强凸极小极大问题的已知下界，并揭示了当前双层优化上下界之间的显著差距。
Motivation: 尽管双层优化的上界保证已被广泛研究，但由于其结构复杂性，下界进展有限。本文旨在填补这一空白，为非凸-强凸双层优化在标准一阶预言机下建立更紧的下界。
Method: 通过构造新的硬实例，在确定性和随机一阶预言机模型下推导下界。所用的算法类别为一阶零变元算法（zero-respecting algorithms）。
Result: 确定性情况下，下界为 Ω(κ^{3/2}ε^{-2})；随机情况下为 Ω(κ^{5/2}ε^{-4})。这些结果优于单层非凸优化和相应极小极大问题的最优下界。
Conclusion: 当前双层优化的上下界之间存在显著差距，即使简化的二次下层目标也需进一步研究以理解最优复杂度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HULFSynth : An INR based Super-Resolution and Ultra Low-Field MRI Synthesis via Contrast factor estimation
papers.abstract_en: We present an unsupervised single image bidirectional Magnetic Resonance Image (MRI) synthesizer that synthesizes an Ultra-Low Field (ULF) like image from a High-Field (HF) magnitude image and vice-versa. Unlike existing MRI synthesis models, our approach is inspired by the physics that drives contrast changes between HF and ULF MRIs. Our forward model simulates a HF to ULF transformation by estimating the tissue-type Signal-to-Noise ratio (SNR) values based on target contrast values. For the Super-Resolution task, we used an Implicit Neural Representation (INR) network to synthesize HF image by simultaneously predicting tissue-type segmentations and image intensity without observed HF data. The proposed method is evaluated using synthetic ULF-like data from generated from standard 3T T$_1$-weighted images for qualitative assessments and paired 3T-64mT T$_1$-weighted images for validation experiments. WM-GM contrast improved by 52% in synthetic ULF-like images and 37% in 64mT images. Sensitivity experiments demonstrated the robustness of our forward model to variations in target contrast, noise and initial seeding.
papers.comment: Medical Image Understanding and Analysis, MIUA 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无监督单图像双向MRI合成器HULFSynth，可从高场（HF）图像合成超低场（ULF）图像，反之亦然。方法受HF与ULF对比度变化的物理机制启发，通过估计组织类型信噪比（SNR）模拟HF到ULF变换，并利用隐式神经表示（INR）网络进行超分辨率，无需配对HF数据。在合成和实际3T-64mT数据上验证，白质-灰质对比度分别提升52%和37%。
Motivation: 现有MRI合成模型未充分利用HF与ULF对比度差异的物理原理，且通常需要配对数据或监督信息，限制了其泛化性。
Method: 提出一个前向模型，通过基于目标对比值估计组织类型SNR来模拟HF到ULF的变换；同时使用INR网络同时预测组织分割和图像强度，实现无观测HF数据的超分辨率重建。
Result: 在合成ULF图像上WM-GM对比度提升52%，在真实64mT图像上提升37%。敏感性实验表明模型对目标对比度、噪声和初始种子的变化具有鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该无监督方法能有效模拟HF-ULF对比度变化，并展示了在超低场MRI合成与超分辨率任务中的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MMRINet: Efficient Mamba-Based Segmentation with Dual-Path Refinement for Low-Resource MRI Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Automated brain tumor segmentation in multi-parametric MRI remains a critical yet underserved challenge in resource-constrained clinical settings, where deep 3D networks requiring high-end GPUs are not viable. This is particularly acute across sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), where low-field scanners, heterogeneous patient demographics, and severe data scarcity compound the difficulty of applying standard deep learning pipelines. We present MMRINet, a lightweight segmentation architecture purpose-built for these constraints. At its core, MMRINet replaces quadratic-complexity self-attention with linear-complexity Mamba state-space models, enabling efficient long-range volumetric context modeling without the computational overhead of Transformer-based approaches. We combine two lightweight refinement components:Dual-Path Feature Refinement (DPFR), which extracts complementary detail and contextual representations to improve feature diversity under limited data, and Progressive Feature Aggregation (PFA), which hierarchically fuses multi-scale decoder outputs for sharper segmentation boundaries. Evaluated on the BraTS-Lighthouse SSA 2025 challenge dataset, comprising 3D MRI scans from Nigerian clinical sites, MMRINet achieves an average Dice score of 0.752 and an average HD95 of 12.23 mm with only ~2.5M parameters, outperforming all evaluated baselines, including UNETR, Swin-UNETR, SegMamba, and SegResNet3D. These results indicate that strong validation-set segmentation performance can be achieved with substantially reduced computation, offering a practical step toward AI-assisted neuro-oncology in low-resource clinical environments. Our GitHub repository can be accessed here: BioMedIA-MBZUAI/MMRINet.
papers.comment: Accepted at The Medical Image Understanding and Analysis Conference (MIUA 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MMRINet，一种轻量级脑肿瘤分割架构，专为资源受限的临床环境设计。它用线性复杂度的 Mamba 状态空间模型替代二次复杂度的自注意力，结合双路径特征细化 (DPFR) 和渐进特征聚合 (PFA)。在 BraTS-Lighthouse SSA 2025 数据集上，以约 2.5M 参数取得平均 Dice 0.752 和 HD95 12.23 mm，优于 UNETR、Swin-UNETR 等基线。
Motivation: 在资源受限的临床环境（如撒哈拉以南非洲）中，高精度 3D 网络因需要高端 GPU 而不可行，且低场扫描仪、患者多样性及数据稀缺加剧了挑战。现有方法难以兼顾效率与精度。
Method: 提出 MMRINet，核心是使用线性复杂度的 Mamba 状态空间模型建立长程体素上下文，替代 Transformer 的二次复杂度自注意力。包括双路径特征细化 (DPFR) 提取互补信息，以及渐进特征聚合 (PFA) 融合多尺度解码器输出。
Result: 在 BraTS-Lighthouse SSA 2025 挑战数据集上，MMRINet 以 2.5M 参数达到平均 Dice 0.752 和平均 HD95 12.23 mm，超越 UNETR、Swin-UNETR、SegMamba 和 SegResNet3D 等基线。
Conclusion: 结果表明，在低资源环境下，使用轻量级模型可以在保证较低计算需求的同时获得有竞争力的分割性能，为 AI 辅助神经肿瘤学提供了实用方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Journal of Prompt-Engineered (Moral) Philosophy Or: Why AI-Assisted Ethics Research Requires Process Transparency
papers.abstract_en: Existing AI disclosure mandates in scholarship require that AI assistance be reported but leave transparency philosophically unspecified: they fix the duty without explaining what the duty serves. We argue that ethical inquiry is essentially contested at two independent levels -- about what it is, and about what it demands of the inquirer -- defeating output-only evaluation and welfare-economic dismissal of the transparency question, and, by extension, reproducibility framings imported from the empirical sciences. The transparency duty is grounded instead in agent-integrity: the legibility, before a community of inquiry, of the identity-constituting commitments that the author's mode of philosophising expresses. Because the standards for evaluating such work are not communally settled, the achievable goal for transparency is not evaluation against agreed criteria but tracking -- accumulating the evidentiary record that lets each tradition assess the work on its own terms and makes future normative judgments possible. We develop a documentation-adequacy framework that operationalises Meaningful Human Control through five transparency elements -- declaration, navigation, documentation account, process documentation, and development records -- demonstrated by the paper itself, whose full documentation record is archived at a persistent identifier. The framework is a first iteration subject to revision, not a settled standard.
papers.comment: 21 pages Transparency material documenting LLM usage available at: https://github.com/MicheleLoi/JPEP/tree/main/transparency/Canonical_MD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从伦理哲学角度论证，AI辅助伦理研究中的披露义务不能仅靠输出评估或实证科学的可重复性框架来满足，而应基于研究者群体的主体完整性。作者提出一个包含五个透明度要素的文档充分性框架，并通过论文自身的完整文档记录加以演示。
Motivation: 现有AI披露要求在学术著作中仅规定报告义务，却未阐明该义务的哲学基础——输出评估和福利经济学视角无法确立合理的透明度标准。
Method: 从主体完整性出发，提出一个操作化有意义人类控制的文档充分性框架，包括声明、导航、文档说明、过程文档和开发记录五个要素，并通过论文自身的透明度实践进行展示。
Result: 框架作为首次迭代提出，可供未来修订，并提供了完整的文档记录存档于持久标识符。
Conclusion: AI辅助伦理研究的透明度目标不是基于共识标准评价，而是积累证据记录以便不同传统按自身标准评估工作，使未来的规范性判断成为可能。
Relevance: 0
