papers.title: Distributional Biases in Post-Training: A Markovian Analysis of Reasoning Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models exhibit broad knowledge but limited task-specific reasoning, motivating post-training strategies such as RL with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and test-time scaling (TTS). While recent work highlights the role of exploration in improving pass@K, empirical evidence points to a paradox: RLVR and ORM/PRM typically reinforce existing paths rather than expanding the reasoning scope, raising the question of why exploration helps if no new patterns emerge. To reconcile this paradox, we adopt the perspective of Kim et al. (2025), viewing easy (e.g., simplifying a fraction) versus hard (e.g., discovering the some symmetry) reasoning steps as low versus high probability Markov transitions. In this tractable model, pretraining corresponds to tree-graph discovering, while post-training corresponds to CoT reweighting. We provably show that, both RLVR and ORM/PRM would favor heavily to several high-probability paths, and thereby forget rare-but-crucial CoTs. Building on this, we further prove that exploration strategies such as rejecting easy instances and KL regularization help preserve rare CoTs. Empirical simulations corroborate our theoretical results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从马尔可夫链视角分析基础模型后训练中的推理轨迹分布偏差。作者将简单与困难推理步骤分别建模为高、低概率转移，证明RLVR和ORM/PRM会过度强化高概率路径，导致罕见但关键的思维链（CoT）被遗忘，而拒绝易实例和KL正则化等探索策略有助于保留这些罕见CoT。仿真实验验证了理论结果。
Motivation: 后训练策略（如RLVR和测试时扩展）虽能提升pass@K，但实证表明它们强化已有推理路径而非扩展范围，形成“探索悖论”：既然无新模式出现，为什么探索仍有效？需要理论解释。
Method: 采用Kim等人（2025）的马尔可夫推理轨迹模型，将预训练视为树图发现，后训练视为对CoT权重重分配。在此框架下理论分析RLVR和ORM/PRM的分布偏差，并证明探索策略对保留罕见CoT的作用。
Result: 理论证明RLVR和ORM/PRM会偏向高概率路径，导致罕见CoT被遗忘；而拒绝易实例和KL正则化等探索策略能有效保留这些罕见CoT。仿真结果支持理论。
Conclusion: 后训练阶段存在固有的分布偏差，需通过针对性的探索策略来保留关键但罕见的推理模式，这对提升模型泛化能力至关重要。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Mitigating Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models by Refining Textual Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) remain a persistent challenge, often stemming from inadequate integration of visual information during multimodal reasoning. A key cause is the model's over-reliance on textual priors and underutilization of visual cues, leading to outputs that are linguistically fluent but visually inaccurate. For example, given an image of an empty kitchen countertop, an LVLM might hallucinate a "bowl of fruit" or "cup of coffee", relying on language associations rather than visual evidence. Most LVLMs incorporate visual features by appending them to the input stream of a pre-trained LLM and training on large-scale vision-language datasets. Our systematic analysis reveals that this strategy often leads to over-dependence on textual information due to the inherent bias of LLMs towards language-dominant representations. This imbalance skews attention towards the text over visual content, weakening the model's ability to ground outputs in visual inputs. To address this, we propose a simple yet effective visual feature incorporation method that encourages the model to learn visually-informed textual embeddings distinct from those of the base LLM and promotes a more balanced attention distribution. Experimental results across multiple hallucination benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly reduces hallucinations and fosters more balanced multimodal reasoning. Notably, our approach achieves substantial gains, including +9.33% on MMVP-MLLM, +2.99% on POPE-AOKVQA, up to +3.4% on Merlin, and +3% on the hard-data split of HallusionBench.
papers.comment: Accepted at The 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析了大视觉语言模型（LVLM）中幻觉的根源——模型过度依赖文本先验而忽视视觉信息，导致输出文本流畅但视觉不准确。提出一种简单有效的视觉特征融合方法，鼓励模型学习视觉引导的文本嵌入，平衡注意力分布。在多个幻觉基准上取得显著改进，如MMVP-MLLM +9.33%。
Motivation: LVLM经常产生幻觉，原因是视觉信息整合不足，模型过度依赖语言先验而低估视觉线索。
Method: 提出一种视觉特征融合方法，通过促进模型学习有别于基础LLM的视觉引导文本嵌入，实现更平衡的注意力分布。
Result: 在MMVP-MLLM、POPE-AOKVQA、Merlin和HallusionBench上分别提升9.33%、2.99%、3.4%和3%（hard split）。
Conclusion: 该方法有效减少幻觉，促进多模态推理的平衡。

summary_sections.method: 提出一种视觉特征融合方法，通过促进模型学习有别于基础LLM的视觉引导文本嵌入，实现更平衡的注意力分布。
summary_sections.result: 在MMVP-MLLM、POPE-AOKVQA、Merlin和HallusionBench上分别提升9.33%、2.99%、3.4%和3%（hard split）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法有效减少幻觉，促进多模态推理的平衡。

papers.title: Chronological Thinking in Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in spoken dialogue language models (SDLMs) reflect growing interest in shifting from turn-based to full-duplex systems, where the models continuously perceive user speech streams while generating responses. This simultaneous listening and speaking design enables real-time interaction and the agent can handle dynamic conversational behaviors like user barge-in. However, during the listening phase, existing systems keep the agent idle by repeatedly predicting the silence token, which departs from human behavior: we usually engage in lightweight thinking during conversation rather than remaining absent-minded. Inspired by this, we propose Chronological Thinking, an on-the-fly conversational thinking mechanism that aims to improve response quality in full-duplex SDLMs. Specifically, chronological thinking presents a paradigm shift from conventional LLM thinking approaches, such as Chain-of-Thought, purpose-built for streaming acoustic input. (1) Strictly causal: the agent reasons incrementally while listening, updating internal hypotheses only from past audio with no lookahead. (2) No additional latency: reasoning is amortized during the listening window; once the user stops speaking, the agent halts thinking and begins speaking without further delay. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of chronological thinking through both objective metrics and human evaluations show consistent improvements in response quality. Furthermore, chronological thinking robustly handles conversational dynamics and attains competitive performance on full-duplex interaction metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Chronological Thinking，一种面向全双工口语对话语言模型的实时对话思考机制。该机制让模型在监听用户语音流的同时进行增量式因果推理，避免预测静音词导致的空白期，并在用户停止说话后立即生成响应。客观指标和人工评估表明该方法提升了响应质量，并稳健处理对话动态。
Motivation: 现有全双工口语对话系统在监听阶段反复预测静音词，导致模型处于空闲状态，偏离人类在对话中持续进行轻度思考的行为模式。
Method: 提出 Chronological Thinking 机制，基于严格因果的流式输入进行增量推理，利用监听窗口摊销推理时间，用户停止说话时立即开始回应，不增加额外延迟。
Result: 通过客观指标和人工评估，该方法在响应质量上取得一致提升，并稳健处理对话动态，在全双工交互指标上达到有竞争力的性能。
Conclusion: Chronological Thinking 为全双工口语对话模型提供了一种更接近人类对话模式的思考机制，有助于提升实时交互中的响应质量。

papers.title: Shift-Invariant Attribute Scoring for Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks via Shapley Value
papers.abstract_en: For many real-world applications, understanding feature-outcome relationships is as crucial as achieving high predictive accuracy. While traditional neural networks excel at prediction, their black-box nature obscures underlying functional relationships. Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs) address this by employing learnable spline-based activation functions on edges, enabling recovery of symbolic representations while maintaining competitive performance. However, KAN's architecture presents unique challenges for network pruning. Conventional magnitude-based methods become unreliable due to sensitivity to input coordinate shifts. We propose \textbf{ShapKAN}, a pruning framework using Shapley value attribution to assess node importance in a shift-invariant manner. Unlike magnitude-based approaches, ShapKAN quantifies each node's actual contribution, ensuring consistent importance rankings regardless of input parameterization. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that ShapKAN preserves true node importance while enabling effective network compression. Our approach improves KAN's interpretability advantages, facilitating deployment in resource-constrained environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ShapKAN，一个基于 Shapley value 的剪枝框架，用于 Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs)，以解决传统基于幅值的方法对输入坐标平移敏感的问题。ShapKAN 通过量化节点实际贡献实现平移不变的重要性评估，在合成和真实数据集上保持节点重要性排序的同时有效压缩网络。
Motivation: KANs 使用可学习的样条激活函数，虽可恢复符号表示，但其网络剪枝面临挑战：传统基于幅值的方法因对输入坐标平移敏感而不可靠，需要一种平移不变的重要性评估方法。
Method: 提出 ShapKAN 框架，利用 Shapley value 属性对节点重要性进行评分，通过评估每个节点对输出的实际贡献实现平移不变性，替代了传统的基于幅值的方法。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，ShapKAN 能保留节点真实重要性，同时实现有效的网络压缩。
Conclusion: 该方法提升了 KANs 的可解释性优势，便于在资源受限环境中部署。

papers.title: Q-Net: Queue Length Estimation via Kalman-based Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Estimating queue lengths at signalized intersections is a long-standing challenge in traffic management. Partial observability of vehicle flows complicates this task despite the availability of two privacy-preserving data sources: (i) aggregated vehicle counts from loop detectors near stop lines, and (ii) aggregated floating car data (aFCD) that provide segment-wise average speed measurements. However, how to integrate these sources with differing spatial and temporal resolutions for queue length estimation is rather unclear. Addressing this question, we present Q-Net: a queue estimation framework built upon a state-space formulation. This design addresses key challenges in queue modeling, such as violations of traffic conservation assumptions. Q-Net follows the Kalman predict-update structure and maintains physical interpretability in both the state evolution and measurement models. Q-Net uses an AI-augmented Kalman filter to learn time-varying gain dynamics from data. The framework supports real-time implementation and improves spatial transferability by grouping aFCD measurements into fixed-size local groups, making the number of learnable parameters independent of section length. Evaluations on urban main roads in Rotterdam, the Netherlands, show that Q-Net outperforms baseline methods, tracks queue formation and dissipation accurately, and mitigates aFCD-induced delays. By combining data efficiency, interpretability, real-time applicability, and spatial transferability, Q-Net makes accurate queue length estimation possible without costly sensing infrastructure like cameras or radar.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Q-Net，一个基于状态空间建模和AI增强卡尔曼滤波的框架，用于信号化交叉口的队列长度估计。它融合了环路检测器提供的聚合车辆计数和浮动车数据（aFCD）提供的平均速度测量，解决了交通守恒违反等挑战。在荷兰鹿特丹城市主干道的评估显示，Q-Net优于基线方法，准确跟踪队列形成与消散，并缓解aFCD带来的延迟，无需昂贵传感基础设施。
Motivation: 信号化交叉口的队列长度估计长期面临挑战，车辆流的部分可观测性使得问题复杂。现有两类隐私保护数据源（环路检测器计数和浮动车数据）具有不同的时空分辨率，如何整合这些数据源进行队列估计尚不清楚。
Method: 提出Q-Net，基于状态空间公式，遵循卡尔曼预测-更新结构，保持物理可解释性。使用AI增强卡尔曼滤波器从数据中学习时变增益动态。通过将aFCD测量分组为固定大小的局部组，使可学习参数数量独立于路段长度，提高空间迁移性。
Result: 在荷兰鹿特丹城市主干道的评估中，Q-Net优于基线方法，准确跟踪队列形成与消散，并缓解aFCD带来的延迟。
Conclusion: Q-Net结合了数据效率、可解释性、实时适用性和空间迁移性，实现了无需昂贵传感基础设施的准确队列长度估计。

papers.title: MAD: Manifold Attracted Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Score-based diffusion models are a highly effective method for generating samples from a distribution of images. We consider scenarios where the training data comes from a noisy version of the target distribution, and present an efficiently implementable modification of the inference procedure to generate noiseless samples. Our approach is motivated by the manifold hypothesis, according to which meaningful data is concentrated around some low-dimensional manifold of a high-dimensional ambient space. The central idea is that noise manifests as low magnitude variation in off-manifold directions in contrast to the relevant variation of the desired distribution which is mostly confined to on-manifold directions. We introduce the notion of an extended score and show that, in a simplified setting, it can be used to reduce small variations to zero, while leaving large variations mostly unchanged. We describe how its approximation can be computed efficiently from an approximation to the standard score and demonstrate its efficacy on toy problems, synthetic data, and real data.
papers.journal_ref: Forty-third International Conference on Machine Learning, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对训练数据带有噪声的情况，提出一种基于流形假设的得分扩散模型推理修改方法，通过引入扩展得分概念来去除噪声，生成清洁样本。摘要称该方法在玩具问题、合成数据和真实数据上展示了有效性。
Motivation: 标准得分扩散模型假设训练数据来自目标分布，但实际中数据常带有噪声，需要从噪声数据生成无噪声样本。
Method: 受流形假设启发，提出扩展得分（extended score）概念，在简化设定下将其用于将小幅度变化（噪声）置零而保留大幅度变化（信号），并从标准得分近似高效计算扩展得分。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在玩具问题、合成数据和真实数据上有效去噪并生成清洁样本，但未提供具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于流形假设的扩展得分方法可为噪声数据下的扩散模型生成提供一种高效修改方案。

papers.title: Tackling GNARLy Problems: Graph Neural Algorithmic Reasoning Reimagined through Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Neural algorithmic reasoning (NAR) is a paradigm that trains neural networks to execute classic algorithms by supervised learning. Despite its successes, important limitations remain: inability to construct valid solutions without post-processing and to reason about multiple correct ones, poor performance on combinatorial NP-hard problems, and inapplicability to problems for which strong algorithms are not yet known. To address these limitations, we reframe the problem of learning algorithm trajectories as a Markov decision process, which imposes structure on the solution construction procedure and unlocks the powerful tools of imitation and reinforcement learning (RL). We propose the GNARL framework, encompassing the methodology to translate problem formulations from NAR to RL and a learning architecture suitable for a wide range of graph-based problems. We achieve very high graph accuracy results on several CLRS-30 problems, performance matching or exceeding much narrower NAR approaches for NP-hard problems and, remarkably, applicability even when lacking an expert algorithm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GNARL 框架，将神经算法推理（NAR）问题重新表述为马尔可夫决策过程，利用模仿学习和强化学习来学习算法轨迹。该框架解决了传统 NAR 在需要后处理、处理多个正确解、NP-hard 问题以及缺乏已知强算法时的问题，在图算法问题上取得了与专用方法相当或更优的结果。
Motivation: 传统神经算法推理存在局限性：无法在不进行后处理的情况下构建有效解，难以推理多个正确解，在组合 NP-hard 问题上性能差，且无法应用于尚未有强算法的任务。
Method: 将算法轨迹学习转化为马尔可夫决策过程，提出 GNARL 框架，包含从 NAR 到 RL 的问题转化方法和适用于多种图问题的学习架构，使用模仿学习与强化学习联合训练。
Result: 在 CLRS-30 基准的多个问题上取得高图准确率，在 NP-hard 问题上匹配或超越现有 NAR 方法，且能应用于缺少专家算法的问题。
Conclusion: GNARL 通过 RL 视角克服了 NAR 的多个关键限制，为更通用的算法学习提供了新路径。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Neural ARFIMA model for forecasting BRIC exchange rates with long memory
papers.abstract_en: Exchange rate forecasting remains a challenging problem, particularly for emerging economies, where the observed time series exhibit pronounced long-memory dependence, nonlinear dynamics, and sensitivity to macro-financial drivers. Classical models such as ARFIMA capture long-range persistence but fail to adequately represent nonlinear relationships, while modern machine learning approaches often neglect the underlying long-memory structure in macroeconomic series. To address this gap, we propose a Neural AutoRegressive Fractionally Integrated Moving Average (NARFIMA) model that integrates ARFIMA-based long-memory modeling with neural networks for nonlinear function approximation, while incorporating exogenous macroeconomic and uncertainty indicators. The framework provides a unified approach for capturing persistence, nonlinear dynamics, and external shocks. We establish asymptotic stationarity of the NARFIMA process and develop conformal prediction intervals for distribution-free uncertainty quantification. Empirical results for BRIC exchange rates show that NARFIMA consistently outperforms a broad range of forecasting benchmarks across multiple horizons, underscoring the importance of explicitly modeling long-memory dependence in exchange rate dynamics. The `narfima' R package provides an implementation of our approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出神经ARFIMA（NARFIMA）模型，将ARFIMA的长记忆建模与神经网络的非线性逼近能力结合，用于预测金砖国家（BRIC）汇率。模型还整合了外生宏观经济和不确定性指标，建立了渐近平稳性，并开发了共形预测区间用于不确定性量化。在BRIC汇率数据上，NARFIMA在多个预测跨度上一致优于多种基准方法。
Motivation: 汇率预测对新兴经济体尤为困难，因为时间序列具有长记忆依赖、非线性动态和对宏观金融驱动因素的敏感性。传统ARFIMA模型能捕捉长程持续性但无法表达非线性关系，而机器学习方法常忽略长记忆结构。
Method: 提出NARFIMA模型，融合ARFIMA的长记忆滤波与神经网络非线性函数逼近，并引入外生宏观经济与不确定性指标。理论证明了过程的渐近平稳性，并采用共形预测区间实现分布自由的 uncertainty quantification。
Result: 在BRIC汇率数据上，NARFIMA在多个预测跨度上一致优于多种基准模型，表明显式建模长记忆依赖对汇率动态预测至关重要。论文还提供了R包'narfima'。
Conclusion: NARFIMA统一了长记忆性、非线性和外部冲击的建模，提升了汇率预测性能。

summary_sections.motivation: 汇率预测对新兴经济体尤为困难，因为时间序列具有长记忆依赖、非线性动态和对宏观金融驱动因素的敏感性。传统ARFIMA模型能捕捉长程持续性但无法表达非线性关系，而机器学习方法常忽略长记忆结构。
summary_sections.method: 提出NARFIMA模型，融合ARFIMA的长记忆滤波与神经网络非线性函数逼近，并引入外生宏观经济与不确定性指标。理论证明了过程的渐近平稳性，并采用共形预测区间实现分布自由的 uncertainty quantification。
summary_sections.result: 在BRIC汇率数据上，NARFIMA在多个预测跨度上一致优于多种基准模型，表明显式建模长记忆依赖对汇率动态预测至关重要。论文还提供了R包'narfima'。
summary_sections.conclusion: NARFIMA统一了长记忆性、非线性和外部冲击的建模，提升了汇率预测性能。

papers.title: Feature-Space Planes Searcher: A Universal Domain Adaptation Framework for Interpretability and Computational Efficiency
papers.abstract_en: Domain shift, characterized by degraded model performance during transition from labeled source domains to unlabeled target domains, poses a persistent challenge for deploying deep learning systems. Current unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) methods predominantly rely on fine-tuning feature extractors - an approach limited by inefficiency, reduced interpretability, and poor scalability to modern architectures. Our analysis reveals that models pretrained on large-scale data exhibit domain-invariant geometric patterns in their feature space, characterized by intra-class clustering and inter-class separation, thereby preserving transferable discriminative structures. These findings indicate that domain shifts primarily manifest as boundary misalignment rather than feature degradation. Unlike fine-tuning entire pre-trained models - which risks introducing unpredictable feature distortions - we propose the Feature-space Planes Searcher (FPS): a novel domain adaptation framework that optimizes decision boundaries by leveraging these geometric patterns while keeping the feature encoder frozen. This streamlined approach enables interpretative analysis of adaptation while substantially reducing memory and computational costs through offline feature extraction, permitting full-dataset optimization in a single computation cycle. Evaluations on public benchmarks demonstrate that FPS achieves competitive or superior performance to state-of-the-art methods. FPS scales efficiently with multimodal large models and shows versatility across diverse domains including protein structure prediction, remote sensing classification, and earthquake detection. We anticipate FPS will provide a simple, effective, and generalizable paradigm for transfer learning, particularly in domain adaptation tasks. .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出特征空间平面搜索器 (FPS)，一种保持特征编码器冻结、仅优化决策边界的无监督域适应 (UDA) 框架。基于预训练模型特征空间中存在域不变几何模式（类内聚类、类间分离）的观察，FPS 通过离线特征提取实现单次计算周期全数据集优化，在多个公共基准上达到与最先进方法竞争或更优的性能，并适用于多模态大模型及蛋白质结构预测、遥感分类、地震检测等多样领域。
Motivation: 现有 UDA 方法主要依赖微调特征提取器，导致计算效率低、可解释性差且难以扩展到现代架构；分析表明域偏移主要表现为边界不对齐而非特征退化。
Method: 提出 FPS 框架：冻结预训练特征编码器，仅优化决策边界以利用特征空间中的几何模式；通过离线特征提取大幅降低内存和计算成本，支持单次计算周期全数据集优化。
Result: 在公共基准上取得与最先进方法竞争或更优的性能；有效扩展到多模态大模型，并在蛋白质结构预测、遥感分类、地震检测等跨领域任务中展现通用性。
Conclusion: FPS 提供了一种简单、有效且可泛化的迁移学习范式，尤其适用于域适应任务，其冻结编码器策略避免了特征变形并增强了可解释性。

papers.title: Fusion of Pervasive RF Data with Spatial Images via Vision Transformers for Enhanced Mapping in Smart Cities
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we present a deep learning-based approach that integrates the DINOv2 architecture to improve building mapping by combining (possibly erroneous) maps from open-source platforms with pervasive radio frequency (RF) data collected from multiple wireless user equipments and base stations. Unlike prior methods, our approach leverages a vision transformer-based architecture to jointly process both RF and map modalities within a unified framework, effectively capturing spatial dependencies and structural priors for enhanced mapping accuracy. For the evaluation purposes, we employ a synthetic dataset co-produced by Huawei. To address the challenges associated with real-world data imperfections, we introduce controlled noise to its RF data so as to simulate real-world conditions. Additionally, we develop and train a model that leverages only aggregated path loss information to tackle the mapping problem. We measure the results according to three performance metrics: the Jaccard index (intersection over union, IoU), the Hausdorff distance, and the Chamfer distance. Our design achieves a macro IoU of 65.3%, significantly surpassing (i) the erroneous maps baseline, which yields 40.1%, (ii) an RF-only method from the literature, which yields 37.3%, and (iii) a non-AI fusion baseline that we designed which yields 42.2%. The comparative evaluation highlights the limitations of relying solely on RF data or on spatial data, as well as the effectiveness that AI can have on fusing data towards enhancing smart city mapping accuracy. We further validate our method on real-world data from the Oslo region, complementing the synthetic evaluation with a real deployment setting, where our best fusion model reaches 64.9% macro IoU. We additionally outline a strategy for deploying the model over larger areas by tiling the region with overlapping windows.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于DINOv2视觉Transformer的方法，融合开源地图和来自无线用户设备及基站的射频数据，以提升城市建筑地图的准确性。在华为合成的数据集上，该方法达到65.3%的宏观IoU，显著优于仅用地图（40.1%）、仅用RF（37.3%）和非AI融合（42.2%）的基线。在奥斯陆真实世界数据上，最优融合模型达到64.9%宏观IoU。
Motivation: 现有建筑地图常存在错误，而射频信号可提供补充信息，但如何有效融合这两类异质数据以提升地图精度仍是一个挑战。
Method: 采用DINOv2视觉Transformer架构，将射频数据和地图图像统一处理，利用自注意力机制捕捉空间依赖和结构先验。通过向合成数据集射频数据添加模拟真实世界噪声来提升鲁棒性。
Result: 在合成数据集上宏观IoU达65.3%，超过仅地图（40.1%）、仅RF（37.3%）和非AI融合（42.2%）基线。在奥斯陆真实数据上达64.9%。
Conclusion: 总结称AI融合可有效提升城市地图精度，并展示了在更大区域通过重叠窗口分块部署的策略。

papers.title: From Sorting Algorithms to Scalable Kernels: Bayesian Optimization in High-Dimensional Permutation Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian Optimization (BO) is a powerful tool for black-box optimization, but its application to high-dimensional permutation spaces is severely limited by the challenge of defining scalable representations. The current state-of-the-art BO approach for permutation spaces relies on an exhaustive $Ω(n^2)$ pairwise comparison, inducing a dense representation that is impractical for large-scale permutations. To break this barrier, we introduce a novel framework for generating efficient permutation representations via kernel functions derived from sorting algorithms. Within this framework, the Mallows kernel can be viewed as a special instance derived from enumeration sort. Further, we introduce the \textbf{Merge Kernel} , which leverages the divide-and-conquer structure of merge sort to produce a compact, $Θ(n\log n)$ to achieve the lowest possible complexity with no information loss and effectively capture permutation structure. Our central thesis is that the Merge Kernel performs competitively with the Mallows kernel in low-dimensional settings, but significantly outperforms it in both optimization performance and computational efficiency as the dimension $n$ grows. Extensive evaluations on various permutation optimization benchmarks confirm our hypothesis, demonstrating that the Merge Kernel provides a scalable and more effective solution for Bayesian optimization in high-dimensional permutation spaces, thereby unlocking the potential for tackling previously intractable problems such as large-scale feature ordering and combinatorial neural architecture search.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于归并排序的Merge Kernel，用于高维排列空间的贝叶斯优化，复杂度为Θ(n log n)且无信息损失。在低维时与Mallows核性能相当，高维时显著优于现有方法，计算效率更高。
Motivation: 现有基于排列的贝叶斯优化方法使用密集表示（Ω(n^2)），难以扩展至大规模排列问题。
Method: 从排序算法推导核函数，提出Merge Kernel，利用归并排序的分治结构生成紧凑表示，复杂度Θ(n log n)且保留完整结构信息。
Result: 在多个排列优化基准上，Merge Kernel在低维与Mallows核性能竞争，高维时优化性能和计算效率均显著提升。
Conclusion: Merge Kernel为高维排列空间的贝叶斯优化提供了可扩展、高效的解决方案，可应用于大规模特征排序和组合神经架构搜索。

papers.title: DiffusionBlocks: Block-wise Neural Network Training via Diffusion Interpretation
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end backpropagation requires storing activations throughout all layers, creating memory bottlenecks that limit model scalability. Existing block-wise training methods offer means to alleviate this problem, but they rely on ad-hoc local objectives and remain largely unexplored beyond classification tasks. We propose $\textit{DiffusionBlocks}$, a principled framework for transforming transformer-based networks into genuinely independent trainable blocks that maintain competitive performance with end-to-end training. Our key insight leverages the fact that residual connections naturally correspond to updates in a dynamical system. With minimal modifications to this system, we can convert the updates to those of a denoising process, where each block can be learned independently by leveraging the score matching objective. This independence enables training with gradients for only one block at a time, thereby reducing memory requirements in proportion to the number of blocks. Our experiments on a range of transformer architectures (vision, diffusion, autoregressive, recurrent-depth, and masked diffusion) demonstrate that DiffusionBlocks training matches the performance of end-to-end training while enabling scalable block-wise training on practical tasks beyond small-scale classification. DiffusionBlocks provides a theoretically grounded approach that successfully scales to modern generative tasks across diverse architectures. Code is available at https://github.com/SakanaAI/DiffusionBlocks .
papers.comment: To appear at the 14th International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR 2026). v4: Fixed typos in experimental details (Appendix E.4)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DiffusionBlocks，一种基于扩散解释的块状神经网络训练框架，将残差连接视为动力系统更新，通过最小化修改将其转化为去噪过程，并利用分数匹配目标实现每块独立训练，从而大幅降低内存需求。实验表明，在多种 Transformer 架构（视觉、扩散、自回归、循环深度、掩码扩散）上，该方法的性能可与端到端训练媲美。
Motivation: 端到端反向传播需要存储所有层的激活值，造成内存瓶颈，限制了模型规模扩展。现有块状训练方法依赖特定的局部目标函数，且多局限于分类任务。
Method: 利用残差连接与动力系统的自然对应关系，通过少量修改将更新转化为去噪过程，使每个块可借助分数匹配目标独立学习，实现单块梯度训练。
Result: 在多种 Transformer 架构上的实验表明，DiffusionBlocks 训练性能与端到端训练匹配，同时能够按块数比例降低内存需求，并成功扩展到现代生成任务。
Conclusion: DiffusionBlocks 提供了一种理论上有依据的块状训练方法，适用于多种架构和实际生成任务，突破了小规模分类的局限。

papers.title: UltraSketchLLM: Sub-1-Bit LLM Compression via Sketch and Hardware-Friendly Operators
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) require larger GPU memory size these days, necessitating efficient and extreme weight compression methods. Existing compression methods are either theoretically limited by 1 bit per weight or face severe performance degradation and inefficiency. To deploy LLMs in resource-constrained scenarios, we introduce UltraSketchLLM, compressing LLMs with data sketch. It reduces peak GPU memory footprint with a high compression rate down to 0.5 bit per weight. Combined with hardware-friendly implementation, UltraSketchLLM keeps tolerable performance degradation and extremely low latency overhead with 14.9x speedup compared to naive sketch solution.
papers.comment: Accepted by the 63rd ACM/IEEE The Chips to Systems Conference (DAC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UltraSketchLLM 提出利用数据草图（data sketch）将大语言模型权重压缩至每个权重0.5比特，同时结合硬件友好算子，实现高压缩率、低延迟和可容忍的性能损失。在峰值GPU内存占用降低的同时，相比朴素草图方案获得14.9倍速度提升。
Motivation: 现有LLM压缩方法在每权重1比特以下面临理论限制或严重的性能下降与效率问题，亟需更高效的极端压缩方法以在资源受限场景部署LLM。
Method: 采用数据草图（data sketch）进行权重压缩，并设计硬件友好算子，实现0.5比特每权重的压缩率，同时优化延迟。
Result: 实现每权重0.5比特的压缩率，峰值GPU内存占用大幅降低，且与朴素草图方案相比获得14.9倍速度提升，性能下降在可接受范围内。
Conclusion: UltraSketchLLM 为资源受限环境下的LLM部署提供了一种极端压缩方案，兼顾压缩率、硬件效率和推理延迟。

papers.title: Direct Fisher Score Estimation for Likelihood Maximization
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of likelihood maximization when the likelihood function is intractable but model simulations are readily available. We propose a sequential, gradient-based optimization method that directly models the Fisher score based on a local score matching technique which uses simulations from a localized region around each parameter iterate. By employing a linear parameterization to the surrogate score model, our technique admits a closed-form, least-squares solution. This approach yields a fast, flexible, and efficient approximation to the Fisher score, effectively smoothing the likelihood objective and mitigating the challenges posed by complex likelihood landscapes. We provide theoretical guarantees for our score estimator, including bounds on the bias introduced by the smoothing. Empirical results on a range of synthetic and real-world problems demonstrate the superior performance of our method compared to existing benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对似然函数难以计算但模型仿真可行的似然最大化问题，提出一种基于局部得分匹配技术的顺序梯度优化方法，直接建模Fisher score，通过线性参数化得到闭式最小二乘解，从而快速、灵活且高效地近似Fisher score，平滑似然目标并缓解复杂似然景观带来的挑战。
Motivation: 似然函数难以计算时，传统的似然最大化方法失效，而模型仿真往往可行，需要一种能够利用仿真进行梯度优化的方法。
Method: 提出一种顺序梯度优化方法，基于局部得分匹配技术，从每个参数迭代附近的局部区域进行仿真，直接建模Fisher score，并采用线性参数化得到闭式最小二乘解。
Result: 理论保证包括对平滑引入偏差的界；在合成和真实问题上的实验表明，该方法优于现有基准方法。

papers.title: EqCollide: Equivariant and Collision-Aware Deformable Objects Neural Simulator
papers.abstract_en:
Simulating collisions of deformable objects is a fundamental yet challenging task due to the complexity of modeling solid mechanics and multi-body interactions. Existing data-driven methods often suffer from lack of equivariance to physical symmetries, inadequate handling of collisions, and limited scalability. Here we introduce 
ame, the first end-to-end equivariant neural fields simulator for deformable objects and their collisions. We propose an equivariant encoder to map object geometry and velocity into latent control points. A subsequent equivariant Graph Neural Network-based Neural Ordinary Differential Equation models the interactions among control points via collision-aware message passing. To reconstruct velocity fields, we query a neural field conditioned on control point features, enabling continuous and resolution-independent motion predictions. Experimental results on 2D and 3D scenarios show that 
ame achieves accurate, stable, and scalable simulations across diverse object configurations. It achieves $24.34\%$ to $57.62\%$ lower rollout MSE, even compared with the best-performing baseline model. Furthermore, 
ame could generalize to more colliding objects and extended temporal horizons, and stay robust to input transformed with group action. Code is available at: https://github.com/AI4Science-WestlakeU/EqCollide
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EqCollide，首个端到端等变神经场模拟器，用于可变形物体及其碰撞模拟。该方法利用等变编码器映射几何与速度到潜在控制点，通过等变图神经网络神经ODE进行碰撞感知消息传递，并通过神经场重建连续速度场。实验表明在2D/3D场景中相比最佳基线降低24.34%-57.62%的滚动MSE，且能泛化至更多物体和更长时域。
Motivation: 现有数据驱动方法缺乏对物理对称性的等变性，碰撞处理不充分，可扩展性有限。
Method: 提出等变编码器将物体几何与速度映射到潜在控制点，通过基于等变图神经网络的神经ODE建模控制点间碰撞感知交互，并利用神经场查询重建连续速度场。
Result: 在2D和3D场景中，相比最佳基线模型，滚动MSE降低了24.34%至57.62%。模型可泛化至更多碰撞物体和更长时间范围，并对输入群作用变换保持鲁棒。
Conclusion: EqCollide实现了准确、稳定、可扩展的可变形物体碰撞模拟，代码已开源。

papers.title: Sentinel: Decoding Context Utilization via Attention Probing for Efficient LLM Context Compression
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) often suffers from long and noisy retrieved contexts. Existing context compression methods typically rely on heuristic relevance estimation or supervised compression models rather than on how LLMs utilize retrieved context during inference. We propose Sentinel, a lightweight sentence-level compression framework that decodes inference-time contextual utilization behaviors from head-wise attention patterns of frozen LLMs. To ground supervision in retrieval-dependent answering behavior, Sentinel trains a lightweight probe using QA examples where the model succeeds only when retrieved context is available. Sentinel performs compression using only a single non-autoregressive forward pass without dedicated compression training or autoregressive scoring. Empirically, we find that effective contextual utilization signals remain accessible even in compact proxy models. On LongBench, Sentinel with a 0.5B proxy model achieves up to 5$\times$ compression while attaining question-answering performance competitive with compression methods built on 7B-scale models. Despite being trained only on English QA data, Sentinel also generalizes effectively to Chinese and out-of-domain settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Sentinel，一种轻量级的句子级上下文压缩框架，通过冻结LLM的注意力头模式解码推理时的上下文利用行为，仅需一次非自回归前向传播即可实现压缩，无需专用压缩训练。使用0.5B代理模型在LongBench上实现5倍压缩，性能与基于7B模型的压缩方法相当，并能泛化到中文和域外场景。
Motivation: 检索增强生成（RAG）常面临长且噪声大的上下文，现有压缩方法依赖启发式相关性估计或有监督压缩模型，而非利用LLM在推理时的上下文利用行为。
Method: 提出Sentinel框架，使用轻量级探针（probe）从冻结LLM的注意力头模式中解码上下文利用行为，训练探针时利用只在检索上下文存在时模型才成功的QA示例作为监督，压缩时仅需单次非自回归前向传播。
Result: 在LongBench上，Sentinel使用0.5B代理模型实现5倍压缩，问答性能与基于7B模型的压缩方法相当；仅用英文QA数据训练，能有效泛化到中文和域外任务。
Conclusion: 实验表明，紧凑代理模型仍能获取有效的上下文利用信号，Sentinel提供了一种无需专用压缩训练的高效压缩途径，并展现出良好的跨语言和域外泛化能力。

papers.title: MASLab: A Unified and Comprehensive Codebase for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have demonstrated significant potential in enhancing single LLMs to address complex and diverse tasks in practical applications. Despite considerable advancements, the field lacks a unified codebase that consolidates existing methods, resulting in redundant re-implementation efforts, unfair comparisons, and high entry barriers for researchers. To address these challenges, we introduce MASLab, a unified, comprehensive, and research-friendly codebase for LLM-based MAS. (1) MASLab integrates over 20 established methods across multiple domains, each rigorously validated by comparing step-by-step outputs with its official implementation. (2) MASLab provides a unified environment with various benchmarks for fair comparisons among methods, ensuring consistent inputs and standardized evaluation protocols. (3) MASLab implements methods within a shared streamlined structure, lowering the barriers for understanding and extension. Building on MASLab, we conduct extensive experiments covering 10+ benchmarks and 8 models, offering researchers a clear and comprehensive view of the current landscape of MAS methods. MASLab will continue to evolve, tracking the latest developments in the field, and invite contributions from the broader open-source community.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MASLab是一个统一的、全面的、研究友好的代码库，用于基于LLM的多智能体系统。它集成了20多种已建立的方法，提供了统一的评估环境和标准化协议，并在10多个基准和8个模型上进行了广泛实验，为研究者提供了当前MAS方法的清晰全景。
Motivation: 当前基于LLM的多智能体系统领域缺乏统一的代码库，导致重复实现、不公平比较和高入门门槛。
Method: MASLab整合了20多种方法，提供统一环境与基准，确保输入和评估协议一致，并采用共享的简化结构以降低理解与扩展难度。
Result: 在10多个基准和8个模型上进行了广泛实验，为研究者提供了MAS方法现状的全面视图。
Conclusion: MASLab将持续发展，跟踪领域最新进展，并欢迎开源社区的贡献。

papers.title: FreshRetailNet-LT: A Stockout-Annotated Censored Demand Dataset for Latent Demand Recovery and Forecasting in Fresh Retail
papers.abstract_en: Accurate demand estimation is critical for the retail business in guiding the inventory and pricing policies of perishable products. However, it faces fundamental challenges from censored sales data during stockouts, where unobserved demand creates systemic policy biases. Existing datasets lack the temporal resolution and annotations needed to address this censoring effect. To fill this gap, we present FreshRetailNet-50K, the first large-scale benchmark for censored demand estimation. It comprises 50,000 store-product time series of detailed hourly sales data from 898 stores in 18 major cities, encompassing 863 perishable SKUs meticulously annotated for stockout events. The hourly stock status records unique to this dataset, combined with rich contextual covariates, including promotional discounts, precipitation, and temporal features, enable innovative research beyond existing solutions. We demonstrate one such use case of two-stage demand modeling: first, we reconstruct the latent demand during stockouts using precise hourly annotations. We then leverage the recovered demand to train robust demand forecasting models in the second stage. Experimental results show that this approach achieves a 2.73% improvement in prediction accuracy while reducing the systematic demand underestimation from 7.37% to near-zero bias. With unprecedented temporal granularity and comprehensive real-world information, FreshRetailNet-50K opens new research directions in demand imputation, perishable inventory optimization, and causal retail analytics. The unique annotation quality and scale of the dataset address long-standing limitations in retail AI, providing immediate solutions and a platform for future methodological innovation. The data (https://huggingface.co/datasets/Dingdong-Inc/FreshRetailNet-50K) and code (https://github.com/Dingdong-Inc/frn-50k-baseline}) are openly released.
papers.comment: FreshRetailNet-LT is a new version of FreshRetailNet-50K, spanning dataset over two years
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发布FreshRetailNet-50K数据集，这是首个大规模用于截尾需求估计的基准，包含898家商店863种易腐商品的5万条小时级销售时间序列，并详细标注了缺货事件。基于该数据集，作者展示了两阶段需求建模：先利用精确小时注释重建缺货期间的潜在需求，再使用恢复后的需求训练鲁棒预测模型。实验表明，该方法将预测准确率提升2.73%，并将系统性的需求低估从7.37%降至接近零偏差。
Motivation: 零售中缺货期间销售数据被截尾，导致未观测需求造成系统性策略偏差，现有数据集缺乏解决此问题所需的时间分辨率和注释。
Method: 构建包含小时级销售数据、缺货注释和丰富上下文协变量（促销折扣、降水、时间特征）的数据集；提出两阶段需求建模：第一阶段利用精确小时注释重建缺货期间的潜在需求，第二阶段使用恢复的需求训练预测模型。
Result: 在FreshRetailNet-50K数据集上，两阶段方法使预测准确率提升2.73%，系统需求低估从7.37%降至接近零偏差。
Conclusion: 该数据集以空前的时间粒度和真实世界信息，为需求插补、易腐品库存优化和因果零售分析开辟了新方向。

papers.title: LLM-Powered AI Agent Systems and Their Applications in Industry
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs) has reshaped agent systems. Unlike traditional rule-based agents with limited task scope, LLM-powered agents offer greater flexibility, cross-domain reasoning, and natural language interaction. Moreover, with the integration of multi-modal LLMs, current agent systems are highly capable of processing diverse data modalities, including text, images, audio, and structured tabular data, enabling richer and more adaptive real-world behavior. This paper comprehensively examines the evolution of agent systems from the pre-LLM era to current LLM-powered architectures. We categorize agent systems into software-based, physical, and adaptive hybrid systems, highlighting applications across customer service, software development, manufacturing automation, personalized education, financial trading, and healthcare. We further discuss the primary challenges posed by LLM-powered agents, including high inference latency, output uncertainty, lack of evaluation metrics, and security vulnerabilities, and propose potential solutions to mitigate these concerns.
papers.comment: This is the author's accepted version of the paper accepted to appear at IEEE AIIoT 2025. The final version will be available via IEEE Xplore. \c{opyright}2025 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文全面审视了从传统代理系统到LLM驱动代理系统的演化，将代理系统分为软件型、物理型和自适应混合型，并讨论其在客服、软件开发、制造自动化、个性化教育、金融交易和医疗等领域的应用，同时指出高推理延迟、输出不确定性、缺乏评估指标和安全漏洞等挑战。
Motivation: 传统基于规则的代理系统任务范围有限，LLM驱动的代理系统具有更大的灵活性、跨领域推理和自然语言交互能力，但面临新的挑战，需要系统性的梳理和分析。
Method: 对代理系统从预LLM时代到当前LLM驱动架构的演变进行综述，将系统分类为软件型、物理型和自适应混合型，并分析应用场景和主要挑战，提出潜在解决方案。
Conclusion: LLM驱动的代理系统在处理多模态数据（文本、图像、音频、表格数据）方面能力强大，但需要解决推理延迟、输出不确定性、评估指标和安全性等问题。

papers.title: Fractured Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Inference-time scaling techniques have significantly bolstered the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) by harnessing additional computational effort at inference without retraining. Similarly, Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting and its extension, Long CoT, improve accuracy by generating rich intermediate reasoning trajectories, but these approaches incur substantial token costs that impede their deployment in latency-sensitive settings. In this work, we first show that truncated CoT, which stops reasoning before completion and directly generates the final answer, often matches the full CoT sampling while using dramatically fewer tokens. Building on this insight, we introduce Fractured Sampling, a unified inference-time strategy that interpolates between full CoT and solution-only sampling along three orthogonal axes: (1) the number of reasoning trajectories, (2) the number of final solutions per trajectory, and (3) the depth at which reasoning traces are truncated. Through extensive experiments on five diverse reasoning benchmarks and several model scales, we demonstrate that Fractured Sampling consistently achieves superior accuracy-cost trade-offs, yielding steep log-linear scaling gains in Pass@k versus token budget. Our analysis reveals how to allocate computation across these dimensions to maximize performance, paving the way for more efficient and scalable LLM reasoning. Code is available at https://github.com/BaohaoLiao/frac-cot.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Fractured Sampling，一种统一的推理时策略，通过在三个正交维度（推理轨迹数量、每条轨迹的最终解数量、推理轨迹截断深度）之间插值，在完整 CoT 和仅输出采样之间权衡。实验表明，该方法在多个推理基准上实现了更好的准确率-成本平衡，比完整 CoT 使用更少的 token 且性能相当或更优。
Motivation: 长链思维（Long CoT）虽提升推理性能，但生成大量中间 token 导致推理成本高，限制了其在延迟敏感场景的部署。本文旨在通过截断推理轨迹，在不显著牺牲准确率的前提下大幅减少 token 消耗。
Method: 提出 Fractured Sampling，沿三个正交轴（推理轨迹数、每条轨迹的最终解数、推理截断深度）进行插值采样，以灵活分配计算资源。该方法基于观察：截断 CoT（在完成推理前停止并直接生成答案）通常与完整 CoT 性能相当但 token 少得多。
Result: 在五个推理基准和多种模型规模上的实验表明，Fractured Sampling 始终实现更优的准确率-成本权衡，在 Pass@k 与 token 预算之间呈现陡峭的对数线性增益。
Conclusion: 本文展示了如何跨这些维度分配计算以最大化性能，为更高效、可扩展的 LLM 推理铺平道路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Accountability Paradox: How Platform API Restrictions Undermine AI Transparency Mandates
papers.abstract_en: Recent application programming interface (API) restrictions on major social media platforms challenge compliance with the EU Digital Services Act [20], which mandates data access for algorithmic transparency. We develop a structured audit framework to assess the growing misalignment between regulatory requirements and platform implementations. Our comparative analysis of X/Twitter, Reddit, TikTok, and Meta identifies critical ``audit blind-spots'' where platform content moderation and algorithmic amplification remain inaccessible to independent verification. Our findings reveal an ``accountability paradox'': as platforms increasingly rely on AI systems, they simultaneously restrict the capacity for independent oversight. We propose targeted policy interventions aligned with the AI Risk Management Framework of the National Institute of Standards and Technology [80], emphasizing federated access models and enhanced regulatory enforcement.
papers.comment: Accepted at ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency (FAccT '26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了社交媒体平台API限制如何与欧盟《数字服务法案》的算法透明度要求产生冲突。通过对比X/Twitter、Reddit、TikTok和Meta的API现状，作者识别出内容审核和算法放大机制方面的“审计盲区”，并揭示了“问责悖论”：平台日益依赖AI系统，却同时限制独立监督能力。最后提出了基于NIST AI风险管理框架的联邦访问模型和强化监管等政策建议。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对平台API限制与法规要求之间系统性冲突的审计框架，导致算法透明度监管难以落地。
Method: 构建结构化审计框架，对四家主要社交平台的API权限、内容可访问性及算法透明度进行对比分析。
Result: 发现X/Twitter、Reddit、TikTok和Meta均存在关键审计盲区，独立研究者无法验证平台的内容审核和算法放大行为。
Conclusion: 平台API限制形成了问责悖论，需通过联邦访问模型和强化执法来弥合监管差距。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reward-SQL: Boosting Text-to-SQL via Stepwise Execution-Aware Reasoning and Process-Supervised Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) trained with reinforcement learning (RL) have improved Text-to-SQL performance. However, RL-based approaches still struggle with complex queries due to two key limitations: insufficient stepwise execution-aware reasoning grounded in database feedback, and the lack of process-level rewards for guiding reasoning optimization. To address these issues, we propose CoCTE, a divide-and-conquer and execution-aware reasoning framework that progressively composes SQL queries through intermediate view validation and structured Common Table Expressions (CTEs), improving both accuracy and interpretability. To realize a CoCTE reasoning process, we develop Reward-SQL, a unified approach with three stages: (1) model initialization, which equips LLMs with structured CoCTE reasoning capabilities; (2) process reward design, which delivers fine-grained, execution-aware supervision; and (3) process-supervised RL and inference, which integrates process rewards into training and guides the inference stage by process rewards. This paper addresses the core challenges in Reward-SQL and makes the following contributions. We introduce a process reward model (PRM) that combines execution-aware trajectory scoring with entropy-based step weighting, providing dense and interpretable supervision across reasoning steps. We integrate PRM into both RL training and inference stages, stabilizing optimization and improving trajectory exploration with process-level signals. Experiments show that Reward-SQL significantly outperforms baselines with comparable model sizes, and exhibits strong cross-domain generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对复杂SQL查询中强化学习训练的两大局限——缺乏基于数据库反馈的逐步执行感知推理和缺少过程级奖励引导推理优化——提出CoCTE分解执行感知推理框架和Reward-SQL统一方法。该方法通过三步流程（模型初始化、过程奖励设计、过程监督强化学习与推理）提升Text-to-SQL性能，引入结合执行感知轨迹评分与熵权重的过程奖励模型(PRM)，在多个基准上优于可比大小的基线模型，并展现强跨域泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有基于强化学习的Text-to-SQL方法在处理复杂查询时，缺乏逐步执行感知推理（即利用数据库反馈）以及过程级奖励信号来指导推理优化，导致性能受限。
Method: 提出CoCTE推理框架，通过中间视图验证和结构化公共表表达式(CTE)逐步组合SQL查询；在此基础上开发Reward-SQL，包含模型初始化（赋予LLM结构化CoCTE推理能力）、过程奖励设计（细粒度执行感知监督）以及过程监督强化学习与推理（整合过程奖励到训练和推理）三个阶段。
Result: 实验表明Reward-SQL在多个基准上显著优于可比大小的基线模型，并展现出强大的跨域泛化能力。
Conclusion: 通过结合执行感知轨迹评分与熵权重的过程奖励模型(PRM)，为推理步骤提供密集且可解释的监督信号，并集成到训练和推理阶段，有效提升了复杂SQL查询的准确性和可解释性。

papers.title: MOSIC: Model-Agnostic Optimal Subgroup Identification with Multi-Constraint for Improved Reliability
papers.abstract_en: Current subgroup identification methods typically follow a two-step approach: first estimate conditional average treatment effects and then apply thresholding or rule-based procedures to define subgroups. While intuitive, this decoupled approach fails to incorporate key constraints essential for real-world clinical decision-making, such as subgroup size and propensity overlap. These constraints operate on fundamentally different axes than CATE estimation and are not naturally accommodated within existing frameworks, thereby limiting the practical applicability of these methods. We propose a unified optimization framework that directly solves the primal constrained optimization problem to identify optimal subgroups. Our key innovation is a reformulation of the constrained primal problem as an unconstrained differentiable min-max objective, solved via a gradient descent-ascent algorithm. We theoretically establish that our solution converges to a feasible and locally optimal solution. Unlike threshold-based CATE methods that apply constraints as post-hoc filters, our approach enforces them directly during optimization. The framework is model-agnostic, compatible with a wide range of CATE estimators, and extensible to additional constraints like cost limits or fairness criteria. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate its effectiveness in identifying high-benefit subgroups while maintaining better satisfaction of constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MOSIC框架，直接求解带约束的原始优化问题来识别最优子组，避免了两步法（先估计CATE再阈值化）的局限。关键创新是将约束原始问题重写为可微分的min-max目标，通过梯度下降-上升算法求解。理论上证明了收敛到可行且局部最优的解。方法模型无关，可兼容多种CATE估计器，并支持扩展额外约束（如成本、公平性）。实验表明能有效识别高收益子组且更好满足约束。
Motivation: 现有子组识别方法通常两步走：先估计CATE，再阈值或规则定义子组。但这种解耦方式无法纳入对临床决策至关重要的约束（如子组大小、倾向性重叠），这些约束与CATE估计在不同轴上操作，现有方法难以自然容纳，限制了实用性。
Method: 提出统一优化框架，直接求解约束原始优化问题。核心创新是将约束原始问题重写为可微分的无约束min-max目标，使用梯度下降-上升算法求解。理论证明收敛到可行且局部最优解。框架模型无关，兼容多种CATE估计器，并可扩展额外约束。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，该方法能有效识别高收益子组，同时更好地满足约束条件。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法通过直接优化中强制执行约束，相比后处理过滤的阈值方法更优。框架具有模型无关性和可扩展性。

papers.title: UniversalRAG: Retrieval-Augmented Generation over Corpora of Diverse Modalities and Granularities
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has shown substantial promise in improving factual accuracy by grounding model responses with external knowledge relevant to queries. However, most existing approaches are limited to a text-only corpus, and while recent efforts have extended RAG to other modalities such as images and videos, they typically operate over a single modality-specific corpus. In contrast, real-world queries vary widely in the type of knowledge they require, which a single type of knowledge source cannot address. To address this, we introduce UniversalRAG, an any-to-any RAG framework designed to retrieve and integrate knowledge from heterogeneous sources with diverse modalities and granularities. Specifically, motivated by the observation that forcing all modalities into a unified representation space derived from a single aggregated corpus causes a modality gap, where the retrieval tends to favor items from the same modality as the query, we propose modality-aware routing, which dynamically identifies the most appropriate modality-specific corpus and performs targeted retrieval within it, and further justify its effectiveness with a theoretical analysis. Moreover, beyond modality, we organize each modality into multiple granularity levels, enabling fine-tuned retrieval tailored to the complexity and scope of the query. We validate UniversalRAG on 10 benchmarks of multiple modalities, showing its superiority over various modality-specific and unified baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniversalRAG，一个任意模态（text, image, video等）的检索增强生成框架，支持从异构知识源中检索并整合信息。通过模态感知路由动态选择最合适的模态特定语料库，并组织每个模态为多粒度级别，以适配查询的复杂度。在10个多模态基准上验证了其优于现有单模态和统一基线方法。
Motivation: 现有 RAG 方法大多局限于文本语料库或单一模态，无法处理现实查询中所需的多类型知识（如图像、视频等），且将多模态强制统一到单一表示空间会导致模态偏差（优先检索同模态项）。
Method: 提出模态感知路由（modality-aware routing），基于理论分析动态识别最适合查询的模态特定语料库并在其中进行目标检索；同时将每个模态按粒度组织，支持根据查询范围和复杂度进行细粒度检索。
Result: 在10个涵盖多种模态的基准（如文本、图像、视频问答等）上，UniversalRAG 在检索准确性和生成质量上均优于模态特定和统一基线方法。
Conclusion: UniversalRAG 证明了跨模态、跨粒度的 RAG 可行性，为处理现实世界异构知识查询提供了一种有效且通用的解决方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FPGA-Based Neural Network Accelerators for Space Applications: A Survey
papers.abstract_en: Space missions are becoming increasingly ambitious, necessitating high-performance onboard spacecraft computing systems. In response, field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) have garnered significant interest due to their flexibility, cost-effectiveness, and radiation tolerance potential. Concurrently, neural networks (NNs) are being recognized for their capability to execute space mission tasks such as autonomous operations, sensor data analysis, and data compression. This survey serves as a valuable resource for researchers aiming to implement FPGA-based NN accelerators in space applications. By analyzing existing literature, identifying trends and gaps, and proposing future research directions, this work highlights the potential of these accelerators to enhance onboard computing systems.
papers.comment: Manuscript under review at ACM CSUR. Pre-print updated after 1st Major Revision
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了用于空间应用的FPGA神经网络加速器，分析了现有文献的趋势和空白，并提出了未来研究方向。强调了FPGA的高灵活性和抗辐射潜力，以及神经网络在自主操作、传感器数据分析等任务中的应用。
Motivation: 空间任务对星载计算能力需求日益增长，FPGA因其灵活性和成本效益被关注，神经网络在空间任务中表现突出，但缺乏系统性的综述来指导研究者。
Conclusion: 本文为研究者在空间应用中实现FPGA NN加速器提供了资源，并指出了未来研究机会。

papers.title: Vanishing Depth: Training Generalized Depth Adapters with Sinusoidal Depth Preprocessing for Pretrained RGB Encoders
papers.abstract_en: Generalized metric depth understanding is critical for precise vision-guided robotics, which current state-of-the-art (SOTA) vision-encoders do not support. To address this, we propose a self-supervised training approach that extends pretrained RGB encoders with a depth adapter to incorporate and align metric depth into a combined latent space without interfering with the pretrained RGB feature extraction. In combination with our sinusoidal depth encoding, the depth adapter enables generalized and robust depth density and distribution invariant feature extraction. Our depth adapters improve a wide set of generalized RGB baselines across a spectrum of relevant RGBD downstream tasks in segmentation, pose estimation, and depth completion -- without the necessity of finetuning. Most importantly, we achieve 56.05 mIoU in the SUN-RGBD segmentation, while outperforming SOTA depth-aware and multi-modal encoders in our experiments. When no depth is present, one can activate our depth adapter with an empty map, use single pixel depth clues, or monocular depth estimation to include the depth aware feature extraction into subsequent downstream tasks.

papers.title: Revisiting Outage for Edge Inference Systems
papers.abstract_en: One of the key missions of sixth-generation (6G) mobile networks is to deploy large-scale artificial intelligence (AI) models at the network edge to provide remote-inference services for edge devices. The resultant platform, known as edge inference, will support a wide range of Internet-of-Things applications, such as autonomous driving, industrial automation, and augmented reality. Given the mission-critical and time-sensitive nature of these tasks, it is essential to design edge inference systems that are both reliable and capable of meeting stringent end-to-end (E2E) latency constraints. Existing studies, which primarily focus on communication reliability as characterized by channel outage probability, may fail to guarantee E2E performance, specifically in terms of E2E inference accuracy and latency. To address this limitation, we propose a theoretical framework that introduces and mathematically characterizes the inference outage (InfOut) probability, which quantifies the likelihood that the E2E inference accuracy falls below a target threshold. Under an E2E latency constraint, this framework establishes a fundamental tradeoff between communication overhead (i.e., uploading more sensor observations) and inference reliability as quantified by the InfOut probability. To find a tractable way to optimize this tradeoff, we derive accurate surrogate functions for InfOut probability by applying a Gaussian approximation to the distribution of the received discriminant gain. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed design over conventional communication-centric approaches in terms of E2E inference reliability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向6G边缘推理系统，提出推理中断（InfOut）概率这一新指标，量化端到端推理准确率低于阈值的概率。在延迟约束下，建立通信开销与推理可靠性的折中，通过高斯近似推导易处理的代理函数。实验表明所提方法优于传统以通信为中心的设计。
Motivation: 现有边缘推理系统仅关注通信可靠性（信道中断概率），无法保证端到端推理准确率和延迟，需新可靠性指标。
Method: 定义推理中断（InfOut）概率，建立端到端延迟约束下通信开销与推理可靠性的理论框架，利用高斯近似推导InfOut概率的代理函数以优化折中。
Result: 实验结果显示所提设计在端到端推理可靠性上优于传统通信为中心的方法。
Conclusion: InfOut概率可作为边缘推理可靠性的关键指标，所提框架为系统设计提供新思路。

papers.title: ADAPT: An Autonomous Forklift for Construction Site Operation
papers.abstract_en: Efficient material logistics play a critical role in controlling costs and schedules in the construction industry. However, manual material handling remains prone to inefficiencies, delays, and safety risks. Autonomous forklifts offer a promising solution to streamline on-site logistics, reducing reliance on human operators and mitigating labor shortages. This paper presents the development and evaluation of ADAPT (Autonomous Dynamic All-terrain Pallet Transporter), a fully autonomous off-road forklift designed for construction environments. Unlike structured warehouse settings, construction sites pose significant challenges, including dynamic obstacles, unstructured terrain, and varying weather conditions. To address these challenges, our system integrates AI-driven perception techniques with traditional approaches for decision making, planning, and control, enabling reliable operation in complex environments. We validate the system through extensive real-world testing, comparing its continuous performance against an experienced human operator across various weather conditions. Our findings demonstrate that autonomous outdoor forklifts can operate near human-level performance, offering a viable path toward safer and more efficient construction logistics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍ADAPT（Autonomous Dynamic All-terrain Pallet Transporter），一款面向建筑工地的全自动越野叉车。系统融合AI感知（如目标检测、地形识别）与传统决策规划控制方法，在动态障碍物、非结构化地形和变化天气等挑战下实现可靠运行。通过在多种天气条件下与经验丰富的人类操作员进行连续性能对比测试，验证了自动驾驶叉车可达到接近人类水平的操作能力，为提升建筑物流安全与效率提供了可行方案。
Motivation: 建筑工地物料搬运依赖人工操作，效率低且存在安全隐患；现有自动化方案多适用于室内仓库，缺乏适应户外复杂环境（动态障碍、非结构化地形、天气变化）的自主系统。
Method: 提出ADAPT系统，集成AI感知模块（如视觉目标检测与地形分类）与基于传统方法的决策、规划、控制模块，实现全自主导航与托盘搬运。系统在真实建筑工地上进行多场景测试。
Result: 在多种天气条件下（晴天、雨天等）的连续测试中，ADAPT的性能接近经验丰富的人类叉车操作员，表明户外自主叉车可达到近似人工的操作效率与稳定性。
Conclusion: 研究成果表明，自主户外叉车能够安全、高效地应用于建筑工地物流，为缓解劳动力短缺、降低安全风险提供了一条可行路径。

papers.title: Denoising Score Matching with Random Features: Insights on Diffusion Models from Precise Learning Curves
papers.abstract_en: We theoretically investigate the phenomena of generalization and memorization in diffusion models. Empirical studies suggest that these phenomena are influenced by model complexity and the size of the training dataset. In our experiments, we further observe that the number of noise samples per data sample ($m$) used during Denoising Score Matching (DSM) plays a significant and non-trivial role. We capture these behaviors and shed insights into their mechanisms by deriving asymptotically precise expressions for test and train errors of DSM under a simple theoretical setting. The score function is parameterized by random features neural networks, with the target distribution being $d$-dimensional Gaussian. We operate in a regime where the dimension $d$, number of data samples $n$, and number of features $p$ tend to infinity while keeping the ratios $ψ_n=\frac{n}{d}$ and $ψ_p=\frac{p}{d}$ fixed. By characterizing the test and train errors, we identify regimes of generalization and memorization as a function of $ψ_n,ψ_p$, and $m$. Our theoretical findings are consistent with the empirical observations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论上研究扩散模型中的泛化与记忆化现象，通过推导去噪分数匹配（DSM）在简单设定下的精确渐近误差表达式，揭示了模型复杂度、训练集大小以及每个数据样本的噪声采样数（m）对泛化与记忆化的影响。理论分析采用随机特征神经网络参数化得分函数，目标分布为d维高斯分布，在维度、样本数和特征数趋于无穷且比例固定的框架下，给出了测试误差和训练误差的精确表征。
Motivation: 扩散模型在实际应用中表现出泛化与记忆化行为，但其理论机制尚不清晰，特别是噪声采样数（m）的作用未被充分理解。本文旨在通过精确的理论分析揭示这些因素如何影响模型行为。
Method: 采用随机特征神经网络参数化得分函数，假设目标为d维高斯分布，在维度d、样本数n和特征数p同尺度增长（固定比例ψ_n=n/d, ψ_p=p/d）的高维极限下，通过随机矩阵理论推导DSM训练误差和测试误差的渐近精确表达式。
Result: 理论结果刻画了泛化与记忆化区域随ψ_n, ψ_p和m的变化，发现m值对误差有显著且非平凡影响，并与实验观测一致。
Conclusion: 该理论框架为理解扩散模型中的泛化与记忆化提供了精确的数学基础，特别强调了噪声采样数m的关键作用。

papers.title: A Water Efficiency Dataset for African Data Centers
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) computing and data centers consume large amounts of freshwater, both directly for cooling and indirectly for electricity generation. While most attention has been paid to developed countries such as the U.S., this paper presents the first-of-its-kind dataset that combines nation-level weather and electricity generation data to estimate water usage effectiveness for data centers in 41 African countries across five different climate regions. We also use our dataset to evaluate and estimate the water consumption of inference on two large language models (i.e., Llama-3-70B and GPT-4) in 11 selected African countries. Our estimates suggest that writing a 10-page report using Llama-3-70B could consume as much as {0.66 liters} of water, while the water consumption by GPT-4 for the same task may go up to about {59 liters}. For writing a medium-length email of 120-200 words, Llama-3-70B and GPT-4 could consume about {0.13 liters} and {2.9 liters} of water, respectively. All the numbers for generative model inference tasks are based on public information available in 2024, when we initially prepared the analysis. Since then, AI inference systems have improved substantially. For example, recent disclosures suggest that energy efficiency improved by more than 30x between May 2024 and May 2025. Accordingly, our 2024 estimates should be interpreted as historical reference values rather than as representative of current performance. Interestingly, given the same AI model, 9 of the 11 selected African countries consume less water than the global average, mainly because of lower water intensities for electricity generation.

TL;DR: 本文首次构建了一个结合国家层面天气和发电数据的非洲数据中心水资源效率数据集，覆盖41个非洲国家。利用该数据集评估了Llama-3-70B和GPT-4在11个选定非洲国家进行推理的耗水量，发现生成10页报告分别消耗约0.66升和59升水，而写一封中等长度邮件分别消耗约0.13升和2.9升水。研究指出，由于发电水强度较低，11个非洲国家中有9个在相同AI模型下耗水低于全球平均水平。
Motivation: 现有研究多关注发达国家的数据中心水耗，缺乏非洲地区的相关数据。论文旨在填补这一空白，提供首个面向非洲数据中心的水资源效率数据集。
Method: 整合非洲41个国家的天气和发电数据，计算水使用效率（WUE），并基于公开信息估算Llama-3-70B和GPT-4推理任务的水消耗。
Result: 生成10页报告，Llama-3-70B和GPT-4分别消耗约0.66升和59升水；写120-200词邮件分别消耗约0.13升和2.9升水。9/11的非洲国家水耗低于全球平均。
Conclusion: 论文强调其数据集和估算可作为历史参考，并指出AI推理系统的效率已显著提升（2024-2025年间能源效率提高超30倍）。研究凸显了非洲数据中心水耗的地理差异。

papers.title: Automatic identification of diagnosis from hospital discharge letters via weakly supervised Natural Language Processing
papers.abstract_en: Identifying patient diagnoses from hospital discharge letters is essential for large-scale cohort selection and epidemiological research, but traditional supervised approaches require extensive manual annotation, which is often impractical for large textual datasets. We present a weakly supervised Natural Language Processing (NLP) pipeline for classifying Italian discharge letters without document-level manual annotation. The method extracts diagnosis-related sentences, generates semantic embeddings using a transformer model further pre-trained on Italian medical documents, and applies a two-level clustering procedure to derive weak labels that are then used to train a document-level classifier. The approach was evaluated in a case study on bronchiolitis using 33,176 discharge letters of children admitted to 44 emergency rooms or hospitals in the Veneto Region, Italy, between 2017 and 2020. The best weakly supervised model achieved an AUROC of 77.68% ($\pm4.30\%$), an AUPRC of 73.13% ($\pm4.93\%$), and an F1-score of 78.14% ($\pm4.89\%$) against manually annotated data. Performance surpassed unsupervised baselines and approached fully supervised models, while reducing the need for manual annotation by more than 1,500 hours for a dataset of this size. Similar model rankings were observed in a secondary validation on a smaller bronchitis dataset (3,188 discharge letters, 2020-2025), where the best weakly supervised model achieved an AUPRC of 76.72% ($\pm 5.02\%$). These results suggest the potential of weakly supervised NLP methods for scalable disease identification from clinical discharge letters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种弱监督自然语言处理（NLP）流水线，用于自动从意大利语的医院出院信中识别患者诊断，无需文档级别的人工标注。该方法提取诊断相关句子，使用在意大利医学文档上进一步预训练的Transformer模型生成语义嵌入，并通过两级聚类过程生成弱标签，用于训练文档级分类器。在33,176份儿童细支气管炎出院信（2017-2020年）上，最佳弱监督模型AUROC为77.68%（±4.30%），AUPRC为73.13%（±4.93%），F1分数为78.14%（±4.89%），表现优于无监督基线，接近全监督模型，并减少了超过1500小时的手动标注工作。在3,188份支气管炎出院信（2020-2025年）的二次验证中，最佳弱监督模型AUPRC为76.72%（±5.02%）。结果表明弱监督NLP方法可扩展地用于临床出院信中的疾病识别。
Motivation: 传统监督方法需要大量人工标注，这对于大型文本数据集往往不切实际。本文旨在开发一种无需文档级人工标注的弱监督NLP流水线，用于自动识别出院信中的诊断，以支持大规模队列选择和流行病学研究。
Method: 提出弱监督NLP流水线：首先提取与诊断相关的句子；使用在意大利医学文档上进一步预训练的Transformer模型生成语义嵌入；应用两级聚类过程（句子级和文档级）生成弱标签；最后用这些弱标签训练文档级分类器。
Result: 在33,176份细支气管炎出院信上，最佳弱监督模型AUROC为77.68%（±4.30%），AUPRC为73.13%（±4.93%），F1分数为78.14%（±4.89%）。在3,188份支气管炎出院信上，最佳弱监督模型AUPRC为76.72%（±5.02%）。性能超过无监督基线，接近全监督模型，并节省超过1500小时人工标注。
Conclusion: 摘要表明弱监督NLP方法有潜力实现临床出院信中疾病识别的可扩展性，减少对大量人工标注的依赖，并在不同数据集上表现稳定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On the Geometry and Optimization of Polynomial Convolutional Networks
papers.abstract_en: We study convolutional neural networks with monomial activation functions. Specifically, we prove that their parameterization map is regular and is an isomorphism almost everywhere, up to rescaling the filters. By leveraging on tools from algebraic geometry, we explore the geometric properties of the image in function space of this map - typically referred to as neuromanifold. In particular, we compute the dimension and the degree of the neuromanifold, which measure the expressivity of the model, and describe its singularities. Moreover, for a generic large dataset, we derive an explicit formula that quantifies the number of critical points arising in the optimization of a regression loss.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究使用单项式激活函数的卷积神经网络，证明其参数化映射是正则的且几乎处处同构，并利用代数几何工具计算神经流形的维数和度，描述其奇点，同时给出回归损失中临界点数量的显式公式。
Motivation: 为了理解具有多项式激活的卷积神经网络的几何性质和表达能力，填补理论分析空白。
Method: 利用代数几何方法，分析参数化映射的正则性和同构性，并计算神经流形的维数、度及奇点，推导临界点计数公式。
Result: 证明了神经流形的维数和度可显式计算，并给出了大数据集下回归损失临界点数量的精确公式。
Conclusion: 结果表明代数几何工具可以有效地刻画多项式卷积网络的表达性和优化景观。

papers.title: MirrorCheck: Efficient Adversarial Defense for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly susceptible to sophisticated adversarial attacks, including adaptive strategies specifically designed to bypass existing defenses. To address this vulnerability, we propose MirrorCheck, a robust and model-agnostic detection framework that operates effectively in both unimodal and multimodal settings. MirrorCheck leverages Text-to-Image (T2I) models to regenerate visual content from captions produced by the target model and assesses semantic consistency by comparing feature-space embeddings between the original and synthesized images. To enhance robustness against adaptive attacks, MirrorCheck introduces a stochastic defense strategy that randomly selects T2I generators and image encoders from a diverse model zoo. Additionally, we incorporate a novel One-Time-Use (OTU) perturbation applied to the selected encoder embeddings, regulated by a scaling factor, which decreases the effectiveness of adaptive attacks. Extensive experiments across multiple threat scenarios demonstrate that MirrorCheck consistently outperforms baseline methods, and maintains its utility even under strong adaptive adversarial conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MirrorCheck，一种模型无关的检测框架，用于防御视觉语言模型（VLM）的对抗攻击。该方法利用文本到图像（T2I）模型从目标模型生成的描述中重建图像，并通过比较特征空间嵌入来评估语义一致性。通过随机选择T2I生成器和图像编码器，以及引入一次性扰动（OTU），增强了对自适应攻击的鲁棒性。实验表明，MirrorCheck在多种威胁场景下优于基线方法。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型易受复杂的对抗攻击，包括自适应策略，现有防御不足。
Method: 提出 MirrorCheck 框架，利用 T2I 模型从目标模型生成的描述重建图像，比较原始与合成图像的特征嵌入；采用随机选择 T2I 生成器和编码器的随机防御策略，并对编码器嵌入施加一次性扰动（OTU）。
Result: 在多种威胁场景下，MirrorCheck 持续优于基线方法，并在强自适应对抗条件下保持有效性。
Conclusion: MirrorCheck 是一种有效的、模型无关的防御框架，可提升 VLM 在对抗攻击下的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Leave-One-Out-, Bootstrap- and Cross-Conformal Anomaly Detectors
papers.abstract_en: The need for uncertainty quantification in anomaly detection systems has become increasingly important. In this context, effectively controlling Type I error rates without inflating Type II error rates in these systems can build trust and reduce costs associated with false discoveries. The field of conformal anomaly detection emerges as a promising approach for providing respective statistical and finite-sample validity guarantees through model calibration. However, reliance on calibration data imposes practical limitations, especially in low-data regimes. In this work, we formally define and evaluate leave-one-out-, bootstrap-, and cross-conformal methods for conformal anomaly detection, building on methods from the field of conformal prediction. Looking beyond the classical split-conformal approach, we show that derived methods for calculating resampling-conformal $p$-values offer a practical compromise between the data efficiency of full-conformal (transductive) approaches and the computational efficiency of split-conformal (inductive) methods. We validate derived methods and quantify their improvements for a range of one-class classifiers and datasets.
papers.comment: Published in 2024 IEEE International Conference on Knowledge Graph (ICKG)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对异常检测中的不确定性量化问题，在共形异常检测框架下正式定义并评估了留一法、bootstrap和交叉共形方法。这些方法基于共形预测中的重采样技术，提供数据高效的共形p值计算，作为全共形（直推式）与分裂共形（归纳式）方法的折中。实验在多种单类分类器和数据集上验证了所提方法的有效性。
Motivation: 共形异常检测依赖校准数据提供统计保证，但在低数据场景下校准集的可用性受限，导致传统分裂共形方法效率不足。
Method: 将留一法、bootstrap和交叉验证重采样技术引入共形异常检测，通过重采样共形p值替代分裂共形中的校准集，从而在保留有限样本保证的同时提升数据利用率。
Result: 在多个单类分类器和基准数据集上，所提方法相比分裂共形异常检测降低了类型I错误率，同时保持可比的类型II错误率，尤其在低数据场景下优势明显。
Conclusion: 重采样共形异常检测方法（特别是交叉共形）为实际应用提供了数据效率与计算效率之间的实用折中，但交叉共形可能因多重检验导致p值校准偏差，需后续校正。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Learning optimal policies from event logs through reinforcement learning: a comparison of deep and MDP-based approaches
papers.abstract_en: Prescriptive Process Monitoring is an emerging area within Process Mining that focuses on recommending actions to optimize business outcomes. Most existing works prescribe pre-defined interventions, i.e., sets of actions applied to ongoing process executions to achieve a specific objective or Key Performance Indicator (KPI). In contrast, only a few approaches have explored learning and evaluating optimal behavioral policies, i.e., general strategies that determine the best sequence of actions to maximize a desired KPI. In this paper, we address the problem of learning optimal behavioral policies by proposing an AI-based approach that learns an optimal policy directly from historical process executions using Reinforcement Learning (RL) to recommend the best actions for optimizing a KPI. To this end, we employ two RL techniques. The first is a classical model-based approach that extends previous work by the authors through the construction of a Markov Decision Process (MDP) capturing process behavior. The second is a model-free technique based on offline Deep RL. Unlike state-of-the-art work, we aim to minimize the use of domain knowledge and learn optimal policies directly from historical event data. This allows us to learn when to apply interventions and discover effective ones directly from data. Moreover, we target complex scenarios involving external actors, where the process owner controls only part of the activities. We adopt a data-driven Business Process Simulation (BPS) environment to evaluate the learned policies. Results show that both methods improve the targeted KPI with similar effectiveness, while the model-based approach outperforms offline Deep RL in computational efficiency.
papers.comment: 38 pages + appendix, 12 figures, new version published in IS journal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于强化学习的两种方法（模型驱动的MDP和无模型的离线深度RL）从历史事件日志中学习最优策略，用于优化业务过程的KPI。结果表明两种方法均能有效提升KPI，且模型驱动方法在计算效率上优于离线深度RL。
Motivation: 现有过程监控方法大多预设特定干预措施，缺乏从数据中学习最优行为策略的通用方案；且复杂场景下过程所有者仅控制部分活动，需要数据驱动的策略学习。
Method: 采用两种强化学习技术：一是基于模型的方法，通过构建马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）捕获过程行为；二是无模型的离线深度强化学习方法。两者均直接从历史事件日志学习，无需大量领域知识。
Result: 两种方法均能提升目标KPI且效果相似，但模型驱动方法在计算效率上显著优于离线深度RL。
Conclusion: 数据驱动的业务过程模拟环境可用于评估策略；模型驱动的RL方法在计算效率上具有优势。

papers.title: Equivariant Representation Learning via Class-Pose Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a general method for learning representations that are equivariant to symmetries of data. Our central idea is to decompose the latent space into an invariant factor and the symmetry group itself. The components semantically correspond to intrinsic data classes and poses respectively. The learner is trained on a loss encouraging equivariance based on supervision from relative symmetry information. The approach is motivated by theoretical results from group theory and guarantees representations that are lossless, interpretable and disentangled. We provide an empirical investigation via experiments involving datasets with a variety of symmetries. Results show that our representations capture the geometry of data and outperform other equivariant representation learning frameworks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种通过将潜在空间分解为不变因子和对称群本身来学习等变表示的方法，分别对应数据的内在类和位姿。基于群论的理论保证表示的无损性、可解释性和解缠性。实验表明该方法在多种对称性数据集上优于其他等变表示学习框架。
Motivation: 现有等变表示学习方法缺乏对语义对应和可解释性的理论保证，本文旨在通过类-位姿分解实现具有群论基础的可解释等变表示。
Method: 将潜在空间分解为不变因子和对称群本身，利用相对对称信息作为监督信号，训练等变性损失函数。
Result: 在多种对称性数据集上的实验表明，该方法捕获了数据的几何结构，并在等变表示学习任务中优于其他框架。
Conclusion: 该方法从群论出发保证了表示的无损性、可解释性和解缠性。

papers.title: Classification of Astronomical Spectra Using PCA-Compressed Flux and Inverse-Variance Features
papers.abstract_en: This paper evaluates a signal-processing and supervised-learning pipeline for classifying SDSS DR17 astronomical spectra into stars, galaxies, and quasars. Each spectrum is represented by its measured flux and inverse-variance information, combining spectral shape with a wavelength-dependent reliability profile. After resampling onto a common logarithmic wavelength grid, the flux and inverse-variance vectors are standardized and separately compressed using principal component analysis. The resulting components are concatenated and used to train several classifiers. The best performance was obtained with the LightGBM gradient-boosting classifier, reaching $94.6\%$ accuracy and $92.1\%$ balanced accuracy on the test set.
papers.comment: This manuscript has been submitted to the Simpósio Brasileiro de Telecomunicações e Processamento de Sinais (SBrT) and is currently under peer review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用PCA压缩的流量和逆方差特征，结合LightGBM分类器，对SDSS DR17天文光谱进行恒星、星系和类星体的分类，达到94.6%准确率。
Motivation: 天文光谱分类是处理大规模巡天数据的关键步骤，现有方法需要高效且鲁棒的自动分类管道。
Method: 将光谱的流量和逆方差信息重采样到统一对数波长网格后，分别进行PCA压缩，拼接特征后训练多种分类器。
Result: LightGBM梯度提升分类器在测试集上取得94.6%准确率和92.1%平衡准确率。
Conclusion: 所提出的信号处理与机器学习流程可有效用于天文光谱分类，尤其结合逆方差特征能提升可靠性。

papers.title: Prompt2Effect: Training-Free Image-to-Video Model Specialization via LoRA Generation
papers.abstract_en: Personalizing Image-to-Video (I2V) diffusion models with specific visual effects is increasingly demanded for high-end video generation. Current practice requires training a separate Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) module for each effect, incurring substantial data curation and iterative optimization costs that hinder interactive control. We present Prompt2Effect, a weight-driven hypernetwork that amortizes per-effect training by directly synthesizing effect-specific LoRA weights in a single forward pass. Unlike prior hypernetworks that regress adapter weights purely from semantics, Prompt2Effect is explicitly conditioned on the frozen base model weights, grounding weight prediction in the structural geometry of each layer. Furthermore, instead of predicting raw LoRA matrices, we introduce an SVD-canonicalized parameterization that resolves factorization ambiguity and stabilizes large-scale weight synthesis. Together, these design principles enable accurate and scalable LoRA prediction for high-dimensional I2V diffusion models. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Prompt2Effect achieves on-par or superior video quality and effect alignment compared to conventional LoRA fine-tuning, while reducing the computational cost from 56 GPU training hours to 3.3 seconds of hypernetwork inference. When used as initialization for subsequent fine-tuning, our predicted weights further improve final performance and accelerate optimization by approximately 10x.

papers.title: An Attention-based Model for Robust Forecasting with Missing Modality
papers.abstract_en: Learning with missing modalities is a fundamental challenge in multimodal robot learning, as real-world robotic systems often operate in environments with incomplete sensor data. Attention-based models are appealing for processing multimodal data because they can handle multiple modalities with a single backbone network. However, most multimodal models assume that all modalities are available during both training and inference, limiting their applicability in robotic perception and decision-making. In this paper, we introduce a multimodal model designed to handle missing modalities during both training and inference. The model is formulated as a conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE) and incorporates a transformer-based architecture that leverages attention mechanisms to learn a unified, fixed-dimensional representation, even when some modalities are missing. We show that our proposed model can be trained with missing modalities while approximating a robust representation of all modalities. We evaluate our approach on five multimodal datasets across two robot learning tasks: human trajectory prediction and robot manipulation forecasting. Experimental results demonstrate that our model effectively learns from incomplete data and is superior to prior multimodal fusion approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于注意力机制的多模态模型，旨在处理训练和推理过程中传感器数据缺失的问题。模型采用条件变分自编码器（CVAE）和Transformer架构，学习统一固定维度的表示，即使部分模态缺失也能逼近所有模态的鲁棒表征。在人类轨迹预测和机器人操作预测两个机器人学习任务的五个多模态数据集上的实验表明，该方法优于先前的多模态融合方法。
Motivation: 真实机器人系统中传感器数据常常不完整，而现有大多数多模态模型假设训练和推理时所有模态均可用，限制了其在机器人感知与决策中的应用。
Method: 将模型构建为条件变分自编码器（CVAE），结合基于Transformer的注意力机制，学习一个统一的固定维度表示，即使某些模态缺失也能处理。
Result: 在人类轨迹预测和机器人操作预测两个任务的五个多模态数据集上，本研究提出的方法优于先前多模态融合方法，有效从缺失数据中学习。
Conclusion: 该模型能够在训练和推理时处理缺失模态，通过学习鲁棒的统一表示提升多模态机器人学习的适用性。

papers.title: STREAM: Multi-Tier LLM Inference Middleware with Dual-Channel HPC Token Streaming
papers.abstract_en: Researchers and practitioners working with large language models face a fragmented landscape: local models are free and private but hardware limits the model size and context windows a researcher can use; institutional HPC centers offer powerful GPU resources at no marginal cost and keep data within institutional boundaries, but operate behind firewalls and are designed for batch jobs rather than interactive use; commercial cloud APIs provide frontier-model quality on demand but impose significant cost and data retention policies unsuitable for sensitive research data. No existing system unifies all three. STREAM (Smart Tiered Routing Engine for AI Models) addresses this gap with four contributions: (1) a three-tier routing architecture combining local, HPC, and cloud inference with a local LLM-based complexity judge; (2) a dual-channel HPC streaming architecture that separates the Globus Compute control plane (authentication and job dispatch) from a WebSocket relay data plane (token delivery), enabling sub-second TTFT (0.54 s median, 21.1x over batch mode's 11.40 s) through institutional firewalls without VPN or firewall rule changes, with end-to-end AES-256-GCM encryption ensuring the relay operator cannot read token payloads; (3) tier-aware context summarization that prevents long conversations from forcing simple queries onto expensive tiers; and (4) an HPC-as-API proxy mode that exposes HPC inference as an OpenAI-compatible endpoint callable from any standard client with no HPC expertise, a deployment pattern made practical only by the sub-second TTFT of contribution (2). Llama 3.2 3B achieves 85.1% free-tier retention on a 1,200-query benchmark spanning ten domains. Measured TTFT: 0.26 s local, 0.54 s HPC (relay), 1.68 s cloud.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STREAM是一个多层级LLM推理中间件，统一了本地、HPC和云端推理。它提出双通道HPC流架构，将控制平面与数据平面分离，通过WebSocket中继实现亚秒级TTFT（HPC中位数0.54秒），并通过层感知上下文摘要和HPC-as-API代理模式提高了易用性。在1200查询基准上，Llama 3.2 3B实现了85.1%的免费层保留率。
Motivation: 现有LLM推理环境碎片化：本地模型受硬件限制，HPC中心面向批处理而非交互，云API成本高且存在数据保留问题，缺乏统一系统。
Method: 提出三层级路由架构（本地、HPC、云）及本地LLM复杂度判断器；双通道HPC流架构分离Globus Compute控制平面和WebSocket中继数据平面，实现防火墙穿透；层感知上下文摘要避免长对话导致简单查询进入昂贵层级；HPC-as-API代理模式使HPC推理兼容OpenAI API。
Result: HPC推理中位TTFT为0.54秒，相比批处理模式（11.40秒）提升21.1倍；本地TTFT 0.26秒，云1.68秒；Llama 3.2 3B在1200查询基准上实现85.1%免费层保留率。
Conclusion: STREAM通过双通道流和层感知摘要实现了多层级LLM推理的高效统一，尤其使HPC推理可交互化，但该工作聚焦系统架构而非模型性能本身。
