papers.title: CaricHarmony: Contrastive Diffusion Paths for Identity-Preserving Caricature Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Sketch-based caricature synthesis suffers from a fundamental failure mode: when identity and shape conditions are combined in diffusion models, they create destructive interference that causes inevitable collapse toward either bland portraits or unrecognizable distortions. We identify the root cause as \emph{condition signal contamination} -- competing probability distributions in the denoising trajectory that make balanced generation impossible. We present CaricHarmony, the first training-free method that explicitly resolves this contamination through parallel uncontaminated diffusion paths. During inference, we maintain three paths: $\mathcal{P}^{\mathrm{i}}$ (pure identity), $\mathcal{P}^{\mathrm{s}}$ (pure shape), and $\mathcal{P}^{\mathrm{i+s}}$ (harmonized output). Novel energy functions operating on cross-attention features provide gradient guidance that steers $\mathcal{P}^{\mathrm{i+s}}$ toward optimal balance: $\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{shape}}$ ensures sketch fidelity through layout and semantic alignment, while $\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{id}}$ employs token-level correspondence matching robust to extreme distortions. Unlike DemoCaricature requiring 70 seconds per-identity fine-tuning or CaricatureBooth constrained to Bezier curves, CaricHarmony accepts any sketch format and generates in under 16 seconds. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance: 0.8615 shape CLIP score (vs. 0.8450) under comparable identity consistency score, with 7.81 overall user preference score (vs. 6.06). Our method fundamentally reconceptualizes the ID-shape conflict as conditioning signal contamination for diffusion models, enabling unprecedented creative control while preserving recognition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对草图漫画生成中身份和形状条件组合时的破坏性干扰问题，提出训练无关的CaricHarmony方法。通过维护三条并行扩散路径（纯身份、纯形状、协调输出），并利用基于交叉注意力的能量函数提供梯度引导，实现了身份保持与形状变形的平衡。实验表明，该方法在形状CLIP分数（0.8615 vs 0.8450）和用户偏好分数（7.81 vs 6.06）上达到最优，且支持任意草图格式，生成时间低于16秒。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型在同时施加身份和形状条件时会产生条件信号污染，导致生成结果要么过于平淡（失去漫画风格）要么失真（无法辨认身份）。作者试图从根本上解决这一冲突，实现无需训练即可保持身份的可控漫画合成。
Method: 提出CaricHarmony，在推理阶段维护三条扩散路径：纯身份路径、纯形状路径和协调输出路径。通过定义作用于交叉注意力特征的能量函数，其中形状能量确保布局与语义对齐，身份能量通过token级对应匹配抵抗极端变形，以此梯度引导协调路径达到最优平衡。该方法无需微调，支持任意草图输入。
Result: 在标准基准上，CaricHarmony获得0.8615的形状CLIP分数（对比基线0.8450），在身份一致性相当的情况下取得更优的漫画夸张效果。用户偏好总体评分7.81（对比基线6.06），且生成速度提升至16秒内（对比DemoCaricature的70秒微调）。
Conclusion: 本文将身份-形状冲突重新定义为扩散模型中的条件信号污染问题，并证明了通过并行无污染路径与能量函数引导可以有效解决，为创意控制与身份保留的平衡提供了新范式。

papers.title: The Silent Cost of Artificial Intelligence Assistance: A Theory of Autonomy Surrender, the Recovery Mechanism, and the Restoration of Human Agency
papers.abstract_en: The integration of artificial intelligence into human decision-making environments has introduced a previously undertheorized cost: the gradual surrender of human autonomy in exchange for access to information and computational assistance. Building on the Human Identity and Autonomy Gap (HIAG) framework, this paper advances a theoretical model of autonomy surrender as a measurable, cumulative process driven by cognitive bandwidth depletion. The model proposes three interacting mechanisms: the silent cost of AI assistance, in which autonomy is transferred incrementally and without awareness; the surrender threshold, beyond which reclaiming autonomous function becomes cognitively and psychologically difficult; and the recovery mechanism, which establishes the design obligation and the ethical responsibility accompanying deliberate human re-assumption of control. The paper argues that human re-entry into the decision loop is not a passive option but an active cognitive event requiring intentional bandwidth restoration. The design of AI systems must incorporate structured re-entry pathways, here termed recovery mechanisms, that preserve human agency while appropriately distributing responsibility. The model further predicts a terminal state, here termed preference inversion, in which functional dependence on AI assistance is experienced not as a deficit but as a preference, transforming the restoration of autonomy from a design problem into a cultural and political one. Implications are drawn for AI system design, governance frameworks, and human factors research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个理论模型，解释人工智能辅助决策中人类自主性逐步放弃的隐性成本。基于人类身份与自主性差距（HIAG）框架，模型包括三个相互作用机制：AI辅助的沉默成本（自主性在无意识中增量转移）、放弃阈值（超过后重新获得自主性变得困难）和恢复机制（设计有意的重新进入决策回路的路径）。论文指出，当功能依赖AI成为偏好而非缺陷时，会出现“偏好反转”终端状态，使自主性恢复从设计问题转变为文化政治问题。
Motivation: AI辅助决策中人类自主性逐步放弃这一成本未被充分理论化，现有研究忽视了认知带宽耗竭驱动的累积过程。
Method: 基于HIAG框架，构建自主性放弃的理论模型，提出三个机制：沉默成本、放弃阈值和恢复机制，并描述偏好反转终端状态。
Result: 模型预测依赖AI的功能会从被动缺陷转化为主动偏好（偏好反转），使自主性恢复成为文化政治问题。
Conclusion: AI系统设计必须包含结构化重新进入路径（恢复机制）以保护人类能动性，同时为AI系统设计、治理框架和人因研究提供启示。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一个理论模型，解释人工智能辅助决策中人类自主性逐步放弃的隐性成本。基于人类身份与自主性差距（HIAG）框架，模型包括三个相互作用机制：AI辅助的沉默成本（自主性在无意识中增量转移）、放弃阈值（超过后重新获得自主性变得困难）和恢复机制（设计有意的重新进入决策回路的路径）。论文指出，当功能依赖AI成为偏好而非缺陷时，会出现“偏好反转”终端状态，使自主性恢复从设计问题转变为文化政治问题。

papers.title: Can Machine Learning Forecast Rice Yields in Data-Constrained Settings? Satellite Climate Data, National Crop Statistics, and Lessons from Sierra Leone
papers.abstract_en: Sierra Leone's agriculture operates with almost no data-driven decision support, and no published machine learning study has examined the country's crop yields. We ask whether rice yield can be forecast from data Sierra Leone currently has. Using 25 years of FAOSTAT production data (2000-2024) for nine major crops, we train XGBoost, Gradient Boosting, and Random Forest under a strict anti-leakage protocol with expanding-window walk-forward evaluation across seven held-out years, benchmarked against naive persistence. No model trained on crop statistics alone outperforms persistence. Augmenting with free satellite climate data (CHIRPS rainfall, NASA POWER temperature) reverses this result: a climate-only XGBoost reduces forecast error by one third (RMSE 284 vs 428 kg/ha), a gain that holds for a linear model and is robust to excluding the anomalous 2018 season. Early-season (May-June) rainfall is the dominant predictor, implying seasonal yield risk is observable months before harvest. No model anticipated the 2018 collapse, whose origins were institutional rather than climatic. We translate the findings into policy recommendations for Sierra Leone's Feed Salone Strategy, with a fully open-source pipeline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次在塞拉利昂这个数据匮乏的国家尝试用机器学习预测水稻产量。使用25年FAOSTAT数据（2000-2024）训练XGBoost、梯度提升和随机森林，并采用严格的反泄漏协议和扩展窗口滚动评估。仅使用作物统计数据的模型未能超越持久性基线；加入免费卫星气候数据（CHIRPS降雨、NASA POWER温度）后，气候驱动的XGBoost将预测误差降低三分之一（RMSE从428降至284 kg/ha），且该结果对线性模型鲁棒。早期季节（5-6月）降雨是最重要的预测因子，但模型未能预测2018年因制度因素导致的产量崩溃。
Motivation: 塞拉利昂农业缺乏数据驱动的决策支持，且尚无已发表的机器学习研究考察该国作物产量。论文旨在评估在现有有限数据条件下，能否利用机器学习预测水稻产量。
Method: 使用25年FAOSTAT生产数据（9种主要作物）训练XGBoost、梯度提升和随机森林，采用严格反泄漏协议的扩展窗口滚动评估（保留7年作为测试集），以朴素持久性模型为基线。数据增强包括免费卫星气候数据（CHIRPS降雨、NASA POWER温度）。
Result: 仅作物统计数据的模型未能超越持久性基线；加入气候数据后，气候驱动的XGBoost将RMSE从428 kg/ha降至284 kg/ha（误差减少三分之一），且线性模型同样有效。早期季节（5-6月）降雨是主导预测因子，但模型未能预测2018年（制度因素导致）的产量异常。
Conclusion: 在数据匮乏环境中，免费卫星气候数据能显著提升作物产量预测精度，但模型易受非气候因素（如制度变迁）影响。研究成果转化为塞拉利昂“Feed Salone策略”的政策建议，并提供完全开源的代码与数据管道。

papers.title: High-Fidelity Video Compression based on Invertible Neural Transform and Implicit Conditioning
papers.abstract_en: Learning-based video compression has recently achieved competitive rate-distortion performance compared to conventional video codecs. However, most existing methods rely on non-invertible analysis-synthesis transforms, with reconstruction quality subject to both quantization and transform approximation errors. This limitation becomes particularly restrictive at higher quality points, where quantization errors are small and transform-induced distortion dominates. To address this, we propose InnVC, an Invertible neural network based Video Codec for wide-range and high-fidelity compression. The core idea is to preserve an invertible main transform path prior to quantization, while injecting content-adaptive context through a compact implicit conditioning field. This decouples strongly correlated video content from harder-to-model fine details, allowing different components to specialize in complementary reconstruction tasks for more efficient compression. To further improve compressibility, we introduce a scheduled masking strategy that progressively concentrates informative content into fewer latent channels for more effective entropy coding. Experiments on the UVG and MCL-JCV benchmarks show that InnVC achieves strong compression performance over a broad quality range, being particularly effective in the high-quality regime, yielding BD-rate reductions of 21.66% in PSNR and 46.06% in MS-SSIM relative to x265 on UVG. To the best of our knowledge, InnVC is the first neural video codec covers operating poins from low bitrate to high fidelity within a single architecture scale, spanning more than 20 dB in PSNR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 InnVC，一种基于可逆神经网络（invertible neural network）的视频编解码器，旨在实现从低码率到高保真的宽范围压缩。核心思路是在量化前保持一条可逆的主变换路径，并通过紧凑的隐式条件场（implicit conditioning field）注入内容自适应上下文，从而解耦强相关视频内容与难以建模的细节。此外，引入调度掩码策略（scheduled masking）将信息逐步集中到更少的潜在通道，提升熵编码效率。在UVG和MCL-JCV基准上，InnVC在高质量区域表现尤其突出，相比x265在PSNR和MS-SSIM上分别降低BD-rate 21.66%和46.06%。据作者称，InnVC是首个在单个架构尺度内覆盖从低比特率到高保真（PSNR跨度超过20 dB）的神经视频编解码器。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的视频压缩方法多采用非可逆的分析-综合变换，重建质量同时受量化误差和变换近似误差影响。在高质量点，量化误差小，变换引入的失真占主导，限制了压缩效率。
Method: 提出可逆神经网络视频编解码器（InnVC），其关键设计包括：（1）量化前保留可逆主变换路径，并通过紧凑隐式条件场注入内容自适应上下文；（2）调度掩码策略，逐步将信息集中到更少潜在通道以提升熵编码效率。
Result: 在UVG和MCL-JCV基准上，InnVC在宽质量范围内表现良好，高质量区域特别有效：相比x265，UVG上PSNR BD-rate降低21.66%，MS-SSIM BD-rate降低46.06%。
Conclusion: InnVC是首个在单一架构内覆盖从低比特率到高保真（PSNR跨度>20 dB）的神经视频编解码器，证明了可逆变换与隐式条件化在高保真压缩中的潜力。

papers.title: Smoothing Dark Areas in Molecular Latent Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Latent diffusion is a promising framework for scalable 3D molecular generation, but it requires a latent space that remains smooth, valid, and navigable beyond posterior samples. Existing molecular VAEs, however, are typically learned through reconstruction-based objectives, which do not guarantee such a latent space. We show that this leads to dark areas: regions of latent space that are reachable during diffusion sampling but decode to disconnected or chemically invalid molecules. Unlike in image generation, molecular decoding requires strict structural and chemical precision, so even small latent perturbations can produce catastrophic failures. We therefore propose TopVAE, a topology-optimized VAE that reduces dark areas by making the decoder internalize structural and chemical constraints during training, eliminating the need for test-time chemical correction. TopVAE greatly improves off-posterior robustness, and when paired with a standard DiT, achieves $77\%$ lower FCD-3D on QM9, the highest V&C, $52\%$ lower FCD-3D on GEOM-Drugs, and $1.29{\times}$ more stable and connected molecules on zero-shot scaffold inpainting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对分子潜在扩散模型中潜在空间存在“暗区”（dark areas）的问题，提出拓扑优化的变分自编码器 TopVAE。TopVAE 通过让解码器在训练时内化结构和化学约束，减少了扩散采样中可达但解码失败的区域。与标准 DiT 结合，在 QM9 上 FCD-3D 降低 77%，在 GEOM-Drugs 上降低 52%，并在零样本支架填充中生成更稳定和连通的分子。
Motivation: 现有分子 VAE 通过重构目标学习潜在空间，不能保证潜在空间平滑、有效和可导航，导致扩散采样时到达的潜在区域解码为不连通或化学无效的分子，即“暗区”。
Method: 提出拓扑优化的 VAE（TopVAE），通过训练时让解码器内化结构和化学约束，减少暗区，避免测试时化学校正。
Result: 在 QM9 上 FCD-3D 降低 77%，在 GEOM-Drugs 上降低 52%，并提升分子稳定性和连通性（1.29 倍），以及在零样本支架填充上的表现。
Conclusion: TopVAE 大幅提高了离后验鲁棒性（off-posterior robustness），无需测试时化学校正。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Side-Channel Attacks Bypass Protection in 3D Printers
papers.abstract_en: Active Motor Noise Cancellation (AMNC) ships in commercial fused deposition modeling (FDM) 3D printers as a hardware countermeasure against acoustic side-channel attacks that target intellectual property (IP). We present the first empirical evaluation of a deployed AMNC countermeasure, using a public dataset of synchronized acoustic and vibration recordings from two AMNC-equipped Bambu Lab printers across 12 object classes. AMNC fully neutralizes the acoustic channel: classification accuracy is indistinguishable from the 8.33% random baseline. The vibration channel, which AMNC does not target, still leaks. With summary statistics the leak is coarse and amplitude-driven (vibration accuracy approximately 31% pooled, 36-47% within-printer), while the waveform shape carries essentially nothing (frequency-only features at chance). A full-sequence temporal model that ingests the ordered evolution of the print raises accuracy to approximately 61%, and an order-shuffling control (approximately 33%) shows that a substantial component is genuinely sequential and tied to print progression. The leak is device-specific: a classifier trained on one printer transfers near chance to the other. We conclude that AMNC is an acoustic-only defense: vibration remains a partial, geometry-correlated side channel it does not address, but one that does not, on this dataset, support full geometric reconstruction; reconstruction-grade attacks would require the magnetic or power channels AMNC also leaves untouched. We release all code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次实证评估了商用FDM 3D打印机中部署的主动电机噪声消除(AMNC)硬件对抗声学侧信道攻击的效果。实验表明AMNC完全中和了声音信道，但振动信道仍然泄漏信息，且泄漏具有设备特异性和顺序依赖性，但不足以支持完整几何重构。
Motivation: 3D打印机的知识产权面临声学侧信道攻击威胁，而AMNC作为商业解决方案的实际效果尚未被系统评估。
Method: 使用包含同步声学与振动记录的公共数据集，在配备AMNC的两台Bambu Lab打印机上对12种物体进行分类实验，比较不同信道和特征（统计特征、频域特征、时序模型）的分类性能。
Result: AMNC使声学信道准确率降至随机水平（8.33%）；振动信道统计特征准确率约31%（打印机内36-47%）；频域特征准确率接近随机；全序列时序模型准确率约61%，乱序对照约33%，表明泄漏依赖于打印进程顺序；跨打印机迁移准确率接近随机。
Conclusion: AMNC仅防御声学信道，振动信道仍存在与几何相关的部分泄漏，但无法支持完整几何重构；重构级攻击需结合AMNC未覆盖的磁或电源信道。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Minim: Privacy-Aware Minimal View for Agents via Trusted Local Sanitization
papers.abstract_en: Modern LLM-powered autonomous agents increasingly rely on rich user interface (UI) state observations to achieve reliable action grounding in complex digital environments. However, many deployments transmit the full UI state to remote inference servers even when most elements are irrelevant to the current task, which can leak sensitive but unnecessary context such as authentication codes, private notifications, and background application states. We propose MINIM, a trusted local broker that performs privacy-aware minimization on the client side before any observation leaves the device. Grounded in Contextual Integrity (CI), MINIM learns a dual-score representation for each UI element by predicting an inherent sensitivity score (s) and a task-conditioned necessity score (n). These scores drive a ternary disclosure policy that keeps essential elements, abstracts sensitive attributes when needed, and removes task-irrelevant content. We optimize a CI-aware objective that penalizes necessity errors more strongly on high-risk content, enabling aggressive pruning while preserving task-critical information. Experiments on real-world UI observations derived from WebArena show that MINIM substantially reduces task-irrelevant sensitive leakage while preserving task-critical semantic context and the interactive affordances required for reliable agent actions.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 (43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea). Code available at https://github.com/yyyyhx/MINIM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MINIM，一个可信本地代理，在客户端对LLM代理的UI观测进行隐私感知的最小化处理。基于上下文完整性（CI）框架，MINIM学习每个UI元素的敏感性分数和任务必要性分数，采用三元披露策略（保留、抽象、移除）来平衡隐私与功能。在WebArena真实UI观测上的实验表明，该方法能大幅减少任务无关的敏感信息泄露，同时保留任务关键语义和交互能力。
Motivation: 现代LLM自治代理常将完整UI状态传输到远程服务器，其中包含大量与当前任务无关的敏感信息（如验证码、私密通知），导致隐私泄露风险。需要一种在客户端进行隐私最小化的方法。
Method: 提出MINIM可信本地代理，基于CI学习每个UI元素的双重表示：敏感性分数(s)和任务条件必要性分数(n)。采用三元披露策略：保留必要元素、抽象敏感属性、移除无关内容。优化CI感知目标，强惩罚高风险内容上的必要性错误。
Result: 在WebArena真实UI观测上，MINIM显著减少任务无关的敏感泄露，同时保持任务关键语义和交互能力。
Conclusion: MINIM通过本地隐私最小化，在不牺牲功能的前提下有效降低敏感信息泄露，适用于LLM代理的隐私保护场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Binary Black Hole Parameter Estimation with Hybrid CNN-Transformer Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: The detection of gravitational waves has revolutionized our ability to explore fundamental aspects of the Universe. Traditionally, modeled gravitational-wave signals have been identified using template-based matched filtering, followed by coincidence analysis across multiple detectors in the signal-to-noise ratio time series. Recent advances in Machine Learning and Deep Learning have sparked growing interest in their application to both signal detection and parameter estimation. In this study, a hybrid Deep Learning strategy is proposed that leverages the effectiveness of Transformer encoders alongside well-established Convolutional Neural Network architectures in an attempt to estimate the intrinsic and extrinsic parameters of non-precessing binary black hole systems. The primary focus of this work is point estimation, producing single best-fit values for each parameter rather than full posterior distributions. This method is evaluated on both simulated signals embedded in Gaussian noise and real gravitational-wave events, and it demonstrates strong predictive performance and robustness across key astrophysical parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合深度学习策略，结合Transformer编码器和卷积神经网络，用于估计非进动双黑洞系统的内在和外在参数，主要进行点估计而非完整后验分布。该方法在模拟高斯噪声信号和真实引力波事件上均表现出强预测性能和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 传统引力波参数估计依赖模板匹配滤波，机器学习方法在此领域的应用尚待探索，特别是点估计的准确性。
Method: 构建混合CNN-Transformer神经网络，利用Transformer编码器处理序列特征，CNN提取局部模式，共同输出双黑洞参数的单一最佳拟合值。
Result: 在模拟信号和真实引力波事件上，该方法对关键天体物理参数的估计具有强预测性能和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 混合CNN-Transformer架构在引力波参数估计的点估计任务中有效，但本文未涉及完整后验分布生成。

papers.title: Adversarial Concept Search: Predicting Compositional Errors From Feature Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Humans cannot always intuit what scenarios are most challenging to LLMs. Hoping to capture challenging edge cases, developers either design problems to be difficult for humans or curate extensive benchmarks. What if we could instead anticipate which scenarios a model will fail on? In this paper, we use an LLM's representational geometry to predict which concept combinations it will fail on. We attribute this compositional failure to interference between salient features. In tasks that require systematic composition - toy programmatic settings, multihop reasoning, multilingual factual recall - we find that when a pair of concepts is encoded near-orthogonally, the model reliably composes them. When their linear encodings are close, producing interference, the model fails to compose them. Our method reliably anticipates failure modes across different compositional tasks, without evaluating specific inputs. These results lay the groundwork to use representational geometry to identify high-risk examples, construct targeted stress tests, and provide a scalable foundation for active learning in real-world deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用LLM的表征几何来预测模型在概念组合上的失败，归因于显著特征间的干扰。在程序化任务、多步推理和多语言事实回忆中，当概念对编码接近正交时模型成功组合，编码接近时失败。该方法无需评估具体输入即可提前识别失败模式。
Motivation: 人类难以直观判断哪些场景对LLM最具挑战性，传统方法依赖设计困难问题或大规模基准，本文希望直接预测模型失败场景。
Method: 通过检查LLM中概念对的线性编码是否正交或接近，判断组合是否会失败，利用特征几何中的干扰机制。
Result: 在玩具程序化设置、多步推理、多语言事实回忆等任务中，正交编码对应可靠组合，接近编码导致失败；无需输入即可预测。
Conclusion: 结果为使用表征几何识别高风险样本、构建定向压力测试和支撑主动学习提供基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Self-Evolving Visual Questioner
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are typically trained as passive answerers, while their ability to actively ask diverse, non-trivial, visual-centric and grounded questions remains underexplored. Existing visual questioners' performance is bottlenecked by the availability of high-quality training data or the cost of curating them. We show that a VLM can continuously improve itself as a visual questioner without any external supervision. We propose a self-evolving framework that uses a VLM itself as both a proposer and a filter to produce harder, more informative, and visual-centric questions, while maintaining their exploration diversity to avoid training collapse. These questions are then used to train the VLM in both questioner and answerer modes. To evaluate the questioner, we introduce an agentic protocol that assesses questions along perception, reasoning, and diversity dimensions. Experiments across various backbone VLMs show that our method substantially enhances the quality and substantially expands the difficulty boundary of autonomous question generation. Under the same budget, our self-supervision is more effective than training on the static source data. Moreover, the self-evolving questioner remains a competitive or even better answerer.
papers.comment: 21 pages, including references and appendix. Project Page is available at https://joliang17.github.io/SelfEvolvingVQG/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自进化框架，使视觉语言模型（VLM）无需外部监督即可提升作为视觉提问者的能力。VLM同时作为提议者和过滤器，生成更难、更信息丰富且视觉中心的问题，同时保持探索多样性以避免训练崩溃。这些问题用于训练VLM的提问者和回答者模式。引入了一种代理评估协议，从感知、推理和多样性维度评估问题。实验表明该方法显著提高了自主问题生成的质量和难度边界，并且自我监督比静态源数据训练更有效，且自进化提问者仍保持竞争力甚至更好的回答者能力。
Motivation: 现有VLM通常被训练为被动回答者，而主动提出多样化、非平凡、视觉中心且基于视觉的问题的能力尚未充分探索，且现有视觉提问者的性能受限于高质量训练数据的可用性或整理成本。
Method: 提出一种自进化框架，使用VLM自身同时作为提议者和过滤器，生成更难、更信息丰富、视觉中心的问题，同时保持探索多样性以避免训练崩溃。然后用这些问题训练VLM的提问者和回答者模式。
Result: 实验表明该方法显著提高了自主问题生成的质量，大幅扩展了难度边界。在相同预算下，自我监督比静态源数据训练更有效。自进化提问者仍保持竞争甚至更好的回答者能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调无需外部监督即可持续改进VLM作为视觉提问者，并且自我监督数据比静态数据更有效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sorries Are Not the Hard Part: An Expert-Review Case Study of a Semi-Autonomous Formalization
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can often close proof gaps in interactive theorem provers, but a verified theorem is not the same thing as a reusable library contribution. We study this distinction through a detailed case study: a semi-autonomous formalization of Grothendieck's vanishing theorem. The initial version compiles with no sorries, but an expert review found serious problems in definitions, theorem generality, file organization, and the API. We then ran a review-driven refactor and compression process and obtained a second expert review. The before-and-after comparison shows a sharp split: agents adapted well to local, mechanically checkable feedback, but remained weak at choosing definitions and designing APIs. We argue that autoformalization should be evaluated not only by closed sorries, but by whether the resulting formalization survives expert review.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过Grothendieck消没定理的半自动形式化案例研究，探讨了自动形式化（autoformalization）的评估标准，指出仅靠编译器无错误（无sorries）不足以保证形式化的质量，还需要通过专家评审来检验定义、定理通用性、文件组织和API设计。研究展示了专家评审驱动的重构过程，并对比了前后版本，发现智能体在局部、机械可检查的反馈上表现良好，但在选择定义和设计API上仍然薄弱。
Motivation: 现有自动形式化评估通常只关注编译器错误（sorries）是否关闭，但忽略了形式化结果作为可重用库贡献的质量问题。论文通过案例研究指出，需要更全面的评估标准。
Method: 对Grothendieck消没定理的半自动形式化进行专家评审，然后进行评审驱动的重构和压缩，再进行第二轮专家评审，对比前后版本。
Result: 智能体在局部、机械可检查的反馈上适应良好，但在定义选择和API设计上仍然薄弱。初始形式化虽然编译无错误，但存在定义、定理通用性、文件组织和API方面的严重问题。
Conclusion: 论文主张自动形式化的评估不应仅依据编译器错误是否关闭，还应考察形式化结果能否通过专家评审。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GMN4AD: Graph Matching Network for Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis with Test-Time Domain Adaptation using Multi-centered Structure Magnetic Resonance Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Alzheimer's Disease (AD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder that affects millions of older adults, with prevalence expected to rise significantly in the coming years. Early diagnosis, particularly during the mild cognitive impairment (MCI) stage, is critical for timely intervention. Structural Magnetic Resonance Imaging (sMRI) has emerged as a key modality for detecting AD-related brain changes, but traditional graph-based approaches often struggle with modality and inter-site heterogeneity, limiting diagnostic performance. In this paper, we propose Graph Matching Network for Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis (GMN4AD), designed to model interactions between heterogeneous brain graphs derived from neuroimaging data. Unlike conventional methods that treat each brain graph independently, GMN4AD leverages graph matching to capture cross-graph relationships, enhancing diagnostic precision. Furthermore, we introduce a test-time domain adaptation strategy that combines contrastive learning to mitigate domain shifts during inference. Extensive experiments on three public AD datasets demonstrate that GMN4AD achieves superior performance compared to state-of-the-art methods, offering a robust and generalizable solution for AD diagnosis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出图匹配网络GMN4AD，用于阿尔茨海默病诊断，通过图匹配建模异质性脑图之间的交互，并引入测试时域自适应策略缓解域偏移。在三个公共AD数据集上，该方法优于现有方法。
Motivation: 传统基于图的方法在处理多中心、多模态的sMRI数据时，难以应对异质性，导致诊断性能受限。
Method: 利用图匹配（graph matching）捕获不同脑图之间的跨图关系，并结合对比学习的测试时域自适应（test-time domain adaptation）减轻域偏移。
Result: 在三个公开AD数据集上，GMN4AD的诊断准确率优于当前最先进方法，展示出更强的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
Conclusion: 所提方法为解决多中心数据异质性提供了一种鲁棒且可泛化的AD诊断方案。

papers.title: A Multi-Agent AI System for Automated High School Transcript Processing: Collaborative Document Analysis at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Each year, college admissions offices face an overwhelming challenge: processing millions of high school transcripts, each with unique formats, grading systems, and layouts. This manual process creates operational bottlenecks that delay admissions decisions and consume valuable resources. We present a transformative solution through a multi-agent AI system where specialized agents collaborate to automatically process diverse transcript formats through intelligent coordination and communication. Our multi-agent architecture consists of three specialized agents-a Pattern Recognition Agent for format-specific parsing, a Semantic Analysis Agent for natural language understanding, and a Vision Intelligence Agent for multimodal document analysis-coordinated by an Orchestration Agent that manages agent communication and result reconciliation. Our key innovation lies in agent-based quality control using GPA extraction as a coordination signal, ensuring reliable agent collaboration and preventing critical information loss. When evaluated on 40 real world transcripts from high schools across 13 U.S. states, our agent system successfully processed every document, achieving 96.7% accuracy compared to expert manual review while maintaining practical processing speeds of 45 seconds per transcript. This work demonstrates how multi-agent coordination can solve complex document processing challenges, offering institutions a scalable, collaborative AI solution that preserves accuracy while dramatically reducing processing time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出一个多智能体AI系统，通过三个专门智能体（模式识别、语义分析、视觉智能）由协调智能体协作处理高中成绩单，利用GPA提取作为协调信号实现质量控制。在40份来自美国13个州的高中成绩单上达到96.7%的准确率，每份处理时间45秒。
Motivation: 大学招生办公室每年需手动处理数百万份格式各异的高中成绩单，造成操作瓶颈并延迟录取决策，急需自动化解决方案。
Method: 构建多智能体架构，包括模式识别智能体（格式解析）、语义分析智能体（自然语言理解）、视觉智能体（多模态分析），由协调智能体管理通信与结果整合；创新点在于基于GPA提取的智能体质量控制。
Result: 在40份真实成绩单上，系统成功处理所有文档，与专家人工审查相比达96.7%准确率，每份处理时间45秒。
Conclusion: 多智能体协调可解决复杂文档处理挑战，为机构提供可扩展的协作AI方案，在保证准确性的同时大幅缩短处理时间。

papers.title: Direct/adaptive-mixture phase-gradient learning for neural-network quantum states with complex phase structure
papers.abstract_en: Neural-network quantum states (NQS) are a leading variational tool for quantum many-body physics, yet their optimization is fragile whenever the ground state carries a non-trivial sign or complex phase structure, a situation generic to gauge fields, broken time-reversal symmetry, and fermionic statistics. We trace this fragility to the stochastic estimator of the phase gradient rather than to network expressiveness. The phase sector of the Monte Carlo energy gradient is a noisy score-function estimator; differentiating the local energy instead yields a direct estimator that is unbiased for the same phase force, has far lower variance, and requires only a separated amplitude--phase ansatz. Demonstrated on a 100-site flux ladder, a small network trained this way reaches $0.89\%$ median error, where tuned standard baselines plateau at $1.8\%$ and wider or deeper standard-gradient networks degrade from $8.4\%$ to $24.6\%$. The advantage carries over to chiral XXX chains: the direct estimator again converges to a markedly lower error than the standard one, across $α$ and size; it grows with flux and vanishes in zero-flux controls. An adaptive-mixture of the two estimators is provably never worse in variance than the better endpoint at the optimal mixing coefficient, with seed-resolved diagnostics tracing much of the gain to eliminating failed runs. Estimator design thus emerges as a first-class lever for complex-valued neural quantum states.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对神经网络量子态（NQS）在具有非平凡相位结构（如规范场、时间反演对称破缺、费米子统计）的基态优化中不稳定的问题，指出根源在于相位梯度的蒙特卡罗噪声估计器而非网络表达能力。提出直接估计器（direct estimator），通过分离幅度-相位ansatz对局部能量求导，得到无偏、低方差的相位力估计；进一步提出两种估计器的自适应混合（adaptive-mixture），保证方差不劣于最优混合系数下的较好端点。在100-site通量梯子模型上，直接估计器训练的小网络达到0.89%中位误差，标准基线为1.8%，而更宽更深的标准梯度网络误差从8.4%增至24.6%。在手性XXX链上也一致优于标准估计器，优势随通量增大且在零通量控制中消失。
Motivation: 现有NQS在具有复杂相位结构的系统中优化脆弱，作者追踪到是相梯度（phase gradient）随机估计器的高方差问题，而非网络表达能力不足。
Method: 提出直接估计器（direct estimator）：利用分离幅度-相位ansatz，对局部能量直接求导得到相位力的无偏估计，方差远低于标准的得分函数估计器；并进一步提出两种估计器的自适应混合（adaptive-mixture），通过优化混合系数保证方差不差于任一端点。
Result: 在100-site通量梯子模型上，直接估计器训练的小网络达到0.89%中位误差，标准基线为1.8%，更宽更深的标准梯度网络误差从8.4%到24.6%。在手性XXX链上，直接估计器也收敛到显著更低的误差，优势随通量增大且在零通量控制中消失。
Conclusion: 估计器设计成为复杂神经量子态优化的一级杠杆（first-class lever），自适应混合方法提供了稳健的方差保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Overhead Wildlife Locator (OWL): Benchmarking Weakly Supervised Learning for Aerial Wildlife Surveys
papers.abstract_en: Automated aerial wildlife surveys increasingly rely on deep learning, yet standard object detectors require bounding-box annotations, reported to be up to seven times slower and three times more expensive to produce than point-level labels. To address this bottleneck, we introduce the Overhead Wildlife Locator (OWL), a weakly supervised density-estimation framework with three variants: OWL-C, a fully convolutional model for high-throughput screening; OWL-T, a Swin-augmented hybrid for heterogeneous, cluttered scenes; and OWL-D, built on a frozen DINOv3 ViT-H+/16 encoder with a DPT-style fusion decoder. We benchmark all three against POLO, YOLOv11n, and YOLOv11l across five public aerial datasets, from sparse fixed-wing savanna surveys to dense UAV paddock imagery, and against the published HerdNet baseline on its native Delplanque split. OWL-D sets a new state of the art on Delplanque (0.934 AP vs. HerdNet's 0.840) and records the highest AP on four of the five datasets. Performance is regime-dependent: on the extreme-density SheepCounter UAV dataset the hybrid OWL-T leads (0.978 AP) and the convolutional variants attain the lowest counting error, whereas the foundation-based OWL-D degrades, indicating which variant suits which survey type. We further validate operational readiness on the Alaska Department of Fish and Game's 2022 Central Arctic Caribou census: under cross-herd and cross-temporal transfer, OWL-C fine-tuned on the 2017 Porcupine Caribou Herd split attains F1 = 0.965 on a held-out patch test set, with a signed count error of +3.1% aggregated across the released test patches. We release the OWL code, model weights, and the annotated Porcupine Caribou Herd 2017 (PCH) and Central Arctic Herd 2022 (CAH) patches, the first open patch-level datasets for large-scale caribou aerial surveys, at https://github.com/microsoft/MegaDetector-Overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Overhead Wildlife Locator (OWL) 弱监督密度估计框架，包含三个变体：全卷积 OWL-C、Swin 增强混合 OWL-T 和基于 DINOv3 ViT-H+/16 编码器与 DPT 融合解码器的 OWL-D。在五个公开航空数据集上对比 POLO、YOLOv11 等模型，OWL-D 在 Delplanque 数据集上达到 SOTA（0.934 AP vs HerdNet 0.840），在四个数据集上取得最高 AP。在阿拉斯加驯鹿普查中，OWL-C 微调后达到 F1=0.965，计数误差 +3.1%。框架通过点级标签替代边界框标注，大幅降低标注成本。
Motivation: 航空野生动物调查依赖深度学习物体检测，但边界框标注速度慢（慢 7 倍）且成本高（贵 3 倍）。弱监督点级标签可缓解这一瓶颈。
Method: 提出三个弱监督密度估计变体：OWL-C（全卷积，适合高通量筛选）、OWL-T（Swin 增强混合，适合异质杂乱场景）、OWL-D（基于冻结 DINOv3 ViT-H+/16 编码器与 DPT 风格融合解码器）。在五个数据集上基准测试，并与 HerdNet、POLO、YOLOv11 对比。
Result: OWL-D 在 Delplanque 数据集上 AP 0.934（HerdNet 0.840），在五个数据集中的四个取得最高 AP。在极密 SheepCounter UAV 数据集中 OWL-T 领先（AP 0.978），卷积变体计数误差最低。阿拉斯加驯鹿普查中，OWL-C 微调后 F1=0.965，计数误差 +3.1%。
Conclusion: 弱监督密度估计框架在航拍野生动物调查中有效，不同变体适用于不同调查场景（稀疏/密集/杂波）。开源代码、模型权重和两个驯鹿普查数据集。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PMOF: A Dataset and Benchmark for Passenger Monitoring Using Overhead Fisheye Cameras
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous staff-free public transport requires reliable in-vehicle passenger monitoring. However, perception inside moving vehicles is challenged by confined spaces, variable illumination, motion-induced background variation, occlusion, and limited viewpoints. To mitigate these spatial constraints, ceiling-mounted fisheye cameras provide full-scene coverage from a single viewpoint. Yet existing public overhead fisheye datasets are recorded in static environments and do not capture the domain shift introduced by vehicle motion. To fill this gap, we introduce PMOF, Passenger Monitoring using Overhead Fisheye cameras, the first public dataset of top-view fisheye imagery captured inside a moving vehicle, comprising over 19k manually annotated frames. PMOF provides rotated bounding boxes, tracking identifiers, and action labels, supporting object detection, tracking, and action recognition. We benchmark PMOF using YOLO26m-obb models fine-tuned under multiple dataset configurations that combine PMOF with existing overhead fisheye datasets. Cross-domain fine-tuning with custom rotation-aware augmentation achieves 94.8% AP50 on PMOF and 96.5% AP50 on an unseen overhead fisheye dataset from a different domain. Our results highlight the domain gap between static and moving environments and show that incorporating PMOF improves detection performance and advances generalization beyond passenger monitoring to broader fisheye-based person detection tasks. The dataset and code are available at https://swermuth.github.io/pmof/.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 7 figures. Accepted to the 22nd IEEE International Conference on Advanced Visual and Signal-Based Systems (AVSS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了 PMOF（Passenger Monitoring using Overhead Fisheye cameras），首个在移动车辆内采集的俯视鱼眼相机公开数据集，包含超过19k帧人工标注，支持旋转边界框、跟踪ID和动作标签。使用 YOLO26m-obb 模型进行跨域微调，在 PMOF 上达到 94.8% AP50，在另一个未见过的鱼眼数据集上达到 96.5% AP50，验证了移动环境与静态环境之间的域差异。
Motivation: 现有公开鱼眼数据集均在静态环境中录制，无法捕捉车辆运动带来的域偏移，缺乏用于车内乘客监测的移动场景鱼眼数据。
Method: 在移动车辆内通过天花板安装的鱼眼相机采集数据，构建包含旋转边界框、跟踪ID和动作标签的 PMOF 数据集，并使用 YOLO26m-obb 模型结合旋转感知增强进行跨域微调。
Result: 跨域微调后，PMOF 数据集检测 AP50 达 94.8%，在另一个域外的鱼眼数据集上达到 96.5% AP50，表明 PMOF 能有效提升移动环境下的检测性能。
Conclusion: PMOF 填补了移动车辆内鱼眼监测数据集的空白，不仅改进了乘客监测任务，还能推广至更广泛的鱼眼行人检测场景。

papers.title: SANA: What Matters for QA Agents over Massive Data Lakes?
papers.abstract_en: Exploratory question answering (EQA) over data lakes requires an LLM agent to discover relevant sources, analyze retrieved data, and adapt its actions based on intermediate results. End-to-end accuracy alone cannot distinguish failures in search, planning, data analysis, or the agent's Action Policy: its decisions about what to do next and when to submit an answer. We present SANA (Search Agent Navigation Ablation framework), a diagnostic ablation framework that transforms EQA tasks into runtime profiles containing gold source sequence, sanitized subquestions, and execution records. SANA uses these profiles to construct idealized search, planning, and data-analysis tools, allowing each component to be ablated; the residual gap is diagnostic evidence for policy failures. To illustrate SANA as a reusable evaluation framework, we adapted two recent EQA benchmarks, LakeQA and KramaBench, and evaluated lightweight and mid-sized agents under fixed prompts, budgets, data lakes, and runtimes. Across both benchmarks, data analysis is a consistent bottleneck while planning is less so. Search is a major limitation in LakeQA's large data-lake setting, but less so for the smaller-scale KramaBench. SANA thus deconstructs end-to-end task accuracies into a diagnosis of where data-lake agents fail, and allows for systematic comparisons of progress in search, planning, data analysis, and agent design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SANA 诊断消融框架，将数据湖上的探索式问答 (EQA) 转化为运行时 profile，通过消融理想化的搜索、规划和数据分析组件来定位 Agent 策略失败。在 LakeQA 和 KramaBench 上评估，发现数据分析是持续瓶颈，搜索在 LakeQA 的大数据湖中限制显著，而规划影响较小。框架可分解端到端精度，指导 Agent 组件改进。
Motivation: 端到端精度无法区分 EQA 任务中搜索、规划、数据分析或 Agent 决策策略的具体失败来源，需要诊断性分析方法。
Method: SANA 将 EQA 任务转化为包含金标准源序列、清理子问题及执行记录的 profile，据此构建理想化的搜索、规划和数据分析工具进行控制变量消融，剩余性能缺口即策略失败的诊断证据。
Result: 在 LakeQA 和 KramaBench 上，数据分析是持续瓶颈；搜索在 LakeQA 的大数据湖设置下是主要限制，但对较小规模的 KramaBench 影响较小；规划不是显著瓶颈。
Conclusion: SANA 为数据湖 Agent 的失败来源提供诊断，并支持在搜索、规划、分析和 Agent 设计方面的系统化进展比较。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: SANA 为数据湖 Agent 的失败来源提供诊断，并支持在搜索、规划、分析和 Agent 设计方面的系统化进展比较。

papers.title: SpikF-GO: Spiking Fourier Graph Operators for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have emerged as an energy-efficient alternative to conventional neural networks, demonstrating strong performance in computer vision and robotics. More recently, SNNs have been applied to time series forecasting (TSF), with methods exploring spiking temporal backbones, spike-compatible positional encodings, Fourier-domain processing, and redesigned neuron dynamics. However, existing SNN forecasting approaches process variables independently, lacking explicit mechanisms for modeling inter-variable dependencies. This is a critical limitation in multivariate settings, where cross-variable correlations carry substantial predictive information. We propose Spiking Fourier Graph Operators (SpikF-GO), which addresses this gap by combining a hypervariate graph formulation in which every scalar observation becomes a graph node with spike-driven spectral processing. SpikF-GO introduces a Hard Concrete frequency gate for learnable sparse frequency selection and a Complex LIF gate that applies independent spiking neurons to real and imaginary Fourier components, preserving binary, event-driven computation throughout the spectral domain. We further present a variant incorporating Central Pattern Generator-based positional encodings for stronger long-range temporal modeling. Evaluated on eight benchmarks under a unified experimental protocol, SpikF-GO achieves the best average rank among all SNN methods and outperforms its ANN counterpart, FourierGNN, at reduced energy cost. SpikF-GO maintains competitive accuracy even at substantially smaller embedding dimensions, thereby achieving significant energy reductions. To our knowledge, this is among the first works to bring graph-based multivariate modeling into the spiking domain for TSF and the first to provide a unified comparison across SNN forecasting architectures under a common experimental protocol.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 2 figures, 11 tables. Accepted for presentation at ECML PKDD 2026. Code: https://github.com/jafarbakhshaliyev/SpikF-GO
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SpikF-GO，一种基于脉冲神经网络的多元时间序列预测模型，通过将每个标量观测值视为图节点，引入超变量图结构以建模变量间依赖关系，并采用可学习的稀疏频率门控和复数LIF门实现脉冲驱动的谱域处理。在八个基准上，SpikF-GO 在所有 SNN 方法中平均排名最佳，且优于其 ANN 对应模型 FourierGNN，同时能耗更低。
Motivation: 现有 SNN 时间序列预测方法独立处理每个变量，缺乏对跨变量依赖关系的显式建模，限制了在多元场景下的预测性能。
Method: 提出 Spiking Fourier Graph Operators (SpikF-GO)，结合超变量图（每个标量观测为节点）和脉冲驱动的谱处理，包含 Hard Concrete 频率门（学习稀疏频率选择）和 Complex LIF 门（对实部和虚部分别施加独立脉冲神经元），并可选基于中心模式生成器的位置编码。
Result: 在八个基准下，SpikF-GO 在所有 SNN 方法中平均排名最佳，并优于 ANN 基线 FourierGNN；在更小嵌入维度下仍保持竞争精度，显著降低能耗。
Conclusion: 本文首次将基于图的多元建模引入 SNN 时间序列预测，并在统一协议下比较了多种 SNN 架构。

papers.title: HiLo-Token: Input-Adaptive High-Low Frequency Token Compression for Efficient Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Creative image editing tools, such as Photoshop's Remove or Generative Fill buttons, are central to everyday customer use and account for a major share of traffic in Photoshop and Lightroom. However, current generative AI models face significant latency challenges, which become even more pronounced when transitioning from convolution-based U-Nets to Diffusion Transformers (DiTs). In our evaluation on hundreds of representative image editing samples spanning a wide range of mask ratios, the DiT module alone accounts for an average of 73% of the total model latency, even after being distilled from 50 timesteps down to 8 timesteps. To tackle this challenge, we propose $\textbf{HiLo-Token}$, an input-adaptive token compression framework that allocates more token budget to high-frequency, rich-context regions while assigning fewer tokens to low-frequency areas. Specifically, for the editing region specified by the user mask, we retain all tokens within a dilated mask to preserve strong locality and contextual relevance. Outside the editing region, we introduce a simple yet effective high-frequency token selection strategy based on spatial frequency to capture important local details, while using tokens from a 16x downsampled image to represent low-frequency components and preserve the blurry but global structure. Extensive experiments on production-level evaluation data validate the effectiveness of the proposed method, achieving 3.13x, 2.59x, and 1.67x DiT speedups on A100-80GB for image editing tasks across small, medium, and large mask ratio categories with average ratios of 6.38%, 15.92%, and 35.36%, respectively, without any regression in generation quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HiLo-Token，一种输入自适应的token压缩框架，用于加速扩散Transformer（DiT）在图像编辑任务中的推理。该方法根据空间频率保留编辑区域内的所有token，并在编辑区域外对高频区域选择性保留token，低频区域使用下采样token，在A100-80GB上实现小、中、大掩码比例下分别3.13倍、2.59倍、1.67倍的DiT加速，且不降低生成质量。
Motivation: 当前图像编辑工具依赖扩散Transformer（DiT），但即使将采样步数从50压缩到8，DiT模块仍占模型总延迟的73%，成为主要瓶颈。
Method: 提出HiLo-Token框架：在用户掩码区域内保留所有token以保持局部性；在区域外，基于空间频率选择高频区域的token，低频区域使用16倍下采样图像token，自适应分配token预算。
Result: 在涵盖多个掩码比例的生产级评估数据上，DiT加速比分别为3.13倍（小掩码6.38%）、2.59倍（中掩码15.92%）、1.67倍（大掩码35.36%），且生成质量无退化。
Conclusion: HiLo-Token通过输入自适应的频率感知token压缩，在不牺牲质量的前提下显著加速图像编辑中的DiT推理。

papers.title: How do Self-Supervised Remote Sensing Vision Models Transfer to Downstream Tasks?
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised geospatial foundation models (GeoFMs) learn transferable representations from remote sensing data, but their downstream behavior is difficult to characterize. We study six representative GeoFMs spanning joint-embedding, reconstruction, and multimodal pretraining families, and evaluate transfer across classification, regression, and segmentation benchmarks under different label availability and downstream pipelines. We find that model rankings change across tasks and adaptation settings. Layerwise probing shows that, in most cases, task-relevant information is more accessible in intermediate transformer blocks compared to final-layer embeddings, and that GeoFMs exhibit distinct depthwise profiles. In segmentation case studies on PASTIS and Sen1Floods11, downstream adaptation settings such as decoder design and fine-tuning can be as impactful as the choice of GeoFM, and standard dense-prediction heads may be poorly aligned with how GeoFMs organize information over depth. Finally, CKA analysis on case studies shows that fine-tuning does not rewrite GeoFMs uniformly across depth, and the strongest changes are localized to the first linear layer of the MLP in ViT blocks. These results help explain why GeoFM rankings shift across benchmarks and motivate more representation-aware evaluation and adaptation strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了六种自监督地理空间基础模型（GeoFMs）在下游遥感任务中的迁移表现，涵盖分类、回归和分割基准。研究发现，模型排名随任务和适应设置而变化；中间Transformer块比最终层嵌入包含更多任务相关信息；在分割任务中，解码器设计和微调策略的影响与模型选择相当；CKA分析表明微调对GeoFMs不同深度的修改不均匀。
Motivation: 自监督GeoFMs学习可迁移表征，但其下游行为难以刻画，缺乏系统性的跨任务、跨适应设置比较研究。
Method: 选取六种代表性GeoFMs（联合嵌入、重建和多模态预训练家族），在分类、回归和分割基准上评估不同标签可用性和下游管道下的迁移性能，并进行逐层探测、CKA分析和分割案例研究。
Result: 模型排名随任务和适应设置变化；中间Transformer块比最终层嵌入包含更多任务相关信息；分割案例中，解码器设计和微调策略的影响与模型选择相当；CKA显示微调主要修改ViT块MLP的第一个线性层。
Conclusion: GeoFM排名因基准不同而变动，需采用表征感知的评估与适应策略。

papers.title: Gefen: Optimized Stochastic Optimizer
papers.abstract_en: AdamW is a default optimizer for modern deep learning, but its first and second moment states add roughly two parameter-sized buffers to training memory. We propose Gefen, a memory-efficient optimizer that automatically shares second-moment estimates across parameter blocks and quantizes the first moment using a learned codebook, thereby reducing AdamW's memory footprint by ~8x while maintaining the same performance, corresponding to a reduction of 6.5 GiB per billion parameters. The method is motivated by a theoretical result showing that large mixed Hessian entries constrain the ratio of squared gradients toward one, suggesting that Hessian-aligned parameters are natural candidates for sharing second-moment statistics. Since computing Hessians is impractical at scale, Gefen infers block structure from the initial squared gradients, requiring no architecture-specific metadata or hyperparameters beyond AdamW defaults. Gefen learns an exact histogram-based dynamic-programming quantization codebook and reuses the same blocks for first-moment scaling. Across diverse experiments, Gefen achieves the lowest peak optimizer memory among the compared AdamW-like methods while maintaining AdamW-level performance. In FSDP and DDP training, the reduced memory footprint enables larger microbatches and improves throughput significantly over AdamW, providing a practical drop-in replacement with lower memory usage that can increase throughput and enable training larger models or using larger batch sizes. We provide the complete Python implementation, including fused CUDA kernels at https://github.com/ndvbd/Gefen
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出Gefen优化器，通过自动共享二阶矩估计和量化一阶矩，将AdamW的内存占用降低约8倍（每十亿参数减少6.5 GiB），同时保持同等性能。方法基于Hessian混合项的理论分析，无需架构元数据即可推断块结构，并通过直方图动态规划实现量化。在多种实验中，Gefen在峰值优化器内存上优于同类方法，并在FSDP/DDP训练中通过降低内存提升吞吐量。
Motivation: AdamW作为现代深度学习的默认优化器，其存储一阶和二阶矩需要两倍于参数的内存，限制了模型规模和批大小。
Method: Gefen利用理论结果（混合Hessian项约束平方梯度比值接近1）推断可共享二阶矩的参数块结构，从初始平方梯度中自动确定块划分；同时采用基于直方图的动态规划量化码本压缩一阶矩，无需额外超参数。
Result: 在保持AdamW性能的前提下，将优化器内存减少约8倍（6.5 GiB/十亿参数）；在FSDP和DDP训练中，因内存降低可增大微批次，从而提升吞吐量。
Conclusion: Gefen可作为AdamW的即插即用替代，显著降低内存占用，支持更大模型或批大小，且无需修改现有训练流程。

papers.title: Crypto x AI, AI x Crypto: A Survey
papers.abstract_en: The intersection of crypto x AI is spawning papers, products, online posts, and companies. All the surrounding buzz, though, obscures what exactly has been done, what the opportunities and challenges are, and what open questions deserve attention. This survey paper asks what AI can do for blockchain-based technologies (broadly construed as "crypto") (crypto x AI), and vice versa (AI x crypto). We systematize existing work, summarize key takeaways, highlight open research questions, and offer a perspective on pervasive industry misconceptions, concluding that AI and crypto are still in the very early stages of meaningful integration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇综述论文系统梳理了区块链技术（Crypto）与人工智能（AI）交叉领域的现有工作，涵盖Crypto x AI（AI为区块链技术赋能）和AI x Crypto（区块链为AI赋能）两个方向。文章总结了关键结论，指出了开放研究问题，并对行业中普遍存在的误解进行了分析，认为两者目前仍处于非常早期的集成阶段。
Motivation: 当前Crypto与AI交叉领域存在大量论文、产品和创业项目，但缺乏系统性的梳理与总结，导致研究现状、机遇与挑战以及开放问题不够清晰。
Method: 采用综述方法，对现有文献进行系统化组织，从两个方向（Crypto x AI 和 AI x Crypto）分类讨论，提取关键结论并分析行业误解。
Result: 论文指出Crypto与AI的深度集成仍处于极早期阶段，并明确了若干待解决的研究问题。
Conclusion: AI和Crypto的融合尚不成熟，需要更多基础性研究，现有应用多为概念验证，距离实际落地仍有距离。

papers.title: PhysVLA: Towards Physically-Grounded VLA for Embodied Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models excel at mapping visual inputs and natural language instructions directly to robotic control policies. However, because they are trained primarily to fit behavioural demonstration data, they do not explicitly enforce fundamental physical principles such as rigid-body dynamics or contact constraints. This exposes a critical physics gap: standard temporal smoothing applied on top of single-step or chunked VLAs trades trajectory quality for added failures that short-term memory cannot resolve. To bridge this gap, we introduce PhysVLA (Physics-VLA), a plug-and-play, inference-time framework designed to wrap any frozen VLA backbone without retraining, fine-tuning, or weight access, with less than 1 ms of overhead per control step. PhysVLA intercepts the predicted control action, captures only the simulator or system state, and applies a dual-layered correction: (i) a phase-aware finite-state machine that structures discrete task segments (approach, grasp, transport, and place), and (ii) a selective Euler-Lagrange gate that activates only when a dynamics oracle detects kinodynamic inconsistency. Evaluated across OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, Force-VLA, and Generalist-VLA on LIBERO-Spatial with a 7-DoF Franka Panda, the framework delivers absolute success rate increases of up to 17% and stability increases of up to 19% with no per-task regressions, improves trajectory efficiency by up to 15% across all four backbones, and shows up to a 10x improvement in trajectory jerk robustness on a Robosuite Lift cross-simulator sweep. We further validate the framework on a real Agilex Piper arm with a pick-and-place task, confirming that PhysVLA transfers to physical hardware without retraining, with success-rate improvements of up to 50%, establishing physical awareness as a composable, backbone-agnostic runtime module.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PhysVLA，一种即插即用的推理时框架，为任何冻结的视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型添加物理约束（刚体动力学、接触约束），无需重新训练或微调。该框架通过相位有限状态机和选择性欧拉-拉格朗日门修正动作，在 LIBERO-Spatial 基准上使成功率提升最高 17%、稳定性提升最高 19%，并在真实机器人上验证了可迁移性。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型仅拟合行为数据，不显式遵循物理规律，导致轨迹平滑失效和短期记忆无法解决的失败。
Method: PhysVLA 在推理时拦截 VLA 输出的动作，结合相位有限状态机（离散任务阶段）和选择性欧拉-拉格朗日门（仅在动力学不一致时激活），对动作进行双重修正，开销小于 1 ms/步。
Result: 在 OpenVLA、OpenVLA-OFT、Force-VLA、Generalist-VLA 四个骨干网络上，PhysVLA 在 LIBERO-Spatial 任务中实现成功率绝对提升最高 17%、稳定性提升最高 19%、轨迹效率提升最高 15%；在 Robosuite Lift 跨模拟器测试中，轨迹抖动鲁棒性提升最高 10 倍；真实 Agilex Piper 机器人上成功率提升最高 50%。
Conclusion: 物理感知可以作为与骨干无关的运行时模块，即插即用并显著提升 VLA 模型的物理合理性和操作性能，且无需修改原始模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Capability Minimization as a Safety Primitive: Risk-Aware Causal Gating for Least-Privilege LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Modern decision systems increasingly rely on learned components whose outputs may be confident yet wrong, exposing downstream actions to costly errors. We introduce Risk-Aware Causal Gating (RACG), a framework that decides whether to act on, defer, or abstain from a model's prediction by combining causal effect estimation with calibrated risk control. RACG models the causal pathway from candidate actions to outcomes and gates each decision according to an estimated counterfactual risk rather than raw predictive confidence. To make gating reliable, we derive distribution-free bounds on the probability of acting under high-risk conditions and show how these bounds translate into operating thresholds that satisfy user-specified safety constraints. We further propose an adaptive gating policy that adjusts to distribution shift by monitoring discrepancies between predicted and realized outcomes, tightening the gate when causal assumptions appear violated. Across simulated interventions and real-world decision benchmarks, RACG reduces high-cost errors substantially while preserving most of the utility of an ungated policy, and it outperforms confidence-based and selective-prediction baselines at matched abstention rates. Our results indicate that explicitly separating causal risk from predictive uncertainty yields decision systems that are both safer and more transparent, offering a principled mechanism for trustworthy automation in high-stakes settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出风险感知因果门控（RACG）框架，通过结合因果效应估计与校准的风险控制，决定是否采纳、推迟或放弃模型的预测。RACG从候选行动到结果建模因果路径，基于反事实风险而非原始置信度进行门控决策，并推导出无分布界限以满足安全约束。自适应门控策略可监测分布偏移并调整阈值。实验表明，RACG在保持大部分效用的同时显著减少高成本错误，优于基于置信度和选择性预测的基线。
Motivation: 现代决策系统依赖的学习组件可能自信但错误，导致下游行动产生高昂代价。现有方法通常仅依赖预测不确定性，缺乏对因果风险与预测不确定性的明确分离。
Method: 提出RACG框架，包括因果效应估计、无分布风险界限推导、自适应门控策略。通过反事实风险而非原始置信度进行决策门控，并动态调整操作阈值以应对分布偏移。
Result: 在模拟干预和实际决策基准上，RACG大幅减少高成本错误，同时保持未门控策略的大部分效用。在匹配的弃权率下，优于基于置信度和选择性预测的基线。
Conclusion: 明确分离因果风险与预测不确定性可产生更安全、更透明的决策系统，为高风险环境中的可信自动化提供原则性机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Longitudinal Attribute-Conditioned Neural Network for Modeling Health-State Transition Probabilities in Temporally Irregular Data: The LANTERN Framework
papers.abstract_en: Accurate estimation of long-term care transition probabilities is central to disability insurance pricing, reserving, and solvency assessment. Classical actuarial multi-state models commonly rely on Markov, semi-Markov, or proportional-hazard specifications, which provide a direct connection to cohort projection but may be restrictive for irregular longitudinal health data with nonlinear aging patterns and heterogeneous covariate histories. This paper develops a well-calibrated estimator of multi-state transition probabilities for irregular longitudinal health data. The model learns from individual health history, incorporates the time elapsed between observations, and conditions transition probabilities on demographic and socioeconomic attributes. It produces a valid probability distribution over the next observed health state, with four possible states: healthy, mild disability, severe disability, and death. Individual probabilities are aggregated by age group and origin state to form transition matrices compatible with actuarial cohort projection. Using longitudinal data from the Health and Retirement Study, we compare the proposed estimator with logistic regression, gradient-boosted trees, a recurrent neural network, and a last-state persistence benchmark. The evaluation considers probabilistic accuracy, endpoint discrimination and calibration for severe disability and death, risk concentration, and transition matrix error after aggregation. The proposed estimator improves severe disability discrimination relative to logistic regression and gradient-boosted tree benchmarks, maintains strong calibration, and yields the lowest transition matrix error among the evaluated models in the held-out test analysis. Results show that a structured machine learning estimator can support long-term care transition modeling when judged by calibration and projection fidelity, beyond discrimination.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LANTERN框架，一种基于纵向属性条件的神经网络模型，用于从不规则纵向健康数据中估计多状态转移概率。该模型结合个体健康史、观测时间间隔以及人口和社会经济属性，输出健康、轻度残疾、重度残疾和死亡四种状态的有效概率分布，并聚合成与精算队列投影兼容的转移矩阵。在健康与退休研究数据上的评估表明，该模型在重度残疾区分能力上优于逻辑回归和梯度提升树，保持良好校准，并取得最低的转移矩阵误差。
Motivation: 经典精算多状态模型（如马尔可夫、半马尔可夫或比例风险模型）在处理非线性衰老模式和异质性协变量历史的纵向健康数据时可能过于严格，需要更灵活的估计器。
Method: 提出一个条件神经网络，从个体健康史中学习，融入观测间时间间隔，并以人口和社会经济属性为条件，输出下一个观测健康状态的有效概率分布。
Result: 在健康与退休研究数据上，所提估计器在重度残疾区分能力上优于逻辑回归和梯度提升树，保持了强校准性，并在保留测试中取得最低的转移矩阵误差。
Conclusion: 一个结构化的机器学习估计器可以在校准和投影保真度方面支持长期护理转移建模，而不仅仅是区分能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Natively Unlearnable Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Unlearning aims to remove the influence of specific training data sources, but this has proved challenging because the contributions of different sources are entangled within the model. Isolating source contributions to disjoint parameters makes removal easier, though it obstructs joint learning across sources. We propose NULLs (Natively Unlearnable LLMs), a model class that satisfies the two opposing goals of isolating source-specific contributions and learning jointly across sources, by training a set of shared backbone neurons alongside a pool of sparsely activated sinks. During training, information specific to a source naturally concentrates in its sinks while information shared across sources accumulates in the backbone. A source is then unlearned at deployment by disabling its corresponding sinks, with no gradient updates and no access to the retained data. We show that NULLs scales to Wikipedia's ~6M articles, isolating each as an independent source. Unlearning a single article removes knowledge specific to it while preserving facts shared with semantically related articles, closely matching retraining from scratch. We note that unlearning with NULLs is also robust: in a case study of unlearning the Harry Potter books, NULLs resists both adversarial extraction and relearning that reverses post-hoc unlearning. Finally, NULLs preserves general language capabilities, matching a standard transformer on downstream benchmarks. Together, these results suggest that source-level unlearning need not be an afterthought. It can be built natively into LLM training while retaining the benefits of shared representation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NULLs (Natively Unlearnable LLMs)，一种通过共享骨干神经元和稀疏激活的“汇” (sinks) 实现源级别遗忘的模型架构。训练时每个数据源的信息自然集中在对应的汇中，部署时禁用汇即可遗忘该源，无需梯度更新或访问保留数据。在 Wikipedia 约600万文章上验证，单篇文章遗忘效果接近从头重训练，且能抵抗对抗性提取和再学习。模型在通用语言能力上匹配标准 Transformer。
Motivation: 现有遗忘方法难以分离不同数据源在模型中的贡献，而将参数划分为独立源会阻碍联合学习。需要一种既能隔离源特定信息又能跨源共享学习的方案。
Method: 提出 NULLs 架构：训练一组共享骨干神经元和一组稀疏激活的汇。通过训练使每个数据源的信息自然集中在对应汇中，共享知识留在骨干。遗忘时只需禁用目标源的汇。
Result: 在 Wikipedia 约600万文章上，单篇文章遗忘后知识消除且与语义相关文章共享的事实得以保留，效果接近重训练。在哈利波特书籍遗忘案例中，能抵抗对抗性提取和再学习。通用语言能力在标准下游基准上与 Transformer 持平。
Conclusion: 源级别遗忘可以原生地构建到 LLM 训练中，同时保留共享表示学习的优势。

papers.title: Avatar V: Scaling Video-Reference Avatar Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating avatar videos that are not merely visually similar to a target individual but behaviorally recognizable, faithfully reproducing their talking rhythm, gestural tendencies, and expression dynamics, remains an open challenge. Existing methods predominantly condition on single static images, which provide insufficient identity information and cannot capture dynamic motion traits, while standard pixel-level objectives underserve the perceptually critical facial regions that determine avatar fidelity. We present Avatar V, a production-scale framework that addresses these limitations through video-reference-conditioned identity modeling. Rather than compressing identity into fixed-size embeddings, the model conditions directly on the full token sequence of a reference video, learning to reproduce both static identity attributes (facial geometry, skin texture) and dynamic behavioral patterns (talking rhythm, micro-expressions) through attention over the reference context. We introduce Sparse Reference Attention, an asymmetric mechanism achieving linear-complexity conditioning on arbitrarily long references; a motion representation stream enabling closed-loop talking style transfer; and an identity-aware super-resolution refiner inheriting the full reference conditioning. These are supported by a data engine curating 100M+ training clips from 50M raw videos, and a five-stage training pipeline with flow matching pre-training, personality fine-tuning, two-phase distillation (>10x acceleration), and RLHF alignment, deployed across thousands of GPUs. Avatar V generates 1080p videos of unlimited duration, achieving state-of-the-art identity preservation, lip synchronization, and generation quality on our cross-scene benchmark, consistently outperforming leading systems including Seedance 2.0, Kling O3 Pro, Veo 3.1, and OmniHuman 1.5 in both automated metrics and human evaluation.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 15 figures. All contributors are listed in alphabetical order by first name
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Avatar V，一个大规模视频参考驱动的数字人视频生成框架，通过引入稀疏参考注意力（Sparse Reference Attention）、运动表示流和身份感知超分辨率精炼器等组件，从参考视频中提取静态和动态身份特征，生成不限时长的1080p视频。在跨场景基准测试中，该方法在身份保持、唇形同步和生成质量上超越 Seedance 2.0、Kling O3 Pro 等现有系统。
Motivation: 现有数字人视频生成方法多依赖单张静态图像，缺乏对动态行为模式（如说话节奏、手势倾向）的捕捉，且像素级损失函数忽视了面部感知关键区域，导致生成结果在行为可识别性上不足。
Method: 提出视频参考条件建模，直接对参考视频的完整 token 序列进行注意力操作，实现线性复杂度的稀疏参考注意力；引入运动表示流用于闭环说话风格迁移；结合身份感知超分辨率精炼器继承参考条件。训练采用五阶段流水线：流匹配预训练、个性微调、两阶段蒸馏（10倍加速）和 RLHF 对齐，数据引擎从5000万原始视频中筛选超过1亿训练片段。
Result: 生成1080p不限时长视频，在跨场景基准上取得最优身份保持、唇形同步和生成质量，自动指标和人工评估均优于 Seedance 2.0、Kling O3 Pro、Veo 3.1 和 OmniHuman 1.5。
Conclusion: Avatar V 展示了基于视频参考条件建模在大规模数字人视频生成中的有效性，但该方法专注于人物视频生成，不涉及其它领域。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hyperdimensional computing for structured querying on tabular data embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Tabular data embeddings have become a cornerstone of data profiling and data integration pipelines, enabling tasks such as entity annotation and resolution; schema matching; column type detection; and table search, among others. Existing approaches embed rows, columns, or entire tables into a vector space and rely on nearest-neighbor search to retrieve candidate matches. A fundamental limitation of current embedding methods is the lack of interpretable similarity scores: the concrete similarity value between a query and its nearest neighbour carries no intrinsic meaning, making it impossible to determine whether that neighbour is a true match or simply the least-dissimilar item in a corpus that contains no valid answer. This inability to set principled thresholds for retrieval undermines practical deployment, particularly for zero-match detection. We investigate the use of HyperDimensional Computing (HDC), specifically the Holographic Reduced Representations (HRR) model, as a framework for tabular row embeddings when the retrieval task corresponds to answering structured select-project queries in vector space. Exploiting the algebraic properties of HDC operations, we derive closed-form expected similarity values for both equality and non-equality retrieval predicates, which converge to interpretable values as dimensionality increases, and use these to identify suitable retrieval thresholds. We evaluate HDC against EmbDI, a graph-based baseline, on two real-world datasets across varying table sizes and predicate lengths. Our results show that HDC matches or outperforms EmbDI for row retrieval across all configurations, handles non-equality predicates more robustly, and achieves perfect attribute projection accuracy at sufficient dimensionality -- while uniquely enabling reliable identification of zero-match predicates through its principled thresholds.
papers.comment: 15 pages with appendices. 8 figures. Under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对表格数据嵌入中可解释相似度缺失的问题，提出使用超维计算（HDC）中的全息简化表示（HRR）模型来嵌入表格行，从而支持结构化查询。HRR利用代数性质导出等式和非等式谓词的闭式期望相似度，这些值随维度增加收敛到可解释的值，并据此设定合理的检索阈值。在真实数据集上的实验表明，HDC在行检索上匹配或优于基线EmbDI，对非等式谓词更鲁棒，且在高维下实现完美的属性投影精度，同时能可靠地识别零匹配谓词。
Motivation: 现有表格数据嵌入方法依赖最近邻搜索，但相似度值本身缺乏可解释性，无法区分真正匹配与无答案时的最不相似项，尤其无法检测零匹配场景。
Method: 采用全息简化表示（HRR）模型将表格行嵌入为超维向量，利用HRR的代数性质（如捆绑、置换、绑定）进行结构化查询，并推导出等式和非等式谓词下期望相似度的闭式公式，作为可解释的检索阈值。
Result: 在真实数据集上，HDC在行检索任务中匹配或优于EmbDI；对非等式谓词更鲁棒；在足够维度下属性投影精度达到完美；能通过原则性阈值可靠识别零匹配谓词。
Conclusion: HDC为表格数据嵌入提供了可解释的相似度度量，尤其适用于需要零匹配检测的结构化查询场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mirage Probes: How Vision Models Fake Visual Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) can answer image-based questions confidently, and often correctly, even when no image is provided. This mirage behavior inflates benchmark scores without reflecting visual grounding. Prior work treats this as a single failure mode. We argue it is two. Using Mirage Probes, a contrastive probing framework that pairs paraphrased question variants with matched mirage and non-mirage labels on the same image, we show that mirage behavior is linearly decodable from internal activations across residual stream, MLP, post-attention, and attention-head sites in two open-source VLMs. We demonstrate that a Naive Bayes text baseline cannot recover this signal, ruling out surface lexical confounds. Cross-benchmark separability patterns, together with a novel Prior Harnessing Index (PHI) measuring how much a model can answer from text alone, expose two distinct regimes: textual biases, where the model answers from language priors without engaging visual representations, and spurious images, where it constructs false visual content in latent space and answers as if grounded. The distinction has direct mitigation consequences: text-distribution cleaning can address the first regime but cannot reach the second, since spurious-image mirages live in the model's visual representations rather than its text. Faithful visual grounding will require interventions at the representational level.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Mirage Probes 对比探测框架，揭示视觉语言模型（VLM）在无图像输入时也能正确回答图像问题，这种“幻象行为”夸大了基准分数。作者将其分为两种不同机制：文本偏差（利用语言先验）和虚假图像（在隐空间构造视觉内容）。通过内部激活线性可解码和 Prior Harnessing Index（PHI）等实验，证明两种机制需要不同的缓解策略。
Motivation: 现有研究将 VLM 的无图像回答能力视为单一失败模式，但本文认为这实际上是两种独立问题，需要区分以制定有效缓解措施。
Method: 使用 Mirage Probes，一种对比探测框架，将问题变体与匹配的幻象/非幻象标签配对，分析两个开源 VLM 的内部激活（残差流、MLP、后注意力、注意力头），并引入 Prior Harnessing Index（PHI）量化模型仅从文本回答的能力。
Result: 文本偏差可通过清理文本分布缓解，而虚假图像无法通过文本手段处理，因为其存在于视觉表征中；Naive Bayes 基线无法复现该信号，排除了词汇混淆。
Conclusion: 实现真实视觉基础需要表征层面的干预，而非仅文本层面。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multi-Variable Stellar Parameter Estimation Using Residual Multitask Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: We present an end-to-end pipeline for estimating stellar parameters from Sloan Digital Sky Survey Data Release 12 spectra using a fully connected multitask neural network with residual blocks, whose hyperparameters are tuned via Bayesian optimization. The preprocessing pipeline includes per-spectrum standardization, RobustScaler normalization of the target variables -- effective temperature $T_{\mathrm{eff}}$, metallicity $[\mathrm{Fe/H}]$, and surface gravity $\log g$ -- and data augmentation via Gaussian noise injection. On a held-out test set, the model achieved Mean Absolute Errors (MAE) of $59.76~\mathrm{K}$ for $T_{\mathrm{eff}}$, $0.103~\mathrm{dex}$ for $[\mathrm{Fe/H}]$, and $0.130~\mathrm{dex}$ for $\log g$. Normalized against the full-scale range of each parameter, these results represent range-normalized errors between $1\%$ and $3\%$, achieved with a highly efficient model complexity of approximately 540,000 trainable parameters. These results demonstrate that a compact residual multitask architecture, combined with principled signal preprocessing, provides a parameter-efficient solution for nonlinear parameter estimation in large-scale spectral datasets. In particular, the proposed model achieves competitive performance with substantially lower complexity than deeper neural network baselines.
papers.comment: This manuscript has been submitted to the Congresso Brasileiro de Automática (CBA) and is currently under peer review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出一种端到端管线，使用全连接多任务神经网络（含残差块）从SDSS DR12光谱估计恒星参数（有效温度、金属丰度、表面重力）。通过贝叶斯优化调参，在测试集上达到MAE分别为59.76 K、0.103 dex、0.130 dex，归一化误差在1%-3%之间，模型仅约54万参数，比深层网络更高效。
Motivation: 现有深层次网络复杂度高，需要更参数高效的方案来从大规模光谱数据中估计恒星参数。
Method: 采用全连接多任务神经网络，包含残差块，结合预处理（每光谱标准化、RobustScaler归一化目标变量、高斯噪声数据增强），超参数通过贝叶斯优化。
Result: 在SDSS DR12测试集上，有效温度MAE 59.76 K，金属丰度MAE 0.103 dex，表面重力MAE 0.130 dex，归一化误差1%-3%，模型参数约54万。
Conclusion: 紧凑的残差多任务架构结合信号预处理，能为大规模光谱数据提供参数高效的非线性参数估计方案，性能与更深网络相当但复杂度更低。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Muon$^p$: Muon with Fractional Spectral Powers
papers.abstract_en: Muon is an increasingly widely used optimizer that replaces a gradient $G=USV^\top$ with its polar factor $UV^\top$, thereby flattening the singular spectrum. However, full flattening discards singular-value information that may matter for adaptation. We introduce Muon$^p$, a Muon-style optimizer that instead uses fractional spectral-power updates $US^pV^\top$ for rational $p\in(0,1)$, interpolating between Muon and gradient descent. To make it practical, we prove that fractional spectral powers cannot be computed by any fixed univariate polynomial iteration, and furthermore derive low-degree odd bivariate recurrences that approximate $US^pV^\top$ using only matrix multiplications, preserving Muon's matrix-multiplication-only structure and compute complexity. We show that Muon$^p$ maximizes the linear improvement in loss under the Schatten $q$-norm for $q=1+\frac{1}{p}$. Empirically, Muon$^p$ is especially effective for finetuning: on billion-scale models, Muon$^p$ improves validation perplexity and downstream task performance. We further analyze when Muon$^p$ is less suitable, through the lens of spectral geometry. Our results reveal important insights on when preserving the singular spectrum can bring significant gains, and introduce a principled way to achieve them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Muon$^p$ 是一种改进的优化器，通过分数谱幂更新 $US^pV^\top$ 在 Muon 和梯度下降之间插值，避免完全扁平化奇异值谱。论文证明了分数谱幂无法由固定单变量多项式迭代计算，并推导了低次奇双变量递归来近似，仅使用矩阵乘法。实验表明 Muon$^p$ 在微调十亿级模型时提升了验证困惑度和下游任务性能，并通过谱几何分析了其适用场景。
Motivation: Muon 优化器完全扁平化奇异值谱可能丢弃对自适应有用的奇异值信息，需要一种在保留部分谱信息的同时保持计算效率的方法。
Method: 引入分数谱幂更新 $US^pV^\top$（$p\in(0,1)$ 有理数），并证明无法用固定单变量多项式迭代计算；为此推导了低次奇双变量递归，仅用矩阵乘法近似该更新，保持 Muon 的矩阵乘法结构和计算复杂度。
Result: 在十亿级模型微调中，Muon$^p$ 改善了验证困惑度和下游任务性能；理论上表明 Muon$^p$ 在 Schatten $q$-范数（$q=1+1/p$）下最大化损失的线性改进。
Conclusion: Muon$^p$ 提供了一种在保留奇异值谱的同时保持计算效率的优化方法，通过谱几何分析揭示了其适用场景，但论文也指出了其不适合的情况。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SuperThoughts: Reasoning Tokens in Superposition
papers.abstract_en: Long Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning improves LLM problem-solving but is computationally expensive due to sequential token generation. While recent works explore reasoning in continuous latent spaces to bypass discrete token generation, they often struggle with training stability and fail to scale to complex, long-horizon tasks due to lack of supervision signal. We propose SuperThoughts, which compresses pairs of consecutive CoT tokens into single latent representations and decodes two tokens per step via a lightweight Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) module. This preserves discrete token supervision at training time while doubling throughput at inference time. We finetune Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-Math-14B-Instruct, and evaluate on MATH500, AMC, OlympiadBench, and GPQA-Diamond. With a confidence-based adaptive mechanism that falls back to standard decoding when uncertain, SuperThoughts achieves $\sim$20--30\% CoT length reduction while maintaining accuracy with minimal degradation (1-2 points accuracy drop on most tasks).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SuperThoughts，将连续两个CoT推理token压缩为单个潜在表示，并通过轻量级多token预测模块每步解码两个token，从而在训练时保留离散token监督，推理时实现吞吐量翻倍。在多个数学推理基准上，该方法在保持准确率基本不变（多数任务仅下降1-2个点）的同时，将CoT长度减少约20-30%。
Motivation: 长链推理（CoT）虽能提升LLM问题求解能力，但顺序生成token导致计算开销大；现有连续潜在空间推理方法训练不稳定且难以扩展到复杂长程任务。
Method: 将连续两个CoT token压缩为单个潜在表示，并通过轻量级Multi-Token Prediction模块每步解码两个token；同时引入基于置信度的自适应机制，在不确信时回退到标准解码。
Result: 在MATH500、AMC、OlympiadBench、GPQA-Diamond上，使用Qwen2.5-Math系列模型（1.5B/7B/14B），实现约20-30%的CoT长度缩减，准确率仅下降1-2个点。
Conclusion: SuperThoughts通过潜在空间压缩与多token预测，有效平衡了CoT推理的效率与准确性，且自适应机制保证了鲁棒性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Temporal Backtracking Search for Test-time Generative Video Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: While test-time scaling has revolutionized reasoning in large language models, generative video reasoning remains bottlenecked by a single-shot paradigm. We demonstrate that searching over denoising steps cannot rescue logically flawed rollouts because spatial trajectories commit early in the diffusion process. Root-level Best-of-N (BoN) sampling is similarly inefficient: reasoning errors cluster early in the temporal axis, and resampling blindly discards verified upstream progress. To unlock effective test-time scaling for video models, we introduce Temporal Backtracking Search (TBS), which shifts the search space to the temporal axis. TBS transforms video generation into an iterative generate-verify-restart loop via three core mechanisms: (1) variable-K conditioning to resume generation from arbitrary clean prefixes; (2) temporal process verification to localize failures and extract valid restart anchors; and (3) prefix-based search to reallocate compute toward extending correct trajectories rather than root resampling. Across algorithmic, navigation, and robotics domains, TBS Pareto-dominates matched-budget BoN. In a strict out-of-distribution setting where one-shot generation collapses (0.7% for BoN), TBS achieves 22.7%, with every solved episode stemming from a restarted branch. Ultimately, TBS reveals that the local reasoning competence of video models far exceeds what single-shot rollouts indicate, providing a scalable test-time framework to unlock it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出时间回溯搜索（TBS）方法，将视频生成的测试时扩展从单次采样转向时间轴上的迭代生成-验证-重启循环。TBS通过可变K条件生成、时间过程验证和前缀搜索机制，在算法、导航和机器人领域优于等预算的Best-of-N采样，在严格分布外场景中将成功率从0.7%提升至22.7%。
Motivation: 现有视频推理模型受限于单次生成范式，扩散过程中的空间轨迹早期即锁定错误，而Best-of-N采样盲目丢弃已验证的正确上游进展，导致测试时扩展效率低下。
Method: 提出三种核心机制：(1) 可变K条件生成，从任意干净前缀恢复生成；(2) 时间过程验证，定位失败并提取有效重启锚点；(3) 基于前缀的搜索，将计算重分配给正确轨迹的延伸而非根重采样。
Result: 在算法、导航和机器人领域，TBS帕累托支配等预算BoN。在严格OOD场景中（BoN仅0.7%），TBS达到22.7%的成功率，所有成功轨迹均源自重启分支。
Conclusion: TBS揭示了视频模型局部推理能力远超单次生成所表现的水平，提供了可扩展的测试时框架以释放其潜力。

papers.title: Closed-loop discovery of out-of-distribution processing protocols by evolutionary search and uncertainty-aware learning
papers.abstract_en: Many materials and chemical systems exhibit history-dependent responses, where functional outcomes are governed not only by final-state variables but by the time-dependent sequence of fields, temperatures, or chemical potentials applied during operation. Discovering new processing protocols is therefore a high-dimensional search problem in which the control variable is an entire waveform or sample history, and conventional strategies either remain confined to conservative interpolative families or become prohibitively measurement intensive. Here, a closed-loop workflow is introduced that couples evolutionary search over a compact waveform representation with uncertainty-aware deep kernel learning to generate, rank, and experimentally validate candidate protocols. Applied to ferroelectric thin films, with the scanning-probe tip-bias waveform as the protocol and the nonlinear electromechanical response as the reward, the workflow discovers waveform families that enhance nonlinearity by de-aging the film. Spatially resolved before/after measurements show that the best-performing waveforms selectively activate pre-existing, weakly pinned domain-wall segments, whereas the worst drive long-range irreversible switching. This framework reframes protocol tuning as out-of-distribution discovery, generalizable to synthesis and annealing trajectories, battery formation protocols, and other high-dimensional control problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种闭环工作流，将紧凑波形表示的进化搜索与不确定性感知深度核学习相结合，用于发现材料系统中依赖历史响应的处理协议。应用于铁电薄膜的扫描探针尖端偏压波形优化，该工作流成功发现通过去老化解锁弱钉扎畴壁来增强非线性响应的波形族。该框架将协议调优重新定义为分布外发现，可推广到合成、退火轨迹及电池形成协议等高维控制问题。
Motivation: 许多材料和化学系统表现出历史依赖响应，传统搜索策略要么局限于保守的插值族，要么测量成本过高，因此需要一种高效的协议发现方法。
Method: 提出闭环工作流，通过进化搜索紧凑的波形表示，并结合不确定性感知深度核学习来生成、排序及实验验证候选协议。
Result: 在铁电薄膜实验中，该方法发现了增强非线性响应的波形族，空间分辨测量显示最佳波形选择性激活预先存在的弱钉扎畴壁段，而最差波形导致长程不可逆切换。
Conclusion: 该工作将协议调优重新定义为分布外发现，可推广到其他高维控制问题，如合成、退火、电池形成等。

papers.title: Mood-Aware Music Recommendation: Integrating User Affective Signals into Ranking Systems
papers.abstract_en: Recommendation systems are essential in modern music streaming platforms due to the vast amount of available content. While collaborative filtering is widely used to suggest items based on the preferences of others with similar patterns, it performs poorly in domains where user-item interactions are sparse, such as music. Content-based filtering is an alternative approach that examines the qualities of the items themselves. Genre, instrumentation, and lyrics have been explored; however, relatively little attention has been given to emotion recognition. Since a user's emotional state strongly influences their music choice, incorporating mood signals offers a promising direction for personalization. In this work, we propose a mood-conditioned ranking framework that integrates user affective signals into the recommendation process via softmax-based sampling in the energy-valence space. We evaluate the approach via single-blind experiments in which participants compare recommendations from the proposed system against a baseline. The results indicate improved perceived recommendation quality, providing preliminary evidence for the effectiveness of incorporating mood-based inputs into music recommendations.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于情绪的歌曲推荐框架，通过在能量-效价空间中进行softmax采样来整合用户情感信号，并通过单盲实验验证其有效性。
Motivation: 现有音乐推荐系统在用户交互稀疏时表现不佳，且较少利用情绪信号，而用户情绪状态对音乐选择影响显著。
Method: 提出情绪条件排序框架，在能量-效价空间中通过softmax采样将用户情感信号融入推荐过程。
Result: 单盲实验表明，与基线相比，该框架提高了用户感知的推荐质量。
Conclusion: 初步证据表明，将情绪信号融入音乐推荐是有效的，但仍需进一步研究。

papers.title: SpheriCity: Designing Trustworthy Conversational AI for Sustainability Decision Support
papers.abstract_en: We present SpheriCity, an expert-grounded conversational prototype designed to support trustworthy knowledge sensemaking from sustainability reports. City-level circularity assessment reports contain rich information about materials, infrastructure, and policy interventions, yet their length and heterogeneous structure make cross-document synthesis and comparison difficult for practitioners and researchers working on circular economy initiatives. While large language models (LLM) promise faster knowledge access and synthesis, their opaque reasoning, hallucinations, and lack of source transparency introduce risks for trust and interpretability, and require verification in high-stakes sustainability contexts. SpheriCity addresses these challenges through a provenance-first conversational agent that foregrounds evidence traceability, structured synthesis, and interaction scaffolds to support exploratory querying and cross-document synthesis across sustainability reports. We conducted a formative expert review with six sustainability experts using representative queries spanning cross-city comparison, policy summarization, and recommendation-oriented tasks. Experts evaluated responses across dimensions and provided qualitative reflections on the system's usefulness for sustainability knowledge work. Our results reveal that transparent sourcing, contextual explanation, interpretability, and alignment with expert workflow strongly shape expert trust and judgments of system usefulness. This work contributes (1) a conversational prototype for sustainability knowledge sensemaking, (2) an expert-grounded evaluation framework for assessing AI responses in high-stakes knowledge domains, and (3) design insights into how provenance, uncertainty communication, and integration in workflow influence expert users' trust in AI assistance for sustainability decision support.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACM SIGCAS/SIGCHI Conference on Computing and Sustainable Societies (COMPASS '26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SpheriCity，一个以溯源为先的对话式 AI 原型，旨在帮助可持续性专家从城市循环性评估报告中可信地提取和综合知识。通过六位专家的形成性评审验证，发现透明来源、上下文解释和与工作流程的对齐是影响信任的关键因素。该工作提供了原型系统、评估框架和设计洞见。
Motivation: 城市循环性评估报告内容冗长、结构异构，跨文档综合和比较困难；大型语言模型虽然能加速知识获取，但其不透明推理、幻觉和缺乏来源透明性在高风险的可持续性决策中带来信任和可解释性风险。
Method: 构建一个溯源优先的对话代理，强调证据可追溯性、结构化综合和交互支架，支持探索性查询和跨文档综合。通过六位可持续性专家进行形成性评审，使用代表性查询（跨城市比较、政策摘要、推荐任务）评估系统。
Result: 专家评审表明，透明来源、上下文解释、可解释性以及与专家工作流程的对齐强烈影响专家对系统有用性和信任的判断。
Conclusion: 该工作贡献了一个可持续性知识梳理的对话原型、一个针对高风险知识领域 AI 响应的专家评估框架，以及关于溯源、不确定性沟通和工作流集成如何影响专家信任的设计洞见。
