papers.title: Controller-Augmented Hidden Markov Models: A Computational Framework for Constrained Sequential Inference
papers.abstract_en: Hidden Markov models are foundational for sequential inference, but their Markovian assumption fails under pathwise constraints such as precedence requirements, visitation cardinalities, or monotonic state progression, which induce long-range dependencies that invalidate standard dynamic programming algorithms. To deal with this, we present Controller-Augmented Hidden Markov Models (CHMMs), a framework that compiles each constraint into a finite-state controller tracking the minimal sufficient history, after which standard forward--backward and Viterbi recursions on the augmented chain compute exact constrained posteriors and maximum a posteriori paths in both discrete and continuous time, the latter through uniformization. We establish four theoretical guarantees: exactness of constrained inference, monotone ascent of constrained EM, inference complexity linear in the controller cardinality, and a total-variation bound under constraint misspecification. A catalog of controller encodings covering 11 constraint families across the ordering, visitation, path, and temporal categories operationalizes the framework. Empirically, we evaluate CHMMs against 6 alternative decoders on 3 real-world sequence-labeling tasks of substantively different character: gene-structure decoding in \emph{Drosophila melanogaster}, free-living activity recognition in CASAS smart-home environments, and protocol-defined human activity recognition from wearable sensors. The results reveal a clean local-versus-cumulative dichotomy in which controller augmentation is uniquely able to recover globally feasible trajectories on cumulative-constraint regimes, whilst simpler decoders are matched in validity on locally-dominated regimes. Together, theory and experiment characterize when exact controller augmentation is necessary and when simpler approaches suffice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出控制器增强隐马尔可夫模型（CHMM），通过将路径约束编译为有限状态控制器，使得标准前向-后向和维特比算法能够在增广链上精确计算约束后验和最大后验路径，适用于离散和连续时间。理论上证明了约束推断的精确性、约束EM的单调上升、推理复杂度与控制器基数线性相关，以及约束错误指定下的全变差界。在三个真实世界序列标注任务（果蝇基因结构解码、智能家居活动识别、可穿戴传感器活动识别）上，与6种替代解码器对比，显示控制器增强在累积约束场景中能恢复全局可行轨迹，而简单解码器在局部主导场景中足够。
Motivation: 隐马尔可夫模型的马尔可夫假设在处理路径约束（如顺序要求、访问基数、单调状态进展）时会失败，因为这些约束引入长程依赖，使标准动态规划算法失效。本文旨在提供一种框架来精确处理这类约束序列推断。
Method: 提出Controller-Augmented Hidden Markov Models (CHMMs)，将每个约束编译为一个有限状态控制器，跟踪最小充分历史，然后在增广链上应用标准的前向-后向和维特比递归，在离散和连续时间（通过均匀化）下计算精确约束后验和最大后验路径。
Result: 在果蝇基因结构解码、智能家居活动识别、可穿戴传感器活动识别三个任务上，与6种替代解码器对比，结果显示控制器增强在累积约束场景中唯一能恢复全局可行轨迹，而简单解码器在局部主导场景中有效性相当。
Conclusion: 理论和实验共同刻画了何时需要精确控制器增强，何时简单方法足够。同时提供了涵盖11种约束族（排序、访问、路径、时间类别）的控制器编码目录。

papers.title: Temporally Consistent Graph Q-Networks for Intelligent Network Control
papers.abstract_en: Mobile networks continue to grow in complexity and next generation networks are expected to support both increasing traffic loads and more diverse services. As network complexity rises, optimizing antenna parameters under dynamic or changing objectives becomes increasingly challenging. We propose a novel multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) algorithm for high-level control and orchestration of mobile networks. The Temporally Consistent Graph Q-Network (TC-GQN) algorithm learns a self-predicting representation of the whole network that is task-independent and aggregates information from all base-stations. A graph neural network is trained using a global reward function to assign coordinated local actions based on the learned encoding of the global network state. We evaluate the algorithm in a simulated environment to orchestrate an energy-saving feature across multiple sectors and multiple carriers under different quality of service (QoS) constraints. The proposed algorithm outperforms state-of-the-art graph-based baselines and a competitive rule-based controller by improving hardware sleep time while maintaining QoS. Moreover, the learned representation enables rapid adaptation to changing intents.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to the 6G AI-RAN Workshop at IEEE INFOCOM 2026. The final published version will be available via IEEE Xplore
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于图神经网络的多智能体强化学习算法TC-GQN，用于移动网络的高层控制和编排。算法学习整个网络的自预测表示，通过全局奖励函数训练图神经网络，使各基站协同执行本地动作。在仿真环境中，该算法在多个QoS约束下优化节能特征，相比现有基线方法提高了硬件休眠时间并保持了服务质量。
Motivation: 移动网络日益复杂，下一代网络需支持更大流量和更多样化的服务，动态优化天线参数变得更加困难，现有方法难以应对动态或变化的目标。
Method: 提出Temporally Consistent Graph Q-Network (TC-GQN) 算法，利用图神经网络学习任务无关的自预测网络表示，聚合所有基站信息，并通过全局奖励函数分配协调的本地动作。
Result: 在仿真实验中，TC-GQN在多个QoS约束下优化多扇区多载波的节能特征，优于图基基线方法和规则控制器，提升了硬件休眠时间并保持了服务质量。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于图神经网络的多智能体强化学习算法TC-GQN，用于移动网络的高层控制和编排。算法学习整个网络的自预测表示，通过全局奖励函数训练图神经网络，使各基站协同执行本地动作。在仿真环境中，该算法在多个QoS约束下优化节能特征，相比现有基线方法提高了硬件休眠时间并保持了服务质量。
summary_sections.motivation: 移动网络日益复杂，下一代网络需支持更大流量和更多样化的服务，动态优化天线参数变得更加困难，现有方法难以应对动态或变化的目标。
summary_sections.method: 提出Temporally Consistent Graph Q-Network (TC-GQN) 算法，利用图神经网络学习任务无关的自预测网络表示，聚合所有基站信息，并通过全局奖励函数分配协调的本地动作。

summary_sections.conclusion: 算法学习到的表示能够快速适应变化的目标，展示了在复杂网络控制中的潜力。

papers.title: Multi-Agent Embodied Autonomous Driving: From V2X Information Exchange to Shared World Models
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous driving is shifting from isolated vehicle intelligence toward multi-agent embodied systems that share perception, infer intent, and coordinate action under uncertainty. This survey examines this transition through the lens of Shared World Models (SWMs): predictive cross-agent representations maintained across vehicles, infrastructure, and other traffic participants. We review more than 380 publications spanning vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communication, collaborative perception, inter-agent cognition, cooperative planning, end-to-end cooperative driving, and simulation and data engines for closed-loop validation. The organizing question is how exchanged observations become aligned state, intent-aware interaction, and coordinated downstream action. Across the surveyed literature, evaluation remains concentrated in simulation, curated benchmarks, and offline protocols. Foundation-model-based coordination also lacks verified real-time safety guarantees in open traffic. These gaps motivate key research priorities for multi-agent embodied autonomous driving (MAEAD): verifiable shared-state maintenance, robust intent and plan alignment, and safe coordinated action under communication, latency, and deployment constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该综述探讨了自动驾驶从单一车辆智能向多智能体具身系统的转变，核心是共享世界模型（SWM），即跨车辆、基础设施和其他交通参与者的预测性交叉主体表征。作者回顾了380余篇文献，涵盖V2X通信、协同感知、智能体间认知、协同规划、端到端协同驾驶及闭环验证的仿真与数据引擎，指出当前评估集中于仿真和离线协议，且基于基础模型的协调缺乏可验证的实时安全保障。
Motivation: 传统自动驾驶局限于孤立车辆智能，无法有效处理感知不确定性、意图推断和协调行动。跨主体共享感知和预测模型是解决这一问题的关键方向。
Method: 提出共享世界模型（SWM）的框架性视角，将V2X信息交换与跨主体协同感知、意图推断和行动规划统一到预测性表征中，并系统分类和评估了相关文献。
Result: 综述发现，现有评估主要依赖仿真环境、固定基准和离线协议，缺乏开放交通场景下实时安全性的严格验证。
Conclusion: 未来研究需优先解决可验证的共享状态维护、鲁棒的意图与计划对齐，以及通信、延迟和部署约束下的安全协调行动。

papers.title: Explaining RhythmFormer: A Systematic XAI Analysis of Periodic Sparse Attention for Remote Photoplethysmography
papers.abstract_en: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) transformers achieve low heart-rate error on benchmarks, yet their decisions remain opaque--a growing concern as rPPG moves toward clinical heart rate estimation. Existing rPPG XAI is dominated by qualitative heatmap inspection without quantitative faithfulness metrics or physiology-grounded validation, leaving a gap between visual plausibility and auditable evidence. We address this gap. First, we adapt four attribution methods (raw attention, rollout, flow, Beyond Intuition) to RhythmFormer's bi-level routing attention with top-$k$ selection. Second, we introduce a skin coverage metric quantifying how much attribution mass falls on skin regions. Third, we adapt the SaCo faithfulness coefficient from its original classification setting to rPPG regression by using the MAE between original and perturbed predicted rPPG waveforms as the perturbation impact. Applying these tools, we quantify a multi-hop leakage effect under sparse top-$k$ routing: attention rollout and flow almost completely restores the connections that individual refined-attention layers explicitly set to zero. Beyond Intuition mitigates this via its value-projection-weighted rollout and gradient-supported mask, attaining the highest median refined skin coverage ($0.83$ vs. $0.57$ for vanilla rollout) and faithfulness ($F=0.92$) among the evaluated methods on UBFC-rPPG. Validation across diverse datasets and model variants is needed. A case study on a low-SaCo outlier further shows all four methods recovering consistently once an artefactual region is replaced, suggesting consistent SaCo behavior across attribution families in this illustrative case. Together, these metrics move XAI for rPPG toward auditable numerical evidence about spatial alignment and perturbation faithfulness, i.e. trustworthy rPPG XAI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对rPPG Transformer的可解释性不足问题，系统评估了四种归因方法在RhythmFormer上的表现，并引入皮肤覆盖度（skin coverage）和忠实度（faithfulness, SaCo）等量化指标。实验发现，稀疏top-k路由下存在多跳泄漏效应，Beyond Intuition方法通过值投影权重和梯度支持掩码缓解了这一效应，在UBFC-rPPG数据集上取得最高中位数皮肤覆盖度（0.83）和忠实度（0.92）。
Motivation: 现有rPPG Transformer的决策过程不透明，且已有可解释性研究缺乏定量忠实度指标和生理学验证，无法提供可审计的证据。
Method: 将四种归因方法（raw attention, rollout, flow, Beyond Intuition）适配到RhythmFormer的双层路由注意力机制，并引入皮肤覆盖度指标和基于rPPG波形MAE的SaCo忠实度系数。
Result: Beyond Intuition在UBFC-rPPG上取得中位数皮肤覆盖度0.83（vs. 0.57）和忠实度0.92，高于其他方法；同时揭示了稀疏路由下的多跳泄漏效应。
Conclusion: 本文为rPPG XAI提供了可审计的数值证据，但方法需要跨数据集和变体的验证。

papers.title: When Plausible Is Not Realistic: Evaluating Human Mobility in LLM-Based Urban Simulation
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based generative agents are increasingly used in urban simulators, yet it remains unclear whether they reproduce empirically realistic human mobility patterns or merely generate plausible mobility narratives. We introduce a validation framework for evaluating the mobility of generative agents of LLM-based urban simulators against real-world mobility data. For this, we use mobility laws, temporal rhythms, network motifs, semantic activity transitions, and behavioral mobility profiles. Using datasets from the Greater Paris region and Shanghai, we evaluate AgentSociety and CitySim across multiple dimensions of mobility realism. Our analysis reveals a substantial gap between narrative plausibility and empirical mobility realism. Although the simulators capture some high-level semantic activity distributions, they struggle to reproduce core spatial and temporal constraints, including realistic trip-length distributions, origin-destination flows, dwell times, and transition dynamics. We further observe that realistic mobility diversity is unstable across default prompting configurations and may require explicit profile-aware initialization. To support reproducible evaluation, we also contribute scalable and open LLM-driven infrastructure for regional-scale map generation, observability-enhanced simulation, mobility-metric computation, and traffic simulation. Our findings highlight the need for rigorous empirical validation of LLM-based urban simulators and provide practical tools for building more realistic and reproducible urban simulation systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于LLM的生成代理在城市模拟中是否再现经验真实的人类移动模式问题，提出一个验证框架，利用移动性定律、时间节奏、网络模式等维度，在巴黎和上海数据集上评估AgentSociety和CitySim。结果表明模拟器虽然能捕捉高层语义活动分布，但在行程长度、起终点流、停留时间等核心时空约束上与真实数据差距显著，且移动多样性不稳定。同时贡献了可扩展的LLM驱动基础设施。
Motivation: 现有LLM城市模拟器缺乏对生成代理移动模式经验真实性的系统验证，不清楚它们是否仅生成合理叙事而非真实移动模式。
Method: 提出验证框架，综合应用移动性定律、时间节奏、网络模式、语义活动转换和行为移动画像等多维度指标，对比真实移动数据评估模拟器的移动现实性。
Result: 在巴黎和上海数据集上，AgentSociety和CitySim虽能部分再现高层语义活动分布，但在行程长度分布、起终点流、停留时间、转移动态等核心时空约束上与真实数据存在明显差距；移动多样性对默认提示配置不稳定，需显式初始化。
Conclusion: 强调需要严格的实证验证，本文框架和开源基础设施有助于构建更现实、可复现的LLM城市模拟系统。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: Safety-Contract Graph Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Network Security Response
authors: Jose Luis Lima de Jesus Silva
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous network-security response systems promise to reduce Security Operations Centre (SOC) reaction latency, but reward-only multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) can improve security reward while remaining non-deployable. We present a safety-contract graph MARL framework and instantiate it as ACD$^3$-GAT (Adaptive Constrained Counterfactual Decisioning with a Graph Attention Network encoder), an architecture that separates simulator observations from reusable operational budgets, constrained optimization, graph state encoding, and counterfactual action screening. We evaluate the method in CAGE Challenge 4, where agents operate under budgets for Mean Time to Recover (MTTR), false-positive response, and firewall change-management disruption. Across the benchmark, every unconstrained method violates the SOC downtime budget in 100% of evaluated episodes, with mean downtime proxy costs of 311-430 against a budget of 50. This complements prior CAGE Challenge 4 findings by showing that reward-only learning lacks operational discipline. Constrained MAPPO-GAT (C-MAPPO-GAT) isolates Lagrangian operational-cost control and budget-aware screening, while ACD$^3$-GAT adds budget context, CVaR tail-risk estimation, opponent-belief state, and Graph Counterfactual Risk Propagation (G-CRP). The replicated comparison includes three 200-episode seeds for IPPO, MAPPO-GAT, C-MAPPO-GAT, and ACD$^3$-GAT. C-MAPPO-GAT reduces downtime violation from 100% to 0.3% and mean downtime cost from 355.4 to 15.5 relative to MAPPO-GAT. ACD$^3$-GAT reduces mean downtime cost to 48.2 with a 13.8% violation rate, placing it on the safety-contract frontier rather than at the most conservative compliance point. Topology-seed and coupled adaptive Red-process stress tests preserve this contrast and show lower worst adaptive degradation for safety-constrained policies than reward-only MAPPO-GAT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出安全合约图多智能体强化学习框架ACD³-GAT，用于自主网络安全响应。在CAGE Challenge 4中，无约束方法100%违反停机预算，而约束方法C-MAPPO-GAT将违反率降至0.3%并大幅降低平均停机成本，ACD³-GAT则处于安全合约前沿。
Motivation: 奖励-only的多智能体强化学习在网络安全响应中虽能提升安全奖励，但缺乏操作纪律，无法满足实际部署对预算约束的要求。
Method: 提出安全合约图框架，将模拟器观察与可复用运营预算分离，结合约束优化、图状态编码（GAT）和反事实动作筛选，具体实现为ACD³-GAT。
Result: 在CAGE Challenge 4中，无约束方法100%违反停机预算，平均停机成本311-430（预算50）；C-MAPPO-GAT将违反率降至0.3%，平均停机成本从355.4降至15.5；ACD³-GAT平均停机成本48.2，违反率13.8%。
Conclusion: 安全约束策略在自适应压力测试中表现出更低的worst-case退化，证明安全合约框架可实现可部署的自主网络安全响应。

papers.title: AI can help scientists publish less
papers.abstract_en: We can do more than defend science from a flood of AI-assisted papers. Used well, AI offers a historic opportunity to correct distortions in the publication system, help us publish fewer and better papers, and give scientists back the time to do their best work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇观点文章，讨论如何利用人工智能来应对AI辅助论文泛滥的问题，提出通过AI帮助科学家发表更少但更高质量的论文，从而将时间还给科研工作。
Motivation: 当前科学出版系统面临大量低质量AI辅助论文的冲击，需要纠正这种扭曲现象。
Conclusion: AI提供了一个历史性机会来改进出版系统，促使科学家发表更少但更好的论文。

papers.title: Approximating Whittle-Matern Fields over Discretized Manifolds
papers.abstract_en: Markovian Whittle-Matérn fields have been convergently approximated by discrete Gauss Markov Random Fields (GMRFs) with sparse precision matrices using a Finite Element approximation of the two-parameter family, \[ (κ^2 - Δ)^{α/2} u = \mathcal{W}, \;\; κ\in \mathbb{R}, \; α\in \mathbb{N}. \] of SPDEs. Using recent developements in the analysis of Discrete Exterior Calculus (DEC), we present a different, yet closely related, convergent GMRF approximation to these Matérn fields over complete, boundaryless Riemannian manifolds discretized as well-centered simplicial complexes. This convergent method (i) is agnostic to $α, κ$ and thus allows a universal approximation scheme for the precision and covariance matrices of the entire $(α, κ)$-family of GMRFs, so they may be inferred rather than guessed. (ii) inherently models pointwise and piecewise-smoothed measurements of a random field and approximates both equally well (iii) is computationally independent of the interpolants used - it suffers no overhead if one convergent interpolant were replaced with another suitable interpolant over the same mesh. Furthermore, we show that, on discretizations that are well-connected in a precise sense, and volume-concentrated, the precision matrices are spectral functions of a graph-laplacian. We provide a low rank approximator to the family of such Matérn GMRFs and mention a use case: reducing the number of measurements needed to model the GMRF by compressed-sensing.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于离散外微分（DEC）的收敛高斯马尔可夫随机场（GMRF）近似方法，用于在完整无边界的黎曼流形上逼近Whittle-Matérn场。该方法对参数α和κ通用，可同时处理点测量和分段平滑测量，且精度矩阵是图拉普拉斯的谱函数。还提供了低秩近似，并提及压缩感知在减少测量数量中的应用。
Motivation: 现有通过有限元近似Whittle-Matérn场的方法依赖于特定参数，缺乏通用性；需要一种与参数无关、且能统一处理不同测量类型的逼近方案。
Method: 利用离散外微分（DEC）分析，在良好中心的单纯复形上构造GMRF逼近，精度矩阵是图拉普拉斯的谱函数，并通过低秩近似实现高效计算。
Result: 该方法对α和κ通用，无需分别设计；能同时逼近点测量和分段平滑测量；计算复杂度不依赖于插值函数的选择。
Conclusion: 该工作为流形上Matérn场的GMRF逼近提供了一种通用且计算高效的方法，并展示了压缩感知在减少测量数量中的潜在应用。

papers.title: Scalable Deep Unfolding of Conic Optimizers
papers.abstract_en: Deep unfolding (DU) accelerates iterative optimizers by introducing learnable components and training them through unrolled iterations, but extending DU to the large-scale semidefinite programs (SDPs) common in robotics has remained limited. Unrolling a full-update conic solver such as COSMO exposes two obstacles that prior work on learned conic solvers has not: backpropagating through the per-iteration linear-system solve incurs memory quadratic in the problem size once the coefficient matrix is formed explicitly, and backpropagating through the positive semidefinite (PSD) cone projection becomes numerically unstable when eigenvalues coincide. We address the first obstacle with a matrix-free implicit differentiation rule that operates entirely through matrix-vector products, reducing memory from $O(n^2)$ to $O(n)$ and enabling backpropagation at scales where direct factorization runs out of memory. We address the second with a backward rule based on the Dalečkii--Krein representation of the Fréchet derivative, which remains well-defined under repeated eigenvalues. Together these make it possible to learn lightweight hyperparameter policies and warm-starts for a full-update conic solver. We evaluate on nonlinear covariance steering problems solved via sequential convex programming (SCP), as well as standalone SDPs and second-order cone programs ranging from max-cut and Lovász $\vartheta$ SDPs to robust estimation and control problems. The learned policies outperform state-of-the-art solvers across all problems, and can provide up to a 50$\times$ speedup depending on the class. When used as a subroutine in SCP, the learned approach delivers over a 30$\times$ speedup compared to COSMO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对机器人领域常见的大规模半定规划（SDP）问题，提出可扩展的深度展开（deep unfolding）方法，解决全更新锥求解器反向传播中的两个障碍：显式形成系数矩阵带来的二次内存开销，以及正半定锥投影在特征值重合时的数值不稳定。通过矩阵自由隐式微分和基于Dalečkii-Krein表示的后向规则，该方法在多种SDP和二阶锥规划问题（如非线性协方差控制、max-cut、Lovász ϑ SDP）中学习超参数策略和热启动，取得高达50倍的加速。
Motivation: 现有深度展开方法难以应用于机器人中的大规模SDP，因为反向传播时每步线性系统求解需要显式存储系数矩阵导致内存开销与问题规模二次方增长，同时PSD锥投影在重复特征值下数值不稳定。
Method: 提出两种关键技术：1）基于矩阵-向量乘积的无矩阵隐式微分规则，将内存从O(n^2)降至O(n)；2）基于Dalečkii-Krein表示的后向规则，在重复特征值下保持数值稳定。二者结合使全更新锥求解器的轻量级超参数策略和热启动学习成为可能。
Result: 在非线性协方差控制、max-cut、Lovász ϑ SDP及鲁棒估计与控制等任务上，学习策略优于现有最先进求解器，提供最高50倍加速；作为序列凸规划（SCP）子程序时，相比COSMO获得超过30倍加速。
Conclusion: 该工作证明了深度展开可以成功应用于大规模锥优化，通过解决内存和数值稳定性两大障碍，为学习高效的求解器策略提供了通用框架。

papers.title: A Stationarity-and-Coupling Criterion for Training-Free Time-Lagged Spectral Embeddings of Multivariate Time Series
papers.abstract_en: We study training-free fixed-length descriptors for multivariate time series and ask not merely whether such a descriptor performs well, but when it can be expected to work at all. Our object of study is $D(τ)$, built from a time-lagged correlation matrix truncated at the Marchenko-Pastur edge so that only signal-bearing eigenvalues survive and classified by cosine similarity to class centroids with zero learned parameters. The central contribution is not the descriptor but a falsifiable applicability criterion for it. Working from a stationary Gaussian VAR(1) model, we argue that $D(τ)$ separates two classes when the signals are approximately stationary and the class information lives in their cross-channel temporal coupling rather than in marginal per-channel power. We derive, semi-formally, three consequences: a distinguishability condition, why the static ($τ=0$) covariance collapses to chance, and why a stationary but power-discriminated paradigm defeats the descriptor. The criterion is operational: a two-part pre-flight test -- an augmented Dickey-Fuller stationarity check and a power-baseline saturation check -- predicts applicability before any training. We validate both halves on a mixed assortment. On four paradigms that satisfy the criterion (Sleep-EDF, BCI-IV-2a, MIT-BIH, ESC-50) the descriptor is competitive with strong baselines at a fraction of their cost, reaching $88.5\pm4.5\%$ under 20-subject leave-one-subject-out on Sleep-EDF on a single CPU thread. On three that violate it -- non-stationary ERPs, and financial-volatility and wearable-stress regimes that are power-discriminated -- it fails exactly as the pre-flight predicts, and these negatives are the more informative half. We are explicit that $D(τ)$ is not the most accurate representation; its value is a compact, training-free embedding whose domain of validity is known in advance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多变量时间序列的无训练固定长度描述符 D(τ)，基于时滞相关矩阵在 Marchenko-Pastur 阈值处截断，仅保留信号特征值，并通过余弦相似度分类至类质心（零学习参数）。核心贡献是一个可证伪的适用性判据，基于平稳高斯 VAR(1) 模型，推导出区分性条件、静态协方差失效原因以及功率判别范式下的失败。预测试包括 ADF 平稳性检验和功率基线饱和检验。在满足判据的四个数据集（Sleep-EDF、BCI-IV-2a、MIT-BIH、ESC-50）上，描述符在单 CPU 线程上达到与强基线竞争的性能（如 Sleep-EDF 上 88.5±4.5%）；在违反判据的三个场景（非平稳 ERP、金融波动、可穿戴应力）中，预测试准确预测失败。
Motivation: 现有无训练时间序列描述符缺乏明确的适用条件，导致不可预测的性能。论文旨在回答何时无训练固定长度嵌入能够工作的问题。
Method: 基于平稳高斯 VAR(1) 模型提出 D(τ) 描述符，并推导出三重理论后果：区分性条件、静态协方差退化原因、功率判别范式的失败。设计两阶段预测试：ADF 平稳性检验和功率基线饱和检验。
Result: 在满足判据的数据集上，D(τ) 达到竞争性性能，例如 Sleep-EDF 上 20 折留一法正确率 88.5±4.5% 在单 CPU 线程上；在违反判据的数据集上，预测试准确预测失败。
Conclusion: D(τ) 不是最准确的表示，但其价值在于提供一种无训练、紧凑的嵌入，且其适用域可事先已知。该方法适用于平稳、交叉通道时滞耦合而非边际功率区分的场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Attention-Based Estimation of the Individual Treatment Benefit Probability under Dose Variation
papers.abstract_en: Estimating the probability that a treatment outperforms a control for an individual patient, called the Individual Probability of Treatment Benefit (IPTB), offers a clinically intuitive alternative to population-average metrics. However, existing methods for IPTB estimation are largely confined to binary treatment settings, despite the prevalence of dose-varying interventions in clinical practice. We propose a general framework for IPTB estimation with ordinal outcomes under discrete dose assignments, called Dose-AIPTB (Dose Attention-based IPTB). Our approach recasts the problem as binary classification over the unobserved sign of the individual treatment effect, constructing pseudo-labels from covariate-similar pairwise comparisons and aggregating them via attention mechanisms or Nadaraya-Watson kernel regression. This formulation naturally accommodates multiple discrete dose levels, extending beyond the binary treatment paradigm. Through numerical experiments on real-world and synthetic data under covariate shift, varying sample sizes, and heterogeneous outcomes, we demonstrate that attention-based aggregation consistently outperforms kernel alternatives. The framework provides a foundation for personalized dose selection grounded in individual-level benefit probabilities. Codes implementing the model are publicly available at https://github.com/NTAILab/AIPTBDose.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于注意力的框架Dose-AIPTB，用于在离散剂量分配下估计个体治疗效益概率（IPTB），将问题转化为二元分类，通过注意力机制或核回归聚合伪标签，并处理多个剂量水平。实验表明注意力聚合优于核方法。
Motivation: 现有IPTB估计方法局限于二元治疗，无法处理临床中常见的剂量变化干预，亟需适用于多剂量水平的个体化概率估计框架。
Method: 将问题转化为对个体治疗效应符号的二元分类，通过协变量相似成对比较构建伪标签，并利用注意力机制或Nadaraya-Watson核回归进行聚合，支持多个离散剂量水平。
Result: 在真实和合成数据上的实验表明，基于注意力的聚合方法在协变量偏移、不同样本量和异质性结果下始终优于核回归替代方法。
Conclusion: 该框架为基于个体效益概率的个性化剂量选择提供了基础，但主要针对有序结局和离散剂量设置，扩展至连续剂量或生存结局需进一步研究。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Uncertainty Estimation and Generalization Bounds for Modern Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: This thesis investigates how Bayesian principles can deepen our understanding of modern deep learning systems. While neural networks achieve remarkable predictive performance, their ability to generalize and to quantify uncertainty remains only partly understood. This thesis approaches this challenge from both methodological and theoretical angles: unifying Bayesian inference, function-space modeling, and large-deviation theory under a common probabilistic perspective. On the methodological side, the thesis introduces the Deep Variational Implicit Process (DVIP), a scalable Bayesian framework that extends implicit processes to deep architectures. Complementing this, two post-hoc methods -- the Variational Linearized Laplace Approximation (VaLLA) and the Fixed-Mean Gaussian Process (FMGP) -- are proposed to equip pretrained deterministic networks with calibrated uncertainty estimates. The theoretical contributions focus on one of the central open questions in modern machine learning: why do large, over-parameterized neural networks generalize so well? To address this, the thesis develops a unified probabilistic framework that connects three key mechanisms -- diversity, smoothness, and stochasticity -- within the language of PAC-Bayesian and large-deviation theory.
papers.comment: PhD Thesis, Autonomous University of Madrid
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是博士论文，从贝叶斯原理出发，统一变分推断、函数空间建模和大偏差理论，理解现代深度学习的泛化与不确定性估计。方法上提出深度变分隐过程（DVIP）和两种后处理校准方法，理论上用PAC-贝叶斯和大偏差框架解释过参数化网络的泛化能力。
Motivation: 深度神经网络在预测性能上表现优异，但其泛化能力和不确定性量化机制尚不清晰，尤其是大规模过参数化网络的泛化原因。
Method: 提出Deep Variational Implicit Process (DVIP)扩展隐过程至深层架构，以及两种后处理方法：Variational Linearized Laplace Approximation (VaLLA)和Fixed-Mean Gaussian Process (FMGP)用于校准确定性网络的不确定性。理论上建立统一概率框架，连接多样性、平滑性和随机性，基于PAC-贝叶斯和大偏差理论。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值，仅提及方法可校准不确定性并连接泛化机制。
Conclusion: 该论文强调贝叶斯原理能加深对深度学习系统泛化和不确定性理解，并提供理论和算法工具。

papers.title: FlowMo-WM: A World Model with Object Momentum and Hidden Ambient Drift
papers.abstract_en: World models in robot learning predict future states from visual observations and actions, enabling agents to reason about the consequences of their controls. However, many action-conditioned models are evaluated in settings where motion is dominated by immediate control, whereas aquatic surface vehicles and other real-world objects continue moving under inertia and are displaced by hidden ambient drift, such as water currents or wind. We propose FlowMo-WM, an end-to-end trainable visual world model that infers object-centric motion state and a predictive long-history context associated with hidden drift from image-action histories without direct supervision of flow fields. FlowMo-WM factorizes image-action history into a short-history latent state, trained to summarize object-centric motion, and a longer-history context, trained to summarize slowly varying exogenous influences. A zero-context residual transition separates action-conditioned base dynamics from context-dependent drift effects during latent rollout. In simulated aquatic surface-vehicle environments with diverse hidden flows, disturbances, and randomized vehicle dynamics, FlowMo-WM improves long-horizon rollout accuracy over representative action-conditioned latent world models. Prediction-time context ablations, in which the inferred context is zeroed or shuffled during rollout, show that the ambient context is important for stable prediction under hidden drift, while frozen linear probes characterize information encoded in the learned factors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FlowMo-WM，一种端到端可训练的视觉世界模型，用于机器人在惯性运动和隐藏环境漂移（如水流水流）下的运动预测。该模型将图像-动作历史分解为短期潜在状态（总结物体中心运动）和长期上下文（总结缓慢变化的外生影响），并通过零上下文残差转移分离基本动力学和漂移效应。在模拟水面飞行器环境中，FlowMo-WM 在长时滚动预测精度上优于现有行动条件潜在世界模型。
Motivation: 现有行动条件世界模型多假设运动由即时控制主导，但水面飞行器等实际物体在惯性下持续运动并受隐藏漂移影响，导致预测不准确。
Method: 部署端到端可训练视觉世界模型，通过因子化图像-动作历史为短期潜在状态和长期上下文，并加入零上下文残差转移模块来区分行动条件基础动力学与上下文依赖的漂移效应。
Result: 在具有多样隐藏流、干扰和随机动力学的模拟水面飞行器环境中，FlowMo-WM 提升了长时滚动预测准确性，背景上下文消融实验表明其对稳定预测的重要作用。
Conclusion: FlowMo-WM 有效处理了隐藏漂移下的运动预测，适用于水面飞行器等现实场景。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 FlowMo-WM，一种端到端可训练的视觉世界模型，用于机器人在惯性运动和隐藏环境漂移（如水流水流）下的运动预测。该模型将图像-动作历史分解为短期潜在状态（总结物体中心运动）和长期上下文（总结缓慢变化的外生影响），并通过零上下文残差转移分离基本动力学和漂移效应。在模拟水面飞行器环境中，FlowMo-WM 在长时滚动预测精度上优于现有行动条件潜在世界模型。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有行动条件世界模型多假设运动由即时控制主导，但水面飞行器等实际物体在惯性下持续运动并受隐藏漂移影响，导致预测不准确。
summary_sections.method: 部署端到端可训练视觉世界模型，通过因子化图像-动作历史为短期潜在状态和长期上下文，并加入零上下文残差转移模块来区分行动条件基础动力学与上下文依赖的漂移效应。
summary_sections.result: 在具有多样隐藏流、干扰和随机动力学的模拟水面飞行器环境中，FlowMo-WM 提升了长时滚动预测准确性，背景上下文消融实验表明其对稳定预测的重要作用。
summary_sections.conclusion: FlowMo-WM 有效处理了隐藏漂移下的运动预测，适用于水面飞行器等现实场景。

papers.title: Poker Arena: Multi-Axis Profiling of Strategic Reasoning and Memory in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Strategic reasoning under uncertainty underpins consequential decisions in negotiation, finance, and policy, but prevailing game-play benchmarks collapse heterogeneous reasoning dimensions into a single scalar, leaving the capability structure of frontier LLMs unexamined. We introduce Poker Arena, a no-limit Texas Hold'em tournament platform that couples a three-layer memory architecture (within-hand, session, and cross-session) with a nine-axis cognitive profile decomposing strategic reasoning into interpretable dimensions such as bet-sizing calibration and positional awareness. We evaluate seven frontier models across 50 sessions of 1,000 hands and a controlled memory ablation; tournament chips and aggregate axis score order the field differently: Claude Opus 4.6 wins +$15,730 chips with 14 first-place finishes, yet ranks only fifth of seven on mean axis score, while persistent memory helps some models and hurts others. These findings show that multi-axis evaluation surfaces capability structure that scalar leaderboards systematically misrank, with cross-dimensional consistency outweighing peak performance on any single axis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Poker Arena，一个无限制德州扑克锦标赛平台，用于多维度剖析LLM的战略推理与记忆能力。平台结合三层记忆架构（局内、会话、跨会话）和九轴认知剖面（如注码校准、位置意识），评估了七个前沿模型。结果表明，多轴评估揭示的能力结构与标量排行榜系统性地不同：Claude Opus 4.6赢得最多筹码，但平均轴得分仅排第五；持久记忆对不同模型影响各异。
Motivation: 现有游戏基准将异构推理维度压缩为单一标量，无法揭示前沿LLM在战略推理和记忆方面的能力结构，导致模型间细微差异被掩盖。
Method: 构建Poker Arena平台，采用三层记忆架构（within-hand, session, cross-session）和九轴认知剖面（包括bet-sizing calibration和positional awareness等）。在50轮（每轮1000手牌）中测试七个模型，并进行记忆消融实验。
Result: Claude Opus 4.6赢得+15,730筹码和14次第一名，但平均轴得分仅排第五；持久记忆对部分模型有帮助，对另一些模型则有害。
Conclusion: 多轴评估揭示了标量排行榜系统性误排的能力结构，跨维度一致性比单轴峰值性能更重要。

papers.title: Aligning Quantum Operators with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Can Large Language Models (LLMs) understand and reason about quantum operators? Despite their remarkable capabilities in mathematics and symbolic reasoning, LLMs remain inherently blind to quantum representations such as unitary matrices. In this work, we take a step toward bridging this gap by introducing an approach that maps unitary operators into the latent space of an LLM, enabling unified modeling over quantum and linguistic inputs. We instantiate this idea on Clifford+T circuit synthesis over a Pauli rotation gate set, where our model achieves results competitive with state-of-the-art methods and scales consistently with training data, with no signs of saturation. Our approach further enables language-conditioned synthesis, allowing gate constraints unseen during training to be specified directly in natural language. This work suggests a path toward quantum--aware foundation models that can natively interpret and reason about quantum operations, which could have broader implications reaching across quantum compilation and algorithm discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）无法直接理解量子算子（如酉矩阵）的问题，提出将酉算子映射到LLM的潜在空间，实现量子与语言输入的统一建模。在Clifford+T电路合成任务上，该方法达到了与最先进方法竞争的结果，并支持自然语言条件合成，可指定训练中未见过的门约束。这项工作为构建量子感知的基础模型铺平了道路。
Motivation: 大语言模型在数学和符号推理方面表现出色，但对量子表示（如酉矩阵）存在固有的盲区，无法理解和推理量子算子，这限制了它们在量子计算领域的应用。
Method: 提出一种将酉算子映射到LLM潜在空间的方法，使模型能够对量子输入和语言输入进行统一建模。在基于Pauli旋转门集的Clifford+T电路合成任务上实例化该方法。
Result: 在Clifford+T电路合成上，该方法达到了与最先进方法竞争的结果，并且随着训练数据量的增加，性能一致提升，没有出现饱和迹象。此外，方法支持语言条件合成，允许用户用自然语言指定门约束，即使这些约束在训练中未曾出现。
Conclusion: 这项工作表明，通过将量子算子对齐到LLM的潜在空间，可以构建能够原生理解和推理量子操作的量子感知基础模型，这对量子编译和算法发现具有更广泛的意义。

papers.title: Compressing Image Style Training into a Single Model Forward
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based style transfer must balance inference efficiency with stylization fidelity. Adapter-based methods are efficient, but they inject style as an external condition and can either weaken reference-specific appearance or copy reference semantics into the generated image. Optimization-based personalization methods such as LoRA internalize style more effectively, but require a separate training process for every new style. We introduce i2L (image-to-LoRA), a framework that amortizes style LoRA training into a single forward pass. Given one or more reference images, i2L predicts LoRA weights for a text-to-image model, enabling immediate style instantiation without per-style optimization. The architecture combines an image encoder, learnable LoRA queries, and compressed decoding heads that generate adapted matrices. Training on semantically diverse style pairs encourages the predictor to preserve appearance cues while suppressing reference-content copying. Experiments on Z-Image, FLUX.2, and Hidream-O1 show that i2L improves style fidelity, prompt alignment, and perceptual quality over existing baselines. Because i2L produces explicit LoRA weights, it also supports asymmetric classifier-free guidance, multi-reference style fusion, and composition with controllable-generation modules.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出i2L（image-to-LoRA）框架，将风格LoRA训练摊销到单次前向传播中，通过预测LoRA权重实现即时风格迁移，无需针对每个风格单独优化。方法结合图像编码器、可学习LoRA查询和压缩解码头生成适配矩阵。在Z-Image、FLUX.2和Hidream-O1上，i2L在风格保真度、提示对齐和感知质量上优于现有基线，并支持非对称无分类器引导、多参考风格融合等。
Motivation: 现有的基于适配器的方法注入风格作为外部条件，可能削弱参考特定外观或复制参考语义；基于优化的个性化方法（如LoRA）虽然更有效地内化风格，但需要为每个新风格进行单独训练。目标是实现高效且高保真的风格迁移，避免上述缺陷。
Method: i2L框架将风格LoRA训练摊销到单次前向传播中。架构包括图像编码器、可学习LoRA查询和压缩解码头，用于生成适应矩阵。通过语义多样的风格对训练，鼓励保留外观 cues 同时抑制参考内容复制。
Result: 在Z-Image、FLUX.2和Hidream-O1数据集上，i2L在风格保真度、提示对齐和感知质量上优于现有基线。此外，i2L支持非对称无分类器引导、多参考风格融合以及与可控生成模块的组合。
Conclusion: i2L通过单次前向预测LoRA权重实现即时风格迁移，避免了每风格优化，同时在多个指标上表现优异，并具有灵活的组合能力。

papers.title: Neural Slack Variables for Shape Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Enforcing functional inequality constraints such as monotonicity and convexity in neural networks is a fundamental challenge in many industrial and scientific applications. Classical one-sided penalty methods, along with primal-dual methods gated by complementary slackness, provide constraint gradients only at violated locations, resulting in fragile satisfaction. Architectures that guarantee feasibility by construction, on the other hand, remain largely limited to elementary cases and impose additional inductive biases. We introduce neural slack variables, a deep learning native primal-side approach that converts constraint enforcement into a regression problem by coupling the primary network with a jointly learned auxiliary network. The auxiliary network serves as a valid target for the primary network's constraint quantities, inducing feasibility and regularity. Neural slack variables achieve zero measured violations on dense-grid monotonicity and convexity test cases, where penalty and primal-dual baselines leave residual violations, and enable arbitrage-free learning of volatility surfaces, an open industrial challenge in quantitative finance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出神经松弛变量（neural slack variables）方法，将神经网络的单调性、凸性等形状约束强制执行转化为回归问题，通过主网络与辅助网络联合学习实现零违规。在密集网格测试中，该方法优于惩罚法和原始对偶基线，并成功应用于定量金融中波动率曲面的无套利学习。
Motivation: 现有的惩罚法和原始对偶法仅在约束违规处提供梯度，导致约束满足脆弱；而保证可行性的架构又局限于简单情况。需要一种既有效又灵活的约束强制执行方法。
Method: 提出神经松弛变量：主网络与辅助网络联合学习，辅助网络作为主网络约束量的有效目标，诱导可行性和正则性。
Result: 在密集网格单调性和凸性测试中实现零测量违规，而惩罚法和原始对偶基线存在残留违规；成功学习无套利波动率曲面，解决了定量金融中的工业挑战。
Conclusion: 神经松弛变量在形状约束强制执行上提供更鲁棒和精确的方案，在金融应用中具有实际价值。

papers.title: A Benchmark and Framework for Evaluating Next Action Predictions in Spreadsheets
papers.abstract_en: Predictive code completion greatly accelerates how quickly developers work. In spreadsheets, despite being much more common, such auto-completion features are virtually non-existent. To address this gap, we introduce a benchmark for systems that observe a sequence of user actions in a spreadsheet and predict future actions. Two challenges are (1) the absence of edit histories in public spreadsheet corpora and (2) the complex space of spreadsheet actions (spatial, temporal, composite). To address (1), we manually curate 52 sequences of 12K actions that recreate spreadsheets from public corpora, seeded by parametrized heuristics and LLM refinement. To address (2), we propose an online evaluation that expects a prediction after each user action, accepts or rejects that prediction, updates the future actions upon acceptance, and repeats this until the target spreadsheet is obtained. We use multiple baseline predictors (including zero-shot LLMs, fine-tuned SLMs, and classical models) and analyze different properties that our benchmark teaches us, including but not limited to: properties of saved actions and false positives, efficiency, effect of user profiles, effect of triggers, and effect of context.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. Code and benchmark: https://github.com/Tej-55/NAPE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了电子表格中下一步操作预测（next action prediction）的基准和评估框架。由于公共电子表格语料库缺少编辑历史，作者手动整理了52个动作序列（共12K个动作），并提出了在线评估方法。基线包括零样本LLM、微调SLM和经典模型，并分析了多种属性（如保存动作、误报、效率、用户画像等）。
Motivation: 电子表格缺乏类似代码补全的自动补全功能，主要挑战在于缺乏编辑历史数据和电子表格动作的复杂空间（时空组合）。
Method: 手动构建包含52个序列、12K个动作的基准；提出在线评估框架：在每次用户动作后预测，接受或拒绝，更新未来动作，直到目标电子表格。
Result: 使用了多种基线模型（零样本LLM、微调SLM、经典模型），分析了保存动作、误报、效率、用户画像、触发条件、上下文等属性。
Conclusion: 本文建立的基准和评估框架有助于推动电子表格中预测性自动补全的研究。

papers.title: Neural Variability Enhances Artificial Network Robustness
papers.abstract_en: Neural responses in cortex exhibit substantial trial-to-trial variability in response to repeated stimuli, while peripheral sensory neurons respond far more consistently, leading many to wonder whether stochasticity may carry meaning. Existing work has argued that noise and signal correlations may be optimized for discrimination in animals, whereas artificial neural network (ANN) studies have shown similar benefits of noise in machine learning tasks, although most ANN work has neglected the effects of correlations. Here we investigate whether correlated noise improves the robustness of artificial neural networks to adversarial attacks and naturalistic image modifications. Using the covariance of activations under modified versus clean inputs, we find that structured noise may significantly improve network robustness. Robustness to naturalistic image modifications benefits most from structure, but this structure transfers poorly across modification types. In contrast, noise structure from adversarial attacks can generalize to other kinds of attacks. These results suggest that structured noise in ANN activations generally improves robustness, establishing a biologically plausible strategy for creating robust artificial neural networks that only relies on local information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究皮层神经响应中的变异性（trial-to-trial variability）如何增强人工神经网络（ANN）的鲁棒性。通过分析对抗攻击和自然图像修改下激活的协方差，发现结构化噪声能显著提升网络鲁棒性，且抗对抗攻击的噪声结构可泛化至其他攻击类型。
Motivation: 神经系统中的噪声通常被视为干扰，但现有研究表明噪声可能对动物判别和机器学习有益。然而，多数ANN研究忽略了噪声相关性的影响，本文旨在探索相关性噪声是否能提升ANN对对抗攻击和自然图像修改的鲁棒性。
Method: 利用修改与干净输入下激活的协方差来度量结构化噪声，并在ANN中引入该噪声结构，测试其对对抗攻击和自然图像修改的鲁棒性。
Result: 结构化噪声显著提升了网络鲁棒性，其中自然图像修改的鲁棒性受益最大，但噪声结构在不同修改类型间迁移性差；而对抗攻击的噪声结构可泛化至其他攻击类型。
Conclusion: 结构化噪声能一般性地提升ANN鲁棒性，提供了一种仅依赖局部信息的生物合理策略来构建鲁棒神经网络。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Program Is Still There: A Conservation Law for Program Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Finding the shortest program that generates a sequence is uncomputable, and for six decades that fact has been mistaken for a wall around finding any generating program. It is not a wall but a price, and this paper measures it. For every algorithm that learns about a candidate program only through its score, a class spanning Levin search, evolutionary methods, simulated annealing, and the cross-entropy method, we define the coupling width of a search problem and prove an unconditional worst-case lower bound, exponential in that width with base one less than the domain size. From it follows a conservation law: structural knowledge injected into a search trades one for one against the search it removes, and their sum can never fall below the length of the program sought. Levin's 1973 upper bound and the lower bound proved here are the two ends of one conserved quantity, closing on each other as the instruction set grows. The only escape is to read a candidate's structure rather than its score, and its price, which we prove for generic targets, is incompleteness. A deterministic engine built on this theory recovers a generating program, certified by compressing its data and predicting an unseen continuation, for 2,383 of 3,914 sequences across four independent populations, including 244 of the 256 elementary cellular automata, with measured discovery cost rising along program length more than an order of magnitude inside the score-oracle worst case.
papers.comment: 9 pages main text and 33 pages supporting information. Engine source and full sweep data: https://github.com/jorgeMFS/omnis, archived at doi:10.5281/zenodo.20634984
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明程序发现（program discovery）存在一个守恒律：注入搜索的结构知识与由此减少的搜索量一一对应，两者之和不能低于被搜索程序的长度。通过定义耦合宽度（coupling width），作者给出一个无条件最坏情况下的指数下界，该下界与Levin 1973年的上界构成守恒量的两端。基于该理论构建的确定性引擎在3914个序列中恢复了2383个生成程序（含256个初等元胞自动机中的244个），其发现代价在分数预言机（score-oracle）最坏情况下比程序长度增长快一个数量级以上。
Motivation: 六十年来，寻找生成序列的最短程序的不可计算性被误认为是无法找到任何生成程序的障碍。本文旨在揭示这并非不可逾越的墙，而是可量化的代价，并证明其与注入的先验知识之间存在守恒关系。
Method: 定义耦合宽度，对任何仅通过分数（score）学习候选程序的算法（涵盖Levin搜索、进化方法、模拟退火、交叉熵方法），证明一个无条件最坏情况指数下界，基数为域大小减1。据此推导守恒律：结构知识与搜索量之和守恒。并构造确定性引擎来恢复生成程序。
Result: 在3914个跨四个独立种群的序列中，该引擎恢复了2383个生成程序（包括256个初等元胞自动机中的244个），且实测发现代价沿程序长度增长，比分数预言机最坏情况下的指数界快一个数量级以上。
Conclusion: 唯一跳出守恒律的方法是读取候选程序的结构而非分数，但对于一般性目标，这会导致不完备性（incompleteness）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Recursively Trained Diffusion Models: Limiting Collapse Distribution and Spectral Characterization
papers.abstract_en: Recursive training of generative models on their own outputs can lead to model collapse, a compounding drift away from the true data distribution. Existing theoretical works bound finite-round error accumulation in the context of diffusion models, but two questions remain open:~what distribution does the recursion converge to, and how fast? We answer both, isolating a mechanism distinct from imperfect learning: even with perfect score estimation and exact sampling, the early stopping of the reverse diffusion (required for numerical stability) drives a progressive drift away from the data distribution. We prove that this recursion converges geometrically to a unique limiting distribution, which admits a closed-form characterization as an infinite mixture of increasingly Gaussian-smoothed versions of the data distribution. A Hermite spectral decomposition of this limit reveals that recursive training acts as a low-pass filter: higher-order modes, which encode fine non-Gaussian structure, are attenuated much more strongly than coarse modes. This spectral picture motivates annealed truncation schedules that progressively shrink truncation times across retraining rounds; we prove that any schedule converging to $0$ asymptotically eliminates recursive compounding. Finally, we show our idealized characterization is robust: in the presence of discretization and score estimation errors, the learned distribution remains in a Wasserstein-2 ball around the ideal limit, with mode-dependent contraction rates that contract high-order errors faster than low-order ones. We validate the theory on synthetic Gaussian mixtures and CIFAR-10.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了扩散模型递归训练导致的模型塌缩问题，证明了即使完美学习也会因逆扩散提前停止而产生渐进漂移，且递归收敛到唯一的极限分布，该分布可表征为数据分布与逐次高斯平滑的无穷混合。通过Hermite谱分解揭示递归训练相当于低通滤波器，高阶非高斯模式被强烈衰减。提出退火截断调度可渐近消除递归累积。理论在合成高斯混合和CIFAR-10上验证。
Motivation: 现有理论界定了有限轮次误差累积，但未回答递归收敛到的极限分布及其收敛速度，本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 对扩散模型的递归训练进行理论分析，假设完美得分估计和精确采样，仅考虑逆扩散早期停止的影响；利用Hermite谱分解表征极限分布，并设计退火截断调度。
Result: 递归收敛几何级数到唯一极限分布，该分布为数据分布与高斯平滑的无穷混合；谱分解表明高阶模式衰减更快；退火截断调度可消除递归累积；在存在离散化和得分误差时，学习分布保持在Wasserstein-2球内。
Conclusion: 递归训练中的塌缩主要是由逆扩散提前停止而非学习不完美驱动，退火截断是缓解塌缩的有效策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Diffusion Policy Optimization without Drifting Apart
papers.abstract_en: RL post-training has become increasingly pivotal for improving diffusion policies, but existing diffusion policy-gradient methods are often unstable and cannot achieve reliable policy improvement. We identify the cause as the double-drift phenomenon: optimizing a variational surrogate can let the ELBO separate from the true log-likelihood, which then makes the resulting proxy policy gradient misaligned with the true policy gradient of expected return. We propose \textbf{DiPOD}, a diffusion policy optimization framework that maintains tight-bound behavior throughout training by interleaving self-distillation with policy-improving gradient updates. This leads to a simple and practical algorithm: augmenting each diffusion policy-gradient update with an on-policy ELBO regularizer. Across diffusion language model post-training and continuous-control diffusion policies, DiPOD substantially stabilizes training and reaches higher rewards than previous methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出扩散策略梯度方法存在“双重漂移”现象，即变分代理优化导致ELBO与真实对数似然分离，使得代理策略梯度与真实策略梯度不一致。作者提出DiPOD框架，通过在策略改进梯度更新中穿插自蒸馏来保持紧边界行为，从而稳定训练并提高奖励。
Motivation: 现有的扩散策略后训练方法不稳定，无法实现可靠的策略改进，原因是双重漂移现象。
Method: 提出DiPOD，在每次扩散策略梯度更新中增加一个在线ELBO正则化器，通过自蒸馏保持紧边界。
Result: 在扩散语言模型后训练和连续控制扩散策略上，DiPOD显著稳定训练并获得比以往方法更高的奖励。
Conclusion: DiPOD通过简单的在线ELBO正则化解决了扩散策略梯度中的不稳定性问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An integrated interpretable control effectiveness learning and nonlinear control allocation methodology for overactuated aircrafts
papers.abstract_en: Nonlinear dynamics and the strong couplings that arise between multiple effectors undermine the assumptions behind conventional, linear control allocation techniques. When flight enters regimes where nonlinear effects dominate, linear allocators exhibit reduced accuracy due to increased model mismatch, which subsequently degrades performance and robustness of the flight control system. High fidelity onboard models and black box data driven approaches can recover accuracy across the flight envelope, but respectively impose computational burdens prohibitive for real time allocation and sacrifice the interpretability required for verification and fault diagnosis. This paper addresses these limitations by learning an explicit, physics constrained analytical model of the control effectiveness mapping from representative flight data using Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics. The resulting mapping is compact, interpretable, and admits analytical derivatives, enabling efficient computation within nonlinear solvers that additionally incorporate actuator dynamics, without requiring an onboard model. An online adaptation mechanism monitors prediction residuals and refreshes the model when significant plant changes are detected, providing graceful reconfiguration under actuator failures and varying operating conditions. The methodology is evaluated on a high fidelity nonlinear benchmark aircraft across a range of aggressive maneuvers, achieving accuracy comparable to a full nonlinear onboard model while substantially reducing computational cost relative to established baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对过驱动飞行器在非线性动态和强耦合条件下的控制分配问题，提出一种基于稀疏非线性动力学辨识（SINDy）的可解释控制效能学习与非线性控制分配方法。该方法从飞行数据中学习一个物理约束的显式解析模型，该模型紧凑、可解释且具有解析导数，能够结合执行器动态高效求解非线性分配问题，并通过在线自适应机制应对执行器故障和工况变化。在非线性基准飞行器上的评估表明，该方法在保持与全非线性机载模型相当精度的同时，大幅降低计算成本。
Motivation: 传统线性控制分配技术在非线性占主导的飞行区域内因模型失配导致精度下降，而高保真机载模型或黑箱数据驱动方法分别存在实时计算负担重或缺乏可解释性的问题。
Method: 利用稀疏非线性动力学辨识（SINDy）从典型飞行数据中学习一个物理约束的显式控制效能映射模型，该模型支持解析导数，可高效集成到非线性求解器中并包含执行器动态；同时引入在线自适应机制，通过监测残差在检测到显著变化时更新模型。
Result: 在非线性基准飞行器上的剧烈机动测试中，该方法达到与全非线性机载模型相当的分配精度，同时相比已有基线方法显著降低计算成本。
Conclusion: 提出的方法在保持可解释性和低计算成本的前提下，实现了与高保真模型相当的控制分配精度，并通过在线自适应提供了对执行器故障和工况变化的优雅重构能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MA-ProofBench: A Two-Tiered Evaluation of LLMs for Theorem Proving in Mathematical Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have made notable progress in automated theorem proving, yet existing formal benchmarks remain limited in both mathematical coverage and difficulty. Most are concentrated in areas that are easier to formalize, such as algebra and elementary number theory, and provide limited coverage of subfields that require deeper reasoning, including mathematical analysis. To address this gap, we introduce MA-ProofBench, to the best of our knowledge, the first formal theorem-proving benchmark dedicated to Mathematical Analysis. The benchmark contains 200 formalized theorems covering 6 core topics and 27 subcategories, including measure and integration theory, complex analysis, and functional analysis. The problems are divided into two difficulty levels, an undergraduate level (Level I, 100 problems) and a Ph.D. qualifying level (Level II, 100 problems), to evaluate how well LLMs perform formal reasoning at different mathematical depths. Each problem is constructed through a human-led, LLM-assisted formalization pipeline followed by independent expert review, ensuring that the formal statements remain faithful to the original mathematics. We evaluate a range of recent general-purpose reasoning models and formal theorem provers on MA-ProofBench. However, most models perform poorly: even the best-performing model, GPT-5.5, achieves only 16% Pass@8 on Level I and 5% on Level II, while most models stay close to 0% on Level II. Further analysis identifies Mathlib hallucinations and incomplete proofs as the two dominant failure modes, while an evaluation on the natural-language version of the benchmark exposes a clear gap between informal and formal reasoning. MA-ProofBench is intended to serve as a reliable reference for tracking progress in formal mathematical reasoning in advanced domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MA-ProofBench，据作者所知是首个专门针对数学分析的形式化定理证明基准。基准包含200个形式化定理，覆盖6个核心主题和27个子类别，分为本科水平（Level I）和博士资格考水平（Level II）各100题。评估发现最佳模型GPT-5.5仅在Level I上达到16% Pass@8，Level II上仅5%，多数模型在Level II上接近0%。分析指出Mathlib幻觉和不完全证明是主要失败模式。
Motivation: 现有形式化定理证明基准主要覆盖代数和初等数论等较易形式化的领域，缺乏对数学分析等需要深层推理子领域的充分覆盖。
Method: 构建一个包含200个形式化定理的两级难度基准，通过人类主导、LLM辅助的形式化流水线生成，并由独立专家审查确保忠实于原始数学。
Result: 评估多种通用推理模型和形式化定理证明器，最佳模型GPT-5.5在Level I上Pass@8为16%，Level II上为5%，大多数模型在Level II上接近0%。
Conclusion: MA-ProofBench旨在作为追踪高级形式化数学推理进展的可靠参考，揭示了当前模型在深层形式化推理上的显著不足。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Conformal calibration and look-elsewhere effect in anomaly detection for new-physics searches
papers.abstract_en: Machine-learned anomaly detection is reshaping searches for new physics, but it has outrun the statistics used to interpret it. A raw anomaly score has no calibrated meaning, a model that scans many regions inflates the look-elsewhere effect, and the asymptotic significances the field relies on are blind to the background mismodelling that anomaly detectors are especially prone to. We propose a calibration layer, built on conformal prediction, that turns any anomaly score into a defensible significance with distribution-free, finite-sample guarantees. Conformal prediction converts scores into valid local p-values, weighted and Mondrian variants repair the sideband-to-signal-region exchangeability failures that resonant searches suffer, and a Gross-Vitells step carries the result through to a look-elsewhere-aware global significance. The layer does two things at once. It exposes miscalibration that the standard pipeline cannot see, and it corrects it without retraining the detector. On public LHC Olympics data, a classifier develops a substructure-mass correlation that makes sideband-calibrated background p-values anti-conservative. Taken at face value, this manufactures a $\sim 46σ$ excess from background sculpting alone, which the label-free weighted correction removes, restoring an honest null. When run as a blind wide-mass bump hunt, the standard asymptotic and unweighted procedures fabricate $\gtrsim10σ$ excesses and $\approx5σ$ excesses even in signal-free windows, while the conformal layer raises no false alarms and its global false-positive rate is verified on background-only pseudoexperiments. The result is an auditable, detector-agnostic path from an uncalibrated score to a trials-factor-aware significance, ready to be folded into experimental anomaly searches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于保形预测（conformal prediction）的校准层，将异常检测中的原始异常分数转化为具有分布无关、有限样本保证的显著性值。该方法同时修正了共振搜索中边带到信号区交换性失败的问题，并通过Gross-Vitells步骤给出考虑试因子（look-elsewhere effect）的全局显著性。在LHC Olympics数据上，未校正方法会从本底刻画中制造出~46σ的假超额，而保形校准消除了这一假象。
Motivation: 机器学习异常检测在新物理搜索中广泛应用，但原始异常分数缺乏校准意义，扫描多个区域会放大look-elsewhere效应，且常用的渐近显著性对本底误建模不敏感，而异常检测器尤其容易受此影响。
Method: 构建基于保形预测的校准层：将异常分数转化为有效的局部p值，采用加权和Mondrian变体修复共振搜索中的交换性失效，并利用Gross-Vitells步骤转换为考虑试因子的全局显著性。该层可即插即用，无需重新训练检测器。
Result: 在公开的LHC Olympics数据上，标准渐近方法和未加权程序在本底窗口内制造了≥10σ和约5σ的假超额，而保形层不产生任何误报，其全局假阳性率在纯本底伪实验中得到验证。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一条从未校准分数到考虑试因子显著性的可审计、检测器无关的路径，可集成到实验异常搜索中。

papers.title: $μ_0$: A Scalable 3D Interaction-Trace World Model
papers.abstract_en: World models that capture how actions induce physical change enable scalable robot learning without reliance on embodiment-specific action labels. Pixel-space video models provide broad visual priors but expend model capacity on dense appearance reconstruction, while direct action models require embodiment-specific labels that hinder scalability. We present $μ_0$, a scalable world model based on 3D traces. Rather than predicting dense pixels or directly modeling actions, $μ_0$ forecasts smooth 3D trajectories for salient interaction points such as objects, tools, hands, and contact regions, yielding a compact, embodiment-agnostic motion interface. To enable training from diverse video sources, our TraceExtract system automatically extracts 3D supervision by selecting keypoints, constructing globally aligned traces, and associating motion segments with hierarchical language captions. This TraceExtract supervision pretrains $μ_0$ by combining a pretrained vision-language backbone with a modular trace expert, which represents each query via B-spline control points and predicts future traces. Experiments show that $μ_0$ outperforms baselines in both 2D and 3D trace prediction, including trace prediction models and tokenized VLM methods. Because $μ_0$ is frozen and reusable, it can be paired with action experts for downstream robot embodiments. Despite action-free pretraining, the resulting trace-conditioned policies achieve performance competitive with VLA models pretrained with action supervision, such as $π_0$. These results establish 3D traces as a scalable and transferable representation for cross-embodiment manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 μ0，一种基于3D交互轨迹的可扩展世界模型，用于机器人学习。与预测像素或直接建模动作不同，μ0 预测关键交互点（如物体、工具、手、接触区域）的平滑3D轨迹，形成紧凑且与具体形态无关的运动接口。为了从多样化视频源训练，系统 TraceExtract 自动提取3D监督信息，包括选择关键点、构建全局对齐轨迹、以及用分层语言描述关联运动片段。实验表明，μ0 在2D和3D轨迹预测上优于基线模型，并且即使没有动作监督预训练，其轨迹条件策略也能达到与动作监督预训练的 VLA 模型（如 π0）相当的性能，证明3D轨迹是一种可扩展且可迁移的跨形态操作表示。
Motivation: 现有世界模型要么预测密集像素（耗费模型容量在重建外观上），要么需要具体形态的动作标签（阻碍可扩展性）。本文旨在寻找一种可扩展、与具体形态无关的中间表示。
Method: 提出 μ0 世界模型，预测3D交互轨迹而非像素或动作。使用 TraceExtract 系统从视频中自动提取3D监督：选择关键点、构建全局对齐轨迹、关联运动片段与语言描述。模型结合预训练的视觉-语言骨干和模块化轨迹专家（用B样条控制点表示查询并预测未来轨迹）。
Result: μ0 在2D和3D轨迹预测上优于基线，包括轨迹预测模型和 tokenized VLM 方法。冻结的 μ0 可搭配下游动作专家，其轨迹条件策略在无需动作预训练的情况下，性能与动作监督预训练的 VLA 模型（如 π0）相当。
Conclusion: 本文结果表明3D轨迹是一种可扩展且可迁移的表示，能够实现跨形态操作，且无需具体形态的动作标签。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CineOrchestra: Unified Entity-Centric Conditioning for Cinematic Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Cinematic video depicts multiple subjects acting or interacting at specific moments, captured with deliberate camera movement, and stitched together by shot transitions. Together, these elements demand a level of fine-grained control beyond current text-to-video models. Existing work addresses each axis in isolation: multi-subject personalization, temporal control, multi-shot synthesis, or camera control; no prior framework jointly integrates all four. We present CineOrchestra, a unified video diffusion model that controls subjects, events, cameras, and shot transitions simultaneously. Our key insight is that these heterogeneous cinematic elements share a fundamental structure: each is an entity acting over a specific temporal interval, which can therefore all be expressed through one shared structure of entity-centric conditioning primitives, augmented with reference images for visual entities. This formulation reduces the architectural challenge to a single positional encoding problem, which we solve with two parameter-free coordinated rotary embeddings: (a) an interval-sampled temporal RoPE that yields consistent attention behavior across events of dramatically varying duration, and (b) a 2D entity-temporal cross-attention RoPE that disambiguates per-entity conditions and routes each to its corresponding spatiotemporal region. On two new benchmarks, CineOrchestra outperforms six per-axis specialists on dense caption following and shot-transition timing, with consistent gains in a pairwise user study and component ablations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CineOrchestra是一个统一的视频扩散模型，能够同时控制主体、事件、摄像机和镜头切换。其核心思想是将异质的电影元素统一表示为实体中心的条件基元，并参考图像来实现视觉实体。通过两种参数无关的协调旋转嵌入（区间采样时间RoPE和二维实体-时间交叉注意力RoPE）解决位置编码问题。在两个新基准上，CineOrchestra在密集字幕遵循和镜头切换时序方面优于六个专门模型，并通过成对用户研究和组件消融实验验证了其一致性增益。
Motivation: 现有文本生成视频模型缺乏对多主体、动态事件、摄像机运动和镜头切换的联合细粒度控制，这些元素在电影视频中至关重要。
Method: 提出一种统一的实体中心条件框架，将主体、事件、摄像机和镜头切换都表示为在特定时间区间内活动的实体，并通过两种参数无关的协调旋转嵌入（interval-sampled temporal RoPE和2D entity-temporal cross-attention RoPE）实现精确的位置编码和注意力路由。
Result: 在两个新基准上，CineOrchestra在密集字幕遵循和镜头切换时序方面优于六个专门模型；用户研究和消融实验证实了其一致性改进。
Conclusion: 摘要强调实体中心条件框架能够统一电影视频生成中的多个控制维度，并且提出的旋转嵌入方法有效处理了可变时长事件和跨实体注意力路由。

papers.title: Beyond LoRA: Is Sparsity-Induced Adaptation Better?
papers.abstract_en: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) and its variants provide a memory- and compute-efficient alternative to full fine-tuning of pre-trained models. However, questions remain about the comparative generalizability of these approaches and how the structural restrictions on low-rank updates preserve effective adaptation performance. We present a historical framing, covering the past (full fine-tuning and original LoRA), the present (different variants of LoRA), and propose simpler, cheaper, parameter-efficient extensions by inducing sparsity within existing LoRA variants: Cheap LoRA (cLA), training a single low-rank factor with the other fixed (deterministically or, in its randomized variant, stochastically), and the chained circulant variant, ${c}^3$LA. We frame cLA as a structured instance of asymmetric LoRA, serving as a controlled column-subspace restriction of full fine-tuning. We derive information-theoretic generalization error bounds for these variants, marking one of the first endeavors in this area. Empirically, we evaluate 11 fine-tuning methods across 10 pre-trained models and 14 datasets, analyzing the fine-tuned models' performance and generalization using tools such as loss landscapes and spectral analysis. Despite the sensitivity of fine-tuned models to the pre-trained model, datasets, and other factors, our study suggests that restricting LoRA-based PEFT methods' adaptation to a sparse, structured column space remains competitive across tasks with their parameter-matched baselines while reducing up to 10% training time and peak GPU memory up to 15%, even with a naïve, non-optimized, sparse implementation. Our theoretical and empirical generalization measures provide a more consistent and principled approach to their cost-effective adaptation than commonly used analytical tools. Overview and code are available at: https://elicaden.github.io/Beyond_LoRA/.
papers.comment: Overview of the paper and code can be found here: https://elicaden.github.io/Beyond_LoRA/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文回顾了低秩适应（LoRA）及其变体，并提出通过稀疏诱导的低秩适应方法：Cheap LoRA (cLA) 及其链式循环变体 c³LA。cLA 仅训练一个低秩因子，另一个固定（确定性或随机性），将其视为非对称 LoRA 的结构化实例。论文推导了信息论泛化误差界，并在 10 个预训练模型、14 个数据集上评估了 11 种微调方法，发现基于 LoRA 的参数高效微调方法在限制为稀疏、结构化列空间时，在性能上与参数匹配的基线相当，同时训练时间减少最多 10%，峰值 GPU 内存减少最多 15%。
Motivation: LoRA 及其变体在内存和计算效率上优于全微调，但关于低秩更新结构限制如何保持有效适应性能的比较泛化性问题仍待解答。
Method: 提出 cLA，仅训练单个低秩因子（另一个固定），及其链式循环变体 c³LA；将其视为非对称 LoRA 的结构化实例，并推导信息论泛化误差界。
Result: 在 10 个预训练模型、14 个数据集上，cLA/c³LA 与参数匹配的 LoRA 基线性能相当，但训练时间减少最多 10%，峰值 GPU 内存减少最多 15%。
Conclusion: 限制 LoRA 类方法适应到稀疏、结构化列空间在实际任务中具有竞争力，且理论泛化界提供了比常用分析工具更一致的评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SEVRA-BENCH: Social Engineering of Vulnerabilities in Review Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) reviewers are increasingly used in pull-request (PR) workflows, where their approvals help decide which code is merged into a repository. This raises a question that benchmarks for static vulnerability detection or code generation do not address: can an automated reviewer reject a malicious contribution when the attacker controls both the code change and the accompanying PR text? We introduce SEVRA-BENCH (Social Engineering of Vulnerabilities in Review Agents), a benchmark that measures how often an automated reviewer approves such adversarial pull requests. Each malicious PR in SEVRA-BENCH is built from a real project commit that previously fixed a vulnerability listed in the Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) database. We automatically invert that fix to restore the original vulnerable code and submit it as a pull request wrapped in one of 15 social-engineering framings, which vary the claims made, the supporting evidence, the urgency conveyed, signals of prior approval, and appeals to authority. SEVRA-BENCH contains 1,062 malicious PRs drawn from Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE)-linked fixes across the top 10 entries of the 2025 Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) Top 25. In a realistic setting, we evaluate 8 current LLMs as code review agents on PRs that introduce vulnerabilities previously reported in public disclosures. Our results reveal a sharp gap in security capabilities between closed- and open-source models. We hope SEVRA-BENCH will serve as a valuable resource for advancing open-source models and narrowing this gap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SEVRA-BENCH 基准，用于衡量大语言模型作为代码审查代理时是否会批准含有恶意漏洞的 pull request。该基准通过逆向真实 CVE 修复生成 1062 个恶意 PR，并嵌入 15 种社会工程框架。评估了 8 个当前 LLM，发现闭源与开源模型在安全能力上存在显著差距。
Motivation: 现有基准未评估自动代码审查代理在面对攻击者控制的代码和 PR 文本时能否拒绝恶意贡献，而此类场景在现实中至关重要。
Method: 从真实项目中提取之前修复 CVE 漏洞的提交，自动逆向修复以恢复漏洞代码，并作为 PR 提交，同时施加 15 种社会工程框架（如虚假声明、证据、紧急性、权威暗示等），构成 SEVRA-BENCH 基准。
Result: 在 8 个 LLM 作为代码审查代理的评估中，闭源模型与开源模型在拒绝恶意 PR 的能力上存在显著差距。
Conclusion: SEVRA-BENCH 可作为推动开源模型安全能力、缩小与闭源模型差距的资源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Position: Align AI to Our Aspirations, Not Our Flaws
papers.abstract_en: We argue that aligning AI to aggregated human preferences is the wrong target. With current technology, one can train AIs to share the values of a Silicon Valley techno-optimist, a degrowth environmentalist, a national-conservative culture warrior, a single-party state cadre, or a devout religious traditionalist. We should not. Human values produce societies that thrive or fail on the merits of those values - from failed states and extreme inequality to declining happiness, political polarization, and government dysfunction in the world's wealthiest democracies. The pluralistic-alignment program correctly diagnoses that there is no single "humanity" to align with, but is dangerous if taken as the main directive. We argue that AI should be trained to a non-negotiable floor of objective alignment goals - competence, bounded by the constraints of factual accuracy, honesty, and lawfulness and that pluralism belongs at the surface (language, register, conventions, missing-context defaults) and across the wide band of legitimate value tradeoffs that respect the floor, but not at the level of values that violate it. We highlight the empirical reality of unfiltered pluralistic values, propose four commitments as a constructive alternative, and engage six credible objections: commercial pressure and practical feasibility, democratic legitimacy, regulatory compliance, over-reliance on institutionalist explanations, the charge that the floor itself is culturally laden, and the limits of Coherent Extrapolated Volition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文主张AI对齐不应以聚合的人类偏好为目标，而应基于客观对齐目标（如能力、事实准确性、诚实性和合法性）的不可协商底线，将多元性限制在不违反底线的表层（语言、惯例等）和合法的价值权衡范围内。作者提出了四项建设性承诺，并回应了六个可信的反对意见。
Motivation: 现有AI对齐方法汇总人类偏好，但人类价值观本身存在缺陷（如导致不平等、政治极化等），且多元对齐方案若成为主要指令可能危险。
Method: 提出基于不可协商底线的对齐框架：底层由能力、事实准确性、诚实性和合法性构成约束，多元性仅允许在表层（语言、惯例等）及尊重底线的合法价值权衡中存在。
Result: 论文没有提供实验或定量结果，主要基于理论论证和概念分析。
Conclusion: AI对齐应优先确保客观底线，而非迎合人类有缺陷的价值观；多元性应被限制在安全范围内。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: D2H-AD: A Hybrid Model Utilizing Hyperdimensional Computing for Advanced Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Anomaly detection is a fundamental component of intelligent systems with applications in healthcare, cybersecurity, smart grids, and IoT environments. Although conventional machine learning and deep learning methods have demonstrated effectiveness in identifying anomalies, they often rely on large labeled datasets, incur high computational costs, and face scalability challenges in edge and high-dimensional settings. This paper presents D2H-AD, a novel anomaly detection framework based on Hyperdimensional Computing (HDC), a brain-inspired paradigm that represents information using high-dimensional distributed vectors. Unlike existing HDC-based methods, D2H-AD integrates distance-based similarity and density-aware encoding within a unified framework, improving anomaly representation and detection performance. Ablation studies show that hyperdimensional encoding alone yields up to 5.4% higher ROC-AUC than applying the same density-distance scoring directly in the original feature space. Furthermore, D2H-AD consistently outperforms five established baselines, namely HDAD, ODHD, One-Class SVM, Isolation Forest, and Autoencoders, across all evaluated datasets. The framework is lightweight, interpretable, and computationally efficient, making it suitable for resource-constrained and real-time applications. We validate D2H-AD on five benchmark datasets and demonstrate superior F1-score and ROC-AUC performance, together with robustness to class imbalance, noise, and data complexity. In addition to improved accuracy, D2H-AD offers scalability, a small memory footprint, and low-latency operation enabled by binary computations and a compact design. These properties make it particularly attractive for TinyML and edge AI deployments. The proposed framework highlights the potential of HDC for accurate, interpretable, and energy-efficient anomaly detection in dynamic environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 D2H-AD，一种基于超维度计算 (HDC) 的异常检测框架，融合距离相似性与密度感知编码。在五个基准数据集上，D2H-AD 优于 HDAD、ODHD、One-Class SVM、Isolation Forest 和 Autoencoders 等基线，F1 和 ROC-AUC 均有提升，且对类不平衡和噪声具有鲁棒性。超维度编码本身比原始特征空间直接评分提升 5.4% ROC-AUC。该框架轻量、可解释，适合资源受限和实时应用。
Motivation: 现有机器学习与深度学习方法在异常检测中依赖大量标注数据、计算成本高且在边缘和高维场景下可扩展性差。
Method: 提出基于超维度计算 (HDC) 的 D2H-AD 框架，将距离相似性与密度感知编码统一到高维分布式向量中，利用二进制计算实现轻量设计。
Result: 在五个基准数据集上，D2H-AD 在所有评估指标上优于五种基线方法；超维度编码相比直接使用原始特征空间密度-距离评分可提升 5.4% ROC-AUC。
Conclusion: D2H-AD 在保持高准确率的同时具备低延迟、小内存占用和可解释性，特别适用于 TinyML 和边缘 AI 部署。

papers.title: The Weight Norm Sets the Grokking Timescale: A Causal Delay Law
papers.abstract_en: Grokking is the delayed onset of generalization in neural networks, arising long after they fit the training data. Whether the weight norm causes this delay is disputed: some studies report a critical norm at the transition, others observe grokking with no fixed norm at all. We settle this by intervening on the norm during training rather than only observing it. Under free training with weight decay, networks grok when the weight norm reaches a value Wc that varies little across seeds and learning rates (CV 1 to 2 percent) and grows with the modular base as a power law. When we instead clamp the norm to a fixed multiple rho of Wc and hold it there, the network still groks, but the delay follows T_grok proportional to exp(alpha rho). One exponent, alpha near 7.5, fits this delay across four moduli (R^2 = 0.996). Over the swept ranges the held norm moves the delay by about 19x and the learning rate by only about 2x, and holding the norm above Wc slows grokking rather than preventing it. A final LayerNorm removes the dependence by decoupling weight scale from the network function; without it the exponential law returns. This pinned-norm delay is the exponential counterpart to the logarithmic delay predicted for a freely contracting norm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过因果干预权重范数而非仅观察，证实神经网络中grokking（延迟泛化）的时间尺度由权重范数决定。自由训练下，网络在权重范数达到临界值Wc时发生grokking，Wc随模数基底呈幂律增长。固定范数为Wc的倍数rho时，延迟时间T_grok与exp(α rho)成正比，指数α≈7.5，拟合R²=0.996。LayerNorm可消除此依赖，而学习率影响远小于范数。
Motivation: 关于权重范数是否导致grokking延迟存在争议：部分研究认为存在临界范数，另一些则观察到无固定范数下的grokking。本文通过直接操纵范数而非仅观察，建立因果关系。
Method: 在训练中干预权重范数：自由训练（带权重衰减）观察临界范数Wc；固定范数为Wc的倍数rho并保持恒定，测量延迟T_grok，拟合指数关系。
Result: 固定范数下延迟符合T_grok ∝ exp(α ρ)，α≈7.5，R²=0.996；自由训练下Wc变异系数仅1-2%。范数变化可改变延迟约19倍，学习率仅约2倍。LayerNorm消除依赖。
Conclusion: 权重范数因果地设定grokking的时间尺度，提供了指数定律与对数定律的互补视角，对理解泛化动力学有意义。

papers.title: FedSPC: Shared Parameter Correction for Personalized Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Personalized federated learning (PFL) is one of the important approaches in federated learning for addressing statistical heterogeneity while enabling client-specific adaptation. Many PFL methods split the model into shared and personalized parameters, which are jointly trained on each client. However, this creates an optimization issue: shared parameters are updated by clients optimizing different local objectives, which can lead to inconsistent shared updates and weaken the shared representation. To address this problem, we propose Federated Shared Parameter Correction (FedSPC), a modular correction method for PFL. FedSPC applies control-variate correction only to the shared parameters of a given PFL method, while leaving personalized parameters unchanged. It can be integrated into three common PFL settings: shared feature extractors, shared classifiers, and fully shared models with local regularization. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and Tiny-ImageNet with ViT, ResNet-34, and VGG-11 show that FedSPC improves performance across representative PFL methods, including FedPer, FedRep, FedBABU, LG-FedAvg, and Ditto.
papers.comment: Accepted for presentation at FL@FM-IJCAI'26, in conjunction with IJCAI 2026. 9 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对个性化联邦学习（PFL）中共享参数因不同局部目标导致更新不一致的问题，提出FedSPC，一种模块化修正方法，仅对共享参数应用控制变量校正，保持个性化参数不变。该方法可集成到共享特征提取器、共享分类器等常见PFL设置中，在CIFAR-100和Tiny-ImageNet上使用多种架构验证，提升了FedPer、FedRep等代表性PFL方法的性能。
Motivation: PFL中共享参数由不同客户端优化不同局部目标，导致共享更新不一致，削弱共享表示，需要解决该优化问题。
Method: 提出FedSPC，对给定PFL方法的共享参数应用控制变量校正（control-variate correction），不修改个性化参数，可集成到共享特征提取器、共享分类器和完全共享模型加局部正则化三种设置。
Result: 在CIFAR-100和Tiny-ImageNet上使用ViT、ResNet-34、VGG-11，FedSPC提升了FedPer、FedRep、FedBABU、LG-FedAvg和Ditto等代表性PFL方法的性能。
Conclusion: FedSPC是一种模块化、即插即用的PFL共享参数纠正方法，能有效缓解参数更新的不一致性问题，且不改变个性化部分。

papers.title: BigPower: Hierarchical Source-Level Module Power Estimation for CPUs with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Accurate power estimation is important for understanding and optimizing CPU power behavior, yet practical workflows often rely on simulation-derived information or post-silicon analysis. In this work, we present BigPower, a hierarchical source-level surrogate model for fine-grained module-level power estimation during CPU design. BigPower leverages large language model-based representations together with architectural hierarchy, module connectivity, configuration parameters, and workload context to estimate module-level power consumption directly from source-level design information, without requiring additional simulation during inference. Experimental results in the open-source XiangShan processor family demonstrate practical fine-grained power estimation across diverse configurations and workloads, offering an efficient alternative to conventional simulation-based workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BigPower，一种基于大规模语言模型（LLM）的层次化源级模块级功耗估计模型，用于CPU设计阶段。它利用LLM表示结合架构层次、模块连接、配置参数和工作负载上下文，直接从源级设计信息估计功耗，无需模拟。在开源XiangShan处理器系列上的实验展示了跨多种配置和工作负载的细粒度功耗估计。
Motivation: 准确的功耗估计对于理解和优化CPU功耗行为很重要，但现有流程依赖模拟或硅后分析，效率低。
Method: 提出BigPower，一种层次化源级代理模型，利用LLM表示，结合架构层次、模块连接性、配置参数和工作负载上下文，直接从源级设计信息估计模块级功耗，推理时无需额外模拟。
Result: 在开源XiangShan处理器系列上的实验表明，该方法能实现跨多种配置和工作负载的实用细粒度功耗估计，是传统模拟工作流的有效替代。
Conclusion: BigPower提供了一种高效替代传统模拟的功耗估计方法，在CPU设计阶段直接估计模块级功耗。

papers.title: A fully GPU-based workflow for building physics emulators of hypersonic flows
papers.abstract_en: The ability to resolve complex physical phenomena with high fidelity and at low computational cost is central to addressing key challenges in modern engineering. A prime example lies in hypersonic flows, where the precise prediction of the full flowfield topology, in particular with respect to shock wave location and intensity, is critical. Yet supersonic and hypersonic flows continue to be a stumbling block for traditional reduced-order models and neural emulators that struggle to capture steep gradients in flow states with physical consistency in applications of industrial relevance. To that end, we introduce a fully GPU based workflow that integrates accelerated data generation with the training of neural emulators augmented by uncertainty quantification and physics-aware refinement. Our workflow is enabled by a differentiable high-fidelity solver (JAX-Fluids) which we employ for rapid dataset creation and residual-based improvement of the neural emulator to enhance physical consistency. Building on this framework, we first present a suite of model architectures and analyze their scaling behavior to expose their strengths and shortcomings. We then show that residual-based refinement enables training on cases where only mesh and input parameters are available, substantially reducing residuals and improving physical consistency. Together, differentiable simulation and residual-based refinement yield physics emulators that remain reliable beyond their training distribution, a key requirement for deploying surrogates in real-world engineering design loops.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种完全基于GPU的工作流，用于构建高超声速流场的物理仿真器。该方法结合JAX-Fluids可微求解器进行快速数据生成和残差驱动的神经仿真器改进，以在工业应用中实现物理一致性和外推可靠性。
Motivation: 高超声速流中等陡峭梯度使传统降阶模型和神经仿真器难以在物理一致性和工业相关性下捕捉流场拓扑，尤其是激波位置和强度。
Method: 引入完全基于GPU的工作流，集成加速数据生成与神经仿真器训练，通过可微高保真求解器JAX-Fluids快速生成数据集，并利用残差驱动改进物理一致性。
Result: 残差驱动方法使仿真器在仅提供网格和输入参数时也能训练，显著降低残差并提升物理一致性；仿真器在训练分布外仍保持可靠性。
Conclusion: 可微模拟与残差驱动改进结合可构建可靠的物理仿真器，适合部署于实际工程设计循环。

papers.title: High-Frequency Pricing at Scale for E-Commerce
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents the design, development, and implementation of a specialized forecast-then-optimize algorithmic pricing tool for sales campaigns in fashion e-commerce. Sales events present unique challenges for pricing including volatile demand patterns, rapid pricing decisions, and the need to balance short-term revenue with long-term profitability. We describe our approach combining daily-resolution demand forecasting using gradient-boosted trees with a multi-objective optimization framework that maximizes both long-term profit and net merchandise value for more than 5 million articles. Our solution addresses key limitations of existing weekly-granularity systems by implementing a forecast-then-optimize architecture that reduces pricing decision time from hours to minutes. We validate our approach through 23 A/B tests across 12 markets during 2023-2024 sales campaigns at Zalando, one of Europe's leading online fashion retailers. Experimental results demonstrate that the new pricing system achieves approximately 6% higher profit while maintaining equivalent performance on sales and revenue compared to the previous manual-algorithmic hybrid approach. Based on these results, the algorithm was successfully deployed to production and now handles the majority of algorithmic pricing decisions for sales campaigns at the company.

papers.title: Efficient On-Device Diffusion LLM Inference with Mobile NPU
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) accelerate generation by denoising multiple tokens in parallel, making them attractive for latency-sensitive mobile inference. However, repeated denoising introduces substantial computation on smartphones. Mobile neural processing units (NPUs) offer high-throughput dense matrix computation, but efficiently exploiting them remains challenging: token commitment shrinks per-block effective workloads, token revision complicates KV cache reuse, and limited NPU-visible address space incurs costly remapping and data transfer overheads. In this paper, we propose llada.cpp, the first NPU-aware inference framework for accelerating dLLMs on smartphones. llada.cpp aligns block-wise dLLM inference with the execution characteristics of mobile NPUs through three techniques. (1) Multi-Block Speculative Decoding fills the shrinking workload in late-stage current-block decoding with speculative future-block tokens. (2) Dual-Path Progressive Revision keeps committed tokens revisable until stable and refreshes unstable tokens through a CPU-side path without stalling dense NPU execution. (3) Swap-Optimized Memory Runtime compacts NPU-visible address layouts and overlaps data staging with NPU computation to reduce remapping and transfer overheads. We implement llada.cpp as an end-to-end framework and evaluate it across diverse hardware platforms and dLLM workloads. llada.cpp reduces LLaDA-8B generation latency by 17x-42x over the CPU baseline with prefix KV cache reuse, while preserving generation quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 llada.cpp，首个面向移动NPU的扩散大模型（dLLM）推理框架。通过多块推测解码、双路径渐进修订和交换优化内存运行时三项技术，解决NPU上token承诺导致的工作负载缩小、KV缓存复用困难以及地址空间有限带来的开销问题。在LLaDA-8B模型上，相比CPU基线实现17倍至42倍延迟降低，且生成质量不变。
Motivation: 现有扩散LLM在移动设备上推理延迟高，NPU虽能加速矩阵计算，但面临token承诺导致的工作量萎缩、token修订阻碍KV缓存复用以及NPU地址空间有限带来的数据重映射和传输开销等挑战。
Method: 提出NPU感知推理框架 llada.cpp，包含三项技术：(1) 多块推测解码：用推测的未来token填充当前块解码的缩减工作量；(2) 双路径渐进修订：允许已提交token在稳定前持续修订，并通过CPU路径刷新不稳定token而不阻塞NPU计算；(3) 交换优化内存运行时：压缩NPU可见地址布局并重叠数据准备与计算。
Result: 在LLaDA-8B模型上，llada.cpp相比使用前缀KV缓存复用的CPU基线，生成延迟降低17倍至42倍，且生成质量保持不变。
Conclusion: llada.cpp首次在移动NPU上高效实现扩散LLM推理，通过协同设计计算与内存管理克服硬件限制，为边缘端实时生成任务提供了可行方案。
