papers.title: FlexMS: A Unified Public Benchmark for Molecule Tandem Mass Spectrum Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) is central to small molecule identification, but current deep learning systems for spectrum prediction still remain difficult to evaluate and deploy in practice. While novel architectures constantly claim state-of-the-art performance, inconsistent metadata conditioning and entangled preprocessing pipelines hinder fair architectural comparisons. Besides, existing evaluations are often restricted to curated datasets, failing to capture the heterogeneity and cross-domain shifts of real-world metabolomics. Furthermore, current benchmarks lack difficulty-aware diagnostics and leave blind to how models behave under specific compute or data constraints. To address this, we present FlexMS, a modular public-data benchmark framework that standardizes MS/MS prediction across public resources while keeping molecular encoders, metadata conditioning, predictor heads, and downstream retrieval under one protocol. FlexMS establishes a fair evaluation playground which significantly lowers the barrier for integrating new predictive tools. Rather than solely optimizing for average scores, FlexMS augments aggregate accuracy with difficulty-aware diagnostics, providing actionable guidance on model selection across different compute constraints, data scales, and downstream retrieval objectives. Ultimately, FlexMS provides the community with a reproducible standard to identify which algorithmic conclusions are stable and which operating points are most viable in practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FlexMS，一个统一的公共基准框架，用于标准化分子串联质谱（MS/MS）预测。该框架整合分子编码器、元数据条件化、预测头以及下游检索，建立公平评估环境，并结合困难感知诊断提供模型选择指导。旨在解决当前深度学习系统难以评估和部署的问题。
Motivation: 现有深度学习谱预测系统因不一致的元数据条件和混杂预处理管线导致架构比较不公平，且评估局限于精选数据集，无法反映真实代谢组学的异质性和跨域偏移。缺乏困难感知诊断和对计算或数据约束下模型行为的了解。
Method: 提出FlexMS模块化基准框架，标准化MS/MS预测流程，统一分子编码器、元数据条件化、预测头和下游检索协议，并引入困难感知诊断。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但声称FlexMS提供了可重复的标准，有助于识别稳定的算法结论和实际可行的操作点。
Conclusion: FlexMS为社区提供了一个可重复的标准，用于评估和比较MS/MS预测模型，降低新工具集成门槛，并提供困难感知指导。

papers.title: Generalized Discrete Diffusion with Self-Correction
papers.abstract_en: Self-correction is an effective technique for maintaining parallel sampling in discrete diffusion models with minimal performance degradation. Prior work has explored self-correction at inference time or during post-training; however, such approaches often suffer from limited generalization and may impair reasoning performance. GIDD pioneers pretraining-based self-correction via a multi-step BERT-style uniform-absorbing objective. However, GIDD relies on a continuous interpolation-based pipeline with opaque interactions between uniform transitions and absorbing masks, which complicates hyperparameter tuning and hinders practical performance. In this work, we propose a Self-Correcting Discrete Diffusion (SCDD) model to reformulate pretrained self-correction with explicit state transitions and learn directly in discrete time. Our framework also simplifies the training noise schedule, eliminates a redundant remasking step, and relies exclusively on uniform transitions to learn self-correction. Experiments at the GPT-2 scale demonstrate that our method enables more efficient parallel decoding while preserving generation quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自纠正离散扩散模型 (SCDD)，在预训练阶段引入显式状态转移的自纠正机制，简化了噪声调度并消除了冗余重掩码步骤。实验表明该方法在GPT-2规模上实现更高效的并行解码，同时保持生成质量。
Motivation: 现有基于预训练的自纠正方法（如GIDD）依赖连续插值管道，均匀转移与吸收掩码间交互不透明，导致超参数调优困难且实际性能受限。
Method: SCDD以离散时间直接学习自纠正，采用多步BERT风格的统一吸收目标，但仅使用均匀转移并简化训练噪声调度。
Result: 在GPT-2规模实验显示，SCDD实现了更高效的并行解码，同时保持与基线相当的生成质量。
Conclusion: 通过离散时间显式状态转移，预训练自纠正方法可以变得更简洁有效，避免了连续插值管道的复杂性。

papers.title: Protean Compiler: An Agile Framework to Drive Fine-grain Phase Ordering
papers.abstract_en: The phase ordering problem has been a long-standing challenge since the late 1970s, yet it remains an open problem due to having a vast optimization space and an unbounded nature, making it an open-ended problem without a finite solution, one can limit the scope by reducing the number and the length of optimizations. Traditionally, such locally optimized decisions are made by hand-coded algorithms tuned for a small number of benchmarks, often requiring significant effort to be retuned when the benchmark suite changes. In the past 20 years, Machine Learning has been employed to construct performance models to improve the selection and ordering of compiler optimizations, however, the approaches are not baked into the compiler seamlessly and never materialized to be leveraged at a fine-grained scope of code segments. This paper presents Protean Compiler: An agile framework to enable LLVM with built-in phase-ordering capabilities at a fine-grained scope. The framework also comprises a complete library of more than 140 handcrafted static feature collection methods at varying scopes, and the experimental results showcase speedup gains of up to 4.1% on average and up to 15.7% on select Cbench applications wrt LLVM's O3 by just incurring a few extra seconds of build time on Cbench. Additionally, Protean compiler allows for an easy integration with third-party ML frameworks and other Large Language Models, and two applications of this two-step optimization show a gain of 10.1\% and 8.5\% speedup w.r.t. -O3 on CBench's Susan and Jpeg applications. Protean compiler is seamlessly integrated into LLVM and can be used as a new, enhanced, full-fledged compiler. We plan to release the project to the open-source community in the near future.

papers.title: Mitigating Heterogeneity-Induced Drift in Hierarchical Sign-Based Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Hierarchical federated learning (HFL) is well suited for large-scale wireless and Internet of Things systems, where devices communicate with nearby edge servers before reaching the cloud. In these environments, uplink bandwidth and latency impose strict communication constraints, making aggressive gradient compression essential. One-bit sign-based stochastic gradient descent methods provide an attractive solution in flat federated settings, but their behavior in hierarchical edge--cloud architectures remains insufficiently understood, especially under inter-cluster data heterogeneity. To address this gap, we develop a sign-based HFL framework in which devices transmit binary stochastic-gradient signs to edge servers, edge servers apply majority voting, and the cloud periodically aggregates edge models. Our analysis reveals that inter-cluster heterogeneity induces a persistent bias term in the convergence bound, reflecting the drift of edge models toward local objectives. This term cannot be removed by increasing the number of training rounds or by tuning standard hyperparameters alone. We therefore propose \(\mathtt{DC\text{-}HierSignSGD}\), a drift-corrected sign-based HFL algorithm in which devices apply a cloud-assisted gradient correction before taking the sign. We show that this pre-sign correction mitigates the non-vanishing heterogeneity-induced bias while preserving binary device--edge communication during the repeated local sign-update steps. Experiments under severe inter-cluster heterogeneity demonstrate that \(\mathtt{DC\text{-}HierSignSGD}\) improves the stability and accuracy of sign-based HFL and achieves performance comparable to full-precision hierarchical SGD with substantially lower device--edge communication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究分层联邦学习（HFL）中基于符号（sign）的梯度压缩方法，针对边缘-云架构下集群间数据异构性导致的漂移问题。分析表明异构性引入非消失偏差，提出DC-HierSignSGD算法，通过云辅助梯度校正消除偏差，同时保留设备到边缘的二进制通信。实验显示在严重异构下提高稳定性和精度，性能接近全精度分层SGD。
Motivation: 现有基于符号的随机梯度下降在平坦联邦设置中有效，但在分层边缘-云架构下的行为尚不清晰，特别是集群间数据异构性导致的漂移问题未解决。
Method: 提出DC-HierSignSGD算法：设备在取符号前应用云辅助梯度校正（cloud-assisted gradient correction），从而缓解非消失的异构性偏差，同时保持本地符号更新步骤中的二进制设备-边缘通信。
Result: 分析揭示集群间异构性会在收敛界中引入非消失偏差，实验表明DC-HierSignSGD在严重集群间异构下改善稳定性和精度，性能接近全精度分层SGD，且大幅降低设备-边缘通信。
Conclusion: 提出的预符号校正方法有效缓解了基于符号的HFL中由异构性导致的非消失偏差，实现了二进制通信与精度的较好权衡。

papers.title: Optimizing Agentic Reasoning with Retrieval via Synthetic Semantic Information Gain Reward
papers.abstract_en: Agentic reasoning enables large reasoning models (LRMs) to dynamically acquire external knowledge, but yet optimizing the retrieval process remains challenging due to the lack of dense, principled reward signals. In this paper, we introduce InfoReasoner, a unified framework that incentivizes effective information seeking via a synthetic semantic information gain reward. Theoretically, we redefine information gain as uncertainty reduction over the model's belief states, establishing guarantees, including non-negativity, telescoping additivity, and channel monotonicity. Practically, to enable scalable optimization without manual retrieval annotations, we propose an output-aware intrinsic estimator that computes information gain directly from the model's output distributions using semantic clustering via bidirectional textual entailment. This intrinsic reward guides the policy to maximize epistemic progress, enabling efficient training via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Experiments across seven question-answering benchmarks demonstrate that InfoReasoner consistently outperforms strong retrieval-augmented baselines, achieving up to 5.4% average accuracy improvement. Our work provides a theoretically grounded and scalable path toward agentic reasoning with retrieval. The code is available at https://github.com/dl-m9/InfoReasoner
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 InfoReasoner，一个通过合成语义信息增益奖励优化智能体推理中检索过程的统一框架。理论上重新定义了信息增益为信念状态的不确定性减少，并建立了非负性、可加性和通道单调性等保证。实践中，提出输出感知内在估计器，利用双向文本蕴含的语义聚类从模型输出分布中计算信息增益，并通过 GRPO 进行训练。在七个问答基准上，该方法比强检索增强基线平均提升高达 5.4% 的准确率。
Motivation: 大推理模型在智能体推理中需要动态获取外部知识，但检索过程缺乏密集且有原则的奖励信号，难以优化。
Method: 提出 InfoReasoner 框架，核心是合成语义信息增益奖励：通过输出感知内在估计器计算模型输出分布的信息增益，利用双向文本蕴含进行语义聚类，并基于 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 训练策略。
Result: 在七个问答基准上，InfoReasoner 一致优于强检索增强基线，平均准确率提升高达 5.4%。
Conclusion: 该工作为智能体推理中的检索提供了理论上有基础且可扩展的优化路径，代码已开源。

papers.title: Learning What to Predict: Downstream-Guided Task Design for Continued Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Continued pretraining is optimized with fixed self-supervised tasks but selected by downstream performance, creating a coarse feedback loop in which practitioners evaluate checkpoints, change data mixtures or objectives, and restart runs, while individual updates remain blind to target capabilities. We ask whether a small set of verifiable downstream examples can provide step-level feedback without directly supervising the learner. We introduce V-pretraining, which decouples a learner trained only with a self-supervised loss from a lightweight task designer that constructs targets or views for unlabeled batches. Given the current learner and batch, V-pretraining scores a candidate construction by predicting the first-order reduction in downstream loss after the induced self-supervised update. The designer maximizes this value; the learner then applies the update with targets or views detached, so downstream labels never update learner parameters. We instantiate V-pretraining as adaptive top-K soft targets for language modeling and learned views or masks for self-supervised vision. Across both modalities, V-pretraining improves target capabilities without degrading generalization. Under wall-clock-matched continued pretraining, it improves GSM8K Pass@1 for Qwen models using 1,024 GSM8K examples only as feedback, including a +7.4 point single-run gain for Qwen2.5-0.5B. In vision, it improves DINOv3 transfer to ADE20K semantic segmentation and NYUv2 depth estimation while preserving ImageNet linear accuracy, suggesting that feedback-guided task construction can improve target capabilities without collapsing general-purpose representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出V-pretraining，一种通过轻量级任务设计器为自监督学习构造目标或视图的方法，该设计器利用少量下游验证样本预测自监督更新后的下游损失减少，从而优化预训练过程。实验表明，该方法在语言模型（如Qwen）和自监督视觉（如DINOv3）上提升了目标能力，且不损害泛化性能。
Motivation: 继续预训练使用固定的自监督任务，但通过下游性能选择模型，导致反馈循环粗糙且更新对目标能力不敏感。需要一种能够利用少量下游示例提供逐步骤反馈的方法。
Method: V-pretraining将学习者（仅用自监督损失训练）与轻量级任务设计器解耦。设计器为无标签批次构造目标或视图，并预测该自监督更新后下游损失的减少量，最大化该分数；学习者随后应用目标或视图，下游标签不更新学习者参数。实例化为自适应top-K软目标和学习视图/掩码。
Result: 在语言模型上，使用1024个GSM8K示例作为反馈，Qwen2.5-0.5B的GSM8K Pass@1提升7.4个百分点；在视觉上，DINOv3在ADE20K语义分割和NYUv2深度估计上迁移性能提升，同时保持ImageNet线性准确率。
Conclusion: 反馈引导的任务构建可以提升目标能力而不破坏通用表示，为在自监督预训练中有效利用少量下游数据提供了新范式。

papers.title: A Pragmatic VLA Foundation Model
papers.abstract_en: Offering great potential in robotic manipulation, a capable Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation model is expected to faithfully generalize across tasks and platforms while ensuring cost efficiency (e.g., data and GPU hours required for adaptation). To this end, we develop LingBot-VLA with around 20,000 hours of real-world data from 9 popular dual-arm robot configurations. Through a systematic assessment on 3 robotic platforms, each completing 100 tasks with 130 post-training episodes per task, our model achieves clear superiority over competitors, showcasing its strong performance and broad generalizability. We have also built an efficient codebase, which delivers a throughput of 261 samples per second with an 8-GPU training setup, representing a 1.5~2.8$\times$ (depending on the relied VLM base model) speedup over existing VLA-oriented codebases. The above features ensure that our model is well-suited for real-world deployment. To advance the field of robot learning, we provide open access to the code, base model, and benchmark data, with a focus on enabling more challenging tasks and promoting sound evaluation standards.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了LingBot-VLA，一个基于约20,000小时真实数据的视觉-语言-动作基础模型，支持9种常见双臂机器人配置。在3个机器人平台、每个平台100个任务的评估中，该模型在性能和泛化性上显著优于现有方法。其高效的代码库在8-GPU配置下实现每秒261个样本的处理速度，相比现有VLA代码库加速1.5-2.8倍。作者开源了代码、模型和基准数据，以推动机器人学习领域的发展。
Motivation: 现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）基础模型在跨任务和平台泛化时数据与计算成本高昂，难以兼顾性能与效率。本文旨在开发一个既能在多种机器人平台上泛化，又能在适应时保持数据与GPU时间效率的VLA模型。
Method: 收集约20,000小时来自9种双臂机器人配置的真实世界数据，训练LingBot-VLA模型。同时构建了高效的代码库，通过优化训练流程实现高吞吐量。评估时在3个机器人平台上各执行100个任务，每个任务包含130个后训练回合。
Result: 在3个机器人平台的100个任务评估中，LingBot-VLA在性能和泛化性上明显优于竞争对手。在8-GPU训练设置下，代码库吞吐量达261样本/秒，相对于现有VLA代码库加速1.5-2.8倍。
Conclusion: LingBot-VLA展示了在真实世界部署中的适用性，其高效性与泛化能力使其成为实用的机器人基础模型。开源资源有望促进更具挑战性的任务和更严格的评估标准。

papers.title: Jacobian Scopes: token-level causal attributions in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) make next-token predictions based on clues present in their context, such as semantic descriptions and in-context examples. Yet, elucidating which prior tokens most strongly influence a given prediction remains challenging due to the proliferation of layers and attention heads in modern architectures. We propose Jacobian Scopes, a suite of gradient-based, token-level causal attribution methods for interpreting LLM predictions. Grounded in perturbation theory and information geometry, Jacobian Scopes quantify how input tokens influence various aspects of a model's prediction, such as specific logits, the full predictive distribution, and model uncertainty (effective temperature). Through case studies spanning instruction understanding, translation, and in-context learning (ICL), we demonstrate how Jacobian Scopes reveal implicit political biases, uncover word- and phrase-level translation strategies, and shed light on recently debated mechanisms underlying in-context time-series forecasting. To facilitate exploration of Jacobian Scopes on custom text, we open-source our implementations and provide a cloud-hosted interactive demo at https://huggingface.co/spaces/Typony/JacobianScopes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Jacobian Scopes，一套基于梯度的token级因果归因方法，用于解释LLM的预测，包括特定logits、完整预测分布和模型不确定性。通过案例研究展示其揭示隐式偏见、翻译策略和上下文学习机制的能力。
Motivation: 现代LLM层数和注意力头数众多，难以确定哪些前置token最强烈影响当前预测。
Method: 基于扰动理论和信息几何，提出Jacobian Scopes，量化输入token对模型预测不同方面的影响。
Result: 在指令理解、翻译和上下文学习案例中，揭示了隐式政治偏见、词级和短语级翻译策略，以及上下文时间序列预测机制。
Conclusion: 开源实现并提供在线交互演示，便于探索。

papers.title: Can professional translators identify machine-generated text?
papers.abstract_en: This study investigates whether professional translators without prior specialized training can reliably identify short stories generated in Italian by artificial intelligence (AI). Sixty-nine translators took part in an in-person experiment, where they assessed three anonymized short stories - two written by ChatGPT-4o and one by a human author. For each story, participants rated the likelihood of AI authorship and provided justifications for their choices. While average results were inconclusive, a statistically significant subset (16.2%) successfully distinguished the synthetic texts from the human text, suggesting that their judgements were informed by analytical skill rather than chance. However, a nearly equal number misclassified the texts in the opposite direction, often relying on subjective impressions rather than objective markers, possibly reflecting a reader preference for AI-generated texts. Low burstiness and narrative contradiction emerged as the most reliable indicators of synthetic authorship, with unexpected calques, semantic loans and syntactic transfer from English also reported. In contrast, features such as grammatical accuracy and emotional tone frequently led to misclassification. These findings raise questions about the role and scope of synthetic-text editing in professional contexts.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过实验研究专业译者在没有专门训练的情况下能否识别AI生成的意大利语短篇小说。69名译者评估了三篇匿名短篇小说（两篇由ChatGPT-4o生成，一篇由人类撰写）。平均结果不确定，但统计显著子集（16.2%）成功区分，表明分析技能起作用；但接近相等数量反向错误分类，常依赖主观印象。低突发性和叙事矛盾是AI生成文本最可靠的指标，而语法准确性和情感基调常导致误判。
Motivation: 随着机器翻译文本越来越逼真，专业译者需要评估和编辑AI生成文本，但译者识别AI文本的能力尚不明确。
Method: 进行现场实验，69名专业译者评估三篇短篇小说，对每篇评定AI作者可能性并给出理由；分析统计显著性和判断依据特征。
Result: 平均结果无定论，但16.2%的译者能准确区分AI和人类文本；同时接近相等数量反向错误。低突发性和叙事矛盾是AI文本最可靠的指标，而语法准确性和情感基调常导致误判。
Conclusion: 研究发现专业译者群体在识别AI文本方面存在分歧，识别能力参差不齐，且依赖的特征可能误导。这引发了对专业语境中合成文本编辑角色和范围的疑问。

papers.title: Succeeding at Scale: Enterprise Retrieval Benchmark Construction and Index-Preserving Query Adaptation for Multi-Tenant Search
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale multi-tenant retrieval systems generate extensive query logs but lack curated relevance labels for effective domain adaptation, resulting in substantial underutilized "dark data." This challenge is compounded by the high cost of model updates, as jointly fine-tuning query and document encoders requires full corpus re-indexing, which is impractical in multi-tenant settings with thousands of isolated indices. We introduce DevRev-Search, a passage retrieval benchmark for technical customer support built via a fully automated pipeline. Candidate generation uses fusion across diverse sparse and dense retrievers, followed by an LLM-as-a-Judge for consistency filtering and relevance labeling. We further study and systematically evaluate index-preserving query-only adaptation strategies that fine-tune only the query-encoder while keeping the document indices fixed. Experiments on DevRev-Search, SciFact, and FiQA-2018 show that parameter-efficient fine-tuning of the query encoder delivers a remarkable quality-efficiency trade-off, enabling scalable and practical enterprise multi-tenant retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大规模多租户检索系统中缺乏人工标注相关标签且联合微调查询编码器和文档编码器需重建索引的问题，提出DevRev-Search基准和仅微调查询编码器的索引保留查询适配策略。摘要称该方法在DevRev-Search、SciFact和FiQA-2018上取得质量-效率权衡。
Motivation: 多租户检索系统产生大量查询日志但缺乏领域适配的标注数据，且联合微调编码器需全量重索引，在多租户场景下不可行。
Method: 通过融合多种稀疏和稠密检索器生成候选，再用LLM作为评判进行一致性过滤和相关性标注构建DevRev-Search基准；提出仅微调查询编码器、保持文档索引不变的索引保留查询适配策略。
Result: 在DevRev-Search、SciFact和FiQA-2018上，参数高效微调查询编码器可以实现质量与效率的良好权衡。
Conclusion: 所提方法使多租户企业检索更可扩展和实用，但摘要未提及其在非技术客服领域或不同规模数据集上的泛化性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Deep Learning and Elicitability for McKean-Vlasov FBSDEs With Common Noise
papers.abstract_en: We present a novel numerical method for solving McKean--Vlasov forward--backward stochastic differential equations (MV--FBSDEs) with common noise, combining Picard iterations, elicitability and deep learning. The key innovation involves elicitability to derive a pathwise loss function, enabling efficient training of neural networks to approximate both the backward process and the conditional expectations arising from common noise, without requiring computationally expensive nested Monte Carlo simulations. The mean-field interaction term is parameterized via a recurrent neural network trained to minimize an elicitable score, while the backward process is approximated through a hybrid feedforward and recurrent network representing the decoupling field. We validate the algorithm on a systemic-risk inter-bank borrowing and lending model, where analytical solutions exist, demonstrating accurate recovery of the true solution. We further extend the model to quantile-mediated interactions, showcasing the flexibility of the elicitability framework beyond conditional means or moments. Finally, we apply the method to a non-stationary Aiyagari--Bewley--Huggett economic growth model with endogenous interest rates, illustrating its applicability to complex mean-field games without closed-form solutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合Picard迭代、可elicitable性和深度学习的数值方法，用于求解带共同噪声的McKean-Vlasov正倒向随机微分方程（MV-FBSDEs）。通过可elicitable性导出路径损失函数，避免嵌套蒙特卡洛模拟，利用循环神经网络参数化平均场相互作用项和前馈-循环混合网络逼近后向过程。在系统性风险银行间借贷模型、分位数交互模型及非平稳经济增长模型上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 求解带共同噪声的MV-FBSDEs通常需要昂贵的嵌套蒙特卡洛模拟，缺乏高效且灵活的数值方法。
Method: 将Picard迭代与可elicitable性相结合，导出路径损失函数；用循环神经网络表示平均场项，用前馈-循环混合网络表示解耦场，通过最小化可elicitable分数训练。
Result: 在存在解析解的系统性风险银行间借贷模型上准确恢复真实解；展示了分位数交互建模的灵活性；成功应用于无闭式解的非平稳经济模型。
Conclusion: 该方法有效处理带共同噪声的MV-FBSDEs，并拓展到分位数等更一般的交互形式，适用于复杂平均场博弈。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: COGNITION: From Evaluation to Defense against Multimodal LLM CAPTCHA Solvers
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies how multimodal large language models (MLLMs) undermine the security guarantees of visual CAPTCHA. We identify the attack surface where an adversary can cheaply automate CAPTCHA solving using off-the-shelf models. We evaluate 7 representative MLLMs on 18 real-world CAPTCHA task types, measuring single-shot accuracy, success under limited retries, end-to-end latency, and per-solve cost. We further validate our findings through a supplemental external dataset and an adaptive-attacker setting with session memory, while also analyzing the impact of task-specific prompt engineering and few-shot demonstrations on solver effectiveness. We reveal that MLLMs can reliably solve recognition-oriented and low-interaction CAPTCHA tasks at human-like cost and latency, whereas tasks requiring fine-grained localization, multi-step spatial reasoning, or cross-frame consistency remain significantly harder for current models. By examining the reasoning traces of such MLLMs, we investigate the underlying mechanisms of why models succeed/fail on specific CAPTCHA puzzles and use these insights to derive defense-oriented guidelines for selecting and strengthening CAPTCHA tasks. To validate these principles, we present a proof-of-concept by hardening a vulnerable CAPTCHA type using our guidelines. We demonstrate that incorporating fine-grained localization and implicit counting reduces the success rate of state-of-the-art MLLMs from over 95\% to 0\%, confirming that structural changes can effectively mitigate the threat. We conclude by emphasizing the urgent need for CAPTCHA redesign as MLLM capabilities increasingly threaten existing defenses. Code Availability (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20406852).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）如何威胁视觉CAPTCHA的安全。作者在18种真实CAPTCHA任务上评估了7种代表性MLLM，发现它们能够以类似人类的成本和延迟可靠地解决面向识别和低交互的CAPTCHA，而对细粒度定位、多步空间推理或跨帧一致性的任务则仍显困难。通过分析推理轨迹，作者提出了防御导向的指南，并验证了通过引入细粒度定位和隐式计数可将最先进MLLM的成功率从超过95%降至0%。
Motivation: 视觉CAPTCHA的安全性正受到多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的威胁，攻击者可以低成本地利用现成模型自动破解CAPTCHA，亟需评估现有CAPTCHA的安全性并设计有效的防御策略。
Method: 作者在18种真实CAPTCHA任务上系统评估了7种代表性MLLM的破解能力，包括单次准确率、有限重试下的成功率、端到端延迟和每次破解成本。通过分析推理轨迹理解模型成功/失败的原因，并据此提出防御指南，最终通过一个概念验证（强化易受攻击的CAPTCHA类型）验证了指南的有效性。
Result: MLLM能够以类似人类的成本和延迟可靠地解决识别型和低交互型CAPTCHA；但细粒度定位、多步空间推理或跨帧一致性任务对当前模型仍显著困难。通过引入细粒度定位和隐式计数，可将最先进MLLM的成功率从超过95%降至0%。
Conclusion: 随着MLLM能力的提升，现有的视觉CAPTCHA面临严峻威胁，迫切需要重新设计CAPTCHA。作者提出的基于推理轨迹分析的防御指南能够有效指导CAPTCHA的强化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Interpretable Alzheimer's Diagnosis via Multimodal Fusion of Regional Brain Experts
papers.abstract_en: Accurate and early diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease (AD) is critical for effective intervention and requires integrating complementary information from multimodal neuroimaging data. However, conventional fusion approaches often rely on simple concatenation of features, which cannot adaptively balance the contributions of biomarkers such as amyloid PET and MRI across brain regions. In this work, we propose MREF-AD, a Multimodal Regional Expert Fusion model for AD diagnosis. It is a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework that models mesoscopic brain regions within each modality as independent experts and employs a gating network to learn subject-specific fusion weights. Utilizing tabular neuroimaging and demographic information from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI), MREF-AD achieves competitive performance over strong classic and deep baselines while providing interpretable, modality- and region-level insight into how structural and molecular imaging jointly contribute to AD diagnosis. The source code is available at https://github.com/PennShenLab/mref-ad.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MREF-AD，一种基于多模态区域专家融合的阿尔茨海默病诊断模型。它采用混合专家（MoE）框架，将每个模态中的脑区视为独立专家，并通过门控网络学习个体化的融合权重。在ADNI数据集上，MREF-AD在分类性能上优于强基线，同时提供模态和区域级别的可解释性。
Motivation: 现有融合方法通常简单拼接特征，无法自适应平衡不同模态（如淀粉样PET和MRI）在不同脑区的贡献，限制了诊断准确性和可解释性。
Method: 提出MREF-AD，一种基于混合专家（MoE）的多模态融合框架。将每个模态的脑区建模为独立专家，使用门控网络学习每个被试的融合权重。输入为表格化神经影像和人口统计信息。
Result: 在ADNI数据集上，MREF-AD在分类性能上超过了强经典和深度学习基线，并提供了可解释的模态和区域层面的洞察。
Conclusion: 该方法能够自适应融合多模态数据，提供可解释的诊断依据，有助于理解结构成像和分子成像在AD诊断中的联合贡献。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法能够自适应融合多模态数据，提供可解释的诊断依据，有助于理解结构成像和分子成像在AD诊断中的联合贡献。

papers.title: Trend-Aware Multi-Task Learning for Short-Term Energy Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Short-term energy forecasting plays an important role in real-time operational decision-making, such as electricity market bidding and power system dispatch, where both numerical accuracy and correct directional signals are essential. However, most existing forecasting approaches formulate the problem purely as a regression task, limiting their ability to explicitly capture stepwise directional movements and trend consistency required for operational decisions. To address this limitation, this paper proposes a trend-aware multi-task forecasting framework that decomposes forecasting outputs into directional movements and deviation magnitudes relative to the latest observation, enabling both accurate numerical prediction and interpretable trend-aware outputs. The framework adopts a task-specific dual-stream architecture and explores key design choices for integrating trend and deviation information, including hard versus probabilistic trend representations, symmetric versus asymmetric deviation modelling, and parallel versus sequential conditioning strategies. To stabilize multi-task learning and reduce manual tuning, an uncertainty-aware task weighting scheme is incorporated to automatically balance directional classification, deviation regression, and final output prediction during training. Experimental results on real-world energy datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves competitive numerical accuracy compared with state-of-the-art algorithms, while consistently improving trend prediction performance with moderate computational cost. This capability is particularly beneficial in short-term energy system management, where consistent directional forecasting can provide more reliable decision support for practical operational scenarios such as market bidding, resource scheduling, and risk-aware energy management.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种趋势感知的多任务学习框架用于短期能源预测，将预测输出分解为方向性变化和偏差幅度，同时实现数值准确和趋势可解释。采用任务特定的双流架构，探索了多种设计选择，并引入不确定性感知的任务加权方案。实验表明，该框架在数值精度上具有竞争力，并一致提升了趋势预测性能。
Motivation: 现有能源预测方法仅作为回归任务，无法显式捕捉方向性移动和趋势一致性，限制了运营决策支持。
Method: 提出趋势感知多任务框架，分解预测为方向分类和偏差回归，采用双流架构，并比较了硬/概率趋势表示、对称/非对称偏差建模等设计，使用不确定性感知任务加权自动平衡损失。
Result: 在实际能源数据集上，与最先进算法相比，数值精度相当，趋势预测性能一致提升，计算开销适中。
Conclusion: 该框架在短期能源管理中提供更可靠的方向性预测支持，适用于市场竞价、资源调度和风险感知管理等场景。

papers.title: RAMAC: Multimodal Risk-Aware Offline Reinforcement Learning and the Role of Behavior Regularization
papers.abstract_en: In safety-critical domains where online data collection is infeasible, offline reinforcement learning (RL) is attractive only if policies achieve high returns without catastrophic lower-tail risk. Prior work on risk-averse offline RL achieves safety at the cost of either (i) value/model-based pessimism or (ii) restricted policy classes that limit expressiveness, whereas diffusion/flow-based expressive generative policies have largely been used in risk-neutral settings. We introduce \textbf{Risk-Aware Multimodal Actor-Critic (RAMAC)}, a simple, modular, model-free framework that couples an expressive generative actor (e.g., diffusion/flow) with a distributional critic and optimizes a composite objective that combines Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) with behavioral cloning (BC), enabling risk-sensitive learning in complex multimodal scenarios. Since out-of-distribution (OOD) actions are a major driver of catastrophic failures in offline RL, we further provide an objective-level analysis showing that controlling behavior divergence via BC suppresses OOD actions and stabilizes CVaR. Instantiating RAMAC with a diffusion actor, we illustrate these insights on a 2-D risky bandit and evaluate on Stochastic-D4RL, observing consistent gains in $\mathrm{CVaR}_{0.1}$ while maintaining strong returns. The code and experimental results are available on the \href{https://kaifukazawa.github.io/ramac-project/} {project website}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RAMAC，一种风险感知多模态离线强化学习框架，结合生成式策略（如扩散模型）与分布性评论家，优化 CVaR 与行为克隆的复合目标。在随机 D4RL 基准上，RAMAC 在保持高回报的同时提升了 CVaR_0.1 指标。
Motivation: 现有风险规避离线强化学习方法依赖悲观价值模型或受限策略类，限制了表达能力；而扩散/流模型在风险中性设置下表现良好，但缺乏风险感知。
Method: 提出 RAMAC 框架，包含生成式演员（如扩散模型）和分布性评论家，优化 CVaR 与行为克隆的复合目标，并通过分析表明行为克隆可抑制 OOD 动作，稳定 CVaR。
Result: 在 2D 风险赌博和 Stochastic-D4RL 任务上，RAMAC 在保持高回报的同时，持续提升了 CVaR_0.1 指标。
Conclusion: RAMAC 提供了一种模块化、模型无关的风险感知离线强化学习方法，通过行为正则化实现安全与表达能力的平衡。

papers.title: Multidimensional Bayesian Active Machine Learning of Working Memory Task Performance
papers.abstract_en: While adaptive experimental design has outgrown one-dimensional, staircase-based adaptations, most cognitive experiments still control a single factor and summarize performance with a scalar. We show a validation of a Bayesian, two-axis, active-classification approach, carried out in an immersive virtual testing environment for a 5-by-5 working-memory reconstruction task. Two variables are controlled: spatial load L (number of occupied tiles) and feature-binding load K (number of distinct colors) of items. Stimulus acquisition is guided by posterior uncertainty of a nonparametric Gaussian Process (GP) probabilistic classifier, which outputs a surface over (L, K) rather than a single threshold or max span value. In a young adult population, we compare GP-driven Adaptive Mode (AM) with a traditional adaptive staircase Classic Mode (CM), which varies L only at K = 3. Parity between the methods is achieved for this cohort, with an intraclass coefficient of 0.755 at K = 3. Additionally, AM reveals individual differences in interactions between spatial load and feature binding. AM estimates converge more quickly than other sampling strategies, demonstrating that only about 30 samples are required for accurate fitting of the full model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文验证了一种贝叶斯两轴主动分类方法在沉浸式虚拟环境中进行5×5工作记忆重构任务的表现。该方法通过非参数高斯过程（GP）概率分类器生成空间负荷L和特征绑定负荷K的曲面，而非单一阈值。与经典自适应阶梯模式相比，在K=3时组内相关系数达0.755，且能揭示个体差异。自适应模式仅需约30个样本即可准确拟合完整模型。
Motivation: 大多数认知实验仍控制单一变量并用标量概括表现，缺乏多维自适应设计。本文旨在展示一种贝叶斯双轴主动分类方法在认知任务中的有效性。
Method: 采用高斯过程（GP）概率分类器，基于后验不确定性指导刺激获取，输出(L, K)二维曲面。对比了GP驱动的自适应模式（AM）与经典自适应阶梯模式（CM）。
Result: 在年轻成人群体中，AM与CM在K=3时达到相等效果（组内相关系数0.755）。AM揭示了空间负荷与特征绑定之间的个体差异，且仅需约30个样本即可准确拟合模型。
Conclusion: 贝叶斯双轴主动方法能高效收敛并揭示多维变量交互的个体差异，但本研究仅在单一年轻群体中验证，未来需探索更广泛人群。

papers.title: Jackknife Variance Estimation for Hájek-Dominated Generalized U-Statistics
papers.abstract_en: Valid uncertainty quantification for subsampling-based and randomized estimators often depends on variance estimators whose behavior is much less understood than that of the underlying point estimator. We prove ratio-consistency of the jackknife variance estimator, and certain delete-$d$ variants, for a broad class of generalized U-statistics whose variance is asymptotically dominated by their Hajek projection and whose normalized first-projection squares satisfy a row-wise $L^r$ weak law, with the classical fixed-order case recovered as a special instance. This projection-dominance plus square-LLN structure unifies and generalizes several criteria from the existing literature, clarifies when the simple nonparametric jackknife is theoretically justified in the generalized setting, and yields consistent variance estimation for the two-scale distributional nearest-neighbor regression estimator under substantially weaker conditions than previously required.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了一种广义U统计量的Jackknife方差估计的比率一致性，证明了在Hájek投影占优且归一化一阶投影平方满足行向Lr弱律的条件下，Jackknife估计量及其删除-d变体是一致的。该结果统一并推广了现有文献中的多个准则，并为两尺度分布近邻回归估计量在更弱条件下提供了一致的方差估计。
Motivation: 子抽样和随机化估计量的不确定性量化常依赖于方差估计量，但其行为远不如点估计量被理解，需要理论保证。
Method: 利用Hájek投影占优和归一化一阶投影平方的行向Lr弱律结构，证明了Jackknife方差估计量的比率一致性，并推广到删除-d变体。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，但声明该方法在更弱条件下为两尺度分布近邻回归估计量提供了一致的方差估计。
Conclusion: 所提出的投影占优加平方LLN结构统一并推广了现有准则，明确了非参数Jackknife在广义设定下的理论合理性。

papers.title: PCR-CA: Parallel Codebook Representations with Contrastive Alignment for Multiple-Category App Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Modern app store recommender systems struggle with multiple-category apps, as traditional taxonomies fail to capture overlapping semantics, leading to suboptimal personalization. We propose PCR-CA (Parallel Codebook Representations with Contrastive Alignment), an end-to-end framework for improved CTR prediction. PCR-CA first extracts compact multimodal embeddings from app text, then introduces a Parallel Codebook VQ-AE module that learns discrete semantic representations across multiple codebooks in parallel -- unlike hierarchical residual quantization (RQ-VAE). This design enables independent encoding of diverse aspects (e.g., gameplay, art style), better modeling multiple-category semantics. To bridge semantic and collaborative signals, we employ a contrastive alignment loss at both the user and item levels, enhancing representation learning for long-tail items. Additionally, a dual-attention fusion mechanism combines ID-based and semantic features to capture user interests, especially for long-tail apps. Experiments on a large-scale dataset show PCR-CA achieves a +0.76% AUC improvement over strong baselines, with +2.15% AUC gains for long-tail apps. Online A/B testing further validates our approach, showing a +10.52% lift in CTR and a +16.30% improvement in CVR, demonstrating PCR-CA's effectiveness in real-world deployment. The new framework has now been fully deployed on the Microsoft Store.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PCR-CA 框架，用于多类别App推荐中的CTR预测。通过并行码本VQ-AE模块学习多语义离散表示，结合对比对齐损失和双注意力融合机制，提升长尾App的推荐效果。在微软商店数据集上，AUC提升0.76%，长尾App提升2.15%；在线A/B测试显示CTR提升10.52%，CVR提升16.30%。
Motivation: 传统分类法无法捕捉多类别App的重叠语义，导致个性化推荐不准确，特别是长尾App。
Method: 先提取紧凑多模态嵌入，再用并行码本VQ-AE学习独立语义方面（如玩法、画风）；引入用户级和物品级对比对齐损失弥合语义与协同信号；最后用双注意力机制融合ID和语义特征。
Result: 离线实验AUC提升0.76%，长尾App AUC提升2.15%；在线测试CTR提升10.52%，CVR提升16.30%。
Conclusion: PCR-CA有效建模多类别语义并提升长尾推荐，已在微软商店全量部署。

papers.title: From Small to Large: A Graph Convolutional Network Approach for Solving Assortment Optimization Problems
papers.abstract_en: Assortment optimization seeks to select a subset of substitutable products, subject to constraints, to maximize expected revenue. The problem is NP-hard due to its combinatorial and nonlinear nature and arises frequently in industries such as e-commerce, where platforms must solve thousands of such problems each minute. We propose a graph convolutional network (GCN) framework to efficiently solve constrained assortment optimization problems. Our approach constructs a graph representation of the problem, trains a GCN to learn the mapping from problem parameters to optimal assortments, and develops three inference policies based on the GCN's output. Owing to the GCN's ability to generalize across instance sizes, patterns learned from small-scale samples can be transferred to large-scale problems. Theoretical results are established to show the expressive power of the proposed GCN, and explain the underlying mechanism of the size generalization ability. Numerical experiments show that a GCN trained on instances with 20 products achieves over 85% of the optimal revenue on problems with up to 2,000 products within seconds, outperforming existing heuristics in both accuracy and efficiency. We further extend the framework to settings with an unknown choice model using transaction data and demonstrate similar performance and scalability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于图卷积网络（GCN）的框架来解决受约束的分类优化问题，该问题在电子商务中常见且为NP难。方法将问题构建为图表示，训练GCN学习从参数到最优分类的映射，并设计三种推理策略。理论证明了GCN的表达能力和规模泛化能力。实验表明，在20个产品的实例上训练的GCN，在2000个产品的规模上能获得超过85%的最优收益，且速度快于现有启发式方法。
Motivation: 分类优化问题是NP难的组合非线性问题，在电子商务中需要每分钟求解数千次，现有方法在大规模实例上精度或效率不足。
Method: 构建图表示问题，训练GCN学习问题参数到最优分类的映射，并基于GCN输出开发三种推理策略，利用GCN在不同实例规模间的泛化能力。
Result: 在20个产品实例上训练的GCN，在2000个产品问题上秒级获得超过85%的最优收益，准确率和效率均优于现有启发式方法。
Conclusion: GCN框架能高效解决大规模约束分类优化问题，并扩展至未知选择模型场景。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在20个产品实例上训练的GCN，在2000个产品问题上秒级获得超过85%的最优收益，准确率和效率均优于现有启发式方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: GCN框架能高效解决大规模约束分类优化问题，并扩展至未知选择模型场景。

papers.title: Federated Causal Inference from Multi-Site Observational Data via Propensity Score Aggregation
papers.abstract_en: Causal inference typically assumes centralized access to individual-level data. Yet, in practice, data are often decentralized across multiple sites, making centralization infeasible due to privacy, logistical, or legal constraints. We address this problem by estimating the Average Treatment Effect (ATE) from decentralized observational data via a Federated Learning (FL) approach, allowing inference through the exchange of aggregate statistics rather than individual-level data. We propose a novel method to estimate propensity scores via a federated weighted average of local scores using Membership Weights (MW), defined as probabilities of site membership conditional on covariates. MW can be flexibly estimated with parametric or non-parametric classification models using standard FL algorithms. The resulting propensity scores are used to construct Federated Inverse Propensity Weighting (Fed-IPW) and Augmented IPW (Fed-AIPW) estimators. In contrast to meta-analysis methods, which fail when any site violates positivity, our approach exploits heterogeneity in treatment assignment across sites to improve overlap. We show that Fed-IPW and Fed-AIPW perform well under site-level heterogeneity in sample sizes, treatment mechanisms, and covariate distributions. Theoretical analysis and experiments on simulated and real-world data demonstrate clear advantages over meta-analysis and related approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种联邦学习方法，从分散在多站点的观察性数据中估计平均处理效应（ATE），通过交换聚合统计量而非个体级数据。方法使用成员权重（MW）进行倾向得分的联邦加权平均，进而构建联邦逆概率加权（Fed-IPW）和增强逆概率加权（Fed-AIPW）估计器。理论分析和实验表明，该方法在样本量、处理机制和协变量分布存在站点间异质性时优于元分析方法。
Motivation: 因果推断通常假设可以集中访问个体级数据，但实际上数据常分散在多站点，由于隐私、后勤或法律限制无法集中化。现有元分析方法在任意站点违反积极性假设时会失效，需要一种能利用站点间处理分配异质性来改善重叠的方法。
Method: 提出通过成员权重（MW）的联邦加权平均估计倾向得分，成员权重定义为给定协变量下站点成员的概率，可使用标准联邦学习算法灵活估计。基于得到的倾向得分，构建Fed-IPW和Fed-AIPW估计器。
Result: 理论分析和在模拟及真实数据上的实验表明，Fed-IPW和Fed-AIPW在站点间样本量、处理机制和协变量分布存在异质性时表现良好，明显优于元分析及相关方法。
Conclusion: 本文的联邦因果推断方法允许从分散数据中估计ATE而无需共享个体数据，且能利用站点间异质性改善重叠，是一种隐私保护且有效的替代方案。

papers.title: Ensembling Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are used to decompose neural network activations into human-interpretable features. Typically, features learned by a single SAE are used for downstream applications. However, it has recently been shown that a single SAE captures only a limited subset of features that can be extracted from the activation space. Motivated by this limitation, we introduce and formalize SAE ensembles. Furthermore, we propose to ensemble multiple SAEs through naive bagging and boosting. In naive bagging, SAEs trained with different weight initializations are ensembled, whereas in boosting SAEs sequentially trained to minimize the residual error are ensembled. Theoretically, naive bagging and boosting are justified as approaches to reduce reconstruction error. Empirically, we evaluate our ensemble approaches with three settings of language models and SAE architectures. Our empirical results demonstrate that, compared to an expanded SAE that matches the number of features in the ensemble, ensembling SAEs improves the reconstruction of language model activations along with SAE stability. Additionally, on downstream tasks such as concept detection and spurious correlation removal, SAE ensembles achieve better performance, showing improved practical utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对稀疏自编码器（SAE）一次只能捕获激活空间中有限特征子集的问题，提出集成SAE的方法，包括朴素装袋和提升方法。理论证明了这些方法可降低重构误差；实验表明，相比将特征数量匹配的单个扩展SAE，集成SAE能更好地重构语言模型激活，提升稳定性，并在概念检测和去除虚假相关性等下游任务中表现更优。
Motivation: 单个SAE只能学到激活空间中有限的特征子集，限制了其在下游应用中的实用性。
Method: 形式化SAE集成，提出两种集成策略：朴素装袋（不同权重初始化的SAE集成）和提升（顺序训练SAE以最小化残差误差）。
Result: 在三种语言模型和SAE架构设置下，集成SAE相比具有相同特征数量的扩展SAE，在重构语言模型激活和稳定性上均有提升；在概念检测和去除虚假相关性任务中也取得更好效果。
Conclusion: 集成SAE是一种简单有效的提升特征质量和实用性的方法，但未讨论集成带来的计算开销或不同基SAE多样性对效果的进一步影响。

papers.title: A Unified Theory of Sinusoidal Activation Families for Implicit Neural Representations
papers.abstract_en: Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) model continuous signals with compact neural networks and have become a standard tool in vision, graphics, and signal processing. A central challenge is accurately capturing fine detail without heavy hand-crafted encodings or brittle training heuristics. Across the literature, periodic activations have emerged as a compelling remedy: from SIREN, which uses a single sinusoid with a fixed global frequency, to more recent architectures employing multiple sinusoids and, in some cases, trainable frequencies and phases. We study this family of sinusoidal activations and develop a principled theoretical and practical framework for trainable sinusoidal activations in INRs. Concretely, we instantiate this framework with Sinusoidal Trainable Activation Functions (STAF), a Fourier-like activation whose amplitudes, frequencies, and phases are learned. Our analysis (i) establishes a Kronecker-equivalence construction that expresses trainable sinusoidal activations with standard sine networks and quantifies expressive growth, (ii) characterizes how the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) spectrum changes under trainable sinusoidal parameterization, and (iii) provides an initialization that yields standard normal post-activations without asymptotic central limit theorem (CLT) arguments. Empirically, on images, audio, shapes, inverse problems (super-resolution, denoising) and NeRF, STAF is competitive and often stronger on distortion-oriented reconstruction metrics such as PSNR/SSIM across the evaluated INR tasks, with favorable parameter efficiency under layer-wise sharing. While periodic activations can alleviate practical manifestations of spectral bias, our results indicate they do not eliminate it; instead, trainable sinusoids can improve the observed capacity-optimization trade-off in the evaluated settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对隐式神经表示（INR）中精细细节捕捉的挑战，提出了正弦激活函数族（包括可训练频率和相位的STAF）的统一理论和实践框架。分析包括Kronecker等价构建、NTK谱变化和初始化方法。实验表明STAF在图像、音频、形状、逆问题（超分辨率、去噪）和NeRF上，在PSNR/SSIM等指标上具有竞争力，但未消除谱偏差。
Motivation: 现有INR依赖手工编码或脆弱训练策略，而周期性激活如SIREN虽有效但缺乏统一理论框架。本文旨在为可训练正弦激活提供理论支撑并提升性能。
Method: 提出Sinusoidal Trainable Activation Functions（STAF），一种傅里叶类激活函数，其幅度、频率和相位均可学习。建立了Kronecker等价构造将可训练正弦激活与标准正弦网络关联，分析了NTK谱变化，并提出了非渐近CLT的初始化方案。
Result: 在图像、音频、形状、超分辨率、去噪和NeRF等任务上，STAF在PSNR/SSIM等失真导向指标上表现有竞争力，参数效率更高；但结果表明周期性激活不能消除谱偏差，仅改善容量-优化权衡。
Conclusion: 可训练正弦激活家庭提供了一种统一理论框架，在多种INR任务中取得竞争性能，但谱偏差依然存在。

papers.title: ANSR-DT: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Adaptive and Explainable Digital Twins
papers.abstract_en: Digital twins are increasingly used to monitor and optimize industrial systems, yet many existing frameworks remain difficult to interpret, slow to adapt, and limited in their ability to incorporate explicit domain knowledge. This paper presents ANSR-DT, an adaptive neuro-symbolic framework that unifies temporal anomaly detection, symbolic reasoning, and reinforcement-learning-based decision support within a single digital twin pipeline. ANSR-DT combines a CNN-LSTM model for multivariate pattern recognition with Prolog-based reasoning that converts learned signals into explicit rules, enabling transparent diagnoses and traceable decision paths. A PPO-based adaptation layer further refines operational responses under changing conditions while preserving interpretability. Experiments against 8 baselines show that ANSR-DT delivers competitive predictive performance together with stable rule extraction, scalable symbolic reasoning, and actionable explanations. Additional validation on the Skoltech Anomaly Benchmark (SKAB) further indicates that the framework transfers beyond synthetic settings. These findings position ANSR-DT as a practical foundation for trustworthy, adaptive, and explainable industrial digital twins.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ANSR-DT是一个自适应神经符号框架，用于数字孪生，结合CNN-LSTM进行时序异常检测、Prolog符号推理和PPO强化学习决策支持，在保持可解释性的同时实现竞争性预测性能和规则提取。在多个基线对比和SKAB基准上验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 现有数字孪生框架难以解释、适应慢且缺乏显式领域知识集成能力。
Method: 提出ANSR-DT框架，融合CNN-LSTM多变量模式识别、Prolog符号推理将学习信号转化为显式规则，以及基于PPO的适应层，在变化条件下优化运行响应并保持可解释性。
Result: 在8个基线对比中表现竞争性预测性能，实现稳定的规则提取、可扩展符号推理和可操作解释。在SKAB基准上进一步验证了跨合成场景的迁移能力。
Conclusion: ANSR-DT为可信、自适应、可解释的工业数字孪生提供了实用基础。

papers.title: Stability of a Generalized Debiased Lasso with Applications to Resampling-Based Variable Selection
papers.abstract_en: We propose a generalized debiased Lasso estimator based on a stability principle. When a single column of the design matrix is perturbed, the estimator admits a simple update formula that can be computed from the original solution. Under sub-Gaussian designs with well-conditioned covariance, this approximation is asymptotically accurate for all but a vanishing fraction of coordinates in the proportional growth regime. The proof relies on concentration and anti-concentration arguments to control error terms and sign changes. In contrast, establishing comparable distributional limits (e.g., Gaussianity) under similar assumptions remains open. As an application, we show that the approximation significantly reduces the computational cost of resampling-based variable selection procedures, including the conditional randomization test and a local knockoff filter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于稳定性原理提出一种广义去偏Lasso估计器，该估计器在单个设计矩阵列被扰动时具有简单的更新公式，且在比例增长条件下对于几乎所有坐标渐近精确。
Motivation: 传统去偏Lasso的计算成本较高，尤其是在重采样变量选择中。本文旨在提供一种计算高效的近似方法，同时保持统计性质。
Method: 提出广义去偏Lasso估计器，利用稳定性原理，在扰动单个列时通过原始解直接计算更新；理论分析依赖于次高斯设计和条件良好的协方差矩阵，使用集中和反集中不等式控制误差。
Result: 在比例增长条件下，该近似对于几乎所有坐标渐近精确；但在类似假设下建立分布极限（如高斯性）仍为开放问题。
Conclusion: 该近似显著降低了重采样变量选择（如条件随机化检验和局部knockoff滤波器）的计算成本。

papers.title: Arbitrary control over multimode wave propagation for machine learning
papers.abstract_en: Controlled multimode wave propagation can enable more space-efficient photonic processors than architectures based on discrete components connected by single-mode waveguides. Instead of defining discrete elements, one can sculpt the continuous substrate of a photonic processor to perform computations through multimode interference in two dimensions. Here we designed and demonstrated a device with a refractive index that can be rapidly reprogrammed across space, allowing arbitrary control of wave propagation. The device, a two-dimensional programmable waveguide, uses parallel electro-optic modulation of the refractive index of a slab waveguide with about $10^4$ programmable spatial degrees of freedom. We implemented neural network inference on benchmark tasks with up to $49$-dimensional vectors in a single pass, without digital pre-processing or post-processing. Theoretical and numerical analyses further indicated that two-dimensional programmable waveguides may offer not only a constant-factor reduction in device area but also a scaling benefit, with the area required growing as $N^{1.5}$ rather than $N^2$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文设计并演示了一种可通过空间快速编程的二维波导，利用约10^4个可编程空间自由度实现多模波传播的任意控制。该器件在基准任务上执行神经网络推理，处理高达49维向量，无需数字预处理或后处理。理论分析表明，其面积缩放优势为N^{1.5}而非N^2。
Motivation: 传统光子处理器依赖单模波导连接分立元件，面积效率低。本文旨在通过连续基底的多模干涉实现更紧凑的计算架构。
Method: 采用二维可编程波导，通过平行电光调制铌酸锂平板波导的折射率，实现空间任意波前控制，直接完成神经网络推理。
Result: 在基准任务上单次通过实现49维向量的神经推理；理论表明器件面积随N^{1.5}增长，优于传统N^2缩放。
Conclusion: 二维可编程波导为光学计算提供面积效率和可扩展性优势，但需进一步验证大规模集成和实际算法适配。

summary_sections.result: 在基准任务上单次通过实现49维向量的神经推理；理论表明器件面积随N^{1.5}增长，优于传统N^2缩放。
summary_sections.conclusion: 二维可编程波导为光学计算提供面积效率和可扩展性优势，但需进一步验证大规模集成和实际算法适配。

papers.title: On Rate-Optimal Partitioning Classification from Observable and from Privatised Data
papers.abstract_en: In this paper we revisit the classical method of partitioning classification and prove novel convergence rates under relaxed conditions, both for observable (non-privatised) and for privatised data. We consider the problem of classification in a $d$ dimensional Euclidean space. Previous results on the partitioning classifier worked with the strong density assumption (SDA), which is restrictive, as we demonstrate through simple examples. Here, we study the problem under much milder assumptions. We presuppose that the distribution of the inputs is a mixture of an absolutely continuous and a discrete distribution, such that the absolutely continuous component is concentrated on a $d_a$ dimensional subspace. In addition to the standard Lipschitz and margin conditions, a novel characteristic of the absolutely continuous component is introduced, by which the convergence rate of the classification error probability is computed, both for the binary and for the multi-class cases. This bound can reach the minimax optimal convergence rate achievable using SDA, but under much milder distributional assumptions. Interestingly, this convergence rate depends only on the intrinsic dimension of the continuous inputs, $d_a$, and not on $d$. Under privacy constraints, the data cannot be directly observed, and the constructed classifiers are functions of the randomised outcome of a suitable local differential privacy mechanism. In this paper we add Laplace distributed noises to the discretisations of all possible locations of the feature vector and to its label. Again, tight upper bounds on the convergence rate of the classification error probability can be derived, without using SDA, such that this rate depends on $2d_a$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视划分分类（partitioning classification）的经典方法，在更宽松的分布假设下证明了新的收敛速率，适用于可观测数据和隐私化数据。输入分布被建模为绝对连续与离散分量的混合，绝对连续部分集中于d_a维子空间。分类误差概率的收敛速率仅依赖于连续输入的内在维数d_a，而非环境维数d；在局部差分隐私下，速率依赖于2d_a。
Motivation: 以往的划分分类器收敛率需要强密度假设（SDA），该假设过于严格，限制了实际应用。本文旨在放松这些假设，在更一般的分布条件下推导最优收敛速率，并扩展至隐私保护场景。
Method: 假设输入分布为绝对连续与离散分量的混合，绝对连续部分集中于d_a维子空间。引入绝对连续分量的新特征量，结合Lipschitz和margin条件，推导二元与多类分类误差概率的收敛上界。对于隐私数据，对特征向量和标签的离散化添加拉普拉斯噪声，然后分析收敛速率。
Result: 证明了分类误差概率的收敛速率可以达到使用SDA时的极小极大最优速率，但依赖条件更弱。该速率仅依赖于内在维数d_a，而非环境维数d。在局部差分隐私下，速率依赖于2d_a。
Conclusion: 本文在更弱的分布假设下建立了划分分类器的最优收敛理论，并扩展至隐私保护环境，揭示了速率对内在维数的依赖。

papers.title: WorkBench Revisited: Workplace Agents Two Years On
papers.abstract_en: The best agent on WorkBench in March 2024, GPT-4, completed 43% of tasks and took an unintended harmful action, such as emailing the wrong person, on 26% of them. We re-visit the benchmark in June 2026 and find that the best agent to date, Claude Opus 4.8, completes 89% and takes an unintended harmful action on 2.5%. Aside from this considerable progress in frontier agent performance, three things stand out. First, capability and safety go together on WorkBench rather than trade off, so the models that finish the most tasks also do the least unintended damage. Second, while several classes of error have been totally eliminated, frontier models still make some basic mistakes that occasionally result in irreversible harm, such as sending an email to the wrong person. Third, the rise of open-weight models has drastically lowered costs for a performance level that was previously only accessible to proprietary models, while frontier costs have stayed relatively stable. We release an updated version of the benchmark with data and code quality improvements, new model scores, and analysis of agent progress on WorkBench since 2024.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文回顾了WorkBench基准测试两年来的进展，发现前沿代理的性能从2024年3月的43%任务完成率提升到2026年6月的89%，同时意外有害行为从26%降至2.5%。能力与安全性呈正相关，一些错误类型已被消除，但前沿模型仍会犯基础错误导致不可逆伤害。开源模型大幅降低了成本，而前沿模型成本保持稳定。
Motivation: WorkBench基准测试用于评估代理在真实工作场景中的任务完成能力和安全性，两年前的结果显示当时最佳代理GPT-4表现有限且存在较高风险。本文旨在重新评估两年后代理的进步情况，并分析能力与安全的关系、错误模式以及成本变化。
Method: 作者重新运行WorkBench基准测试，使用更新的模型（如Claude Opus 4.8）和经过质量改进的测试数据，比较任务完成率、有害行动率，并分类分析错误类型和成本趋势。
Result: 最佳代理任务完成率从43%提升至89%，有害行动率从26%降至2.5%；能力与安全正相关；部分错误类型被消除，但基础错误仍存在；开源模型性能接近之前的专有模型水平，成本大幅降低。
Conclusion: 尽管代理性能取得显著进步，安全风险并未完全消失，前沿模型仍需警惕基本错误。开源模型的崛起降低了高性能代理的准入门槛，但前沿模型成本未明显下降。

papers.title: TSA: Temporal Slot Activation for Persistent Object-Centric Video Representation
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised video object-centric learning aims to decompose dynamic scenes into temporally persistent entity representations. Existing recurrent video slot-attention methods propagate a fixed set of slots across frames, but typically assume unconditional slot propagation: every slot is updated and decoded at every frame, regardless of whether its corresponding object is visible. We show that this design violates a basic lifecycle requirement for persistent slots: when an object is absent or fully occluded, its slot should preserve its previous state and avoid explaining unrelated visible content. Instead, unconditional propagation creates two failure pathways: update-induced state drift, where current-frame evidence overwrites the absent object's representation, and decoder-induced reconstruction interference, where the inactive slot remains coupled to reconstruction through decoder attention. We propose Temporal Slot Activation (TSA), a mechanism that learns a per-slot, per-frame activation score $α_{k,t} \in (0, 1)$ without visibility supervision. TSA uses this activation as a shared latent control variable for slot lifecycle modeling. When a slot is inactive, TSA anchors its state to the previous slot via activation-gated updating and suppresses its decoder participation through an activation-dependent additive bias on attention logits before softmax normalization. This jointly reduces state drift and reconstruction-driven interference. To improve decisions under partial occlusion and gradual reappearance, TSA further conditions activation prediction on a per-slot temporal memory produced by a Temporal Context Encoder. We evaluate TSA on MOVi-C/E, YT-VIS, and OVIS benchmarks using both standard and tracking-based metrics (FG-ARI, mBO, IDF1, HOTA). TSA consistently improves object decomposition and temporal identity preservation, with large gains on long, heavily occluded videos.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Temporal Slot Activation (TSA) 机制，用于无监督视频目标中心学习。TSA 通过学习每槽每帧的激活分数，在目标消失或遮挡时冻结槽状态并抑制其解码器参与，避免无条件传播导致的状态漂移和重建干扰。在 MOVi-C/E、YT-VIS、OVIS 基准上，TSA 提升了目标分解和时序身份保持，尤其在长遮挡视频上增益显著。
Motivation: 现有视频槽注意力方法无条件传播所有槽到每一帧，当目标不可见时，槽仍被更新和解码，导致状态漂移和重建干扰，违反槽的生命周期要求。
Method: TSA 对每个槽每帧学习一个激活分数 α∈(0,1)，作为共享隐变量控制槽生命周期：非激活时通过激活门控更新锚定状态，并在解码注意力中通过激活依赖的加性偏置抑制参与。此外，使用时序上下文编码器提供每槽时序记忆以改进部分遮挡和渐显下的激活预测。
Result: 在 MOVi-C/E、YT-VIS、OVIS 上，TSA 在 FG-ARI、mBO、IDF1、HOTA 等标准及跟踪指标上一致提升，长遮挡视频上增益明显。
Conclusion: TSA 通过显式建模槽的激活状态，有效解决了视频目标中心学习中目标消失时的表示污染问题，后续可探索与更复杂时序依赖的结合。

papers.title: CisTransCell: Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction via Gene Function, Regulatory Control, and Cellular Context
papers.abstract_en: Predicting cellular transcriptional responses to genetic perturbations is a central problem in single-cell biology, especially in the zero-shot setting where the perturbed gene or gene combination is unseen during training. A major difficulty is that perturbation effects are not determined by expression state alone: they depend on how the perturbed gene product influences other genes and proteins, how those downstream factors act on cis-regulatory elements, and which regulatory programs are active in the current cell state. To better capture this biological complexity, we propose CisTransCell, a cell-conditioned multi-modal framework for single-cell perturbation prediction that augments each gene with two complementary priors: a regulatory-sequence prior that captures how the gene is controlled, and a coding-sequence prior that captures what the gene product does. By integrating these priors with cellular expression state, CisTransCell models perturbation response as a cascade from gene function to regulatory control to downstream transcriptional change. Experiments on benchmark single-cell perturbation datasets show that CisTransCell achieves strong performance in zero-shot perturbation prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CisTransCell 是一个细胞条件多模态框架，用于单细胞扰动预测。它通过为每个基因添加调控序列先验和编码序列先验，整合细胞表达状态，建模从基因功能到调控控制再到下游转录变化的级联效应。在基准数据集上，零样本预测表现强劲。
Motivation: 单细胞扰动预测中，零样本设置下未见过的基因或基因组合的扰动的响应预测是难题，因为扰动效应不仅取决于表达状态，还涉及基因产物对其他基因和蛋白质的影响、下游因子对顺式调控元件的作用以及当前细胞状态中活跃的调控程序。
Method: 提出 CisTransCell，一种细胞条件多模态框架，为每个基因补充两种互补先验：调控序列先验（捕获基因如何被调控）和编码序列先验（捕获基因产物的功能），并与细胞表达状态整合，建模扰动响应级联。
Result: 在单细胞扰动基准数据集上，CisTransCell 在零样本扰动预测中取得了强劲性能。
Conclusion: 该框架通过融合基因功能、调控控制和细胞上下文，有效提升了零样本单细胞扰动预测能力。

papers.title: Hybrid Open-Ended Tri-Evolution Makes Better Deep Researcher
papers.abstract_en: Deep research and agent evolution serve as de-facto tasks for AI agents in real-world applications toward artificial general intelligence. The former enables autonomous retrieval and integration of information in open-ended environments to tackle open-ended research tasks, yet it is constrained by the static parametric deep research capabilities of agent systems. The latter allows agents to autonomously interact with the environment to gain experiences that evolve model capabilities. However, its effectiveness has been widely validated only on verifiable tasks with standard answers, leaving a gap with open-ended research tasks. To bridge these two critical tasks, we propose the Hybrid Open-Ended Tri-Evolution (HOTE) framework, which leverages hybrid-mode reinforcement learning to facilitate the collaborative evolution of a proposer, solver and judge based on web-scale knowledge, moving toward autonomous evolving agents in open-ended tasks and environments. Extensive experiments on three long-form deep research benchmarks demonstrate that the 8B model trained via HOTE surpasses the strongest static open 8-32B models as well as those trained by state-of-the-art deep research training methods with less time overhead, and further verify that the evolution of all three modules in HOTE is indispensable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出混合开放端三元演化（HOTE）框架，通过混合模式强化学习协同进化提议者、求解者和评判者，以连接深度研究与智能体演化，在三个长篇幅深度研究基准上，8B模型超越更强的静态模型及最先进训练方法。
Motivation: 深度研究受限于静态参数能力，而智能体演化在开放端研究任务中验证不足，二者存在鸿沟。
Method: HOTE框架：利用混合模式强化学习，基于网络规模知识，协同进化提议者、求解者和评判者三个模块。
Result: 在三个长篇幅深度研究基准上，HOTE训练的8B模型超越静态8-32B模型及最先进训练方法，且时间开销更少。
Conclusion: HOTE中三个模块的进化缺一不可，该框架向开放端任务中的自主进化智能体迈进一步。

papers.title: LoMC: Localized Multidirectional Correction for Refusal Suppression in Routed Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: We study controlled post-training refusal suppression in routed MoE and hybrid-MoE foundation models, aiming to increase non-refusal target-response behavior while preserving general capability under a compact intervention footprint. Existing broad direction-based edits can perturb general-purpose computation, whereas support-only expert edits often lack sufficient capacity to correct heterogeneous refusal representations. To address this limitation, we introduce Localized Multidirectional Correction (LoMC), a support-gated intervention framework that follows a support-then-correction execution order: it first identifies a compact edit support, then aggregates prototype correction directions into layer-wise correction directions, and finally applies rank-one layer-wise correction only within the selected support. By using the edit support as a structural gating constraint, LoMC increases correction capacity without expanding the intervention scope. Experiments on text-only and multimodal safety benchmarks across four routed backbones show that LoMC substantially improves non-refusal target-response behavior while maintaining general capability under a compact intervention footprint.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 现有的宽方向编辑可能扰动通用计算，而仅支持专家编辑缺乏足够容量来纠正异质拒绝表示，因此需要一种既能增加修正容量又不扩大干预范围的方法。
Method: LoMC是一种支持门控干预框架，包含三个步骤：1) 识别紧凑编辑支持；2) 将原型修正方向聚合为逐层修正方向；3) 仅在选定支持内应用秩一逐层修正，利用编辑支持作为结构门控约束。
Result: 在四个路由骨干网络上的纯文本和多模态安全基准实验中，LoMC显著提高了非拒绝目标响应行为，同时在紧凑干预范围内维持了通用能力。
Conclusion: LoMC通过支持门控结构实现了在不扩大干预范围的前提下增加修正容量，有效抑制拒绝行为，适用于路由基础模型的安全对齐。

papers.title: Orchestra-o1: Omnimodal Agent Orchestration
papers.abstract_en: The recent success of agent swarms has shifted the paradigm of large language model (LLM)-based agents from single-agent workflows to multi-agent systems, highlighting the importance of agent orchestration for task decomposition and collaboration. However, existing orchestration frameworks are limited to a narrow set of modalities and struggle to generalize to more complex settings where heterogeneous modalities coexist and interact. This limitation becomes particularly pronounced in omnimodal scenarios, where tasks require the unified understanding and coordination of diverse inputs such as text, image, audio, and video. In this work, we propose Orchestra-o1, an omnimodal agent orchestration framework designed to support efficient agent collaboration across multiple modalities. Orchestra-o1 introduces a unified orchestration mechanism that enables modality-aware task decomposition, online sub-agent specialization, and parallel sub-task execution. This scalable design allows agent systems to effectively tackle complex real-world tasks involving heterogeneous information sources, surpassing the second-best approach by 10.3% accuracy on the OmniGAIA benchmark. Furthermore, we introduce decision-aligned group relative policy optimization (DA-GRPO), an efficient agentic reinforcement learning approach for training Orchestra-o1-8B, which also achieves state-of-the-art performance against all existing open-source omnimodal agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Orchestra-o1，一个全模态（omnimodal）代理编排框架，支持文本、图像、音频和视频等多种模态的协同任务分解与执行。框架引入统一编排机制、模态感知任务分解、在线子代理专门化和并行子任务执行，并在 OmniGAIA 基准上以 10.3% 的准确率优势超越第二名。同时提出决策对齐组相对策略优化（DA-GRPO）训练方法，使 Orchestra-o1-8B 在所有开源全模态代理中达到最优性能。
Motivation: 现有代理编排框架局限于少数模态，难以泛化到异构模态共存交互的复杂场景，尤其在全模态场景中缺乏统一理解和协调能力。
Method: Orchestra-o1 采用统一编排机制，实现模态感知的任务分解、在线子代理专门化以及并行子任务执行；并引入 DA-GRPO（一种高效的代理强化学习方法）训练模型。
Result: 在 OmniGAIA 基准上超越第二名方法 10.3% 准确率；Orchestra-o1-8B 在开源全模态代理中达到最优性能。
Conclusion: 该框架为多模态异构信息源的复杂现实任务提供了可扩展的代理协作方案，但摘要未提及局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HierSVA: A Data Synthesis Pipeline, Dataset, and Benchmark for LLM-Driven Hierarchical Hardware Formal Verification
papers.abstract_en: We present HierSVA, an integrated suite that combines a pipeline, dataset, and benchmark for LLM-driven hierarchical hardware formal verification. HierSVA-SP pairs an RTL preprocessing toolchain with an LLM-in-the-loop formal verification flow to produce reference SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) on hierarchical RTL. Applying it to BaseJump STL yields HierSVA-DS, a dataset of 342 modules, with hierarchy metadata and depths 0--9, accompanied by a deep subset of 28 module-bug pairs with natural-language specifications and bug variants. HierSVA-B decomposes assertion quality into six metric axes: syntax correctness, assertion proof success rate, vacuity, specification faithfulness, mutation coverage, and formal core coverage. Applying HierSVA-B to twelve recent LLMs reveals three findings. First, the module-level compile rate is 67.1\%; among generated assertions in evaluable runs, 82.1\% prove non-vacuously, but the corresponding assertion sets detect only 70.2\% of eligible injected faults and cover 36.2\% of the formal core. Second, on 211 evaluable model--module entries in the deep subset, assertion sets flag buggy RTL with 0.87 recall, but 40\% of predicted-buggy outcomes are false positives on correct RTL, limiting precision to 0.60. Third, agentic mode improves S1-style provability and strength metrics, but gains plateau and oscillate. Codes and artifacts are available at \href{https://github.com/HierSVAAnon/HierSVACodeAndArtifacts}{https://github.com/HierSVAAnon/HierSVACodeAndArtifacts}. Dataset is available at \href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/AnonymousHierSVA/HierSVA}{https://huggingface.co/datasets/AnonymousHierSVA/HierSVA}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HierSVA 是一个针对 LLM 驱动层次化硬件形式化验证的综合套件，包含数据合成流水线、数据集和基准测试。HierSVA-SP 流水线结合 RTL 预处理工具链和 LLM-in-the-loop 形式化验证流程，生成层次化 RTL 的参考 SystemVerilog 断言 (SVA)。在 BaseJump STL 上应用得到 HierSVA-DS 数据集，包含 342 个模块和 28 个深度子集模块-错误对。HierSVA-B 基准将断言质量分解为六个指标轴。对 12 个最新 LLM 的评测揭示了模块级编译率、断言证明成功率、错误检测率、形式化核心覆盖率等关键发现，并指出 agentic 模式在可证明性和强度指标上有提升但存在平台期和振荡。
Motivation: 现有硬件形式化验证中，层次化 RTL 的断言自动生成缺乏标准化流水线和高质量基准，难以系统评估 LLM 在此任务上的能力。
Method: 提出 HierSVA 套件：HierSVA-SP 流水线通过 RTL 预处理和 LLM 迭代生成 SVA；HierSVA-DS 数据集包含层次化模块及其规范、错误变体；HierSVA-B 基准从语法正确性、断言证明成功率、真空性、规范忠实性、变异覆盖率和形式化核心覆盖率六个维度评估断言质量。
Result: 在 12 个 LLM 上评测显示：模块级编译率 67.1%；可评估运行中 82.1% 断言非真空证明，但仅检测 70.2% 注入错误，形式化核心覆盖率为 36.2%；深度子集中断言集以 0.87 召回率标记错误 RTL，但精确率仅 0.60；agentic 模式改善可证明性等指标但收益有限。
Conclusion: HierSVA 提供了一个标准化工具链和基准，揭示了当前 LLM 在层次化硬件形式化验证中的性能瓶颈，尤其是低覆盖率和高误报率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Can Editing 1 Neuron Fix Repetition Loops in LLMs?
papers.abstract_en: Yes. Can it cure doom loops? Probably not. The Gemma 4 instruction-tuned models share a reproducible failure: on long factual enumeration prompts, such as listing every episode of a TV series, the 88 IAU constellations, or the 151 original Pokemon, they collapse into repetition, either a tight verbatim loop or a list whose entries decay onto a single answer. These loops occur at rates as high as 95% and survive prompt rewording, inference-engine changes, and most sampling adjustments. In this paper we explore whether this behavior is localized enough to remove by weight edits. To localize the cause, we use per-layer ablation and per-neuron attribution, then confirm the strongest candidates with full-generation sweeps. The loops trace to a small set of MLP neurons (or, in the 26B-A4B Mixture-of-Experts model, a few routed experts) which we suppress with static weight edits. These "surgeries" can be as small as a single sign-inverted neuron (in the E2B model). The size of the effective edits grows with model scale, but in all cases, the loop patterns can be addressed at normal generation budgets while preserving general-purpose benchmark scores. However, the edits do not solve everything: we also study longer thinking budgets, where the two larger models most visibly enter doom looping, i.e. a non-convergent regime in which the model self-corrects in circles over a fact it cannot recall, exhausting the budget without committing to a final answer. We show this residual failure is reduced but not eliminated by the same edits, and argue it is fundamentally a knowledge-precision problem rather than a removable circuit; weight surgery can delete a loop, but it cannot supply a missing fact. Our results are both a feasibility demonstration, that is, evidence that a concrete generation pathology can be localized to a few parameters and edited out, and a delineation of where that approach stops.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLM）在长事实枚举任务中出现的重复循环故障，发现该故障可追溯到少量MLP神经元或专家，通过静态权重编辑（如单神经元符号反转）即可修复，且不损害通用基准性能。但该方法无法解决因知识缺失导致的无法收敛的“doom loop”问题。
Motivation: 商业LLM（如Gemma 4）在需要列举多个事实的提示下（如列出所有星座）会以高达95%的概率陷入重复循环，且此故障对提示措辞、推理引擎和采样调整不敏感。需要找到一种轻量级修复方法。
Method: 通过逐层消融和逐神经元归因定位故障神经元，然后在全生成扫描中确认最强候选，最后对这些神经元或专家进行静态权重编辑（如符号反转或抑制）。
Result: 在多个规模模型上，小至单个神经元的编辑即可消除循环，编辑规模随模型规模增大，但所有编辑均不降低通用基准得分。然而，对于需要更长思考预算的任务中出现的“doom loop”（因缺失知识而自我纠错循环），编辑只能减少但不能消除。
Conclusion: 权重编辑可以定位并删除重复循环这类具体的生成病理，但不能替代缺失的知识，因此知识精度问题才是根本限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Position: AI Must Become Planet-Centered, Not Just Human-Centered
papers.abstract_en: This position paper argues that contemporary AI paradigms are insufficient for supporting complex global goals and introduces Planet-Centered AI (PCAI) as a design philosophy and research agenda that reorients AI toward planetary-scale socio-ecological systems and their long-term trajectories. A planet-centered approach is grounded in systems thinking, treating Earth as an interconnected whole of which humans are part. We diagnose recurring limitations across AI frameworks, many of which remain human-centered, and show why these become especially consequential under current planetary conditions characterized by systemic risk, non-stationarity, and deep uncertainty. We then articulate how PCAI reshapes the AI lifecycle, from problem formulation and model design to evaluation and deployment, by emphasizing alignment with global agendas, developing system-aware AI foundations, trajectory-oriented evaluation, and monitorability. Finally, we advance a falsifiable claim: AI systems optimized without explicit consideration of systemic consequences are more likely to exacerbate systemic instability than to mitigate it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，认为当前AI范式不足以应对复杂全球目标，提出以行星为中心的AI（Planet-Centered AI, PCAI）作为设计哲学和研究议程，将AI重新导向行星尺度社会-生态系统及其长期轨迹。PCAI基于系统思维，将地球视为一个互联整体，人类是其一部分。论文诊断了当前AI框架（多为人本中心）的局限性，并阐述了PCAI如何从问题定义、模型设计到评估部署重塑AI生命周期。最后提出可证伪主张：未显式考虑系统后果的AI系统更可能加剧系统不稳定。
Motivation: 现有AI范式多持人本中心视角，在面临系统性风险、非平稳性和深度不确定性的行星条件下，这些框架的局限性变得尤为突出，不足以支持复杂的全球目标。
Method: 提出行星中心AI（PCAI）作为设计哲学和研究议程，强调与全球议程对齐、开发系统感知AI基础、面向轨迹的评估和可监测性，从问题定义到部署全周期重塑AI。
Result: 论文本身为立场声明，未提供实验定量结果，但提出一个可证伪主张：未显式考虑系统后果的AI系统更可能加剧系统不稳定。
Conclusion: PCAI呼吁将AI目标从人本中心转向行星中心，以应对全球系统性风险；论文主要贡献在于提出研究议程和诊断现有不足，而非具体技术方案。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: History of the Muddy Children Puzzle
papers.abstract_en: The Muddy Children Puzzle is a puzzle about knowledge and ignorance that has been inspiring for the development of epistemic logic. Who came up with it first? This is unclear. We trace the origin of the Muddy Children Puzzle through logical and literary publications over the past two centuries. The puzzle inspired a numerous variations such as involving numbers or coloured hats. We also present a novel hats puzzle involving self-reference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文追溯了“泥孩子谜题（Muddy Children Puzzle）”在近两个世纪逻辑与文学出版物中的起源，并展示其多种变体（如涉及数字或彩色帽子），同时提出一个涉及自我指涉的新帽子谜题。
Motivation: 泥孩子谜题是认知逻辑发展的重要灵感来源，但其最早的提出者尚不明确，因此需要梳理其历史渊源。
Method: 通过回顾过去两个世纪的逻辑与文学出版物，追踪泥孩子谜题的起源，并列举其多种变体，最后提出一个自我指涉的新帽子谜题。
Result: 论文揭示了泥孩子谜题的历史演变，并呈现了一个新的自我指涉帽子谜题。
Conclusion: 泥孩子谜题具有丰富的变体，且其起源仍不明确；新提出的自我指涉谜题进一步扩展了这类谜题的范畴。

papers.title: C-MambaPose: A Physics-Informed Complex Mamba Framework for Cross-Environment WiFi Human Pose Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Human pose estimation (HPE) utilizing wireless WiFi signals has emerged as a promising technology owing to its device-free nature, privacy preservation, and robustness against occlusion and poor lighting. However, existing methods often overlook the physical complex phase information of WiFi signals and fail to generalize across diverse environments due to severe domain shifts. In this paper, we present C-MambaPose, a physics-informed complex-valued Mamba-GraFormer hybrid framework for robust cross-environment WiFi-based 3D HPE. Our framework first sanitizes raw WiFi Channel State Information (CSI) phase errors and constructs a phase-preserving complex-valued representation. We then employ a Spatiotemporal Complex Mamba encoder with a dynamic selective receptive field to capture fine-grained phase dynamics. A cross-attention joint-query mapper maps the unstructured sequence tokens to human joints, which are decoded by a Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) to predict anatomically coherent 3D coordinates. Extensive evaluations on the MM-Fi dataset show that C-MambaPose achieves competitive or superior performance to state-of-the-art baselines across all settings, setting a new state-of-the-art specifically on the challenging cross-environment split, requiring only 3.78 M parameters-an 83.1\% reduction compared to GraphPose-Fi~\cite{chen2026graph} and an 85.7\% reduction compared to MetaFi++~\cite{zhou2023metafi++}, while maintaining a comparable size to DT-Pose~\cite{chen2025towards} (which is only 18\% smaller) but achieving significantly superior performance without requiring any pretraining. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/phucngvinuni/cmampose.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 C-MambaPose，一种基于物理信息的复数域 Mamba-GraFormer 混合框架，用于跨环境 WiFi 人体姿态估计。该方法先对 WiFi CSI 相位误差进行校正并构建相位保持的复数表示，再使用时序复数 Mamba 编码器捕捉精细相位动态，最终通过 GCN 解码出 3D 人体关节坐标。在 MM-Fi 数据集上，该方法以 3.78M 参数在跨环境场景下达到 SOTA，参数比 GraphPose-Fi 减少 83.1%。
Motivation: 现有 WiFi 人体姿态估计方法忽视信号复数相位信息，且因域偏移难以泛化到新环境。
Method: 提出物理信息引导的复数域 Mamba-GraFormer 混合框架：先纠正 CSI 相位误差并构造复数表示，再通过时序复数 Mamba 编码器（动态选择性感受野）提取相位动态，最后用交叉注意力将序列映射到人体关节并由 GCN 解码。
Result: 在 MM-Fi 数据集上，C-MambaPose 在所有设置下达到竞争或更好性能，在跨环境拆分上取得 SOTA，仅需 3.78M 参数（比 GraphPose-Fi 减少 83.1%，比 MetaFi++ 减少 85.7%），无需预训练。
Conclusion: 该工作表明物理信息引导的复数域建模可有效提升 WiFi 姿态估计的跨环境泛化能力，且参数量显著降低。

papers.title: Active Inference for Adaptive Traffic Signal Control in Noisy Nonstationary IoT Environments
papers.abstract_en: Urban traffic signal control at IoT-instrumented intersections must remain effective under sensor occlusion, weather attenuation, and nonstationary demand. Conventional controllers degrade under these conditions, and learned policies remain difficult to audit. To address these challenges, we propose an active inference controller for a four-arm signalized intersection that dynamically selects phases by minimizing expected free energy (EFE) over Gaussian beliefs about per-direction congestion levels, yielding a fully traceable decision pipeline. We benchmark the controller in a SUMO traffic simulator against a rule-based heuristic and a deep Q-network (DQN) across four scenarios that progressively increase noise and nonstationarity, spanning sensor occlusion, adverse weather, and stochastic accidents. Across 100 independent random evaluations per scenario, active inference attains the lowest idle times and CO2 emissions in the noisiest scenarios (56,977 s and 29.12 kg vs. 71,741 s and 30.56 kg for DQN). These gains come at a modest cost in bus priority service rate and phase switch frequency.
papers.comment: Submitted to IEEE 12th World Forum on Internet of Things (WF-IoT) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于主动推理（active inference）的自适应交通信号控制方法，在噪声和非平稳物联网环境中通过最小化预期自由能（EFE）动态选择相位。在SUMO模拟器中，主动推理在传感器遮挡、恶劣天气等场景下实现了最低的空闲时间和CO2排放，但公交优先服务率和相位切换频率略有下降。
Motivation: 传统交通信号控制器在传感器遮挡、天气衰减和非平稳需求下性能退化，而学习策略难以审计。需要一种可追踪且鲁棒的控制方法。
Method: 提出主动推理控制器，对每个方向拥堵水平建立高斯信念，通过最小化预期自由能选择相位，形成完全可追踪的决策流水线。
Result: 在SUMO模拟的四个噪声和非平稳性递增场景中，主动推理在最嘈杂场景下取得最低空闲时间（56,977秒）和CO2排放（29.12 kg），优于深度Q网络（71,741秒和30.56 kg）。
Conclusion: 主动推理在噪声环境中表现出鲁棒性，但以牺牲公交优先服务和相位切换频率为代价。方法具有可解释性，适合IoT环境。

papers.title: AGORA: Can Deliberation and Governance Gates Absorb Participation Bias in Transit Planning?
papers.abstract_en: Transit network design depends not only on the optimization algorithm but also on who shows up to the public hearing. Current practice often collects one-directional comments from self-selected attendees, leaving participant mix as an uncontrolled source of outcome variation. We present AGORA, a framework that holds the network, demand, and solver fixed while systematically varying meeting composition through stakeholder agents, structured deliberation, and governance gates. Across two standard benchmark networks at different scales, we find that (i) aggregate outcomes vary little across compositions, but on tail risk and fairness disparity, representative sampling still tends to outperform skewed compositions; (ii) without deliberation, composition produces no variation at all, showing that deliberation is the mechanism through which who attends affects outcomes; and (iii) governance gates compress cross-profile variance without shifting the average outcome on Mandl, but low acceptance on Mumford0 shows thresholds require instance-specific calibration. These findings reframe participation bias from an uncontrollable input to a process-design problem: even without guaranteed representative attendance, well-structured deliberation and governance criteria can substantially reduce how much outcomes depend on who is in the room.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AGORA框架，在固定交通网络、需求和求解器的条件下，通过利益相关者代理、结构化讨论和治理门系统性地变化会议组成，研究参与偏差对公交网络设计结果的影响。实验表明：聚合结果变化不大，但偏斜组成会恶化尾部风险和公平性；讨论是参与影响结果的关键机制；治理门可压缩结果方差，但阈值需实例校准。该研究将参与偏差重新定义为过程设计问题，而非不可控输入。
Motivation: 当前公交规划实践依赖自选参会者的单向意见，导致参会者构成成为结果变化的不可控源，缺乏对参与偏差的系统性理解和控制。
Method: 提出AGORA框架，保持网络、需求和求解器固定，通过代理、结构讨论和治理门系统改变会议组成，并在两个标准基准网络上测试。
Result: （i）聚合结果变化小，但代表性抽样在尾部风险和公平性上优于偏斜组成；（ii）无讨论时组成无影响，说明讨论是关键机制；（iii）治理门压缩方差但不改变Mandi平均结果，但Mumford0的低接受率表明阈值需实例校准。
Conclusion: 参与偏差应从不可控输入转化为过程设计问题：即使无法保证代表性参与，结构化讨论和治理门也能显著减少结果对参会者构成的依赖。

papers.title: Korzhinskii-Net: Physics-Informed Neural Network for Sub-Surface Mineral Prospectivity Modelling
papers.abstract_en: Mineral prospectivity modelling (MPM) underpins exploration economics, yet most operational pipelines reduce to data-driven classifiers trained on shallow surface proxies. Such models are blind to the subsurface physics that actually localises ore: heat advection, fluid flow, and lithology-dependent precipitation. We present Korzhinskii-Net, a 2-D radial physics-informed neural network (PINN) that couples Darcy flow, advective-diffusive heat transport, and a softplus-saturated reaction rate into a single differentiable forward model, weakly supervised by surface and remote-sensing proxies. The network is named after Dmitri S. Korzhinskii (1899-1985), whose theory of infiltration metasomatism provides the physical scaffold. We evaluate Korzhinskii-Net on five ore provinces spanning four commodity classes -- Norilsk (Ni-Cu-PGE), Pechenga (Ni-Cu sulphide), Udokan (sandstone-hosted Cu), Sukhoi Log (orogenic Au), and Mirny (kimberlitic diamond) -- under a fair, leakage-controlled 5-fold cross-validation protocol with hard ring-shaped negatives. Korzhinskii-Net attains a mean PR-AUC of 0.885 versus 0.281 for the strongest classical baseline (gradient boosting), and a mean fractional rank of 0.019 versus 0.413. The improvement is consistent across all five provinces and four commodity systems, suggesting that physics-informed differentiable simulators, even when constrained only by global open-data proxies, can recover localisation patterns that pure feature-based learners systematically miss. We release the full pipeline and evaluation harness as open source.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Korzhinskii-Net 是一种二维径向物理信息神经网络 (PINN)，用于地下矿物潜力建模 (MPM)，将 Darcy 流、平流-扩散热传输和反应速率耦合为单一可微正向模型，并受到地表和遥感代理的弱监督。在五个矿产省（Norilsk、Pechenga、Udokan、Sukhoi Log、Mirny）上，该模型的平均 PR-AUC 达到 0.885，远超梯度提升的 0.281，表明物理信息可微模拟器能够恢复纯特征学习器遗漏的定位模式。
Motivation: 现有矿物潜力建模方法大多基于地表代理的数据驱动分类器，忽略了控制矿化的地下物理过程（热对流、流体流动、岩性依赖的沉淀），因此性能受限。
Method: 提出二维径向 PINN，结合 Darcy 流、平流-扩散热传输和 softplus 饱和反应速率，利用地表和遥感代理弱监督进行训练，并采用硬环形负样本的五折交叉验证。
Result: 在五个矿产省上，Korzhinskii-Net 的平均 PR-AUC 为 0.885，平均分数排名为 0.019，而最强基线（梯度提升）分别为 0.281 和 0.413。改进在五个省份和四种矿产系统中一致。
Conclusion: 物理信息可微模拟器即使在仅有全局开放数据代理约束下，也能恢复纯特征学习者系统性地遗漏的定位模式。作者将完整 pipeline 和评估框架开源。
