papers.title: Efficient Temporal Modeling for Mobile Sleep Staging via Lightweight Random Attention
papers.abstract_en: Mobile sleep staging serves as a foundational infrastructure for in-home sleep monitoring and closed-loop modulation. But existing sequential models such as RNNs and Transformers are computationally expensive for mobile deployment. In this paper, we propose Random Attention (RA), a lightweight temporal modeling module based on fixed random projections, which replaces learnable sequence modeling with similarity-based aggregation. RA introduces little additional parameters beyond the epoch encoder while enabling effective temporal smoothing. We further provide a theoretical interpretation via the Random Attention Prior Kernel (RAPK), which decomposes RA into a global smoothing term and a feature similarity term, offering an interpretable view of temporal sleep structure. Experiments on Sleep-EDF-20 and Sleep-EDF-78 show that RA consistently improves epoch-wise baselines by 1-3\% in accuracy and F1 score, while achieving competitive performance compared with LSTM, GRU, and Transformer models. RA also demonstrates strong generalization across different backbone encoders and improved robustness over conventional temporal smoothing methods. These results indicate that efficient sleep staging can be achieved through lightweight similarity-based temporal aggregation, making RA suitable for real-time wearable applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出随机注意力（Random Attention, RA），一种基于固定随机投影的轻量级时序建模模块，用于移动睡眠分期。RA在epoch编码器之外引入极少量参数，通过相似性聚合实现时序平滑。实验在Sleep-EDF-20和Sleep-EDF-78数据集上显示，RA在准确率和F1分数上比逐epoch基线提升1-3%，性能与LSTM、GRU、Transformer相当，并具有良好的泛化性和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有RNN和Transformer等序列模型计算开销大，难以部署在移动设备上，需要更高效的时序建模方法。
Method: 提出随机注意力（RA），利用固定的随机投影进行相似性聚合，替代可学习的序列建模；并给出随机注意力先验核（RAPK）理论解释，将其分解为全局平滑项和特征相似项。
Result: 在Sleep-EDF-20和Sleep-EDF-78数据集上，RA使逐epoch基线准确率和F1提升1-3%，性能与LSTM、GRU、Transformer相当，且比传统时序平滑方法更鲁棒。
Conclusion: 轻量级相似性聚合的时序建模足以实现高效睡眠分期，RA适用于实时可穿戴应用。

summary_sections.method: 提出随机注意力（RA），利用固定的随机投影进行相似性聚合，替代可学习的序列建模；并给出随机注意力先验核（RAPK）理论解释，将其分解为全局平滑项和特征相似项。
summary_sections.result: 在Sleep-EDF-20和Sleep-EDF-78数据集上，RA使逐epoch基线准确率和F1提升1-3%，性能与LSTM、GRU、Transformer相当，且比传统时序平滑方法更鲁棒。
summary_sections.conclusion: 轻量级相似性聚合的时序建模足以实现高效睡眠分期，RA适用于实时可穿戴应用。

papers.title: Planning with the Views via Scene Self-Exploration
papers.abstract_en: Can VLMs predict how each camera move changes the view, and plan many such moves ahead? We call this capability view planning, requiring (1)understanding how a single action transforms the view, and (2)composing many such transformations across multi-turn plans to identify a target view. We probe both abilities in our proposed ViewSuite, a 3D point-cloud environment on real ScanNet scenes. Across 13 frontier VLMs, a critical planning gap emerges: they possess basic view-action knowledge but fail to compose it across multi-turn plans, with the gap widening as viewpoint distance grows. To close this gap, we propose an iterative framework that alternates self-exploration with view graph distillation. The key insight is that all exploration trajectories, regardless of their outcome, collectively form a view graph that compactly captures how viewpoints connect across a scene. Distilling this graph into diverse supervised tasks reshapes the policy distribution and overcomes the sparse rewards that stall pure RL. This improves Qwen2.5-VL-7B from 2.5% to 47.8% on interactive view planning, surpassing GPT-5.4 Pro (18.5%) and Gemini 3.1 Pro (21.4%). Self-exploration emerges as a promising path toward VLMs that can actively reason and plan in 3D space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型（VLM）是否能预测相机移动如何改变视角，并进行多步规划。提出ViewSuite基准测试，发现VLM具备基础视角动作知识但无法组合多步计划。提出迭代框架，交替自我探索和视图图蒸馏，将探索轨迹形成的视图图蒸馏为多样化监督任务，显著提升规划性能。
Motivation: 现有VLM在多步视图规划中存在关键规划差距，即具备基础视角动作知识但无法在长距离多步计划中组合使用。
Method: 提出迭代框架，交替进行自我探索（self-exploration）和视图图蒸馏（view graph distillation）。探索轨迹形成视图图，蒸馏为多样化的监督任务，重塑策略分布，克服纯RL的稀疏奖励问题。
Result: 在交互式视图规划任务上，Qwen2.5-VL-7B从2.5%提升至47.8%，超过GPT-5.4 Pro（18.5%）和Gemini 3.1 Pro（21.4%）。
Conclusion: 自我探索有望成为VLM在3D空间主动推理和规划的有效路径。

papers.title: Knowing When to Quit: A Principled Framework for Dynamic Abstention in LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: LLMs utilizing chain-of-thought reasoning often waste substantial compute by producing long, incorrect responses. Abstention can mitigate this by withholding outputs unlikely to be correct. While most abstention methods decide to withhold outputs before or after generation, dynamic mid-generation abstention considers early termination of unpromising reasoning traces at each token position. Prior work has explored empirical variants of this idea, but principled guidance for the abstention rule remains lacking. We present a formal analysis of dynamic abstention for LLMs, modeling abstention as an explicit action within a regularized reinforcement learning framework. An abstention reward parameter controls the trade-off between compute and information. We show that abstaining when the value function falls below this reward strictly outperforms natural baselines under general conditions. We further derive a principled and efficient method to approximate the value function. Empirical results on mathematical reasoning and toxicity avoidance tasks support our theory and demonstrate improved selective accuracy over existing methods.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea. PMLR 306, 2026. Copyright 2026 by the author(s)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型链式推理中计算浪费的问题，提出动态放弃（dynamic abstention）的形式化框架。将放弃建模为正则化强化学习中的显式动作，通过控制放弃奖励参数来权衡计算与信息。理论上证明当价值函数低于该奖励时放弃严格优于自然基线，并推导出高效的近似方法。在数学推理和毒性避免任务上的实验验证了理论，并显示比现有方法更高的选择性准确率。
Motivation: 现有放弃方法多在生成前或生成后决策，缺乏中间放弃的理论指导，导致不确定的推理路径消耗大量计算资源。
Method: 将动态放弃形式化为带正则化的强化学习框架，引入放弃奖励参数以控制计算-信息权衡，并推导出一种基于价值函数的放弃原则及高效近似方法。
Result: 在数学推理和毒性避免基准上，所提方法的选择性准确率优于现有动态放弃和静态放弃基线。
Conclusion: 论文强调该原则性框架可有效减少LLM推理中的浪费，为动态放弃提供理论保障，但局限尚未在更大规模模型或更多任务上验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An Agentic Retrieval Framework for Autonomous Context-Aware Data Quality Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Data quality assessment is a critical prerequisite for effective data analytics and data-driven decision-making, yet it remains a challenging task due to the inherently context-dependent nature of data quality. Existing approaches often rely on static rules or manual assessment strategies, limiting their adaptability to diverse usage scenarios and constraining automation at scale. Recent advances in artificial intelligence, particularly large language models, offer new opportunities for automating data quality assessment, but raise concerns related to reliability, grounding, and execution safety. In this paper, we propose a unified agentic-retrieval framework for autonomous context-aware data quality assessment. The framework interprets natural-language descriptions of intended data usage, derives context-aware assessment strategies, and generates executable validation logic through a multi-agent workflow. To ensure operational reliability, the framework introduces a feasibility validation stage that evaluates the realism and executability of generated assessment specifications before execution, enabling iterative refinement when necessary. Accepted validation logic is executed deterministically to guarantee reproducible and auditable results. We implement the proposed framework as an end-to-end prototype and evaluate it across multiple usage scenarios applied to the same dataset. The results demonstrate that assessment outcomes adapt meaningfully to different intended uses, while feasibility-gated execution reduces unrealistic or non-executable rule generation. The proposed approach provides a practical foundation for deploying autonomous yet controlled data quality assessment in modern data-driven environments.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 18 figures, Submitted to the International Journal of Intelligent Information and Database Systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于智能体检索的统一框架，用于自主上下文感知的数据质量评估。该框架通过多智能体工作流解析自然语言描述的数据使用意图，生成可执行的验证逻辑，并引入可行性验证阶段确保生成的规则真实可执行。实验表明，该方法能根据不同的使用场景调整评估结果，并减少不切实际的规则生成。
Motivation: 现有数据质量评估方法依赖静态规则或人工评估，难以适应多样化的使用场景和规模化自动化，而大语言模型虽提供新机会，但存在可靠性、接地性和执行安全性问题。
Method: 提出一个统一智能体检索框架：首先解析自然语言描述的数据使用意图，推导上下文感知的评估策略，通过多智能体工作流生成可执行验证逻辑；引入可行性验证阶段评估规则的现实性和可执行性，必要时迭代优化；通过确定性执行保证结果可重现和可审计。
Result: 在多个使用场景下对同一数据集评估，结果显示评估结果能根据不同的使用意图自适应调整，且可行性门控执行减少了不切实际或不可执行规则的生成。
Conclusion: 该框架为现代数据驱动环境中部署自主且可控的数据质量评估提供了实用基础，但摘要未明确提及局限性。

papers.title: GAGPO: Generalized Advantage Grouped Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has become a powerful paradigm for post-training large language model agents, yet credit assignment in multi-turn environments remains a challenge. Agents often receive sparse, trajectory-level rewards only at the end of an episode, making it difficult to determine which intermediate actions contributed to success or failure. As a result, propagating delayed outcomes back to individual decision steps without relying on costly auxiliary value models remains an open problem. We propose Generalized Advantage Grouped Policy Optimization (GAGPO), a critic-free reinforcement learning method for precise, step-aligned temporal credit assignment. GAGPO constructs a non-parametric grouped value proxy from sampled rollouts and uses it to compute TD/GAE-style temporal advantages, recursively propagating outcome supervision backward through time. Combined with group-wise advantage normalization and an action-level importance ratio, GAGPO extracts stable, localized optimization signals directly from multi-turn trajectories. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop show that GAGPO outperforms strong reinforcement learning baselines. Further analyses demonstrate faster early-stage learning, improved interaction efficiency, and smoother optimization dynamics, suggesting that GAGPO offers a simple yet effective framework for multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GAGPO，一种无需评论家（critic-free）的强化学习方法，用于多轮对话智能体的时序信用分配。它通过从采样轨迹构建非参数分组价值代理，并递归计算TD/GAE风格的优势，实现步骤级别的精确奖励回溯。在ALFWorld和WebShop环境中，GAGPO优于多个强基线，并展现出更快的早期学习速度和更平滑的优化动态。
Motivation: 在多轮智能体环境中，智能体通常只在回合结束时获得稀疏的轨迹级奖励，难以判断中间动作的贡献，而现有方法依赖昂贵的辅助价值模型。
Method: 提出GAGPO，利用采样轨迹构建非参数化的分组价值代理（grouped value proxy），借此计算TD/GAE风格的时序优势，将结果监督递归地沿时间步反向传播；同时结合组间优势归一化和动作级重要性比率，提取稳定且局部的优化信号。
Result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop实验中，GAGPO超越了多个强强化学习基线；进一步分析显示其早期学习更快、交互效率更高、优化动态更平滑。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，GAGPO为多轮智能体强化学习提供了一种简单而有效的框架，无需价值模型即可实现精确的时序信用分配。

papers.title: Sub-Token Routing for KV Cache Compression
papers.abstract_en: Sub-token routing provides a finer compression axis for transformer efficiency than the coarse units used in most prior work, such as tokens, pages, heads, or layers. In this paper, we study routing within a token representation itself in LoRA-adapted transformers. We consider two settings. In the query-independent setting, we combine routed subspace LoRA with value-group routing on the KV path for compression-aware language modeling. In the query-aware setting, we use a predictor-based selector to allocate a global retention budget over context-token/value-group pairs using query-conditioned relevance. Experiments show that the query-independent design improves language-model quality under reduced KV budgets, while the query-aware design preserves downstream behavior well under KV compression. We further show that sub-token routing is most effective as a complementary compression axis to token-level query-aware selection: token-level methods decide which tokens survive globally, while sub-token routing determines how the surviving tokens are compressed internally. Their combination enables deeper KV compression at nearly unchanged task accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在LoRA适配的Transformer中对token表示内部进行子token路由（sub-token routing），用于KV缓存压缩。提出了查询无关（query-independent）和查询感知（query-aware）两种路由设置。实验表明，查询无关设计在减少KV预算时提升了语言模型质量，查询感知设计在压缩下保持下游行为。子token路由可与token级查询感知选择互补，实现更深压缩且精度几乎不变。
Motivation: 现有工作使用粗粒度单元（token、页、头、层）进行压缩，本文研究在token表示内部更细粒度的子token路由，以提供更精细的压缩轴。
Method: 在LoRA适配的Transformer中，考虑两种设置：1）查询无关设置：结合路由子空间LoRA和KV路径上的值组路由进行压缩感知语言建模。2）查询感知设置：使用基于预测器的选择器，根据查询条件相关性为上下文token/值组对分配全局保留预算。
Result: 查询无关设计在减少KV预算下提升了语言模型质量；查询感知设计在KV压缩下很好地保持了下游行为。结合token级和子token级方法可在几乎不改变任务精度的情况下实现更深的KV压缩。
Conclusion: 子token路由作为token级查询感知选择的补充压缩轴，两者结合可实现更深压缩，且对任务精度影响极小。

papers.title: The Coin Flip Judge? Reliability and Bias in LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: LLM-as-a-Judge is now widely used to rank model outputs, train reward models, and populate public leaderboards, but its run-to-run reliability remains under-characterized. We study repeated identical evaluations on 29 tasks spanning 10 categories using two OpenAI judge models (GPT-4o-mini and GPT-4.1-mini), with 50 pairwise trials and 50 pointwise trials per question, supplemented by temperature and prompt-sensitivity ablations. Across judges, pairwise preferences flip on average 13.6% of the time, with 28% of questions exceeding a 20% flip rate and one question reaching 56%. GPT-4o-mini also exhibits a significant first-position bias (72% A-majority, p = 0.024). At the same time, mean pointwise score gaps are small (0.19--0.36 on a 10-point scale) and not statistically significant in aggregate, producing a pairwise--pointwise gap: judges frequently choose a winner even when their own scalar scores provide little evidence of a meaningful quality difference. Beyond within-judge instability, cross-judge agreement is only 76% ($κ= 0.51$), semantically equivalent prompt templates change majority outcomes in 25% of tested cases, and deterministic decoding reduces but does not eliminate inconsistency. A reliability curve analysis shows that, in our dataset, 11 repeated trials are needed for a majority vote to recover the 50-trial reference verdict with 95% probability on average, rising to 15 for high-variance questions. These findings suggest that single-trial LLM judging is often too noisy for high-stakes evaluation, and that multi-trial aggregation, position randomization, and explicit uncertainty reporting should be standard practice. Because both judges are from a single provider, cross-provider replication remains an important next step.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了LLM-as-a-Judge评估的可靠性，发现成对偏好平均有13.6%的翻转率，28%的问题翻转率超过20%，且GPT-4o-mini存在显著的首位位置偏差（72%偏向A）。点态评分差距虽小但不显著，导致成对与点态结果不一致。跨评判者一致性仅76%，提示模板改变可导致25%的多数结果变化。可靠性曲线分析表明，平均需要11次重复试验才能以95%概率恢复50次参考判决。
Motivation: LLM-as-a-Judge已被广泛用于模型输出排序、奖励模型训练和公开排行榜，但其运行间可靠性尚未被充分刻画。
Method: 在29个任务上使用两个OpenAI评判模型（GPT-4o-mini和GPT-4.1-mini），每问题执行50次成对和50次点态试验，辅以温度和提示敏感性消融，计算可靠性曲线。
Result: 成对偏好平均13.6%翻转，28%问题超过20%翻转率；GPT-4o-mini表现出72%的首位位置偏差；点态评分差距仅0.19-0.36但统计不显著；跨评判者一致性76%（κ=0.51）；确定性解码减少不一致但未消除。
Conclusion: 单次LLM评判在高风险评估中噪声过大，建议将多试验聚合、位置随机化和显式不确定性报告作为标准实践。

papers.title: Cross-Dataset Bloom Question Classification: Supervised Models and Prompted LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Automatic Bloom's taxonomy classification of assessment questions can substantially reduce instructor workload, but labeling is subjective and teacher-dependent. Prior machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) approaches reported strong within-dataset results, yet were rarely evaluated in cross-dataset settings, leaving real-world generalizability unclear; meanwhile, LLM effectiveness for Bloom question classification has not been systematically studied. We evaluated the cross-dataset generalization of existing ML/DL methods and assessed LLMs with multiple prompting strategies on five datasets; the best prompting strategy combined in-context examples with course-specific action verbs. Supervised ML/DL models degraded substantially on unseen datasets, whereas LLMs were more stable, suggesting a robust alternative across diverse educational contexts. Based on the best prompting strategy, we also presented a lightweight UI that supports instructors in automatically classifying large question banks; a usability study indicated low workload and high usability.
papers.comment: Accepted at AIED 2026. Abdolali Faraji and Mohammadreza Molavi contributed equally to this work
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文研究了跨数据集情境下Bloom分类问题的监督学习与LLM方法。在五个数据集上评估了现有ML/DL模型和多种提示策略的LLM，发现LLM在跨数据集时更稳定。基于最佳提示策略开发了轻量级UI，可用性测试显示低工作负荷和高可用性。
Motivation: 自动Bloom分类可减轻教师工作负担，但现有方法多限于单数据集评估，缺乏跨数据集泛化性研究；LLM在此任务上的系统性评估也尚属空白。
Method: 评估了监督ML/DL模型和多种LLM提示策略（包括上下文示例结合课程特定动词）在五个数据集上的跨数据集分类性能，并基于最佳策略构建了轻量级UI。
Result: 监督ML/DL模型在未见数据集上性能显著下降，而LLM更稳定；最佳提示策略结合上下文示例与课程特定动词；UI可用性测试报告低工作负荷和高可用性。
Conclusion: LLM作为跨教育场景的鲁棒分类替代方案优于监督方法，且可支撑实际工具开发。

papers.title: UP-NRPA: User Portrait based Nested Rollout Policy Adaptation for Planning with Large Language Models in Goal-oriented Dialogue Systems
papers.abstract_en: To address the challenge that current dialogue policy planning methods struggle to dynamically adapt to diverse user characteristics, this paper proposes a User Portrait based Nested Rollout Policy Adaptation (UP-NRPA) online framework with Large Language Models. In contrast to conventional approaches dependent on model training and require offline reinforcement learning policy models for user groups, UP-NRPA enables dynamic customization of dialogue strategies through an adaptive mechanism. This is achieved by leveraging real-time user feedback alongside personality, preferences, and objectives mapped from the current user portrait, thereby adapting to user characteristics without offline reinforcement learning. In collaborative and non-collaborative dialogue benchmarks, UP-NRPA demonstrated considerable benefits, achieving an impressive 100% success rate in multiple dialogue tasks. Particularly in negotiation tasks, the sale-to-list ratio (SL) increased by 56.41%. This demonstrates that UP-NRPA can adapt to diverse user needs without requiring a training mechanism, enabling the dialogue system to adapt to user characteristics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于用户画像的嵌套 rollout 策略自适应（UP-NRPA）在线框架，结合大语言模型，使对话系统能根据实时用户反馈和画像动态调整对话策略，无需离线强化学习。在协作与非协作对话基准上，该方法在多项对话任务中达到100%成功率，在谈判任务中销售比例提升56.41%。
Motivation: 现有对话策略规划方法难以动态适应不同用户特征，通常依赖离线强化学习模型，无法实时个性化调整。
Method: 提出 UP-NRPA 框架，利用大语言模型，通过实时用户反馈与当前用户画像中的个性、偏好和目标映射，动态定制对话策略，无需离线训练。
Result: 在协作和非协作对话基准上，UP-NRPA 在多个对话任务中取得100%成功率；谈判任务的销售-报价比例（SL）提升56.41%。
Conclusion: UP-NRPA 无需训练机制即可适应多样化用户需求，使对话系统能动态匹配用户特征。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Low-Burden LLM-Based Preference Learning: Personalizing Assistive Robots from Natural Language Feedback for Users with Paralysis
papers.abstract_en: Physically Assistive Robots (PARs) require personalized behaviors to ensure user safety and comfort. However, traditional preference learning methods, like exhaustive pairwise comparisons, cause severe physical and cognitive fatigue for users with profound motor impairments. To solve this, we propose a low-burden, offline framework that translates unstructured natural language feedback directly into deterministic robotic control policies. To safely bridge the gap between ambiguous human speech and robotic code, our pipeline uses Large Language Models (LLMs) grounded in the Occupational Therapy Practice Framework (OTPF). This clinical reasoning decodes subjective user reactions into explicit physical and psychological needs, which are then mapped into transparent decision trees. Before deployment, an automated "LLM-as-a-Judge" verifies the code's structural safety. We validated this system in a simulated meal preparation study with 10 adults with paralysis. Results show our natural language approach significantly reduces user workload compared to traditional baselines. Additionally, independent clinical experts confirmed the generated policies are safe and accurately reflect user preferences.
papers.comment: This work has been submitted to the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robot and Human Interactive Communication (ROMAN)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对严重运动功能障碍用户在使用物理辅助机器人（PAR）时，传统偏好学习方法（如成对比较）导致身心疲劳的问题，提出一种低负担的离线框架，将非结构化的自然语言反馈直接转化为确定性机器人控制策略。该框架利用大语言模型（LLM）结合职业治疗实践框架（OTPF）进行临床推理，将用户主观反应解码为物理和心理需求，并映射为透明的决策树。部署前通过自动化“LLM-as-a-Judge”验证代码结构安全性。在10名瘫痪成人的模拟备餐研究中，该方法显著降低了用户工作负荷，且独立临床专家确认生成策略安全并准确反映用户偏好。
Motivation: 传统偏好学习方法（如穷举成对比较）对严重运动障碍用户造成严重的身体和认知疲劳，需要一种低负担的偏好获取方式。
Method: 提出离线框架，使用LLM结合OTPF临床推理，将非结构化自然语言反馈解码为物理和心理需求，并转换为确定性决策树；部署前用LLM-as-a-Judge进行结构安全验证。
Result: 在10名瘫痪成人的模拟备餐研究中，自然语言方法相比传统基线显著降低用户工作负荷；独立临床专家确认策略安全且准确反映用户偏好。
Conclusion: 该框架能低负担地从自然语言反馈中学习个性化机器人行为，并保证安全性和偏好准确性。

papers.title: A Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL)-Based Transformer Method for Solving the Open Shop Scheduling Problem
papers.abstract_en: The open shop scheduling problem (OSSP) arises in many industrial and service settings but remains computationally challenging as the number of jobs and machines increases. While exact methods quickly become intractable, classical dispatching rules and metaheuristics may require substantial tuning to maintain solution quality at large scales. This study develops a Transformer-based scheduling policy for OSSP using an encoder-decoder architecture with multi-head attention. The model is trained on Taillard benchmark instances (4x4, 5x5, 7x7, and 10x10) using only the processing-time matrix as input and produces feasible schedules with makespans typically within 15-30% of best-known values. To evaluate scalability, the trained policy is applied without retraining to randomly generated instances from 40x40 to 100x100 and compared against classical dispatching heuristics, including SPT, LPT, MWKR, and EST. Across these large instances, the Transformer achieved average gaps of 12.89-15.12% relative to a standard lower bound. Compared with EST, the Transformer remained competitive, typically within a modest margin, while substantially outperforming SPT and LPT. These results indicate that a Transformer policy trained on small OSSP instances can generalize to substantially larger problems and provide a feature-light, learning-based alternative to classical dispatching rules.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于Transformer的编码器-解码器架构来解决开放车间调度问题(OSSP)。模型仅在Taillard小规模基准(4x4至10x10)上训练，使用处理时间矩阵作为输入，生成可行调度方案，其makespan通常接近已知最优值的15-30%以内。将训练好的策略直接应用于40x40至100x100的随机实例，与经典调度规则(SPT, LPT, MWKR, EST)比较，平均差距为12.89-15.12%。结果表明小规模训练的策略可以泛化到更大规模问题。
Motivation: 开放车间调度问题(OSSP)在大规模时计算困难，精确方法不可解，经典规则需要大量调参。本文旨在开发一种轻量级的基于学习的方法，可从小规模实例泛化到大规模问题，无需重新训练。
Method: 采用Transformer编码器-解码器架构，使用多头注意力机制，输入仅为处理时间矩阵，输出调度序列。通过深度强化学习(DRL)训练，在Taillard小规模基准上训练策略。
Result: 在Taillard小规模实例上，makespan通常达到最佳已知值的15-30%以内。在40x40至100x100随机实例上，平均差距为12.89-15.12%相对于标准下界；与EST竞争，优于SPT和LPT。
Conclusion: 该研究表明在小型OSSP实例上训练的Transformer策略可以泛化到显著更大的问题，提供了一种特征轻量的基于学习的替代方案。

papers.title: PERRY: Policy Evaluation with Confidence Intervals using Auxiliary Data
papers.abstract_en: Off-policy evaluation (OPE) methods aim to estimate the value of a new reinforcement learning (RL) policy prior to deployment. Recent advances have shown that leveraging auxiliary datasets, such as those synthesized by generative models, can improve the accuracy of these value estimates. Unfortunately, such auxiliary datasets may also be biased, and existing methods for using data augmentation for OPE in RL lack principled uncertainty quantification. In high stakes settings like healthcare, reliable uncertainty estimates are important for comparing policy value estimates. In this work, we propose two approaches to construct valid confidence intervals for OPE when using data augmentation. The first provides a confidence interval over the policy performance conditioned on a particular initial state $V^π(s_0)$-- such intervals are particularly important for human-centered applications. To do so we introduce a new conformal prediction method for high dimensional state MDPs. Second, we consider the more common task of estimating the average policy performance over many initial states; to do so we draw on ideas from doubly robust estimation and prediction powered inference. Across simulators spanning robotics, healthcare and inventory management, and a real healthcare dataset from MIMIC-IV, we find that our methods can use augmented data and still consistently produce intervals that cover the ground truth values, unlike previously proposed methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对强化学习中的离策略评估（OPE）提出两种构建置信区间的方法，允许使用辅助数据集（如生成模型合成的数据）来提高评估精度，同时提供有效的不确定性量化。第一种方法基于保形预测（conformal prediction）为给定初始状态下的策略价值提供置信区间；第二种方法结合双重稳健估计和预测驱动推断来估计平均策略性能。在机器人、医疗、库存管理模拟器以及MIMIC-IV真实医疗数据集上，所提方法能够一致地生成覆盖真实值的区间，而现有方法则不能。
Motivation: 现有使用数据增强进行OPE的方法缺乏原理性的不确定性量化，而在医疗等高风险场景中，可靠的置信区间对于比较策略价值至关重要。
Method: 提出两种方法：1）基于保形预测为高维状态MDP下的条件价值 V^π(s_0) 构建置信区间；2）基于双重稳健估计和预测驱动推断为平均策略性能构建置信区间。
Result: 在机器人、医疗、库存管理模拟器及MIMIC-IV真实医疗数据集上，所提方法能一致产生覆盖真实值的区间，而对比的现有方法则无法做到。
Conclusion: 本文展示了如何利用辅助数据构建有效的OPE置信区间，为高风险场景中的可靠策略评估提供了工具。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有使用数据增强进行OPE的方法缺乏原理性的不确定性量化，而在医疗等高风险场景中，可靠的置信区间对于比较策略价值至关重要。
summary_sections.method: 提出两种方法：1）基于保形预测为高维状态MDP下的条件价值 V^π(s_0) 构建置信区间；2）基于双重稳健估计和预测驱动推断为平均策略性能构建置信区间。
summary_sections.result: 在机器人、医疗、库存管理模拟器及MIMIC-IV真实医疗数据集上，所提方法能一致产生覆盖真实值的区间，而对比的现有方法则无法做到。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文展示了如何利用辅助数据构建有效的OPE置信区间，为高风险场景中的可靠策略评估提供了工具。

papers.title: Application of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Libraries: A Systematic Review
papers.abstract_en: As the concept and implementation of cutting-edge technologies like artificial intelligence and machine learning has become relevant, academics, researchers and information professionals involve research in this area. The objective of this systematic literature review is to provide a synthesis of empirical studies exploring application of artificial intelligence and machine learning in libraries. To achieve the objectives of the study, a systematic literature review was conducted based on the original guidelines proposed by Kitchenham et al. (2009). Data was collected from Web of Science, Scopus, LISA and LISTA databases. Following the rigorous/ established selection process, a total of thirty-two articles were finally selected, reviewed and analyzed to summarize on the application of AI and ML domain and techniques which are most often used in libraries. Findings show that the current state of the AI and ML research that is relevant with the LIS domain mainly focuses on theoretical works. However, some researchers also emphasized on implementation projects or case studies. This study will provide a panoramic view of AI and ML in libraries for researchers, practitioners and educators for furthering the more technology-oriented approaches, and anticipating future innovation pathways.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对人工智能和机器学习在图书馆中的应用进行了系统综述，遵循Kitchenham等人的指南，从多个数据库筛选出32篇实证研究。分析表明当前研究以理论工作为主，但也包含部分实施项目或案例研究，旨在为研究者、实践者和教育者提供该领域的全景视图。
Motivation: 随着AI/ML技术逐渐渗透到图书馆领域，需要对现有实证研究进行系统梳理，以了解当前研究状态、常用技术及其应用方向。
Method: 采用Kitchenham等人提出的系统综述方法，从Web of Science、Scopus、LISA和LISTA数据库中收集文献，经过严格筛选最终纳入32篇论文进行综合分析。
Result: 研究发现图书馆领域的AI/ML研究主要集中在理论工作，同时也有一些实施项目或案例研究，但缺乏大规模实践。
Conclusion: 本研究为图书馆中的AI/ML应用提供了系统性概览，有助于推动技术导向的研究和未来创新路径的探索。
